jobs.title: Software Development Engineer - GPU Interconnects and Ethernet AI
jobs.description: Overview: **ADVANCE YOUR CAREER. ADVANCE THE WORLD.** At AMD, we believe technology has the power to solve the world’s most important challenges. From advancing healthcare and scientific discovery to powering AI and the technologies people rely on every day, innovation at AMD is shaping the future. Whether you’re designing next\-gen processors, enabling AI breakthroughs, or bringing leading edge products to market, every role at AMD contributes to something bigger — technology that moves the world forward. Join us and, together, we’ll advance your career. Responsibilities: **THE ROLE:** AMD is looking for AI Networking Systems Software Engineer to drive the design, development and bring\-up of networking software for GPU scale\-up interconnects and Ethernet\-based AI fabrics. You will be a senior technical contributor in a core team of industry specialists, working with the latest GPU, NIC, switch and rack\-scale technology. In this role, you will lead the design, development, optimization and bring\-up of networking software across the driver, firmware and systems software layers for AMD Helios rack\-scale deployments, with a primary focus on Ethernet\-based scale\-up GPU interconnect and scale\-out networking. You will work across silicon, hardware, firmware, driver, switch software and architecture teams to deliver high\-performance, low\-latency and resilient networking for next\-generation AI infrastructure. **THE PERSON:** The ideal candidate is a senior software engineer with deep experience across networking, switches and GPU interconnects, who can own complex technical areas end to end and drive difficult cross\-team issues to resolution. You communicate clearly with architecture, hardware, firmware and software teams, and provide technical direction and mentorship to other engineers. You have hands\-on experience spanning device drivers, embedded firmware and systems software, and are comfortable debugging problems that cross silicon, firmware, driver, switch and workload boundaries. You work well in ambiguous, fast\-moving environments and are motivated by end\-to\-end system challenges in rack\-scale AI platforms. **KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:** * Lead the design and development of networking software for GPU scale\-up interconnect and Ethernet\-based AI fabrics on AMD Helios rack\-scale systems * Develop and optimize Linux kernel drivers, embedded firmware and user\-space software for GPU interconnect, NIC and switch subsystems * Drive hardware and software bring\-up of new ASICs and platforms, including SerDes and link initialization, Ethernet MAC/PCS/FEC configuration, topology discovery and validation * Work with switch software teams on switch configuration, forwarding, QoS, telemetry and fabric management for scale\-up and scale\-out topologies * Define firmware, driver and management interfaces and control\-plane protocols between GPUs, switches and fabric management software * Analyze end\-to\-end network performance, latency, bandwidth utilization, congestion behavior and communication efficiency across multi\-node and rack\-scale deployments * Develop tools, diagnostics and telemetry frameworks to monitor link and fabric health, identify bottlenecks and accelerate root cause analysis * Investigate and resolve issues across the stack, including GPU interconnect, NICs, switches, transport layers, firmware, drivers, collective communication libraries and distributed runtimes * Contribute to resiliency, RAS, serviceability and deployment readiness features for large\-scale clusters * Support performance characterization of collective operations and distributed training and inference workloads over scale\-up and scale\-out fabrics * Partner with internal and external teams, including switch and platform vendors, to validate interoperability and optimize AI workload performance on AMD platforms * Help define software requirements and influence future GPU, interconnect, switch and system architecture * Provide technical leadership through design and code reviews, and mentor engineers across the team **PREFERRED EXPERIENCE:** * Years of experience in networking, systems software, driver or firmware development * Strong C/C\+\+ programming skills with a keen attention to code quality; Python or Go for tooling is a plus * Linux kernel driver development experience, including PCIe devices, DMA, interrupts and memory management * Embedded firmware development experience on microcontrollers or SoC management processors, including RTOS or bare\-metal environments * Strong knowledge of Ethernet (MAC, PCS, FEC, SerDes, link training and auto\-negotiation) and high\-speed link bring\-up * Experience with GPU interconnect or scale\-up fabric technologies such as UALink, Infinity Fabric/xGMI, NVLink or Ethernet\-based scale\-up * Strong Ethernet networking experience, including L2 switching and bridging, VLANs, MAC learning, LLDP, link aggregation, L3 forwarding, and QoS (PFC, ETS, ECN, buffer and queue management) * Experience with datacenter switch software such as SONiC, SAI or switch ASIC SDKs * Experience with network protocols and transports such as RDMA, RoCE, InfiniBand, TCP/IP or related high\-performance transport technologies * Familiarity with scale\-up and scale\-out architectures in AI or large distributed computing environments * Experience debugging complex multi\-node system issues involving hardware, firmware, drivers, switches and application workloads * Experience with performance analysis, profiling, tracing and observability tools used for system and network performance tuning * Experience with ASIC, GPU, NIC or switch bring\-up is highly desirable * Knowledge of reliability, availability and serviceability considerations in rack\-scale or datacenter deployments is a plus * Experience with software development processes and tools such as debuggers and source code control * Effective communication and problem\-solving skills, with a proven ability to lead technical work across architecture, hardware, firmware, software and validation teams **ACADEMIC CREDENTIALS:** * Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or equivalent **LOCATION:** Santa Clara, CA **This role is not eligible for visa sponsorship.** \#LI\-NP1 Qualifications: *Benefits offered are described:* AMD benefits at a glance. *AMD does not accept unsolicited resumes from headhunters, recruitment agencies, or fee\-based recruitment services. AMD and its subsidiaries are equal opportunity, inclusive employers and will consider all applicants without regard to age, ancestry, color, marital status, medical condition, mental or physical disability, national origin, race, religion, political and/or third\-party affiliation, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. jobs.title: Manufacturing Engineer
jobs.description: **About Us** American Shizuki Corporation is a leading manufacturer of specialized film capacitors with a deep history in Ogallala, Nebraska. We design and build precision capacitors tailored to demanding customer applications across industrial, medical, and renewable sectors. We are expanding our engineering team to help optimize our production lines while keeping them safe, lean, and highly reliable. **The Role** We’re looking for a hands\-on Manufacturing Engineer who genuinely enjoys making production better. You won’t be buried in paperwork behind a desk all day—you’ll lead Kaizen events, eliminate waste, and drive line efficiency right on the production floor where you can see the impact of your work. In this role, you will work side\-by\-side with associates, machine operators, production supervisors, quality, and design engineering to turn practical continuous improvement ideas into standard plant reality. **What You’ll Do** * Lead production\-floor Kaizen events and targeted continuous improvement projects. * Drive measurable improvements in throughput, scrap reduction, first\-pass yield, changeover time (SMED), and OEE. * Establish and sustain robust standard work instructions and visual management on the line. * Lead structured root\-cause analysis (5\-Why, Fishbone, 8D) to solve recurring quality and downtime headaches. * Design and implement simple fixtures, tooling improvements, and workstation ergonomics to improve operator efficiency. * Track, verify, and communicate baseline vs. post\-implementation project metrics. **What We’re Looking For** * Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical, Manufacturing, Industrial Engineering, or a related technical discipline. * 2–5 years of hands\-on manufacturing engineering experience in a production environment. * Demonstrated experience facilitating Kaizen events and applying Lean tools with measurable floor results. * Demonstrate ASC Core Values: Accountability, Courage, Curious Intelligence, Discipline, Empathy, and Mobility. * Strong interpersonal skills—comfortable listening to, learning from, and collaborating directly with associates, machine operators, and line leads. * Basic proficiency with 3D CAD software (SolidWorks, Inventor, etc.) for fixture/tooling design. * Ability to work an early production schedule (Monday – Thursday, 5:00 AM – 3:30 PM). Nice to have: Lean or Six Sigma Green Belt certification, or experience in electronics assembly, precision winding, or automated equipment. **Why Join American Shizuki?** * 4\-Day Work Week: Work Monday through Thursday (5:00 AM – 3:30 PM) and enjoy every Friday, Saturday, and Sunday off. * Real Ownership: Direct autonomy to lead projects from concept to floor implementation without excessive corporate red tape. * High Visibility: A close\-knit, collaborative engineering team where your wins make a clear difference to the business. * Relocation Package: $5,000 relocation stipend to support your move to Keith County. * Community: Enjoy a low cost of living, zero commute stress, and outdoor recreation right next door to Lake McConaughy. * Benefits: Health, dental, and vision insurance; 401(k) with company match; and paid time off (PTO). **Application Requirement: To be considered, please include a brief note in your application or cover letter describing one specific improvement project you personally led on a production floor, the challenge you faced, and the measurable result.** American Shizuki Corporation is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States. Pay: $75,000\.00 \- $90,000\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) * 401(k) matching * Dental insurance * Flexible spending account * Health insurance * Life insurance * Paid time off * Professional development assistance * Referral program * Relocation assistance * Retirement plan * Tuition reimbursement * Vision insurance Application Question(s): * Describe one specific improvement project you personally led on a production floor, the challenge you faced, and the measurable result. Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Software Developer
jobs.description: **Where Banking Feels Like Belonging** At APGFCU, our values are at the heart of everything we do, empowering us as leaders in the credit union movement. We prioritize purpose and connection in how we serve our members, co\-workers and communities \- helping to navigate life's little and big moments. **Who we are:** As a member\-owned, not\-for\-profit credit union, APG Federal Credit Union (APGFCU®) empowers our members with financial products and services to support them at every stage of their financial lives, helping them become money smart and financially independent. We proudly serve people in: * Harford County * Cecil County * Baltimore County * Baltimore City We believe banking should feel personal, supportive, and human. That goes for our members and our employees. Here, you’re not just filling a role — you’re making a difference in your community. Our team lifts each other up and our leaders invest in your growth. We celebrate wins, recognize and value contributions, and support each other through challenges. We strive for meaningful connections across our teams, because that’s what belonging is all about. Let’s build something meaningful together. **Role Summary:** APGFCU is seeking an innovative and member\-focused Software Developer to help build the future of digital banking and digital member\-facing solutions. This role will design, develop, integrate, and maintain digital solutions that create seamless, secure, and intuitive experiences across online / mobile banking, digital onboarding, Online Account Opening/Online Loan Portal, payments, and emerging digital channels including cutting\-edge fintech solutions. Our goal is to be in the top quartile for member experience of credit unions by consistently offering the right features in an intuitive and easy to use experience, as well as incorporating a human touch when it is right. The ideal candidate combines strong full\-stack development expertise with a passion for user experience, modern fintech integrations, and agile software delivery. This individual will partner closely with Digital Experience, Product Owners, Operations, Lending, Marketing, and third\-party vendors to transform business requirements and user stories into scalable digital solutions that improve member engagement, self\-service adoption, and operational efficiency. This work will be accomplished through a highly collaborative partnership model, empowering the Developer to serve as a strategic partner who actively shapes solutions that align business objectives with member needs, rather than functioning solely as a recipient of requirements. **Key Responsibilities:** * Software Development (50%): + **Application Development \& Engineering:** Design, develop, prototype, test, deploy, and maintain consumer\-facing and business\-facing digital banking applications, including responsive web and mobile experiences, scalable backend services, APIs, middleware integrations, and reusable components across digital channels. + **Digital Banking Platform Support:** Create technical solutions that support online banking, mobile banking, account opening, lending, payments, financial wellness, chatbots, self\-service, personalization, virtual branch (chat and video), and AI\-driven member experiences. + **Architecture, Scalability, and SDK Solutions:** Design solutions with a focus on long\-term architecture, scalability, maintainability, and future readiness across digital banking channels. This includes implementing SDK solutions when appropriate and working with APIs and middleware to support secure, flexible integrations. Work closely with IT infrastructure, cloud, and application SMEs to develop solutions in accordance with established best practices and existing standards. + **API \& Integration Development:** Design and support RESTful APIs, event\-driven integrations, and secure data exchange mechanisms that connect core banking systems, digital banking platforms, loan origination systems, account opening platforms, payment providers, fraud and security systems, CRM solutions, data platforms, and data warehouses. The Developer may also be asked to evaluate the technical aspects of various vendors during evaluations. + **Security, Compliance \& Quality:** Follow secure software development lifecycle practices, ensure solutions comply with financial services regulations and internal security standards, leverage secrets management, CI/CD pipelines, automated actions, conduct code reviews, unit testing, load testing, regression testing, and vulnerability remediation. Support audits, penetration testing, and compliance initiatives as required. * Digital Innovation \& Collaboration (25%): + **Product \& Digital Experience Partnership:** Participate in Agile ceremonies and sprint planning, collaborate with Product Owners to transform member needs, create UI/UX mockups, wireframes, research findings, journey maps, and user stories into working digital solutions, and partner with Digi olders; strong problem\-solving and analytical capabilities; excellent collaboration and relationship\-building skills; ability to work independently while managing multiple priorities; passion for creating exceptional member experiences; and commitment to continuous learning and innovation. * **Preferred Certifications:** Microsoft Azure Developer Associate, AWS Certified Developer, Certified Scrum Developer (CSD), Certified Kubernetes Application Developer (CKAD), CompTIA Security\+, Certified Secure Software Lifecycle Professional (CSSLP), and Certified API Security Professional (CAPS). **What Success Looks Like:** ---------------------------- * **Increases Digital Feature Adoption:** Builds solutions that make it easier for members to use digital banking features and complete tasks through self\-service channels. * **Strong Communication:** The ability to convey technical information in a simple way. * **Maintains System Uptime and Reliability:** Supports stable, available, and high\-performing digital experiences across online banking, mobile banking, account opening, lending, payments, and related platforms. * **Delivers Against Sprint Commitments:** Completes high\-quality work in alignment with Agile delivery expectations, sprint goals, release plans, and business priorities. * **Improves Digital Member Satisfaction:** Contributes to digital experiences that improve satisfaction scores, reduce member friction, and lower support call volume. Push APGFCU to the top quartile in overall satisfaction, net promoter score and member effort score. * **Delivers High\-Quality Integrations:** Creates secure, scalable, and maintainable integrations with core systems, digital banking platforms, fintech providers, payment networks, CRM solutions, and data platforms. * **Improves Release Effectiveness:** Supports faster, safer, and more reliable deployment practices through DevOps understanding, CI/CD support, documentation, and testing discipline. * **Maintains Security and Compliance Performance:** Follows secure development practices, supports audits and testing, remediates vulnerabilities, and ensures solutions align with financial services regulations and internal security standards. * **Creates Meaningful Member Engagement:** Delivers solutions that improve engagement, strengthen self\-service capabilities, and create value for members, employees, and APGFCU. This included measures such as active users and average logins per month. **Compensation:** $103,000 \- $175,200 annually Offers are based on experience and education. APGFCU provides comprehensive benefits such as medical and dental (shared expense), vision, 401(k), life and disability insurance, flexible spending account, employee assistance program, referral program, educational assistance, holidays, annual leave and sick leave. **Equal Opportunity Employer:** ***APGFCU is proud to be an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. We are committed to creating a workplace where everyone feels welcome and supported. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, or any other protected status under applicable federal, state, or local law. If an accommodation is needed during the hiring process, please email*** ***HR@apgfcu.com******.*** ***Employment with APGFCU is at\-will, meaning that either you or APGFCU may terminate the employment relationship at any time, with or without cause or notice.*** APGFCU participates in E\-Verify and will provide the federal government with your Form I\-9 information to confirm that you are authorized to work in the U.S. You can view the details by clicking here or returning to the careers homepage. lead customer acceptance tests alongside program management. * Ensure what is tested in Decatur is what the customer sees on their floor. **Drive Continuous Improvement** * Champion design reuse, standard components, templates, and configurable platforms to reduce rework and accelerate delivery. * Introduce design automation and checking tools that catch errors before release. * Run post\-project reviews on significant programs so lessons learned become standards. * Trace design\-related rework and change orders to root cause and close the loop with engineering teams. * Working directly with Sales, Application and Estimating, as needed. * Working directly with CPT (Core Products Team) on automation design support. **QUALIFICATIONS** * Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Controls Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a closely related field. * 5\+ years of controls or automation engineering experience; If you align with our core values—Stay Curious, Have Empathy, and Be Accountable—and are ready to make a significant impact, we encourage you to apply. **Your Role:** We are seeking an AI Security Engineer to own the technical security controls for how Alpaca uses AI. The scope includes identity for AI agents and automations, security requirements for AI tools and integrations, guardrails, and security logging. You will also assist in developing AI\-powered security tooling. You will keep those controls consistent as AI adoption grows, and you will work with the teams building with AI so security is part of the design. This role reports to the Enterprise Security Architect and works closely with AI Enablement, Engineering, DevOps, GRC, and the wider Security team. The Security Team is 100% distributed and remote. **Things You Get To Do:** The core responsibilities of the AI Security Engineer are focused on AI access controls, secure AI platforms, guardrails, visibility into AI usage, and AI\-powered security tooling. ### **AI Identity and Access Controls:** * **Agent Identity: Define how AI agents, bots, and automations authenticate, what they can access, and how their actions are attributed and audited.** * **Tool Access: Own security requirements for AI tool integrations, including least\-privilege access and credential handling.** * **AI Assistant Controls: Define and enforce security settings for approved AI tools, including data handling and access policy.** * **Least Privilege: Limit each agent and integration to the access it needs, and review that access when the integration changes.** ### **Secure AI Platform, Tooling, and Response:** * **Security Requirements: Define security requirements for internal AI applications, including identity, data handling, secrets, and review of new integrations.** * **Guardrails: Design and implement guardrails for AI applications and agents.** * **Design Reviews: Review new AI applications and integrations for security risks, and give builders clear, practical requirements.** * **Security Tooling: Assist Security Operations in developing AI\-powered tooling that supports detection, jobs.title: Senior Architectural Millwork Engineer

In this role, you will translate architectural plans, design concepts, and field measurements into accurate, production\-ready drawings and engineering packages. We are looking for someone with extensive experience in architectural millwork, custom cabinetry, and luxury residential interiors, along with advanced knowledge of CAD drafting, CNC manufacturing, materials, hardware, joinery, and fabrication processes. Responsibilities** * Lead the engineering and technical development of custom millwork projects from initial design through manufacturing and installation. * Prepare, review, and approve detailed shop drawings, fabrication drawings, bills of materials, cut lists, and production documentation. * Interpret architectural plans, design specifications, client requirements, and field measurements to develop accurate engineering packages. * Engineer custom cabinetry, closets, architectural casework, wall paneling, ceilings, countertops, and specialty woodwork. * Evaluate designs for manufacturability, material selection, hardware compatibility, joinery methods, and installation requirements. * Collaborate with our project managers, designers, estimators, CNC programmers, production personnel, and installation teams to ensure technical accuracy and project alignment. * Identify and resolve design conflicts, dimensional discrepancies, and fabrication challenges before engineering practices. * Support quality control throughout engineering, fabrication, and field installation. * Develop practical engineering solutions for complex custom millwork applications and challenging design requirements. * Identify opportunities to improve our engineering workflows, drawing standards, production processes, and overall manufacturing performance. * Coordinate engineering revisions and communicate technical changes to relevant project stakeholders. **Requirements** * 7\+ years of experience in architectural millwork engineering, millwork drafting, or technical design. * Extensive experience with custom cabinetry, luxury residential millwork, or high\-end architectural interiors. * Strong technical background in engineering custom casework, cabinetry, closets, wall systems, countertops, and specialty millwork. * Advanced ability to produce detailed, production\-ready shop drawings and fabrication documentation. * Thorough understanding of CNC manufacturing, woodworking machinery, fabrication methods, and production workflows. * Proficiency with millwork design and engineering software such as AutoCAD, Microvellum, Cabinet Vision, AlphaCAM, Rhino, KCD, or similar platforms. * In\-depth knowledge of millwork materials, hardware systems, joinery techniques, construction methods, and installation practices. * Ability to accurately interpret architectural drawings, construction documents, technical specifications, and field dimensions. * Experience working directly with manufacturing and installation teams to troubleshoot technical issues and improve constructability. * Previous experience mentoring engineers or drafters, leading technical teams, or overseeing engineering workflows is preferred. * Strong organizational, communication, analytical, and problem\-solving skills. * Ability to manage multiple projects and competing deadlines while maintaining accuracy and attention to detail. **Benefits** * Competitive salary of $110,000–$130,000, architectural millwork projects. * A senior\-level position with the opportunity to influence our engineering standards and manufacturing processes. * A collaborative, quality\-focused work jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description: **About Us** At Alteva RCM, we're dedicated to helping healthcare providers thrive through expert revenue cycle management, strategic insight, and innovative solutions. We're always looking for passionate, driven professionals who want to make a meaningful impact, grow their careers, and be part of a collaborative team committed to excellence. **About** **Alteva** **RCM** Alteva RCM is a healthcare revenue cycle management company that partners with medical practices and surgical centers nationwide. We help providers operate more efficiently, strengthen revenue cycle operations, and navigate the complexity of today's healthcare environment. We serve a wide range of specialties and operate at scale, with technology playing an important role in how we support clients and internal operations. **About the Role** We are growing our technology team and building new software that sits at the center of the medical billing process: eligibility checks, claim status, payer connectivity, document handling, and the internal tools our operations teams use every day. This is an early, hands\-on role on a team that is still taking shape, so the people we hire now will help set how we build. As a Senior Software Engineer, you will design, build, and support production microservices and integrations on our cloud\-native platform, which is primarily C\#/.NET on Azure today, with room for other languages and cloud platforms where they are the right fit. You will work closely with the Technical Lead, operations stakeholders, and a distributed team of internal and outsourced developers, and you will own your work from requirements through release and production support. We develop with AI\-assisted tools every day, primarily Claude Code. We are looking for engineers who use these tools to move faster while staying fully accountable for correctness, security, and maintainability. **What You'll Own** **Build \& Integrate** * Design, build, and maintain backend microservices and APIs, primarily in C\# and ASP.NET Core * Build integrations with payer APIs and portals, clearinghouses, eligibility services, and internal platforms such as Salesforce * Design relational data models and write well\-tuned SQL for high\-volume operational workflows * Turn ambiguous business workflows into clear technical designs, and push back when a requirement doesn't make sense * Use AI\-assisted development tools to accelerate implementation, testing, and refactoring, while reviewing every change for correctness and fit **Quality \& Reliability** * Participate in code reviews, giving and receiving direct feedback across internal and outsourced developers * Support releases, rollbacks, and post\-release validation in live environments * Improve logging, monitoring, observability, and documentation so the next person can understand and support what you built * Investigate and resolve production issues, using logs and monitoring to find root causes rather than symptoms **Team \& Delivery** * Work closely with the Technical Lead on design decisions, estimates, and priorities * Collaborate with operations, product, QA, and business stakeholders to understand how the work is actually done * Mentor and support other developers as the team grows * Surface blockers and risks early, and communicate clearly about tradeoffs **What We're Looking For** **Required** * 5\+ years of professional software engineering experience, with recent hands\-on work building backend services in C\#/.NET (ASP.NET Core) or an equivalent modern language and framework (for example, Java with Spring Boot, Go, or Node.js with TypeScript) * Experience building and supporting production backend services and REST APIs * Experience designing, building, and operating microservices, including service boundaries, inter\-service communication (REST and messaging), and independent deployment * Strong SQL and relational database skills (SQL Server or similar) * Hands\-on experience with Microsoft Azure or AWS (or an equivalent cloud platform) * Experience integrating with third\-party APIs, enterprise platforms, or data feeds * Solid testing habits, Git\-based workflows, and experience with code review * Comfort using AI\-assisted development tools, with the judgment to know when not to trust them * Clear communicator who can work with non\-technical stakeholders and explain technical tradeoffs accurately * Comfortable in a live environment where systems are still being built and not everything is defined **Preferred** * Background in healthcare, revenue cycle management, medical billing, or claims processing * Familiarity with healthcare data and transactions such as X12 EDI (270/271, 276/277, 835, 837\) or FHIR * Experience with payer connectivity, clearinghouses, or eligibility and claim status automation * Salesforce or other enterprise CRM integration experience * Experience with document processing, OCR, or intelligent data extraction * Event\-driven or message\-based architecture (for example, AMQP or RabbitMQ) * CI/CD with Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions, and observability with OpenTelemetry and a backend such as Application Insights * Front\-end experience (React or Angular) for internal tools * Experience working alongside outsourced or distributed development teams * Experience developing low\-level agentic AI orchestration, such as agents that perform work on internal systems **What This** **Isn't** This is not a ticket\-taking role. You will be expected to understand the business problem, question requirements, and own the outcome of what you ship. It is also not a frontend\-only or desktop role. Most of the work is backend microservices, integrations, and data on a modern, cloud\-native stack. **Location** Our office is in Richmond Hill, Queens, NY, and we prefer candidates who can work there on a hybrid basis. **Why Join** * Help build core technology for a growing healthcare company, with a short feedback loop between your work and real operational outcomes * Join early, as the technology team scales, and help shape engineering standards and practices * Work with modern tools, including AI\-assisted development as an everyday part of the job * Grow alongside experienced technical leadership, with room to take on more ownership over time **Alteva RCM \| Technology** **Benefits** Alteva RCM offers our employees a comprehensive benefits package, including health, dental, vision, employee assistance plan, paid family leave, short\-term disability and life insurance. We also provide a 401(k) plan with employer match, flexible spending accounts, employee discount program and an employee referral program. **Benefits** Alteva RCM offers our employees a comprehensive benefits package, including health, dental, vision, employee assistance plan, paid family leave, short\-term disability and life insurance. jobs.title: Chief Engineer, USMC Air Defense Programs
jobs.description: Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century's most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril's family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI\-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting\-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years. **ABOUT THE TEAM** ------------------ Anduril's Air Defense team develops, integrates, and fields autonomous systems that find, track, and defeat threats in the sky while keeping operators in control of engagement decisions. The team brings together Roadrunner, Sentry, Anvil, Pulsar, and Wisp with existing and third\-party sensors and effectors through Lattice, creating a software\-enabled family of systems for the modern battlespace. As control of the air becomes more contested, these networked capabilities give warfighters the awareness and response options needed to protect forces against rapidly evolving UAS threats. **ABOUT THE JOB** ----------------- Anduril runs two kinds of air defense programs for the U.S. Marine Corps. The first is a counter\-UAS program of record that defends Marine Corps installations in the U.S. and overseas. The second is organic counter\-UAS for the Marine maneuver force across dismounted, mounted, and expeditionary formations, where the Marine Corps is selecting systems now through competitive white papers, government demonstrations, and fly\-offs. As Chief Engineer, you're the single technical authority across both. You own the architecture and technical performance of everything Anduril delivers or proposes to the Marine Corps: our own sensors and effectors, the third\-party and government\-furnished systems we integrate, and the networks and command and control that connect them. The Marine Corps acquires these two kinds of capability in different ways. An installation is a sustained service, where uptime, configuration control, safety, and accreditation carry as much weight as the sensors. A Marine maneuver unit buys a system, takes it out of the box, and expects it to work without a software update in the field. That changes what counts as ready, how Anduril prices and sustains the system, and what we can responsibly promise. You keep the two models separate where they have to differ, and you build commonality across them where it holds up. You also decide what Anduril presents to the customer as ready. Each product team owns its own product, and you own the integrated answer: what we have, which fielded systems we could integrate, what a winning solution looks like for how Marines will use it, and what isn't mature enough to show a customer yet. **WHAT YOU'LL DO** ------------------ **Portfolio technical authority.** Serve as Chief Engineer for Air Defense's U.S. Marine Corps programs. Own system architecture, integration strategy, fielding readiness, and sustainment outcomes across the fielded installation program and the maneuver programs and pursuits. Set the technical baseline, chair design reviews, and make the technical decisions that keep schedule and engineering aligned. Exercise this authority across program engineers, product teams, and field teams who don't report to you. **Fielded baseline.** Maintain the engineering baseline for a fleet deployed across many sites as it transitions to a next\-generation sensor and compute configuration. Run engineering change and configuration management so hardware, software, and documentation agree at every site. Change the baseline when field evidence shows it's incomplete or wrong, and make the case for the investments the next delivery needs. **Maneuver architecture.** Turn Marine Corps operational concepts for dismounted, mounted, and expeditionary counter\-UAS into systems a Marine can carry, mount, or set up and trust. Design within size, weight, power, and transportability limits, and own integration onto vehicles and other platforms. Define interfaces to the command and control and effectors the Marine Corps already fields. Own the technical case through government demonstrations and fly\-offs. **Technical maturity.** Review what product teams and business development plan to show the customer before they show it. Give Anduril a clear account of what works today, what needs an engineering sprint, and what isn't ready, and hold customer commitments to what the engineering supports. **Field performance and recovery.** Define the verification and qualification approach, and make the call on whether a configuration is ready to ship or demonstrate. When a fielded site degrades, lead the recovery under time  g change experience on a program of record, including system safety and item identification requirements * Experience owning a system's technical case through a competitive government demonstration or fly\-off * Depth in one or more of: radar, passive RF detection and electronic warfare, electro\-optical and infrared sensors, effector integration, tactical networking, or air defense command and control * Experience fielding at overseas installations, including host\-nation spectrum and site approvals The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top\-tier benefits for full\-time employees, including: ### **Benefits** At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you're supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. *For more information,* *Explore Our Benefits**.* ### **Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams** Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information. To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind: * **No Financial Requests:** Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates. * **Please always verify communications:** + Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will *only* come from an @anduril.com address. + Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com. * **Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach:** If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links. * **What to Do If You Suspect Fraud:** Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts. ### **Data Privacy** To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant\-privacy\-notice/. By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third\-party service provider to conduct pre\-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. This third\-party service provider provides risk\-intelligence services that may include analysis of sanctions and watchlists, adverse media, public\-record information, and other lawful open\-source or commercial data sources. This third\-party service provider does not act as a consumer reporting agency. Use of this provider helps to ensure compliance with applicable laws and protect technology, intellectual property, and organizational security.

At Arup, you belong to an extraordinary collective – in which we encourage individuality to thrive. Our strength comes from how we respect, share and connect our diverse experiences, perspectives and ideas. This role serves as a critical interface between customers, field service, and engineering teams, leveraging Service Cloud and technical expertise to diagnose problems remotely, coordinate service execution, and drive customer satisfaction. This position emphasizes strong case management, technical troubleshooting, cross\-functional coordination, and continuous communication throughout the service support lifecycle. perform root\-cause analysis and implement corrective actions remotely or onsite when necessary. * Collect and analyze machine error codes and ensure proper documentation in Service Cloud. * Provide customers with technical guides and support materials where available. * Interpret schematics, engineering drawings, ladder logic, and equipment/component documentation to support customers and teams with troubleshooting technical issues and repairs. * Prepare and deliver service estimates to customers, including labor, travel, and materials as required. * Work with procurement teams to generate spare parts quotations (RFQs) in alignment with identified repair needs. * Accurately identify required spare parts and validate part selection based on technical assessment. * Support conversion of quotations into orders by coordinating with customers and internal stakeholders. * Maintain accurate and up\-to\-date case data in Service Cloud, including case description, type, and priority; customer contact details; machine information and location. * Document all troubleshooting activities, communications, and actions taken within the case in Service Cloud. * Ensure complete traceability and quality of service documentation. * Review and approve service reports to confirm quality, accuracy, and completeness. * Support implementation of remote software updates and system improvements. * Escalate complex technical issues to development or engineering teams for resolution. * Identify recurring technical issues and potential product quality concerns. * Communicate findings effectively to development and engineering teams to support continuous improvement initiatives. * Contribute to process improvements in service delivery, case handling, and documentation. * Maintain clear and proactive communication with all stakeholders, including Customers; Field Service Engineers; Schedulers; Supervisors and escalation teams. * Provide updates on mission and case progress, including escalations and resolution timelines. * Ensure professional and consistent customer experience aligned with company standards. * Promote service offerings, including digital tools such as Ascentialytics, where appropriate. * Support customers and after sales teams by identifying spare parts. * Become cross\-trained to support all other technologies within the Ascential portfolio. **Travel Requirements** * Up to 30% Travel domestically and internationally, overnights required. * Must maintain a valid drivers license. * Ability to obtain a passport. * Ability to rent vehicles. **Required Qualifications** * Solid technical foundation in Electromechanics and Mechatronics. Demonstrated knowledge of mechanical, electrical and control system concepts used in industrial automated machinery. * Experience with PLC and HMI platforms (I/Os, Allen Bradley or Siemens, additional platforms a plus). * Ability to interpret electrical schematics (AutoCAD, SolidWorks or EPLAN preferred). * Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with attention to detail. * Ability to effectively communicate with internal and external stakeholders using tact and professionalism. * Software: CRM systems, TeamViewer, Microsoft Teams, Microsoft Office; Word; Outlook; Excel and PowerPoint. **Preferred Qualifications** In addition to required qualifications: * Bachelor's degree in electrical engineering, Controls Engineering, Mechatronics, or related field experience. * Experience utilizing Service Cloud. (Salesforce) * Experience working in automotive test systems, industrial automation, or high precision machinery environments. * Working knowledge of industrial networking (ProfNet, RS232, Ethernet, CAN J1939\). * Experience working with various control and interface devices such as PWM devices, amplifiers, voltage dividers, limit switches, proximity switches, motors, pumps, drives, VFDs etc. * Ability to lead machine debug, support FATs, SATs as necessary. * Experience with risk assessments, functional safety design, and system interlocks. jobs.title: Entry Level Network Engineer – Remote Training

Train remotely on your own schedule, after hours, while maintaining your current job. You have up to six months to complete the curriculum. You will receive guidance and mentorship throughout your training while developing the skills necessary to prepare for a career as a Network Engineer. Upon successfully completing the training curriculum, participants must travel to Minnesota for a final in\-person technical evaluation. Successful candidates will then be prepared to interview for client project assignments nationwide. **Important: Although training is remote, this position requires 100% travel availability once assigned to a client project.** Candidates must be willing and able to travel nationwide and work at client locations as project requirements dictate. Following successful completion of the training program and placement on a project, starting compensation is $20/hour, with opportunities to earn up to $28/hour during the first year through merit\-based performance reviews. Apply today to start your journey toward becoming a Network Engineer.**

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, Search Backend
jobs.description: **Vacancy No** VN449 **Status** Active **Location** Remote US **Location Country** United States **Location Region** **Location City** **Description** Who are we? Auction Technology Group (ATG) is transforming the multi\-billion\-dollar global auction industry. Our platforms connect thousands of auction houses with buyers in over 170 countries, powering more than $15 billion in annual sales. Through innovative online auction technologies, we help auctioneers expand their reach, boost efficiency, and maximize value, while giving bidders unrivaled access to rare and specialized items. As a publicly traded company, ATG has scaled from $18 million to $170 million in revenue, with sustained growth beyond the pandemic. We’re modernizing one of the last industries to fully go digital, building a global, category\-defining business in the process. What are we hiring for? We’re seeking a Staff Software Engineer to join our Search \& Discovery team, the team that owns how millions of buyers find one\-of\-a\-kind items across our marketplaces (LiveAuctioneers, Proxibid, and our whitelabel platform). You’ll own the design and evolution of the shared search backend that serves every keyword search, suggestion, and results page: the query APIs, the real\-time indexing pipelines that keep tens of millions of listings fresh in Elasticsearch, and the data workflows that feed ranking signals back into search. At Staff level, success is measured by whether the work outlasts your direct involvement; the architecture you set, the standards you raise, and the engineers you develop should hold up as the platform grows. Our stack is Python\-centred (FastAPI services on Kubernetes) with Go services at the edges, Elasticsearch at the core, RabbitMQ\-driven indexing, MySQL and Redis for supporting data, and Airflow\-orchestrated batch workflows against our data warehouse. You’ll shape technical direction with the engineering manager and architects, drive initiatives that span the search team and its neighboring teams (Product, Data, platform, and the marketplace front\-ends), and mentor the Senior engineers around you. This is an opportunity to make a significant impact on a platform serving millions of users worldwide. Search is the front door of our marketplaces, and the systems you design directly move what buyers find, what sellers sell, and what the platform costs to run. **Key Responsibilities** What you’ll be doing: Own the design and evolution of the search backend (query serving, indexing, and the ranking\-signal data loop), introducing architectural patterns that improve scalability, reliability, and maintainability Stay hands\-on: design, develop, and maintain scalable backend services and RESTful APIs in Python (FastAPI) powering search across our marketplaces Own and evolve how we query Elasticsearch (query construction, mappings and analyzers, relevance and ranking) for a catalog of tens of millions of live and historical listings, including capacity, latency, and cluster\-cost trade\-offs Drive the health and throughput of the event\-driven indexing pipelines from RabbitMQ into Elasticsearch, setting the standards for freshness, blast\-radius control, and replay/backfill safety Design batch and data workflows (Airflow, data warehouse) that compute ranking signals, search suggestions, and related searches feeding back into the live search experience Drive delivery across teams: decompose complex problems into well\-scoped initiatives, identify risks early, improve predictability, and unblock others without becoming a bottleneck Determine when technical spikes and proof\-of\-concepts are needed, define their success criteria, and validate outcomes; sponsor and review spikes led by Senior engineers Set and raise engineering standards for the team: testing practices, deployment quality gates, observability (Dynatrace/DataSet), and incident readiness of a business\-critical serving path Lead incident response for the search domain when it matters most, and turn incidents into prevention through post\-incident improvements Weigh technical decisions against operations, cost, and customer experience; make the trade\-offs explicit when proposing direction Integrate AI and automation into engineering workflows to improve productivity, quality, and early risk detection, with sound judgment about when not to rely on it Mentor Senior engineers and support their growth into broader technical ownership; act as a key technical interviewer and contributor to hiring decisions Write the technical documentation and decision records that let your architectural decisions survive contact with a growing organization **Key Requirements** Who are we looking for? Required Experience \& Skills: 8\+ years of professional software engineering experience with a focus on backend development (or 6\+ years with a Master’s degree, or a PhD with 3\+ years, or equivalent) Expert\-level Python with production experience building and operating scalable backend services; this is a must Production experience with at least one statically typed language (Go, Java, Kotlin, C\#, or similar) in addition to Python Production experience with Elasticsearch or OpenSearch at scale: query DSL, index mappings and analyzers, performance/relevance tuning, and capacity planning A track record of owning the design and evolution of systems or significant components, applying architectural thinking to scalability, reliability, and maintainability Experience driving delivery across teams: decomposing complex problems into well\-scoped initiatives, guiding sound technical trade\-offs, and improving execution predictability Experience with relational databases (MySQL/PostgreSQL) including schema design, optimization, and query tuning Experience deploying and operating containerized services on Kubernetes Experience with workflow orchestration and batch data pipelines (Airflow or similar) Knowledge of message queuing systems (RabbitMQ, Kafka, AWS SQS/SNS) and event\-driven architectures Strong understanding of RESTful API design, microservices architecture, and distributed systems Experience with testing frameworks and comprehensive test suites, and with observability tooling (Dynatrace/Datadog or similar) Experience with on\-call rotation and incident management: able to independently triage incidents in your domain, without guidance, from alert to root cause and resolution, and to lead incident response when multiple teams are involved A record of mentoring senior\-level engineers and contributing to hiring (interviewing, calibration, raising the bar) Clear understanding of how technical decisions impact operations, cost, and customer experience Familiarity with AWS cloud services Soft Skills: Leads cross\-team initiatives and defines execution standards that improve consistency and scalability Makes data\-backed decisions that impact multiple teams and medium\-term objectives; develops strategic insight from data and experience Excellent communication skills: tailors messages to technical and non\-technical audiences, from engineers to mid\-management, and articulates trade\-offs clearly Engages cross\-functional teams to align on business priorities, influencing beyond immediate team boundaries Leads change initiatives: addresses resistance, secures buy\-in, and reinforces long\-term behavioral shifts Coaches and develops others; models engineering excellence in reviews, design discussions, and hiring Addresses cross\-functional challenges with systemic process improvements rather than one\-off fixes Proactive about technical investment: balances short\-term delivery with long\-term maintainability, and can defend the balance Nice\-to\-Have: Production experience with Go; several of our services are written in Go Exposure to TypeScript (you may occasionally touch front\-end or tooling code) Search relevance and information\-retrieval depth: BM25 tuning, ranking metrics (NDCG, CTR), learning\-to\-rank, vector or hybrid search Experience with data warehouses (Snowflake, Bigquery) and analytics pipelines Experience in eCommerce, marketplace, or auction platforms (e.g. LiveAuctioneers, Proxibid, Chairish); high\-traffic or real\-time systems Auction Technology Group is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. The pay is up to $200,000\. Actual compensation packages are based on several factors that are unique to each candidate, including but not limited to skill set, depth of experience, certifications, and specific work location. This may be different in other locations due to differences in the cost of labor. The total compensation package for this position may also include annual performance bonus, stock, benefits and/or other applicable incentive compensation plans. **Employment Type** Permanent **Duration** **Business Name** **Function Name** Technology

jobs.description: **Who we are** Aurora’s mission is to deliver the benefits of self\-driving technology safely, quickly, and broadly. The Aurora Driver will create a new era in mobility and logistics, one that will bring a safer, more efficient, and more accessible future to everyone. At Aurora, you will tackle massively complex problems alongside other passionate, intelligent individuals, growing as an expert while expanding your knowledge. For the latest news from Aurora, visit aurora.tech or follow us on LinkedIn. **What we are looking for** Aurora hires talented people with diverse backgrounds who are ready to help build a transportation ecosystem that will make our roads safer, get crucial goods where they need to go, and make mobility more efficient and accessible for all. We are searching for a Staff Software Engineer to join Aurora's Autonomy Frameworks team. This team builds the robotics middleware that powers the Aurora Driver: the runtime framework that every Autonomy and Simulation application uses to communicate, execute, and interact with the vehicle platform, both on the road and offline in the cloud. **In this role, you will** * Define and evolve the architecture of Aurora's AV runtime framework across on\-vehicle and offline execution * Design and implement high\-performance, low\-latency inter\-module communication, including shared\-memory, zero\-copy IPC, and RPC * Own stack configuration, deployment, and process lifecycle management on the vehicle compute platform * Improve the determinism, fidelity, and performance of offline execution so on\-vehicle behavior can be faithfully reproduced at scale * Build framework capabilities for fault traceability, health monitoring, and recovery that support Aurora's safety case * Design intuitive C\+\+ APIs that make the right patterns easy for Autonomy engineers * Provide engineering support for field testing and fleet operations * Mentor senior engineers, set coding standards, and drive the long\-term roadmap for the AV framework **Required Qualifications** * BS/MS/PhD in Computer Science or related field, or equivalent industry experience * Expert\-level C\+\+ programming skills and the ability to design high\-performance, thread\-safe, and memory\-efficient systems in a Linux environment * Proven experience building middleware, runtime frameworks, or distributed systems, such as pub/sub messaging, IPC, schedulers, or executors * Deep understanding of concurrency, memory models, and Linux systems internals (processes, threads, scheduling, shared memory) * Ability to work across multiple programming languages and paradigms * A passion for writing robust, intuitive, and pragmatic production code * Ability to navigate and work effectively in large codebases * Strong verbal and written communication skills * Ability to work autonomously and collaborate effectively with colleagues across time zones **Desirable Qualifications** * Experience with robotics middleware such as ROS 2 or ThreadX or FreeRTOS, or with soft real\-time systems * Experience with deterministic simulation, log replay, or reproducible execution * Experience with performance evaluation and optimization * Experience with safety\-critical systems *For roles based in jobs.title: Marketing AI Engineer
jobs.description: **About Avenue Z, Inc.** Avenue Z is a digital marketing and PR agency engineered to move fast. Brands partner with us to drive revenue and reputation through high\-impact public relations, performance media, AI search optimization (AEO), and our creator network. Trusted by leaders in emerging tech, finance and consumer brands, ***we drive influence*** across all channels \- from AI Search to The Wall Street Journal, Shopify to TikTok, Meta to Google. **The role** ------------ You are a growth marketer who builds. You have bought media on Meta, Google, or TikTok with your own hands, you know what a good ROAS looks like before the dashboard loads, and when something is manual, repetitive, or slow, your instinct is to open an editor and wire it to the platform API rather than schedule a working session. The Marketing AI Engineer builds and ships the AI agents, automations, and reporting systems that run paid media, creator and affiliate campaigns, CRO, and client reporting at Avenue Z. The work is concrete: agents that launch and QA ads across Meta, TikTok, and Snap; systems that reallocate budget toward top\-performing creators; reporting that ties creator content, ad spend, and attributed revenue into one picture; alerts that catch an expiring TikTok Shop affiliate code or a Meta partnership permission before spend stalls. You are also the technical lead for our AI builders. You set the standard for how agents are designed, reviewed, and shipped across service lines, you review their work, and you are the person leadership turns to when a build needs a decision. You will embed with the paid media, creator, and ecommerce teams to find where throughput or margin is lost, build the system that fixes it, drive adoption, and move to the next one. This is a builder and a leader role. You ship working systems yourself, and you raise the bar for everyone else who ships them. **What you'll do** ------------------ **Build against the marketing platforms our revenue runs on** * Integrate with the Meta Marketing API, TikTok Business and TikTok Shop APIs, Google Ads API, Snap, Shopify, and affiliate and creator platform APIs: OAuth and token refresh, rate limits, webhooks, and partnership\-access flows. * Build agents and automations for ad launching and QA, budget pacing and reallocation, creative tagging and performance intelligence, anomaly detection, and cross\-platform commission tracking. * Build the reporting layer that shows a brand what actually drove revenue, cross\-referenced against Shopify as the source of truth. **Embed with the teams and ship against real problems** * Sit with paid media, creator and affiliate, CRO, and ecommerce teams. Audit how they work today, map the workflow from input to output, and find the steps that should run automatically. * Turn a messy manual process into a working system inside weeks, not quarters. Define where a human approves and where the system acts on its own, especially where money or brand safety is on the line. * Drive adoption. A system that ships and sits unused does not count. Train the team, gather feedback, and iterate. **Build Innovative AI Driven Marketing SolutionsAI** * Provide technical leadership on product roadmap. Be an expert in building and shipping production ready solutions. * Set the standard for how Avenue Z designs, reviews, documents, and ships agents and automations across service lines, and enforce it through code review and design review. * Review and mentor the engineers and builders already working on AI automation across PR, SEO and AEO, organic social, and ecommerce. Unblock them, raise their quality bar, and own the outcome of their work. * Run the intake and prioritization of automation requests so the team builds what moves revenue, time saved, or client retention, in that order. * Report progress, blockers, and measured impact to the CTO and present to leadership. **Invent new capability** * Build things that create new advantages for the business, not just faster versions of old tasks: autonomous media buying, creative\-to\-landing\-page pipelines, creator performance ranking, and whatever you see next that we have not. **What you won't do** --------------------- * Be a passive project coordinator or a pure strategist with no build capability. * Spend months planning without shipping. * Wait for perfect requirements before building. * Build for novelty instead of business value. * Replace human judgment where brand, strategy, or client context still matters. * Treat marketing as someone else's domain. You have to understand the ad account as well as the people running it. **Who you are** --------------- **Required** * A background in growth marketing. You have personally run paid media on at least one of Instagram and Facebook, Google, or TikTok, and you understand campaign structure, pixels and events, attribution windows, creative testing, and what the numbers mean. * Hands\-on experience working with the Meta Marketing API and the TikTok Business or TikTok Shop APIs, plus other marketing platform APIs (Google Ads, Shopify, Klaviyo, affiliate and creator platforms). You have built something real against them, not read the docs. * Deep, current, hands\-on knowledge of the digital marketing industry: how agencies and brands actually operate, where the manual work sits, and what clients pay for. * Extensive hands\-on experience with AI coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, or similar) and a working command of good coding practice: version control, code review, environment and secrets management, testing, and documentation. A computer science degree is not required. Shipped work is. * Experience leading others who build. You have been a principal engineer, a founder, a lead engineer, a technical team lead, or a leader of product managers, and you have set and enforced a quality bar for a team's work. * Experience building AI agents and automations in production: prompts, tool use, approval gates, error handling, and monitoring, using whatever stack fits (Python or TypeScript, agent frameworks, workflow platforms such as n8n or Make where they are the right tool). * A portfolio of projects or code repositories you can walk us through (see below). * Based in, or relocating at your own expense to, Miami or Orlando. Onsite. **Preferred** * Experience in an ecommerce or performance marketing agency, or on a DTC brand's growth team. * TikTok Shop, creator and affiliate marketing, or influencer campaign experience. * Data work: SQL, BigQuery or a similar warehouse, Looker Studio or similar BI tools. * Shopify app or Shopify API experience. * You have built and sold, launched, or run something of your own. **Critical traits** * Moves fast and learns fast. * Thinks in systems and sees ambiguity as a build opportunity. * Commercially aware: knows the difference between an impressive demo and a system that makes or saves money. * High agency. Does not wait to be assigned the problem. * Good judgment on what should be automated and what should stay human. * Can switch between a conversation with a media buyer and a code review without changing register. **Benefits** ------------ * Salary: $100k\-$120k * Medical, vision, and dental plans * 401(k) plan with 4% employer match * Unlimited PTO * Professional development stipend

Our AI is not just a tool stacked on top of existing software; its intelligence is built to cognitively work within the very fabric of an organization. We are building a future where data\-driven insights align with human potential, and we need exceptional engineering minds to help us build it. **The Role** We are seeking a curious, analytical Junior Software Engineer to join our core platform team. In this role, you will learn from experienced engineers while contributing real code to systems at the intersection of human behavior, machine learning, and scalable architecture. If you are excited by data, enjoy untangling complex logic, and want to grow in an environment built on collaborative reasoning, this is the place for you. You will work alongside data scientists, product leaders, and senior engineers to help build systems that process large datasets and deliver real\-time, actionable insights that shape the future of work. **What You'll Do** * Build and Ship: Take on well\-defined features and fixes, write clean, tested code, and see your work reach production. * Learn the Data: Help build and maintain systems that process HR and behavioral data to feed our AI models, with guidance from senior engineers. * Collaborate and Ask Questions: Join whiteboarding sessions, code reviews, and brainstorming. Bring your perspective and ask the questions that sharpen a solution. * Communicate Clearly: Explain your work and your thinking in code reviews, documentation, and team discussions. * Grow Your Craft: Learn our engineering practices, take feedback openly, and steadily take on more ownership. **What We're Looking For** * Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field. * Experience: Internship, co\-op, or project experience building software. Personal and open\-source projects count. * Scrappy and Adaptable: The engineers that do best here are the ones who can be scrappy and able to adapt quickly to new information and shifting priorities in a fast\-paced environment. * Strong Reasoning Skills: You think critically, look for edge cases, and like working problems out from first principles. * Team\-Oriented Problem Solver: You check your ego at the door. You enjoy working through problems with others and actively seek out different perspectives. * Curiosity About Data: Interest in data pipelines, databases, and data processing. You must live within commuting distance of Glendale, CA, or be able to reliably commute to our office. **Why Join Us?** * Meaningful Impact: You will be building software that directly impacts how people experience their work lives globally. * Modern Stack: Work with modern tools and AI technologies in a space where innovation is the baseline, not an afterthought. This position partners with departments throughout the organization to identify opportunities for AI integration, develop automated workflows, enhance existing business systems, and implement innovative technology solutions. ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES: 1\. AI Strategy and Opportunity Identification * Collaborate with departments across BCH to identify opportunities to leverage AI to improve processes, productivity, and service delivery. * Evaluate existing workflows and business processes to identify opportunities for automation, efficiency, and innovation. * Partner with department leaders to understand operational challenges and recommend appropriate AI\-driven solutions. * Maintain awareness of emerging AI technologies, capabilities, and industry trends. 2\. jobs.title: Associate Director AI Product Engineer - Financial Institution Operations & Technology
jobs.description: **We Do Consulting Differently** -------------------------------- Preferred locations: New York, Chicago, Washington, D.C., Dallas, and Boston. Other locations considered case by case. **About the Practice** Berkeley Research Group is building a Financial Services Operations \& Technology practice focused initially on Commercial and Consumer Banking. We combine banking expertise, technology, and AI to help clients improve operations. **The Role** ------------ We are hiring a hands\-on AI Product Engineer focused on evaluation: proving whether AI products are accurate, reliable, and safe for banking operations. You will build automated tests, investigate failures, and provide evidence for release decisions while contributing to product development. Working with banking experts and engineers, you will define correct results, measure performance, and turn findings into product improvements. Your core responsibility is evaluation from early development through live use. Client stakeholders retain release and risk\-acceptance authority. **What You’ll Do** ------------------ **Own the Evaluation Approach** ------------------------------- * Define what each product must get right, how errors could affect customers or operations, and what evidence is needed before use. * Build reusable software that runs tests, scores results, and compares versions. Make testing part of everyday development, not a final checkpoint. * Work with engineers to reproduce failures, identify causes, and verify fixes. Contribute product code where needed to improve accuracy and control. **Design Tests and Measure Results** ------------------------------------ * Set pass criteria and scoring rules with business and risk teams. Distinguish minor defects from errors that must block release. * Maintain representative test cases, including incomplete records and rare, high\-impact errors. Reserve unseen examples for final testing to avoid overstating performance. * Have banking experts establish expected answers and resolve scoring disagreements. Measure factual accuracy, missing information, incorrect additions, and support from cited sources. * Check automated scoring against expert review. Test whether reviewers agree and whether AI\-based scoring misses important errors. * Compare versions on the same tests. Report results by task and error severity, with sample sizes and uncertainty, not just averages. **Verify Accuracy and Explain Failures** ---------------------------------------- * Test whether the system finds the right information and whether its answer reflects that information. Separate source problems from answer errors. * Check extracted facts against original records. Independently verify amounts, dates, and totals, and test whether citations actually support each important claim. * Test when the product should answer, request clarification, or refer work to a person. Verify that reviewers can detect and correct material errors. **Manage Risk and Monitor Performance** --------------------------------------- * Test for invented facts, unsupported recommendations, unfair outcomes, disclosure of sensitive information, and attempts to make the system ignore its safeguards. * Protect client data, restrict access and permitted actions, and use only approved services. Verify that safeguards work in practice. * Document repeatable test results, unresolved failures, and limitations. Recommend release, restricted use, or further development; support independent review and required client approvals. * Sample live outputs and track error rates and user corrections. Add confirmed failures to repeatable tests; trigger investigation or suspension when quality falls below agreed standards. Explain findings clearly, coach colleagues, and develop reusable tests and controls. Support proposals, technical estimates, and recruiting. * **Qualifications** ------------------ **Required** ------------ * Minimum 5 years of working experience with a minimum of 1 year experience in AI evaluation. * Demonstrated ownership of AI evaluations that informed real release decisions, including test design, expert\-reviewed answers, scoring, and failure investigation. * Strong Python skills and experience building automated test software, connecting data sources, and recording repeatable results across product versions. * Ability to select representative samples, interpret error rates and uncertainty, and distinguish genuine improvement from weak tests or inconsistent scoring. * Experience building or improving AI products used in operations, with practical controls for sensitive data, output accuracy, and human review. * Experience in financial services or another regulated environment, with the ability to translate business requirements into practical tests and controls. Strong communication and teamwork skills, ability to mentor colleagues, and willingness to travel to client sites as needed. * **Preferred** ------------- * Banking experience in lending, payments, servicing, collections, or default operations. * Experience independently evaluating AI products, checking automated scoring against expert judgment, or testing security and fairness in financial institutions. * Experience evaluating document review, summaries, information search, or automated workflows, including comparisons across AI services and conventional software. Consulting or product delivery experience, including client discovery, implementation planning, and user adoption. * **What Success Looks Like** --------------------------- Success means reliable evidence of what a product gets right, where it fails, and whether it is ready for use. Evaluations catch important errors before release, guide measurable improvements, and detect declining quality in live operations. Testing supports sound decisions, not simply a passing score. Associate Director Salary range: $180,000 \- $250,000 Job title and level will be determined based on qualifications and experience. Candidates must be able to verify their legal right to work in the United States without employer sponsorship now or in the future. **About BRG** BRG combines world\-leading academic credentials with world\-tested business expertise and purpose\-built emerging technologies. Our culture centers on agility and connectivity which sets us apart and gets you ahead. At BRG, our professionals include specialist consultants, industry experts, renowned academics, and leading\-edge data scientists. Together, they bring a diversity of real\-world experience, data, and human and artificial intelligence, to economics, disputes, and investigations; corporate finance; and performance improvement services that address the most complex challenges facing organizations across the globe. Our unique structure nurtures the interdisciplinary relationships that give us the edge, laying the groundwork for more informed insights and more original, incisive thinking. When paired with our global reach and resources, our diverse perspectives and technical capabilities make us uniquely capable to address our clients’ challenges. We get results because we know how to apply our thinking to your world. At BRG, we don’t just show you what’s possible. We’re built to help you make it happen. BRG is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. Our hiring practices provide equal opportunity for employment without regard to race, religion, color, sex, gender, national origin, age, United States military veteran status, ancestry, sexual orientation, marital status, family structure, medical condition including genetic characteristics or information, veteran status, or mental or physical disability so long as the essential functions of the job can be performed with or without reasonable accommodation, or any other protected category under federal, state, or local law.

You've built frameworks, libraries, or platform services used by many other engineers to build product features * Bring strong architectural judgment. You know when to invest in abstraction, when to keep things simple, and how to make technical bets that support a maturing product suite * Are an effective communicator and mentor.
