jobs.title: System Administrator I - III
jobs.description: **Company Overview:** Bridgehead IT is a leading provider of innovative technology solutions dedicated to guaranteed outcomes that bring peace of mind and improve its clients’ bottom line. With a commitment to operational excellence and client satisfaction, Bridgehead IT delivers tailored solutions that drive business success. **Position Summary:** The System Administrator career track (Levels I through III) supports the design, deployment, and ongoing maintenance of client server and storage environments. Each level builds upon the last, with increasing expectations for technical depth, independence, automation capability, and leadership contribution. System Administrator I is an entry\-level position designed for individuals with a foundation in IT who are ready to grow into infrastructure support. At this level, the focus is on learning the environment, performing routine maintenance, following documented procedures, and building core skills in Windows Server administration and ticketing. System Administrator II is a mid\-level position for technicians who have demonstrated proficiency in daily system operations and are beginning to take greater ownership of their workload. At this level, the expectation is stronger technical depth, more independent troubleshooting, and active contribution to documentation and process improvement. System Administrator III is a senior\-level position for experienced administrators who take ownership of complex environments, lead system implementations, and serve as escalation points for the team. At this level, the expectation is proficiency in virtualization, scripting, proactive maintenance, and mentoring junior staff. All levels participate in after\-hours and on\-call support rotations and work primarily through the company’s ticketing system to track time, document work, and manage client communications. All levels will be required to work onsite M\-F. **Duties/Responsibilities:** * Install, configure, maintain, and troubleshoot Windows\-based server and storage infrastructure across client environments, including physical and virtual platforms (e.g., Hyper\-V, VMware). * Manage and support Active Directory, Group Policy, DNS, DHCP, and other core directory services with a focus on availability, accuracy, and security. * Apply system updates, security patches, and configuration changes on a regular schedule; verify successful deployment and follow change management processes. * Monitor server health, backups, and system alerts; respond to and resolve tickets related to performance, availability, and access; escalate as appropriate. * Support and maintain backup platforms, enterprise storage systems, and disaster recovery solutions; participate in DR testing and business continuity planning. * Use PowerShell and other tools to perform administrative tasks, support automation, and improve operational efficiency. * Maintain accurate and detailed documentation of system configurations, changes, procedures, and asset/licensing records. * Work with the security team to implement system hardening baselines and remediate identified vulnerabilities. * Assist in the deployment and configuration of monitoring, backup, and endpoint protection tools across client environments. * Collaborate with internal teams and clients to support server migrations, virtualization efforts, infrastructure upgrades, and issue resolution. * Assist with onboarding and offboarding processes, including file server permissions, security group management, and client discovery documentation. * Mentor and support junior team members; serve as an escalation point for system\-related issues. * Operate within the ticketing system to manage time, document work, track task progress, and maintain clear client communications. * Participate in an on\-call rotation and provide after\-hours support as scheduled. * Perform additional tasks as assigned. **Education and Experience:** **Level I – System Administrator I** * 1–3\+ years of experience in IT support or system administration, or relevant technical education * Basic understanding of Windows Server and Active Directory environments * Willingness to learn PowerShell and system automation tools. * Strong communication, documentation, and troubleshooting skills. * Experience using or willingness to learn a ticketing system. * Certifications such as Microsoft Azure Fundamentals, Microsoft 365 Fundamentals, Azure Administrator Associate or similar are preferred. * Ability to lift equipment up to 50 lbs and travel to client sites when required. **Level II – System Administrator II** * 3–5\+ years of experience in system administration or related IT support roles. * Solid understanding of Windows Server, Active Directory, and Group Policy management. * Experience with backup systems, patch management, and system monitoring tools. * Familiarity with PowerShell scripting or a strong interest in developing those skills. * Hands\-on experience using a ticketing system. * Strong troubleshooting, documentation, and communication skills. * Preferred certifications: Microsoft Windows Server Hybrid Administrator Associate, Azure Administrator Associate, Microsoft 365 Administrator Expert, or similar. **Level III – System Administrator III** * 5–7\+ years of experience in system administration, with increasing levels of responsibility. * Proficient in managing Microsoft Windows Server environments and core services (AD, GPO, DNS, DHCP). * Experience with virtualization technologies such as VMware or Hyper\-V. * Working knowledge of backup systems, disaster recovery planning, and storage infrastructure. * Familiarity with Microsoft 365, Azure, or other cloud\-based services is preferred. * Experience with PowerShell scripting for system management and automation is preferred. * Experience using a ticketing system to manage service requests and document resolution steps. * Ability to lift equipment as needed (up to 50 lbs) and travel to client sites if required. * Strong sense of ownership, accountability, and customer service focus. * Preferred certifications: Microsoft Azure Administrator Associate, Windows Server Hybrid Administrator Associate, Azure Solutions Architect Expert, or similar. **Why Join Bridgehead IT?** * Serve as a trusted advisor for a diverse portfolio of SMB and Major Accounts. * Influence technology strategy and business outcomes. * Work alongside highly skilled engineers, architects, and technology leaders. * Gain exposure to a wide range of industries and technologies. * Enjoy a high\-impact role with significant visibility and growth opportunities. * Be part of a team that values ownership, innovation, accountability, and exceptional client service. **Disclaimer:** The duties and responsibilities described in this job description are not a comprehensive list and additional tasks may be assigned to the employee from time to time. This job description in no way states or implies that these are the only duties to be performed by the employee(s) in this position. Employees will be required to follow any other job\-related instructions and to perform any other job\-related duties requested by any person authorized to give instructions or assignments. All duties and responsibilities are essential functions and requirements and are subject to possible modification to reasonably accommodate individuals with disabilities. To perform this job successfully, the employees will possess the skills, aptitudes, and abilities to perform each duty proficiently. The requirements listed in this document are the minimum levels of knowledge, skills, or abilities.

jobs.title: Staff AI Engineer, Developer Relations Engineering
jobs.description: Crusoe is on a mission *to accelerate the abundance of energy and intelligence*. As the only vertically integrated AI infrastructure company built from the ground up, we own and operate each layer of the stack — from electrons to tokens — to power the world's most ambitious AI workloads. When you join Crusoe, you join a team that is building the future, faster. We're in the midst of the greatest industrial revolution of our time. The demand for AI compute is boundless, and power is a bottleneck. We're solving that — with an energy\-first approach that makes AI infrastructure better for the world and faster for the people innovating with AI. We're looking for problem\-solving, opportunity\-finding teammates with a sense of urgency, who believe in the scale of our ambition and thrive on a path not fully paved — people who want to grow their careers alongside a team of experts across energy, manufacturing, data center construction, and cloud services. If you want to do the most meaningful work of your career, help our customers and partners advance their AI strategies, and be part of a high\-performing team that believes in each other, come build with us at Crusoe. **About the Role:** Crusoe is hiring an AI Engineer for our Developer Relations Engineering team: an engineer who builds agentic AI systems and enjoys showing other developers how they work. You will build reference agents, open\-source integrations, and sample applications on Crusoe Cloud and Crusoe Managed Inference. In this role, you will lead technical content creation, community engagement, and developer outreach across AI infrastructure and managed services workloads. You will produce documentation, tutorials, white papers, sample applications, and video guides. You will partner with the Product, Engineering, Research, and GTM/Solutions Engineering teams and work across the open\-source agent ecosystem. You will spend most of your time building and then sharing what you build. **What You'll Be Working On:** * **Agentic Reference Systems:** Architect and ship end\-to\-end reference agents and starter kits on Crusoe that developers can use as a starting point for production, covering tool use, MCP, multi\-agent orchestration, RAG, structured outputs, memory, and evals. * **Examples \& Documentation:** Own the code examples, tutorials, and documentation that help developers go from first API call to working agent, and keep them tested and up to date as the ecosystem changes. * **Open Source \& GitHub:** Own Crusoe's developer\-facing GitHub presence, including examples, cookbooks, and integrations. Contribute upstream to agent frameworks, inference engines, and developer tooling (for example LangGraph, LlamaIndex, CrewAI, Pydantic AI, the OpenAI Agents SDK, MCP, vLLM, and SGLang) so they work well with Crusoe. * **Technical Content \& Video:** Turn the systems you build into content developers rely on: deep\-dive blog posts, notebooks, YouTube videos, livestreams, and short technical clips. * **Building in Public:** Share your work on X, LinkedIn, YouTube, Discord, Reddit, Hacker News, etc. Answer technical questions, review community projects, and become a trusted technical voice in the agent and open\-source community. * **Use\-Case Blueprints:** Partner with GTM/Solutions Engineering to spot recurring customer patterns and turn them into open reference architectures for developer segments such as Physical AI, robotics, simulation, and other industry verticals. * **Product \& Research Partnership:** Join Product, Engineering, and Research workflows. Test features and models before launch, make sure samples and docs are ready on launch day, and bring developer friction back as concrete product input, following each issue until it is fixed or explicitly deprioritized. * **Talks \& Workshops:** Give technical talks, live demos, and hands\-on labs at conferences, meetups, hackathons, and workshops. **What You'll Bring to the Team:** * **Engineering Experience:** 5\+ years as a software engineer, ML engineer, applied AI engineer, forward\-deployed engineer, or in a similar hands\-on engineering role, with strong Python. A Developer Relations title is not required. * **Engineering Credibility:** Ability to earn credibility with both AI infrastructure engineers and ML/AI engineers. * **Agentic AI:** Hands\-on experience building LLM applications and agents with tool calling, MCP, retrieval, memory, and evaluation, using one or more frameworks such as LangGraph, LlamaIndex, CrewAI, Pydantic AI, or the OpenAI Agents SDK. You have well\-formed opinions about what works and what breaks in production. * **Cloud Infrastructure:** Experience working with cloud computing platforms (such as AWS, GCP, or Azure) or managed AI solutions, with a foundational understanding of cloud infrastructure concepts. * **Inference \& Model Serving:** Working knowledge of how models are served, including OpenAI\-compatible APIs, open\-weight models, and serving engines such as vLLM or SGLang. You can explain cost and latency tradeoffs credibly. * **Public Track Record:** Evidence of sharing technical work in public through GitHub repos, open\-source contributions, blog posts, videos, talks, or an active technical presence on social platforms. Please include links when you apply. * **Technical Communication:** Strong communication skills across written and verbal formats, including technical documentation, white papers, video explainers, and presentation decks. * **Ownership \& Collaboration:** You work well across teams, set your own priorities, and ship in a fast\-moving environment. * **Travel Requirement:** Ability to travel up to 20%. * **Education:** Bachelor's/Master's/PhD degree in Computer Science, or equivalent practical experience. **Bonus Points** * Maintainer or significant contributor to an open\-source AI, agent, or inference project * Experience producing technical video content such as YouTube tutorials, livestreams, or screencasts * Experience fine\-tuning or post\-training open\-weight models (SFT/RL/LoRA) * An existing technical audience that trusts your views on models, agents, and tooling **Benefits:** * Competitive compensation and equity packages * Restricted Stock Units * Paid time off, paid holidays \& leave of absence programs * Comprehensive health, dental \& vision insurance * Employer contributions to HSA account * Paid parental leave * Paid life insurance, short\-term and long\-term disability * Professional development \& tuition reimbursement * Mental health \& wellness support * Commuter benefits (parking \& transit) * Cell phone stipend * 401(k) Retirement plan with company match up to 4% of salary * Volunteer time off * Global travel insurance \& emergency assistance * Daily meals allowance * Additional perks \& programs specific to location **Compensation Range** Compensation will be paid in the range of up to $180,000\-$220,000 \+ Bonus. jobs.description: Consolidated Safety Services (CSS) has an opening for a Cloud Program Management Office (PMO) Paleo ARC Support position. The is a remote position based out of Beaumont, North Carolina. Monitoring * Implement excess heat and cold metrics. Based on apparent temperature, these metrics will equip users with unified thermal stress information to improve hazard identification and risk assessments for public health, civil infrastructure, agricultural management, energy production, and other sectoral applications. * Implement a Global Reanalysis Air Mass Index (GRAMI). Rather than tracking a single parameter, GRAMI integrates temperature, moisture, pressure, winds, and clouds into a holistic depiction of the weather, such as hot/humid conditions or the passage of a cold front. GRAMI will provide valuable supporting context for NCEI Monthly Reports and will facilitate a variety of societal applications, such as retail trade (e.g., optimizing inventories based on air mass frequencies) and air quality (e.g., documenting stagnant air mass conditions that trap wildfire smoke). GRAMI was created by the same PIs who developed the excess heat and cold factor metrics. Projections * Support a fledgling Projections Services Protocol (in conjunction with MAPP). This protocol will establish a standardized, tiered framework designed to bridge the operational gap between projection providers and downstream decision makers like civil engineers. Modeled on the success of the North American Multi\-Model Ensemble and co\-designed with end\-users from the outset, the protocol will function as a quality\-assurance pipeline that advances raw model output through a series of evaluation tiers that ultimately support stakeholder requirements. Given this project is at its initial stages and requires community input, specific deliverables will be defined during the performance period. **Duties/Responsibilities** * Development of an ERA5 ingest capability as well as an interactive web interface for real\-time tracking * Implement a Global Reanalysis Air Mass Index (GRAMI) * Potential tasks may include setting up a process to acquire observational datasets and/or hourly model output (e.g., from GFDL) for product development, or the enhancement of an existing industry product (e.g., Future Typical Meteorological Year) **Education and Experience** High School Diploma or equivalent. jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer
jobs.description: **Job Overview:** ExploreK12 Literacy is looking for a Principal Software Engineer who combines deep technical expertise, strong engineering judgment, and hands\-on execution. This role is for an engineer who can get deeply into a complex, mature application, understand how it actually works, and help determine how it should evolve. You will work directly in the code while also helping teams navigate difficult technical decisions, modernization efforts, architectural constraints, and ambiguous engineering problems. You will be a senior technical leader within the Literacy product area, partnering closely with engineers, engineering leaders, and architects to help shape technical direction across multiple teams and products. You will help shape technical direction, surface risks and tradeoffs, and turn complex problems into practical paths forward. You will also work across product boundaries where shared capabilities or product convergence require coordination with other engineering teams. Modernization is an important part of this role, but it is not the goal by itself. The goal is to enable the future of the product while making the system easier to understand, change, test, deploy, and operate. Sometimes that means modernizing a system. Sometimes it means integrating with it, isolating it, incrementally replacing part of it, or deliberately leaving it alone. We are also looking for someone who is fluent in modern AI\-assisted software development and interested in applying AI thoughtfully where it can improve engineering effectiveness or create meaningful product value. You do not need to be an AI specialist. **Job Responsibilities:** **Solve Difficult Technical Problems** * Get deeply into our applications, codebases, data flows, integrations, dependencies, and operational behavior to understand how the system actually works. * Investigate complex technical problems through multiple layers of the system until the underlying causes and constraints are understood. * Turn ambiguous or complicated engineering problems into clear problem statements, options, tradeoffs, and recommended approaches. * Bring strong technical judgment to decisions involving complexity, risk, customer value, cost, maintainability, team capacity, and future product needs. * Surface significant technical risks early and take clear, well\-supported positions when you believe the organization is heading toward a poor technical outcome. **Remain a Hands\-On Engineer** * Contribute meaningful production code and take direct responsibility for technical work where your involvement can have high impact. * Depending on the needs of the product, own or contribute to projects, features, migrations, prototypes, architectural changes, and difficult engineering investigations. * Work at both the architecture and implementation levels, moving between system\-level reasoning and code\-level details as the problem requires. * Use hands\-on involvement to build firsthand understanding of the system rather than operating primarily through architecture documents and reviews. * Exercise judgment about when personally implementing a solution is the highest\-leverage contribution and when enabling another engineer or team will create greater value. **Help Evolve a Mature Product** * Partner with architects and product engineering leaders to understand the current application landscape and help craft practical approaches for its evolution. * Identify where architectural constraints and technical debt are materially affecting engineering effectiveness or limiting future product capabilities. * Recommend modernization investments based on evidence, expected value, risk, cost, reversibility, team capacity, and product direction. * Apply approaches such as incremental replacement, modularization, API enablement, migration, strangler patterns, or parallel adoption when they are appropriate to the problem. * Help teams decompose significant technical change into achievable increments that reduce risk and produce useful progress. * Recognize when existing technology is adequate and modernization would create more cost or risk than value. * Help reduce friction in how engineers understand, change, test, deploy, and operate important parts of the product. * Contribute to a credible longer\-term path for the product's technical evolution rather than treating modernization as a collection of isolated projects. **Provide Principal\-Level Technical Leadership** * Be a high\-leverage technical partner on important architectural decisions, novel problems, technically risky initiatives, and work with significant cross\-product implications. * Identify architectural constraints, technical risks, and systemic issues that span multiple teams, products, or strategic initiatives, and help drive resolution before they become significant delivery, operational, or customer\-impacting problems. * Work with Product and Design during solution discovery and implementation planning  * Over your first year, success should be visible in both the product and the engineering organization. Important parts of the system are becoming easier for engineers to understand, change, test, deploy, or operate. The organization has a clearer, credible path for evolving the product's architecture, and meaningful modernization work is underway where it creates real value. Some of that evolution may also unlock product capabilities that were previously difficult or impractical to deliver. Teams are making more consistent technical decisions across product boundaries because shared architectural assumptions, integration approaches, and long\-term technical tradeoffs are understood earlier. Cross\-team technical risks are surfaced sooner, and the organization has greater confidence in its technical direction beyond any individual application or team. Senior engineers and technical leads are taking on increasingly difficult technical problems with stronger judgment and greater independence. Your presence increases the organization's technical capability rather than creating dependency on you. AI is becoming a practical part of how engineering works, and useful opportunities for AI in the product are being identified and pursued based on customer and business value rather than novelty. **Why Work for Us** When you join ExploreK12™, you become part of a mission to help educators unlock brighter futures for every student. As a trusted leader in educational technology, we serve more than 17 million students and educators across 150\+ countries with innovative, research\-backed learning solutions that truly make a difference. Our flagship products—Gizmos™, Raz\-Plus®, and Reflex™—are beloved by educators and students alike for being as practical and effective as they are fun. To learn more about our organization and the exciting work we do, visit www.ExploreK12\.com. **Remote First Work Environment** Our Remote First approach gives employees the flexibility and trust they need to effectively balance work with life. It creates a culture in which all employees are valued and where success is measured in results. It allows us to work collaboratively, inclusively and for greater positive impact, regardless of our individual locations. If you will be working remotely, either occasionally or on a permanent basis, you must have a reliable internet connection through a cable or fiber\-optic broadband service with minimum speeds of 10 Mbps download and 5 Mbps upload. The successful candidate will be expected to actively participate in video\-based interviews during the recruiting process and ongoing virtual meetings with their camera on, as part of their role. To maintain confidentiality and ensure a fair evaluation process, the use of note\-taking tools, reference materials, or AI\-powered tools (including generative AI, language models, or similar technologies) during interviews or other selection activities is prohibited unless prior written approval has been obtained from the People Experience team. If you require an exception for medical, accessibility, or other reasons, please contact your Talent Acquisition team member to discuss accommodations in advance. As part of our Remote\-First benefits, Cambium offers reimbursement to help cover the cost of setting up your home or remote office. **An Equal Opportunity Employer** We are dedicated to fostering a culture that celebrates unique backgrounds, ideas, and experiences. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without discrimination on the basis of race, color, age, religion, sex (including pregnancy, gender, gender identity/expression, or sexual orientation), national origin, protected veteran status, disability, or genetic information (including family medical history). We will provide reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities. You may request an accommodation during the recruiting process with your Talent Acquisition team member.

jobs.description: Choosing Capgemini means choosing a company where you will be empowered to shape your career in the way you’d like, where you’ll be supported and inspired by a collaborative community of colleagues around the world, and where you’ll be able to reimagine what’s possible. Join us and help the world’s leading organizations unlock the value of technology and build a more sustainable, more inclusive world. **What you will own** --------------------- One or more platform components end to end: model gateway (routing, failover, caching, per\-line cost attribution), agent runtime and orchestration, evaluation harness, guardrail engine, tool and agent registry, or shared product services The training and adaptation loop: pipelines that turn production traces and evaluation verdicts into reinforcement learning and fine\-tuning datasets, and the infrastructure to train, evaluate, and serve NewCo\-tuned LLMs and SLMs behind the same gates as vendor models Reliability, latency, and cost of what you build; platform services carry baselines and you hold them The self\-service surfaces product engineers use: your components ship with documentation, sane defaults, and no ticket queue Co\-building with product teams: new shared services start embedded with a product line and graduate to platform services when proven **What you will need** ---------------------- Strong production engineering: Python plus one systems language (Go or Rust welcome), Kubernetes, infrastructure\-as\-code, and one major cloud Hands\-on experience with LLM infrastructure: a model gateway pattern (such as LiteLLM or in\-house), model serving (such as vLLM or managed endpoints), and vector or retrieval systems Agent\-systems experience: you have built with an agent orchestration framework (such as LangGraph or first\-party agent SDKs) and understand tool calling and the Model Context Protocol (MCP) Evaluation engineering: you have built or operated eval harnesses (golden datasets, regression gates in CI, LLM\-judge calibration) and can explain why they gate merges Post\-training fluency: you have fine\-tuned or post\-trained a model, built the data pipeline behind one, or reproduced techniques from recent papers in production systems Daily, hands\-on use of AI coding assistants as part of your own development workflow We care about depth in four or five of these areas more than surface familiarity with all of them. What sets you apart Guardrail\-engine or AI\-observability experience (NeMo Guardrails, OpenTelemetry GenAI conventions, LangSmith, Braintrust, or equivalent) Reinforcement learning infrastructure (reward modelling, RLHF or GRPO\-class pipelines) or SLM distillation experience Multi\-tenant SaaS infrastructure: tenancy isolation, metering, usage\-based billing Financial services engineering (banks, insurers, or payment providers) is the ideal background; other regulated\-industry or security engineering depth also counts Open\-source contributions or a portfolio of deployed agents and eval suites (we would rather see this than a CV) The reference stack The reference technology stack for this role is our supported paved road: self\-hosted LangSmith and LangGraph Platform as the agent runtime and evaluation plane, model providers behind a swappable gateway seam, PostgreSQL with pgvector plus ClickHouse and S3\-compatible object storage as the data platform, Neo4j Enterprise as the semantic knowledge graph, an agent memory plane serving episodic and precedent memory over MCP, MCP\-native connectors, OpenTelemetry and Grafana for observability, all on CNCF\-conformant Kubernetes with Helm and Argo CD, deployable to any hyperscaler or on\-prem. A tool\-for\-tool match is not expected: analogous experience counts fully. Review, not typing, is where engineering judgment goes. Three human gates govern everything we ship: spec approval, merge, and release. jobs.title: Full-stack Engineer 5 (Finance Tech)
jobs.description: Full\-stack Engineer 5 (Finance Tech) Do you love building and pioneering in the technology space? Do you enjoy solving complex business problems in a fast\-paced, collaborative, inclusive and iterative delivery environment? At Capital One, you'll be part of a big group of makers, breakers, doers and disruptors who solve real problems and meet real customer needs. We are seeking Full\-stack Software Engineers who are passionate about leveraging cutting\-edge open source frameworks and emerging technologies. In this role, you’ll be at the forefront of driving a major transformation across Capital One. Finance Tech is responsible for transforming Capital One's financial engine into the most trusted, nimble, and insightful in the industry. Our core mission is to engineer outcomes that strategically enable the Finance organization and the broader Enterprise to remain efficient. This mission is driven by four technical and functional pillars: Forecasting \& Resiliency, providing advanced decision support; Treasury \& Trade managing sophisticated cash and investment lifecycles; and Accounting \& Reporting, ensuring the integrity of our general ledger and regulatory commitments. Powering these pillars are our Data and Core capabilities, which manage the orchestration, sourcing, and pipelines for critical financial data products. By defining the next generation of financial technology, we ensure that every business process is backed by high fidelity tracking and reporting. Together, we are not just supporting the bottom line \- we are building a strategic enabler that operates as a world class financial engine. **What You’ll Do:** * Lead a portfolio of diverse technology projects and a team of developers with deep experience in distributed microservices, and full stack systems to create solutions that help meet regulatory needs for the company * Share your passion for staying on top of tech trends, experimenting with and learning new technologies, participating in internal \& external technology communities, mentoring other members of the engineering community * Collaborate with digital product managers, and deliver robust cloud\-based solutions that drive powerful experiences to help millions of Americans achieve financial empowerment * Utilize programming languages like Java, Scala, Python, Go, Node.js, Open Source RDBMS and NoSQL databases, Container Orchestration services including Docker and Kubernetes, and a variety of AWS tools and services * Provide technical leadership across multiple teams, shaping system architecture and long\-term technology direction * Drive end\-to\-end design and implementation of large\-scale, distributed, or cloud\-native systems with high reliability and performance requirements * Partner with architects and product leaders to define platform roadmaps and shared services strategy **Basic Qualifications:** * Bachelor's Degree or higher in Computer Science or a related quantitative field (Statistics, Economics, Operations Research, Analytics, Mathematics, Engineering) * At least 6 years of experience in software engineering (Internship experience does not apply) * At least 3 years of experience with public cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure), cloud\-based productivity tools, or virtualization technologies **Preferred Qualifications:** * Master’s Degree in Computer Science or a related field * 9\+ years of experience coding with more than two of the following: Java, Scala, Python, Go, or Node.js * 5\+ years of experience contributing to open source frameworks * 5\+ years of experience creating synchronous and asynchronous APIs * 4\+ years of experience with database and database management systems * 4\+ years of experience with AWS, GCP, Azure, or cloud\-based productivity tools or virtualization technologies * 4\+ years of experience using Git\-based version\-control systems (e.g., Git, GitHub, Bitbucket) * 4\+ years of experience troubleshooting technical issues within cloud environments * 1\+ year of experience leading architectural design reviews and influencing enterprise\-wide technical standards and methodologies * 1\+ year of experience establishing and enforcing coding standards and design patterns across teams * Experience influencing technology strategy at the portfolio or business unit level * Experience leveraging modern AI\-based coding tools and IDE copilots * Experience with interactive AI tooling to accelerate productivity, utilizing capabilities beyond basic code completion ***Capital One will consider sponsoring a new qualified applicant for employment authorization for this position.*** The minimum and maximum full\-time annual salaries for this role are listed below, by location. Please note that this salary information is solely for candidates hired to perform work within one of these locations, and refers to the amount Capital One is willing to pay at the time of this posting. Salaries for part\-time roles will be prorated based upon the agreed upon number of hours to be regularly worked. Cambridge, MA: $229,900 \- $262,400 for Full\-stack Engineer 5 McLean, VA: $229,900 \- $262,400 for Full\-stack Engineer 5 Richmond, VA: $209,000 \- $238,500 for Full\-stack Engineer 5 Candidates hired to work in other locations will be subject to the pay range associated with that location, and the actual annualized salary amount offered to any candidate at the time of hire will be reflected solely in the candidate’s offer letter. This role is also eligible to earn performance based incentive compensation, which may include cash bonus(es) and/or long term incentives (LTI). Incentives could be discretionary or non discretionary depending on the plan. Capital One offers a comprehensive, competitive, and inclusive set of health, financial and other benefits that support your total well\-being. Learn more at the Capital One Careers website. Eligibility varies based on full or part\-time status, exempt or non\-exempt status, and management level. This role is expected to accept applications for a minimum of 5 business days. No agencies please. Capital One is an equal opportunity employer (EOE, including disability/vet) committed to non\-discrimination in compliance with applicable federal, state, and local laws. Capital One promotes a drug\-free workplace. Capital One will consider for employment qualified applicants with a criminal history in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable laws regarding criminal background inquiries, including, to the extent applicable, Article 23\-A of the New York Correction Law; San Francisco, California Police Code Article 49, Sections 4901\-4920; New York City’s Fair Chance Act; Philadelphia’s Fair Criminal Records Screening Act; and other applicable federal, state, and local laws and regulations regarding criminal background inquiries. If you have visited our website in search of information on employment opportunities or to apply for a position, and you require an accommodation, please contact Capital One Recruiting at 1\-800\-304\-9102 or via email at RecruitingAccommodation@capitalone.com. All information you provide will be kept confidential and will be used only to the extent required to provide needed reasonable accommodations. For technical support or questions about Capital One's recruiting process, please send an email to Careers@capitalone.com Capital One does not provide, endorse nor guarantee and is not liable for third\-party products, services, educational tools or other information available through this site. Capital One Financial is made up of several different entities. Please note that any position posted in Canada is for Capital One Canada, any position posted in the United Kingdom is for Capital One Europe and any position posted in the Philippines is for Capital One Philippines Service Corp. (COPSSC).

jobs.title: Systems Administrator
jobs.description: Systems Administrator, Healthcare IT Capitol Imaging Services, we’re a leading provider of diagnostic imaging services committed to delivering high\-quality patient care through innovation and a compassionate approach. Our high\-quality radiology services include—MRI, CT, PET/CT, Nuclear Medicine, ultrasound, X\-ray, and mammography. We are currently operating 60 facilities across six states in the Gulf Coast region. We are growing and have an opening for a Systems Administrator. We treat technology as a driver of revenue and profit, not just a cost to be managed. A core part of our work is supporting healthcare and clinical organizations, including medical imaging providers, where uptime and data protection directly affect patient care. The Role You’ll be a hands\-on member of our infrastructure team, supporting and maintaining client environments across multiple sites. You’ll handle escalated support issues, administer core Microsoft systems, and help keep clinical and imaging workflows running securely and reliably. This is a strong fit for an experienced support professional ready to move deeper into systems administration, with mentorship from senior engineers. Responsibilities * Administer Active Directory, Microsoft 365, and Windows Server environments for client organizations * Provision and support user accounts, devices, permissions, and licensing * Troubleshoot and resolve escalated hardware, software, and network issues * Support networking services, including DNS, DHCP, VPN, and VLAN configurations * Assist with the support and maintenance of PACS, RIS, and DICOM\-connected systems and workstations * Apply HIPAA\-aligned practices to access control, data handling, backups, and system configuration * Document systems, procedures, and resolutions clearly in our ticketing and documentation platforms * Travel between client sites to install, maintain, and repair equipment Requirements * 5\+ years of IT support experience, ideally in a healthcare or clinical setting * Working knowledge of Active Directory, Microsoft 365 administration, and Windows Server * Familiarity with networking fundamentals (DNS, DHCP, VPN, VLANs) * Understanding of HIPAA compliance as it relates to IT systems * Strong troubleshooting skills and a habit of documenting your work * Ability to lift and move IT equipment (typically up to \[50] lbs), with or without reasonable accommodation * Reliable transportation and willingness to travel occasionally between Gulf Coast\-area sites Preferred * Exposure to PACS, RIS, DICOM, or other medical imaging software * CompTIA A\+, Network\+, or Security\+ (or actively pursuing) * Experience in an MSP or multi\-client environment

jobs.title: Network & Wireless Infrastructure Engineer
jobs.description: We are seeking an experienced Global Network \& Wireless Infrastructure Engineer to design, implement, administer, maintain, and support our organization's wired and wireless network infrastructure across all domestic and international locations. This position serves as a primary technical resource for global network infrastructure, with responsibility for maintaining reliable, secure, and high\-performing network connectivity throughout the organization. The ideal candidate will possess extensive hands\-on experience in enterprise Wi\-Fi design, implementation, optimization, and troubleshooting, along with strong technical proficiency in Cisco Catalyst switching, Cisco Meraki MX firewalls, and Ubiquiti UniFi wireless networking. The successful candidate must be capable of independently designing and implementing moderately complex LAN environments, deploying reliable wireless networks in challenging physical environments, and resolving complex networking issues across geographically distributed facilities. The role combines network engineering, infrastructure administration, project implementation, and operational support. Domestic and international travel is required for network installations, upgrades, troubleshooting, site assessments, and other infrastructure projects. **Key Responsibilities** **1\. Global Network Infrastructure Management** * Serve as a primary technical resource responsible for wired and wireless networking infrastructure across all company locations worldwide. * Design, implement, administer, monitor, and maintain LAN, WLAN, WAN, firewall, and VPN infrastructure. * Establish and maintain consistent network architecture, configuration standards, and security practices across global facilities. * Support the deployment of network infrastructure at new locations, facility expansions, relocations, and renovations. * Independently plan and execute network upgrades, hardware replacements, and infrastructure improvements. * Remotely diagnose and resolve network issues affecting domestic and international locations. * Coordinate with local personnel, telecommunications providers, contractors, and equipment vendors. * Maintain accurate network topology diagrams, IP addressing documentation, equipment inventories, and configuration records. * Identify opportunities to improve network reliability, performance, security, and standardization. * Participate in network infrastructure planning, lifecycle management, and technology refresh initiatives. **2\. Enterprise Wireless Network Engineering** * Design, deploy, configure, optimize, and maintain enterprise Wi\-Fi networks, primarily using Ubiquiti UniFi equipment. * Conduct predictive and physical wireless site surveys, RF assessments, and post\-installation validation. * Develop wireless coverage and capacity plans based on facility layouts, building materials, device density, and operational requirements. * Determine appropriate wireless access point placement, antenna selection, channel assignments, and transmit power settings. * Configure and optimize wireless networks using 2\.4 GHz, 5 GHz, and 6 GHz technologies where applicable. * Support Wi\-Fi 5, Wi\-Fi 6/6E, and Wi\-Fi 7 technologies. * Configure SSIDs, VLAN assignments, wireless security, guest access, and enterprise authentication. * Troubleshoot wireless roaming, interference, authentication failures, intermittent connectivity, and performance degradation. * Optimize wireless connectivity for handheld scanners, Android devices, laptops, and other business\-critical mobile equipment. * Design wireless solutions for challenging environments, including warehouses, industrial facilities, high ceilings, metal shelving, and areas with significant RF interference. * Administer Ubiquiti UniFi Network management platforms and maintain consistent wireless configuration standards. * Utilize wireless survey, spectrum analysis, packet capture, and diagnostic tools to identify and resolve complex RF issues. Extensive hands\-on wireless design and troubleshooting experience is essential. **3\. Cisco LAN Switching \& Network Design** * Design and implement moderately complex enterprise LAN environments. * Configure, administer, and troubleshoot Cisco Catalyst switches running Cisco IOS and IOS XE. * Perform switch configuration and troubleshooting using the Cisco command\-line interface. * Configure and maintain Layer 2 and Layer 3 switching, VLANs, trunking, and inter\-VLAN routing. * Configure and troubleshoot STP/RSTP, EtherChannel/LACP, ACLs, and PoE. * Implement IP addressing schemes, subnetting, static routing, and dynamic routing where appropriate. * Troubleshoot switching loops, broadcast storms, network congestion, and connectivity failures. * Design reliable network uplinks, switching architectures, and redundant network connections where required. * Plan and execute switch replacements, firmware upgrades, and configuration changes. * Maintain consistent switching standards and configura AT, VPNs, and WAN connectivity. * Familiarity with Meraki Dashboard monitoring and troubleshooting capabilities. **Core Networking** * Strong understanding of TCP/IP, IPv4 subnetting, DNS, DHCP, routing, switching, and network security. * Proficiency using network diagnostic tools, including Wireshark and packet capture utilities. * Ability to independently troubleshoot complex network performance and connectivity problems. * Knowledge of network documentation and infrastructure management best practices. **Preferred Qualifications** * Cisco CCNA or CCNP certification. * Ubiquiti wireless or enterprise networking certifications. * Wireless networking certifications such as CWNA or CWSP. * Experience with Ekahau, Hamina, NetAlly, or similar wireless design and analysis tools. * Experience designing and supporting wireless networks in warehouses, distribution centers, or industrial facilities. * Experience supporting Android handheld scanners, barcode readers, and other mobile operational devices. * Experience administering network infrastructure across international locations. * Familiarity with Microsoft NPS, RADIUS, and Microsoft Entra ID\-related network authentication. * Experience with SD\-WAN, redundant internet connectivity, and multi\-site VPN architectures. * Knowledge of fiber\-optic networking, structured cabling, and network equipment installation standards. * Familiarity with network automation, scripting, or centralized configuration management. **Professional Skills \& Competencies** * Ability to work independently and take ownership of network infrastructure projects. * Strong analytical, diagnostic, and problem\-solving abilities. * Excellent organizational, documentation, and time\-management skills. * Ability to coordinate technical activities across geographically distributed facilities. * Strong communication skills when working with technical personnel, local management, vendors, and service providers. * Ability to prioritize network incidents, maintenance, and infrastructure projects. * Comfortable performing both network engineering and routine administration responsibilities. * Ability to work effectively with limited supervision during domestic and international assignments. * Willingness to support critical infrastructure outside normal business hours when necessary. **Education \& Certifications** * Associate's or bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Networking, or a related field preferred. * Equivalent professional experience will be considered. * Cisco CCNA certification preferred. * Relevant wireless networking certifications are beneficial but not required. Demonstrated hands\-on technical proficiency and relevant experience are more important than formal education or certifications. **Travel \& Work Requirements** * Ability and willingness to travel domestically and internationally as business needs require. * Ability to obtain and maintain a valid passport and meet applicable international travel requirements. * Ability to work occasional evenings or weekends for planned maintenance, infrastructure implementations, or critical incidents. * Ability to perform on\-site network equipment installation and troubleshooting, including work in network closets, equipment rooms, and warehouse environments. * Ability to coordinate projects and technical support across multiple time zones. **Position Expectations** This is a hands\-on global network engineering and administration role, not an architecture\-only or network monitoring position. The successful candidate must be equally comfortable designing network solutions, implementing infrastructure, troubleshooting complex problems, and performing ongoing network administration. **Enterprise Wi\-Fi design and troubleshooting expertise is a primary requirement.** Candidates whose experience is limited to routine wireless administration or basic access point configuration will not meet the technical expectations of this position.

Citi provides consumers, corporations, governments, and institutions with a broad range of financial products and services, including consumer banking and credit, corporate and investment banking, securities brokerage, transaction services, and wealth management. Our commitment to diversity includes a workforce that represents the clients we serve from all walks of life, backgrounds, and origins. We foster an environment where the best people want to work. We value and demand respect for others, promote individuals based on merit, and ensure opportunities for personal development are widely available to all. Ideal candidates are innovators with well\-rounded backgrounds who bring their authentic selves to work and complement our culture of delivering results with pride. If you are a problem solver who seeks passion in your work, come join us. We’ll enable growth and progress together. **Position Overview:** We are seeking a highly motivated AI Lead Engineer to design, develop, and deploy AI\-powered applications and agentic solutions that enhance business processes and client delivery capabilities. This role is primarily hands\-on and requires strong software engineering, data engineering, and AI/ML expertise with a focus on building scalable enterprise solutions. jobs.title: Data Scientist, Development
jobs.description: Citrin Cooperman offers a dynamic work environment, fostering professional growth and collaboration. We’re continuously seeking talented individuals who bring a problem\-solving mindset, fresh perspectives, and sharp technical expertise. We know you have choices, so our team of collaborative, innovative professionals are ready to support your professional development. At Citrin Cooperman, we offer competitive compensation and benefits and most importantly, the flexibility to manage your personal and professional life to focus on what matters most to you! We are seeking a **Data Operations Scientist, Development**, to join our Development team within the Information Technology department. While our parallel AI Solutions team focuses on Generative AI and Agentic pilots, we’re seeking a dedicated Data Operations Scientist to own our core predictive analytics, statistical modeling, and traditional Machine Learning (ML) capabilities. In this role, you’ll be the analytical powerhouse of our “Base Plan.” You’ll work directly with the Database Administrator and Data Engineers to ensure our Medallion architecture (bronze, silver, gold layers) is optimized not just for BI reporting, but for feature engineering and model training at scale. Utilizing Microsoft Fabric’s Synapse and Databricks, you’ll design, train, and deploy robust ML models that solve tangible business problems, including but not limited to customer churn prediction, demand forecasting, and operational optimization. The ideal candidate is a pragmatic statistician and coder who values MLOps discipline, model interpretability, and stable production deployments over experimental hype. **Responsibilities are, but not limited to:** * **Predictive Modeling \& Advanced Analytics:** Design, train, and validate traditional machine learning models (e.g., regression, classification, clustering, time\-series forecasting) using Python, PySpark, and established libraries (Scikit\-Learn, XGBoost, LightGBM). * **Feature Engineering \& Data Shaping:** Partner closely with Data Engineers to design the “Gold” data layer. Create and manage robust feature pipelines, ensuring data is properly structured, normalized, and optimized for both training and low\-latency inference. * **MLOps \& Model Lifecycle Management:** Deploy models into production within the Microsoft Fabric ecosystem. Establish the MLOps pipelines required to track model versions (e.g., using MLflow), monitor for concept/data drift, and trigger automated retraining when performance degrades. * **Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA):** Conduct deep\-dive statistical analyses on large, complex enterprise datasets (housed in OneLake/SQL) to uncover hidden patterns, validate business hypotheses, and inform strategic decision\-making. * **Collaboration \& Translation:** Act as the bridge between raw data and business strategy. Translate complex statistical outcomes into clear, actionable insights for non\-technical stakeholders, often partnering with BI developers to integrate model outputs into Power BI dashboards. * **Algorithm Governance:** Document model methodologies, assumptions, and limitations to ensure compliance with enterprise data governance and algorithmic fairness standards. **The ideal candidate must:** * Have a bachelor’s degree in computer science, data engineering, mathematics, or equivalent practical experience. * Have 3–5 years of professional experience as a Data Scientist, Machine Learning Engineer, or Advanced Analyst in a corporate environment. * Have deep proficiency in Python and SQL, with strong hands\-on experience using industry\-standard data science and ML libraries (Pandas, NumPy, Scikit\-Learn, PyTorch/TensorFlow). * Have proven experience with Big Data processing frameworks (Apache Spark, PySpark) and modern cloud data platforms (Microsoft Fabric, Databricks, or Azure Machine Learning heavily preferred). * Possess a solid foundation in statistics, probability, and mathematics, with the ability to mathematically justify model selection and evaluation metrics (RMSE, F1\-score, AUC\-ROC). * Have experience implementing MLOps best practices, including model registry management, containerized deployments, and performance monitoring. * Possess strong business acumen and the ability to connect statistical improvements directly to business ROI. * **Be pragmatic problem solver:** Chooses the simplest, most explainable model (like a well\-tuned random forest) that solves the business problem, rather than over\-engineering a complex neural network just for the sake of it. * **Be rigorous \& methodical:** Deeply respects data quality and understands that a model is only as good as the pipelines feeding it. Naturally skeptical of “perfect” training results. * **Be a cross\-functional collaborator:** Thrives in a team setting. Eager to sit down with a Data Engineer to optimize a Spark query or with a TPM to scope a sprint, rather than working in an isolated research silo. * Be Microsoft certified: Azure Data Science Associate (DP\-100\) (preferred). * Be Microsoft certified: Fabric Analytics Engineer Associate (DP\-600\) (preferred). * Be Databricks certified: Machine Learning Associate (PL\-300\) (preferred).

jobs.description: **Job Type:** Flexible Contract (Remote) **Job Summary:** We are hiring PhD\-level Cybersecurity Research Scientists for a contract project that tests whether frontier AI models can handle real security research work. PhD candidates and students are welcome to apply. * Hands\-on research or industry experience in security, such as vulnerability research, reverse engineering, malware analysis, applied cryptography, systems security or network security. jobs.title: Data Scientist I – Production Analytics
jobs.description: PLEASE NOTE BEFORE APPLYING: CODOXO IS NOT ABLE TO OFFER SPONSORSHIP OR ACCOMMODATE ANY CANDIDATES THAT ARE CURRENTLY BEING SPONSORED NOW OR IN THE FUTURE Of the $3\.8T we spend on healthcare in the United States annually, about a third of it is estimated to be lost due to waste, fraud and abuse. Codoxo is the premier provider of artificial intelligence\-driven solutions and services that help healthcare companies and agencies proactively detect and reduce risks from fraud, waste, and abuse and ensure payment integrity. Codoxo helps clients manage costs across network management, clinical care, provider coding and billing, payment integrity, and special investigation units. Our software\-as\-a service applications are built on our proven Forensic AI Engine, which uses patented AI\-based technology to identify problems and suspicious behavior far faster and earlier than traditional techniques. We are venture backed by some of the top investors in the country, with strong financials, and remain one of the fastest growing healthcare AI companies in the industry. ***Position Summary***: Our Data Science team builds and runs the statistical detection, scoring, and reporting engines behind Codoxo’s products. Everything that team has shipped is now live across a growing client base, and supporting it well has become a substantial body of work in its own right. That is where you will start. As Data Scientist I, you will join the Data Science team to help run and support the analytics we already have in production — the client configurations, the recurring reporting workflows, the detection logic, and the code and pipelines underneath them. Early on you will focus on the recurring work and on learning how our systems fit together: configuring clients onto existing products, validating scheduled reports, and investigating issues with a senior data scientist alongside you. As you build that knowledge, you will take on more of this work independently and contribute directly to the production codebase. This is a hands\-on technical role and a deliberate entry point into our platform. You will learn our claims data, our statistical methodology, and a large production Python codebase from people who built it, with support and code review throughout. It is a role designed to grow: the more of our production analytics you can carry, the more time our senior data scientists have for open research questions — reducing false positives, learning patterns across our client base, and catching new forms of fraud, waste, and abuse earlier — and the sooner you will be working on those questions yourself. ***Key Responsibilities****:* Support production analytics and client reporting* Configure new clients to run the analytical workflows and reports included in their purchased solutions, and help maintain those configurations as client needs change. * Validate the monthly and quarterly reporting cadences: confirm jobs execute on schedule, and validate output for accuracy and completeness before delivery. * Investigate failures and unexpected results, and resolve them or escalate with a clear picture of what you found. * Support client\-specific requests for claims examples, analytical validation, and supporting data. * Help turn recurring problems into durable fixes: automate manual steps, add validation checks that catch issues earlier, and document configurations, known issues, and resolutions. Learn and contribute to the production codebase * Contribute to the changes our production analytics code needs to stay secure, compliant, and supported — for example, updating how our jobs authenticate to our databases in response to a security requirement, or upgrading a framework version across the pipelines that depend on it. You will pair with senior data scientists and engineers on this work at first, and take on more of it as you go. * Get comfortable in a large existing Python codebase: read code you did not write, trace how a workflow actually runs, and find every place a pattern is used rather than only the obvious ones. * Write and update unit tests, take your changes through code review and CI, and validate them in a development environment before they reach production. * Build an understanding of how a change behaves in production — not only whether it works, but whether it holds up inside a long\-running job, at a large client’s data volume, or on a path that only one client exercises. * Work with Data Engineering and Platform Engineering on data quality, pipeline, and infrastructure issues that cross team boundaries. Investigate and help improve existing analytical logic * Keep an eye on the output quality of our production statistical detectors and scoring logic. * Investigate detectors flagged as noisy, low\-value, or behaving unexpectedly: analyze the underlying claims and flagged entities to determine whether the cause is data quality, client configuration, detector parameters, or the statistical logic itself. * Handle wel dependently, investigate issues on your own, and make your first reviewed changes to the codebase and to detector configuration. * **Toward the end of your first year:** own a meaningful share of our production analytics end to end, lead maintenance and compliance changes through review, and begin contributing to new analytical work. Growth Path As your depth in our data, code, and payment integrity methodology grows, the scope of your work grows with it — designing and evaluating new statistical detectors, contributing to new product capabilities, improving peer grouping and risk methodologies, and partnering with senior Data Scientists on open research problems. ***Qualifications:**** Bachelor’s degree in Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field. * 0–2 years of experience in data science, analytics, data engineering, or software engineering. Strong internships and academic projects count. * Working proficiency in Python and SQL, and the confidence to read code you did not write. * Familiarity with git and the basics of code review and testing. * Foundational statistics: distributions, variability, and how to tell a real signal from noise. * Strong debugging instincts — given an unexpected number, you are willing to work backward through data, code, configuration, and workflow to find where it went wrong. * Strong attention to detail. Much of this work reaches clients, and quietly wrong output is worse than a failed job. * Ability to keep several recurring deliverables on schedule. * Clear written communication, and good judgment about when to keep going and when to ask for help. * Genuine curiosity about complex healthcare data and a willingness to learn the payment integrity domain. * Remote Work Requirements: To ensure reliable performance on the company\-issued CODOXO laptop, employees working remotely must have a stable high\-speed internet connection. Internet performance should be measured using a speed test conducted directly on the CODOXO laptop, not based solely on the internet plan purchased from the provider. * Physical Requirements: Work is performed in an office environment (either in our office or work\-from home) and requires the ability to work on a computer, operate standard office equipment, and work at a desk. Nice to Have * Experience with healthcare claims data or healthcare analytics, and coding systems such as ICD\-10, CPT, or HCPCS. * pandas, NumPy, or comparable Python data libraries. * Exposure to production data pipelines or scheduled workflows (Airflow or similar). * AWS or another major cloud platform; Spark or other distributed processing. * SQL\-based data warehouses and query performance tuning. * Statistical testing, regression, anomaly detection, or clustering in practice. * Awareness of security or compliance requirements in a regulated environment (HIPAA, FedRAMP, SOC 2\). * Familiarity with machine learning concepts and model evaluation. *Accessibility Notice: If you need reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process due to a physical or mental disability, please send an email to careers@codoxo.com with the subject "Accommodation". Reasonable accommodation requests will be considered on a case\-by\-case basis.* **Benefits for You*** Health, Dental, and Vision insurance with 100% employee premium coverage (Starts Day 1\) * Unlimited PTO * Annual Professional Development stipend * Annual home office stipend * 401K Match (after 90 days) **We are an Equal Opportunity Employer**: Codoxo provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment.

to 20 survey waves and scale to approximately 600 waves annually without substantial rewriting of the core processing system. * Incorporate forecast\-office\-distributed surveys and purchased exception reports for unexpected variables, coding changes, duplicate records, missing metadata, invalid values, and other data inconsistencies. * Produce fully documented and analysis\-ready data dictionaries, change histories, and standard operating procedures in an approved version\-control environment. * Follow applicable Institutional Review Board requirements. **Conditions of cross\-sectional, or multi\-source datasets. * Experience working with confidential, restricted, or human\-subjects research data. * Familiarity with survey weights and sample\-design variables. * Experience using R and packages such as haven or the tidyverse. * Experience producing consistent Stata, R, and CSV outputs from a common data\-processing workflow. * Experience using LLM\-assisted programming tools for code development, schema comparison, testing, or documentation. * Experience working in an academic research center, government agency, policy institute, or similar research setting. * Experience in social science research. * Strong technical writing, documentation, problem\-solving, and communication skills as evidenced by an appropriate cover letter. Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a remote research environment as evidenced by prior remote work experience. * **Application Instructions:** ----------------------------- * Applications must be submitted via online portal. Cover Letter, Resume/CV **Employee Benefits** ===================== Colorado State University is not just a workplace; it’s a thriving community that’s transforming lives and improving the human condition through world\-class teaching, research, and service. jobs.title: Lead Software Engineer
jobs.description: The Lead Software Engineer applies advanced knowledge of software engineering principles, modern architectural patterns, and emerging delivery methodologies to drive the technical direction of complex, distributed software platforms at the Release Train level. Serving as an influential participant in solution discovery and architectural decision\-making, this role leads milestone and epic\-level technical solutioning across the value stream's product portfolio; defines reference implementations and engineering standards for the teams it supports; and partners across release trains to ensure architectural coherence as the platform evolves. This role applies effective influence and collaboration\-without formal management authority\-across Engineering, Product, Architecture, and SRE to drive decisions and unblock delivery throughout the software development lifecycle. The Lead Software Engineer takes the lead on difficult technical problem\-solving and cross\-team coordination, predicts and documents potential architectural risks and constraints, and leverages AI\-assisted engineering tooling to compound their own and the broader engineering organization's productivity. As engineering teams increasingly rely on AI\-generated code, the Lead Software Engineer serves as a thought leader in evolving solution discovery practices to meet this shift \- defining how architectural intent, integration contracts, and implementation patterns are embedded into spec\-driven development workflows and AI coding agent configurations, ensuring technical direction is established at the point of generation rather than discovered through downstream rework. **What You'll Do** * Owns milestone and epic\-level solution discovery for the assigned value stream portfolio, producing implementation\-ready technical specifications that AI Transformed and AI Enabled delivery teams can execute while reducing the need for iterative clarification. * Defines technical standards and reference implementations for the value stream's product architectures, ensuring consistency across the portfolio and clear patterns for delivery teams to follow. * Partners with Value Stream Architects, peer Release Train level engineers, and adjacent release trains to align technical direction, surface architectural risks, and drive cross\-train decisions before they become delivery blockers. * Identifies teams with architectural drift, technical debt, or capability gaps and embeds to lead remediation \- coaching on patterns, driving solution design, and verifying technical readiness before delivery commitments are made. * Drives adoption of spec\-driven development across the value stream's delivery teams, embedding architectural intent and integration contracts into the artifacts AI coding agents and engineers consume \- rather than relying on post\-implementation correction. * Serves as the right hand to the incident commander during production incidents, providing technical depth across the value stream's product surface, accelerating diagnosis, and driving decisive remediation. * Remains the tip of the spear on emerging engineering technologies \- including AI\-assisted development, spec\-driven workflows, and modern integration patterns \- through hands\-on adoption, then transfers that capability to delivery teams through structured mentorship and reference work. * Identifies architectural risks within the value stream's technology footprint, defines mitigation strategies, and drives them to documented decisions that set forward\-looking technical direction. **Who You Are** * Bachelor's degree (list any requirements of discipline here) and 6 years' experience in a related field. The right candidate could also have a different combination, such as a master's degree and 4 years' experience; a Ph.D. and 1 year of experience; or 18 years' experience in a related field. * Hands\-on experience with full\-stack development, including technologies such as StencilJS and C\#, in addition to designing and delivering distributed software systems, including API design, integration patterns, and cloud\-native architectures (AWS or equivalent). * Hands\-on experience leading technical solution discovery for complex initiatives, producing specifications and architectural artifacts that other engineers execute against. * Experience with modern delivery methodologies including spec\-driven development, Agile practices at scale, and AI\-assisted engineering workflows. * Reviews product requirements and system designs with an architectural lens, contributing technical direction during discovery and driving implementation patterns that support maintainability, scalability, and resilience. * Skilled at building partnerships with Product, Architecture, and Engineering teams both inside and outside of the organization, and at driving decisions across organizational boundaries without formal authority. * Remains current on software engineering tooling, architectural patterns, and emerging methodologies, recommending and driving adoption of approaches that measurably improve delivery throughput, technical quality, or engineering productivity. * Demonstrated experience working with AI coding tools (such as Claude, Copilot, or equivalent) and the ability to define and implement architectural guardrails within agent configurations, constitutions, or briefings **Compensation:** Compensation includes a base salary in the range of $0\.00 \- $0\.00\. The base salary may vary within the anticipated base pay range based on factors such as the ultimate location of the position and the selected candidate's knowledge, skills, and abilities. Position may be eligible for additional compensation that may include an incentive program. **Benefits:** The Company offers eligible employees the flexibility to take as much vacation with pay as they deem consistent with their duties, the company's needs, and its obligations; seven paid holidays throughout the calendar year; and up to 160 hours of paid wellness annually for their own wellness or that of family members. Employees are also eligible for additional paid time off in the form of bereavement leave, time off to vote, jury duty leave, volunteer time off, military leave, and parental leave.

jobs.description: For more than 60 years, Data Device Corporation (DDC) has been recognized as a world leader in the design and manufacture of high\-reliability Connectivity, Power, and Control solutions for the Aerospace, Defense, and Space industries. Our dedication to supplying quality products, on\-time delivery, and superior support, has contributed to the success of our customers and the critical missions they serve. **This position is 100% onsite at our Bohemia, NY office.** ***The salary range for this position is $80,000 to $105,000 annually and will depend upon experience.*** This position requires a U.S Person or a person who can qualify for a Department of State or Department of Commerce License. **Position Summary:** The Test Engineer designs, develops, integrates, maintains, troubleshoots, and modernizes production test equipment, ranging from manual fixtures to complex automated test systems. These systems support testing of hybrid microelectronic components, circuit card assemblies, and avionics equipment. The role combines hands\-on electronics troubleshooting, test software development, instrumentation, and system\-level problem solving to sustain reliable manufacturing operations and deliver new testing capabilities. Success requires technical ownership, timely completion of assigned deliverables, proactive communication, and effective collaboration across engineering and manufacturing teams. **Key Position Accountabilities:** * Maintain, troubleshoot, and repair production test equipment; diagnose root causes, verify corrective actions, and minimize downtime and repeat failures. Using schematics and instruments (oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, DMMs, and power supplies) to isolate faults, validate repairs, and confirm performance. * Develop, modify, and optimize automated test software using Visual Basic, C\+\+, C\# or other applicable languages, while creating and maintaining Cadence OrCAD schematics and integrating hardware/software changes to ensure accurate, reliable, and repeatable test system performance. * Troubleshoot CAN, I2C, GPIB, RS485, RS232, and MIL\-STD\-1553 interfaces to maintain reliable communication with units under test. * Develop, implement, and troubleshoot JTAG/boundary\-scan tests to improve fault isolation, detect assembly defects, and maintain appropriate coverage. * Create and maintain test procedures, validation records, and maintenance documentation to ensure consistent operation and effective troubleshooting. * Plan and own assigned work from requirements through verification and closeout; meet milestones, identify risks early, and communicate delays and resource needs. * Collaborate with Test, Product, and Manufacturing Engineering, Quality, Operations, and suppliers to resolve issues, share expertise, and implement solutions. * Support and document qualification and certification testing to demonstrate compliance with applicable product and customer requirements. **Minimum Qualifications:** * Bachelor’s degree in Engineering Technology (electronics focus) or related engineering discipline; minimum three years of relevant hands\-on test engineering experience. * Familiarity with electronic manufacturing and testing of circuit card assemblies, hybrid electronics, or similar products. Knowledge of AC/DC and semiconductor circuit theory, schematic interpretation, laboratory instrumentation, electronic fault isolation, and test hardware integration. * Ability to develop or troubleshoot test software in at least one relevant language (e.g., Visual Basic, C\#, or C\+\+). * Demonstrated ability to complete assignments on schedule, document technical work, communicate risks promptly, and collaborate across teams. * Hands\-on JTAG/boundary\-scan implementation or troubleshooting experience, including fault isolation and test coverage considerations. **Preferred Qualifications:** * Experience with multiple programming languages, especially Visual Basic, C\+\+, and C\#; familiarity with scripting, LabVIEW, or test automation frameworks. * Experience with CAN, I2C, GPIB, RS485, RS232, or MIL\-STD\-1553 interfaces. * Experience modernizing legacy test platforms or integrating modular instrumentation, including VXI/PXI/PXIe. * Knowledge of MIL\-STD\-883, MIL\-PRF\-38534, MIL\-M\-38510, and IPC\-A\-610, as applicable. * Experience coordinating technical solutions with equipment vendors and outside suppliers. * Proficiency with Microsoft Office; familiarity with Microsoft Access. **Desired Characteristics:** * Proactive, hands\-on problem solver who takes responsibility for delivering complete and verified solutions. * Dependable and organized; balances independent execution with timely requests for input and collaborative problem solving. * Communicates transparently about progress, obstacles, priorities, and commitments. * Curious about emerging test technologies and practical continuous improvement.
