jobs.title: Associate DevOps Engineer
jobs.description: **\#GetThereFirst** Digital Hands is an innovative Managed Security Service Provider (MSSP) with a mission to protect customer data and make technology available, productive and secure with the strongest talent in the cyber industry. Members of the Digital Hands Team work with leading technologies and protect a dynamic set of enterprise\-class customers including best\-known brands in the hospitality, financial, manufacturing and communications industries. Digital Hands employees enjoy competitive compensation and benefits, training opportunities, personal skills development, and opportunities for professional advancement across the organization. Digital Hands is comprised of innovators leading from the front, fueled by a desire to achieve, test new boundaries, and a determination to do whatever it takes to get there first every time. Ideal candidates believe in the mission and vision of the company and have a genuine love for what they do. At Digital Hands, we take ownership, obsess over our promises, anticipate our customers' needs. and get ahead of every threat so that our customers can focus on their business with the peace of mind that only comes from knowing their cyberworld is secure. **Join Us in the Fight Against Cyber Threats!** Digital Hands is seeking a Associate DevOps Engineer to join our DevOps team and help build, deploy, maintain, and improve the applications, cloud services, integrations, and automation that support our Security Operations Center (SOC). This is a hands\-on, early\-career software and cloud engineering role with an emphasis on scripting, application development, debugging, cloud deployment, APIs, databases, automation, and infrastructure as code. You will work with DevOps engineers, ServiceNow administrators, SOC team members, and other stakeholders to deliver reliable technical solutions and streamline operational processes. ServiceNow is a secondary but important part of the role. The successful candidate must be able to support and extend ServiceNow through administration, configuration, workflows, integrations, reporting, and automation while continuing to grow broader DevOps and development capabilities. This is a full\-time, onsite position located at Digital Hands Headquarters in Tampa, Florida. **About You** * **You're a Developer and Automator:** You enjoy writing code and scripts, integrating systems, eliminating repetitive work, and turning operational needs into reliable technical solutions. * **You're Cloud\-Oriented:** You understand modern cloud services and are comfortable learning how applications are deployed, operated, monitored, and improved in AWS, GCP, or similar environments. * **You're a Problem Solver:** You can break down technical issues, investigate root causes, test solutions, and improve reliability through disciplined debugging and analysis. * **You're Collaborative:** You work effectively with engineering and operational teams, communicate clearly, and translate requirements into practical implementations. * **You're Continuously Learning:** You are motivated to expand your software engineering, DevOps, cloud, security, and ServiceNow skills in a fast\-paced MSSP environment. **What You'll Do** * **Develop and Automate:** Write, test, debug, and maintain scripts, services, integrations, and automation using Python, JavaScript, or similar languages. * **Build and Support Cloud Solutions:** Deploy and maintain applications in AWS, GCP, or similar cloud environments using cloud\-native and serverless services where appropriate. * **Integrate Systems and Data:** Work with REST APIs, event\-driven services, queues, relational databases, and non\-relational databases to connect platforms and support operational workflows. * **Improve Delivery Practices:** Contribute to source control, code review, testing, release processes, monitoring, documentation, and infrastructure\-as\-code practices. * **Troubleshoot and Maintain:** Investigate application, integration, platform, and cloud issues; identify root causes; and implement durable fixes that improve performance and reliability. * **Support ServiceNow:** Administer and configure users, groups, roles, permissions, forms, notifications, reports, dashboards, and workflows. Support ServiceNow integrations and automation, including Flow Designer, as part of the broader DevOps environment. * **Partner with the SOC:** Work with DevOps and SOC teams to improve the applications, integrations, and workflows used to deliver cybersecurity services. * **Document and Improve:** Maintain technical documentation, procedures, configuration records, and knowledge articles while identifying opportunities to simplify processes and increase automation. **What You Bring** **Required** * Experience with Python, JavaScript, or another scripting or programming language through professional work, internships, coursework, or personal projects. * Experience deploying an application or service to AWS, GCP, or a similar cloud en  such as PostgreSQL and non\-relational databases such as DynamoDB or MongoDB. * Experience using AI coding tools such as GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, or Cursor to write, debug, and refactor code, combined with the judgment to review and validate generated output. * Experience building or supporting ServiceNow workflows, Flow Designer automations, integrations, or platform configurations. * Solid debugging skills and comfort giving and receiving code review feedback. **Preferred** * Familiarity with infrastructure\-as\-code tools such as Terraform or Serverless Framework. * Experience with CI/CD concepts and tools used to build, test, and deploy applications. * Basic understanding of system design concepts, including component boundaries, interfaces, data flows, reliability, and scalability. * Experience with Security Operations Center environments and security tools such as Microsoft Sentinel, Google SecOps, CrowdStrike, SentinelOne, or SOAR platforms. * Ability to get up to speed quickly in an unfamiliar codebase and technical environment. **The Team You'll Join** As part of the Digital Hands DevOps team, you will help develop and maintain the applications, automation, integrations, and cloud services that support our Security Operations Center. While this position does not perform security monitoring or incident analysis, your work will directly support the systems and workflows the SOC relies on to deliver cybersecurity services to Digital Hands customers. Whether you are writing a script, deploying a cloud service, troubleshooting an integration, improving a ServiceNow workflow, or automating a manual process, you will help make our technology environment more reliable, scalable, maintainable, and efficient while building a strong foundation in DevOps engineering. Digital Hands is dedicated to a diverse and inclusive workplace and culture, and proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, reproductive health decisions, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, genetic information, political views or activity, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. Digital Hands is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please contact us at *talentmanagement@digitalhands.com**.* Digital Hands participates in the U.S. Government's E\-Verify program to determine employment eligibility. In compliance with the federal government, all hired applicants will be required to verify identity and employment eligibility upon hire. To learn more about E\-Verify, please visit *dhs.gov/e\-verify*. *This link* *leads to the machine readable files that are made available in response to the federal Transparency in Coverage Rule and includes negotiated service rates and out\-of\-network allowed amounts between health plans and healthcare providers. The machine\-readable files are formatted to allow researchers, regulators, and application developers to more easily access and analyze data.* By submitting your application, you agree that Digital Hands may collect, use, and process your information, which may include personal information and sensitive personal information, in connection with Digital Hands' recruitment activities. You may delete your application and/or unsubscribe from receiving notifications of career opportunities at Digital Hands at any time. For additional details on how Digital Hands uses and protects your personal information in the application process, including your rights under the California Privacy Rights Act ("CPRA"), click here to view our Privacy Notice.

jobs.title: Cloud & Data Center Engineer
jobs.description: Dorman was founded on the belief that people should have greater freedom to fix motor vehicles. For over 100 years, we have been driving new solutions, releasing tens of thousands of aftermarket replacement products engineered to save time and money, and increase convenience and reliability. Founded and headquartered in the United States, we are a pioneering global organization offering an always\-evolving catalog of automotive, heavy\-duty and specialty vehicle products. Today, we have more than 3,800 employees across 29 different locations, with a family of brands that also includes SuperATV and Dayton Parts. Reaching a revenue of $2\.13 billion in 2025, Dorman is publicly traded under the stock ticker DORM. Everyone who works at Dorman is called a Contributor. We need everyone, regardless of role and experience, to contribute to our success. That means everyone has a unique ability to make an impact on the business. We encourage all our Contributors to bring their authentic selves to work. The freedom to pursue new ideas, offer different perspectives, and grow in your career is fundamental to working at Dorman. **Job Summary** --------------- The Cloud \& Data Center Engineer is a hands\-on infrastructure role that supports the day\-to\-day operation, reliability, and improvement of Dorman's on\-premises data center and cloud environments. Reporting to the Lead System Analyst, this position provides operational support across compute, storage, virtualization, backup, monitoring, and cloud infrastructure, with a primary focus on Amazon Web Services (AWS) and supporting responsibilities in Microsoft Azure. The engineer works within established architecture, security, and operational standards, partners with network, security, application, and service teams, and escalates complex design or production issues as appropriate. The role emphasizes dependable operations, automation, documentation, incident response, and continued technical growth across hybrid infrastructure. The role is expected to provide operational support across Dorman's hybrid infrastructure footprint, including AWS cloud services, VMware virtualization, NetApp storage, Veeam backup and recovery platforms, and Datadog monitoring solutions. This role follows a hybrid work model requiring at least one day per week onsite in our corporate headquarters in suburban Philadelphia (Colmar, PA), typically Thursday. Candidates must have flexibility to adjust their onsite day(s) based on business demands, meetings, and collaboration needs. **Primary Duties** ------------------ * Support, maintain, and troubleshoot on\-premises data center and cloud infrastructure, including compute, storage, virtualization, operating systems, backup, and monitoring platforms. * Provision and administer AWS infrastructure and provide supporting administration in Azure using established standards, templates, and change\-management processes. * Support and administer VMware virtualization environments, NetApp storage platforms, Veeam backup and recovery solutions, and Datadog monitoring infrastructure, including configuration, performance tuning, capacity management, troubleshooting, upgrades, and lifecycle management. * Assist with Infrastructure\-as\-Code and automation using tools such as Terraform, CloudFormation, ARM/Bicep, scripting, and approved CI/CD pipelines. * Monitor infrastructure health, availability, performance, capacity, and backup status; respond to alerts and help resolve incidents and recurring problems. * Support hybrid connectivity and shared infrastructure services, including DNS, identity integrations, private connectivity, certificates, and access controls in coordination with network and security teams. * Apply security and compliance requirements for identity, encryption, patching, vulnerability remediation, logging, and configuration management. * Assist with cloud cost management by maintaining tagging, reviewing utilization, identifying rightsizing opportunities, and supporting budgets and alerts. * Execute approved changes, maintenance activities, migrations, and disaster recovery tests, including participation in scheduled after\-hours work and an on\-call rotation as required. * Create and maintain technical documentation, diagrams, asset records, standard operating procedures, and recovery runbooks; share knowledge with peers and support teams. * Contribute to infrastructure projects and continuous\-improvement initiatives under the direction of senior technical staff and the Lead Data Center Engineer. **Qualifications** ------------------ * Working knowledge of AWS infrastructure services and foundational knowledge of Azure. * Hands\-on experience supporting enterprise infrastructure in production environments, including VMware virtualization, NetApp storage, Veeam backup and recovery, Datadog monitoring, and Windows and/or Linux systems. * Familiarity with Infrastructure\-as\-Code and automation concepts; practical experience with Terraform, CloudFormation, ARM/Bicep, PowerShell, Python, or similar tools is preferred. * Working knowledge of TCP/IP, DNS, firewalls, VPNs, cloud networking, identity and access management, and hybrid connectivity concepts. * Experience with observability and incident response tools such as Datadog, CloudWatch, Azure Monitor, or comparable platforms. * Understanding of infrastructure security fundamentals, patching, vulnerability remediation, encryption, least privilege, and change management. * Ability to troubleshoot methodically, document work clearly, manage competing priorities, and communicate effectively with technical and business partners. * Willingness to learn across both on\-premises and cloud technologies and to escalate when an issue exceeds the role's authority or expertise. **Education / Experience** -------------------------- * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. * 3\+ years of experience in infrastructure, systems, data center, cloud, or platform operations. * Hands\-on experience supporting production infrastructure; AWS experience is preferred and Azure experience is a plus. * Experience administering VMware environments, NetApp storage systems, Veeam backup and recovery platforms, and Datadog monitoring solutions is strongly preferred. Experience supporting Windows and Linux infrastructure in enterprise environments is required. * Associate or administrator\-level certifications are preferred, such as AWS Solutions Architect \- Associate, AWS SysOps Administrator \- Associate, Microsoft Azure Administrator Associate, VMware VCP, or comparable credentials. * Experience supporting data, analytics, or AI platform infrastructure is a plus, but is not required. \#LI\-EK1 The US base salary range for this full\-time position is $92,700\.00 to $138,000\.00\. This role is also eligible for a bonus. The actual base pay offered to the successful candidate will depend on multiple factors, including but not limited to job\-related knowledge and skills, experience, business needs, geographical location, and internal pay equity. Compensation decisions are made based on the specific facts and circumstances of each role and candidate. As a Dorman US contributor, you (and eligible dependents, as applicable) will have access to medical, dental, vision, basic life insurance, paid time off (sick/vacation), and Paid Parental Leave. U.S. employees are entitled to paid holidays, floating holidays, and paid time off starting in their first year of employment depending on hire date. You are also able to participate in our 401k retirement plan (with company match and profit\-sharing) and Discounted Employee Stock Purchase Plan. Dorman Products is an equal opportunity employer; we value a combination of ideas, perspectives, and cultures at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. EEO/AA Employer M/F/D/V. www.DormanProducts.com

jobs.title: Senior AI Engineer
jobs.description: **Who We Are** ============== DoubleVerify is the leading independent provider of marketing measurement software, data and analytics that authenticates the quality and effectiveness of digital media for the world's largest brands and media platforms. DV provides media transparency and accountability to deliver the highest level of impression quality for maximum advertising performance. Since 2008, DV has helped hundreds of Fortune 500 companies gain the most from their media spend by delivering best\-in\-class solutions across the digital advertising ecosystem, helping to build a better industry. Learn more at www.doubleverify.com . **Role Overview** ================= We are looking for a talented and driven **Senior AI Engineer** to join the Pinnacle AI (PinAI) team at DoubleVerify. In this role, you will be a core builder of **AgentOS** — our agentic AI platform that powers conversational, intelligent experiences across the Pinnacle advertising analytics suite. You will design and implement AI agents, Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, and LLM\-backed tools that allow Fortune 500 clients to interact with their advertising data through natural language. This is a hands\-on engineering role for someone who is passionate about applied AI, thrives in a fast\-moving environment, and wants to see their work directly impact how the world's largest advertisers make decisions. **What You'll Do** ================== ### **Agentic AI Development** * Design, build, and maintain AI agents within the AgentOS framework using architectures based on MCP (Model Context Protocol), LangChain, LangGraph, and related tooling * Develop new MCP servers and tools that expose Pinnacle analytics capabilities — including metrics, dimensions, settings, and user data — to AI agents * Implement multi\-turn conversational flows, tool\-use reasoning chains, and agent orchestration logic that handle complex, real\-world advertising analytics queries * Build and maintain the chat UI integration layer, connecting AgentOS to the Pinnacle front\-end experience ### **LLM Engineering \& Optimization** * Work with major LLM providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, and others) to select, prompt, and integrate models appropriate for specific agent tasks * Develop and own prompt engineering strategies, including system prompts, few\-shot examples, and chain\-of\-thought techniques * Implement Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines to ground AI responses in Pinnacle's proprietary data and documentation * Continuously optimize model performance through evals, latency tuning, and cost management ### **Evaluation \& Quality** * Build and maintain evaluation (evals) frameworks that measure agent accuracy, instruction\-following, hallucination rates, and user satisfaction * Define quality benchmarks and run regression evals on every agent change before production deployment * Instrument agents with observability tooling (e.g., LangSmith, Weights \& Biases, or custom tracing) to support debugging and continuous improvement ### **Integration \& Platform Engineering** * Integrate AgentOS with Pinnacle's existing platform services — including PIAM/Keycloak authentication, Settings APIs, and analytics data layers * Collaborate with backend teams to build and consume APIs that surface data cleanly and securely to AI agents * Participate in architecture reviews and contribute to technical design documents for new AI\-powered features ### **Cross\-Functional Collaboration** * Partner closely with Product, UX, and Data Science to translate business requirements into agent capabilities and conversational flows * Work with QE teams to define testing strategies for AI features, including behavioral testing and adversarial prompting Contribute to the team's shared AI engineering standards, best practices, and documentation * **Who You Are** =============== **Required Qualifications** --------------------------- ### **Experience:** * 5\+ years of professional software engineering experience building production\-grade systems * 2\+ years of hands\-on experience developing LLM\-based applications or AI agent systems * Demonstrated experience shipping AI\-powered features end\-to\-end, from prototype to production ### **Technical Expertise:** * **Agentic AI Frameworks:** Solid hands\-on experience with LangChain, LangGraph, or equivalent agent orchestration frameworks * **Model Context Protocol (MCP):** Familiarity with MCP or similar modular tool\-integration protocols for AI agents (or strong appetite to ramp quickly) * **LLM Integration:** Experience calling and integrating with LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini, or similar), including streaming, tool\-calling, and structured output patterns * **Python:** Strong Python proficiency; ability to build clean, testable, production\-quality backend services (FastAPI experience a plus) * **RAG \& Embeddings:** Understanding of retrieval\-augmented generation patterns, vector stores, and semantic search * **Evaluation Mindset:** Experience building or using eval frameworks to measure LLM/agent quality and regression\-test AI behavior * **Cloud \& Infrastructure:** Familiarity with cloud environments (GCP, AWS, or Azure) and containerization basics (Docker/Kubernetes) ### **Soft Skills:** * Strong problem\-solving skills with a bias toward shipping and iterating * Clear communicator — able to explain AI behavior and limitations to both technical peers and non\-technical stakeholders * Comfortable operating with ambiguity in a fast\-paced, evolving AI landscape * Collaborative team player who contributes actively to shared standards and code quality ### **Education:** BS/MS in Computer Science, Machine Learning, AI, or a related technical field * **Preferred Qualifications** ---------------------------- * Experience with MCP server development and tool\-use patterns in production agentic systems * Familiarity with IAM, Keycloak, or OAuth 2\.0\-based authentication patterns * Knowledge of advertising analytics, AdTech platforms, or BI tools (Looker, Snowflake, etc.) * Experience with modern front\-end frameworks (React/Angular) for conversational UI features * Contributions to open\-source AI projects or published work in AI/ML * Experience with agent evaluation tools such as DeepEval, LangSmith, or Braintrust Knowledge of responsible AI practices, including bias mitigation and hallucination reduction strategies * This position is full\-time and located in our New York City headquarters offices offering a hybrid work model from office and remote. The successful candidate’s starting salary will be determined by a number of non\-discriminatory factors, including qualifications for the role, level, skills, experience, location, and internal equity relative to peers at DV. The estimated salary range for this role, based on the qualifications set forth in the job description, is between $131,000 $241,000\. This role will also be eligible for bonus/commission (as applicable), equity, and benefits. The range above is for the expectations as laid out in the job description; however, we are often open to a wide variety of profiles and recognize that the person we hire may be more or less experienced than this job description as posted. **Not\-so\-fun fact:** Research shows that while men apply to jobs when they meet an average of 60% of job criteria, women and other marginalized groups tend to only apply when they check every box. So if you think you have what it takes but you’re not sure that you check every box, apply anyway!

jobs.title: Sr Product Security Engineer
jobs.description: **Sr Product Security Engineer** ================================ * **Business Unit:** Draeger Medical Systems, Inc., **Job\-ID:** 1398 * **Location:** Andover * **Function:** R\&D * **Work Location:** Hybrid * **Employment Type:** Permanent **The Job Responsibilities** ---------------------------- We are hiring a Senior Product Security Engineer to work hybrid, 3 days a week, in our Andover, MA office. The Senior Product Security engineer helps secure patient monitoring medical device solutions and connected health software throughout the product lifecycle. This role partners directly with systems, software, and test engineering teams to build security into product architectures, generate objective evidence for regulatory submissions, and maintain product cyber resilience after release. The selected candidate will support the integration of advanced cybersecurity controls, identify and mitigate vulnerabilities, and contribute to initiatives that improve cyber resilience across the product lifecycle. This person will serve as a technical subject matter expert, collaborate across functions, and help drive long\-term improvements in product security posture. This is a product security engineering role; it is not focused on enterprise IT security. Main Responsibilities: * Product Security \- Implement security requirements across the medical device development lifecycle by partnering with cross\-functional teams and applying best practices from design through deployment. * Perform threat modeling, attack\-surface analysis, and product cybersecurity risk assessments. Define security requirements and risk controls, and integrate cybersecurity risks with product safety risk management. * Support the design and delivery of secure medical devices through implementation of capabilities such as secure boot, secure communications, data protection, software update mechanisms, system integration protections, and access controls. * Plan and review cybersecurity testing, including vulnerability scanning, software composition analysis, fuzzing, and penetration testing. jobs.title: Site Reliability Engineer
jobs.description: **About E2B** ============= E2B is a fast\-growing Series A startup with over $37M in funding and 8\-figure revenue. We are building the Agent Cloud and power the infrastructure behind AI labs and some of the most widely used consumer and enterprise agents, including Manus, Genspark, Lindy, Groq, and Artificial Analysis. Our team includes original authors of Firecracker, the AWS microVM technology powering Lambda, along with alumni of Cognition, JetBrains, Zapier, and Wish. **About the role** ================== You'll build and operate the infrastructure that runs E2B in customers' AWS, Google Cloud, and Azure environments. You'll develop reusable Terraform modules, Helm charts, and automation for Kubernetes deployments, and take responsibility for how that infrastructure runs in production. The work spans cloud\-specific integrations, upgrades, and the tools needed to manage a growing fleet of customer environments. You'll work with software engineers across Enterprise Engineering to make customer deployments reliable and easy to operate. **What you'll do** ================== * Build and maintain versioned Terraform modules, Helm charts, and Kubernetes configurations for supported deployments on EKS, GKE, and AKS. * Own the production reliability of customer cluster infrastructure. Improve monitoring, alerting, capacity management, and recovery, and fix recurring operational problems. * Make infrastructure packages reusable across customer environments. Define configuration interfaces, compatibility checks, and release processes, and test installation, scaling, upgrades, rollbacks, and security patches. * Diagnose and resolve problems across Kubernetes, cloud networking, IAM, certificates, and storage, including private connectivity into customer environments. * Work with customer infrastructure and security teams on access controls, secrets management, isolation, and auditability. * Build infrastructure automation and contribute code to the orchestration services that deploy and operate E2B. Develop tests, deployment validation, drift detection, diagnostics, and runbooks that reduce manual work. * Work with FDE, Solutions, and Support on complex deployments and technical escalations, joining customer troubleshooting when needed. You'll participate in production on\-call for the components you own. **What we're looking for** ========================== * 5\+ years of production SRE, infrastructure, or platform engineering experience operating business\-critical services. * Deep experience operating and debugging production Kubernetes clusters, including networking, access control, node lifecycle, scheduling, autoscaling, and storage. * Strong Terraform and Helm skills, including production module and chart development, versioning, testing, and upgrades. * Deep expertise in AWS, GCP, or Azure, with the ability to work across providers. You should understand cloud networking, IAM, compute, and storage. * Strong Linux and networking fundamentals, including process isolation, filesystems, DNS, TCP/IP, and troubleshooting resource constraints. * Experience using metrics, logs, and traces to diagnose production issues, and testing recovery procedures. * Ability to write automation in Go, Python, Bash, or similar, and contribute tested changes to existing services. * Ability to explain technical tradeoffs and work through deployment issues with customer infrastructure teams. * Ability to take a problem from investigation through a production fix. **Nice to have** ================ * Building AI agents or applications that use tools, execute code, or run in sandboxes. * BYOC, self\-hosted, or managed enterprise software in customer\-controlled infrastructure. * Operating large fleets of Kubernetes clusters across organizations or clouds. * GitOps, Argo CD, Flux, Kubernetes operators, or custom controllers. * Air\-gapped environments, on\-premises deployments, or stringent enterprise security. * OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, or similar observability tools. * Firecracker, microVMs, sandbox isolation, or infrastructure for untrusted workloads. * Building deployment automation or internal infrastructure platforms. * Open\-source infrastructure contributions. **What it’s like to work at E2B** ================================= We’re a fast\-growing startup with in\-person (4 days on\-site, 1 day WFH) offices in **San Francisco and Prague, Czech Republic**. We already generate 8\-figure revenue and work directly with top\-tier AI companies like Manus, Genspark, Lindy, Groq, Artificial Analysis and other exciting teams pushing the frontier of AI. We offer healthcare, vision, and dental insurance, unlimited PTO, 401k, and a variety of perks for in\-office employees.

jobs.description: Introduction: Since 1973, East West Bank has served as a pathway to success. With over 110 locations across the U.S. and Asia, we are the premier financial bridge between the East and West. Our teams of experienced, multi\-cultural professionals help guide businesses and community members on both sides of the Pacific looking to explore new markets and create new opportunities, and our sustained growth and expertise in industries like real estate, entertainment and media, private equity and venture capital, and high\-tech help build sustainable businesses and expand our associates’ potential for career advancement. Headquartered in California, East West Bank (Nasdaq: EWBC) is a top\-performing commercial bank with a strong foundation, an enterprising spirit and a commitment to absolute integrity. East West Bank gives people the confidence to reach further. Overview: We are seeking an experienced **Cloud Site Reliability Engineer (SRE)** to improve the reliability, availability, performance, and operational efficiency of enterprise services running in Cloud. jobs.title: Scientist I, High-Throughput Biology
jobs.description: Eikon Therapeutics is a new biopharmaceutical company employing revolutionary technology at the intersection of chemistry, engineering, computation, and biology to discover novel treatments for life\-threatening diseases. Eikon's discovery platform is built on groundbreaking innovations from its founders (Nobel Prize, 2014\), culminating in the creation of microscopes which enable real time, molecular\-resolution measurements of protein movement in living cells, thereby unlocking otherwise intractable classes of proteins as drug targets. **Position** As a member of the High\-Throughput Biology Team, you will play a key role in pioneering drug discovery screening assays using Eikon's proprietary live\-cell, single\-molecule high\-throughput super\-resolution microscopy platform. You will work at the intersection of biology, automation engineering, and computational science to design, execute and deliver scalable, reproducible, decision\-enabling biological data that drives progress across drug discovery portfolios. **About You** You are a highly motivated, rigorous, and interdisciplinary scientist who enjoys developing, optimizing, and validating live\-cell imaging\-based assays at scale to push the frontier of drug discovery. You are creative, data\-driven, and skilled at problem solving in a fast\-paced, dynamic, and matrixed environment. You are conscientious, detail\-oriented, and organized, and are committed to delivering high\-quality and actionable data in a timely manner. You are an effective communicator and teammate who is eager to learn and collaborate with people from diverse scientific backgrounds. **What You'll Do** * Design, execute, and analyze robust and reproducible experiments to optimize, validate, and scale up live\-cell imaging\-based assays for high\-throughput screening using Eikon's proprietary super\-resolution microscopy platform. * Collaborate with computational biologists and software engineers to apply state\-of\-the\-art computational and statistical methods including machine\-learning to analyze large datasets. * Summarize and deliver timely, high\-quality and actionable data to drive project team decisions across drug discovery portfolios. * Exercise good scientific judgment and provide data\-driven recommendations to project teams. * Maintain organized and comprehensive electronic records of experiments, results, and protocols in adherence to company standards and regulatory requirements. * Work closely with the High\-Throughput Biology Operations Team to transfer optimized processes into productionized operations workflows with well\-documented standard operating procedures. * Collaborate and communicate across a diverse team of biologists, chemists, and engineers. * Contribute to the growth and training of junior scientists. **Qualifications** * Ph.D. or Master's plus 10 years of relevant experience or Bachelor's degree plus 12 years of relevant experience in Biology, Bioengineering, Biotechnology, or related field. * Proficiency in mammalian cell culture with sterile technique. * Proficiency in laboratory techniques and equipment relevant to molecular and cellular biological research. * Demonstrated experience in systematic optimization and validation of biological assays. * Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills with novel assay technologies. * Working experience in quantitative fluorescence microscopy and/or super\-resolution microscopy. * Working experience with relevant quantitative and/or statistical analysis using common software tools (e.g., Microsoft Suite, GraphPad Prism, etc.). * Working experience with one or more high\-level programming languages (e.g., Python, MATLAB or R) to perform large dataset analysis and visualization. * Excellent communication skills, with the ability to convey scientific concepts effectively. * Collaborative mindset with the capacity to work effectively within multidisciplinary teams. * Proactive and adaptable to evolving research priorities and challenges. * Working experience in protein dynamics using single\-molecule microscopy is preferred. * Working experience with high\-throughput instrumentation and automation systems is preferred. At Eikon, employee compensation also includes bonus and equity compensation, in addition to several generous benefit programs, including: * 401k plan with company matching * Medical (premiums covered by Eikon at 95%), dental and vision insurance (premiums covered by Eikon at 100%) * Mental health and wellness benefits * Weeklong summer and winter holiday shutdowns * Generous paid time off and holiday policies * Life/AD\&D Insurance (premiums covered by Eikon at 100%) and optional supplemental employee\-paid life/AD\&D policies * Enhanced parental leave benefit * Daily subsidized lunch program when on\-site The expected salary range for this role is $123,000 to $149,100 depending on skills, competency, and the market demand for your expertise. Please do not forward unsolicited agency resumes to our website, employees or Human Resources. Eikon Therapeutics will not pay fees to any third\-party agency or firm associated with unsolicited resumes.

jobs.title: Research Scientist – Multimodal Foundation Models & Visual Reasoning
jobs.description: **About Us** ------------ We are a well\-funded, early\-stage AI research and product lab focused on building the next generation of frontier multimodal AI models. Founded by former DeepMind researchers—including Andrew Dai, previously an engineering leader on Gemini—our mission is to push the frontier of visual and multimodal intelligence. Our first model, Glimpse, launched publicly in October 2026\. Our team currently consists of 25 world\-class scientists and engineers. We raised a $55M seed round led by Altimeter Capital, Menlo Ventures, Striker VC, and NVIDIA. We are tackling foundational problems in artificial intelligence and translating cutting\-edge multimodal research into scalable, real\-world systems. **About the role** ------------------ In this role, you will lead ambitious, high\-impact research across next\-generation model architectures, distributed training methodologies, multimodal visual reasoning, reinforcement learning, and data\-centric learning. Backed by dedicated, large\-scale compute clusters and deep engineering support, you will formulate first\-principles hypotheses and run large\-scale empirical experiments. You will collaborate closely with world\-class research and engineering peers to push the boundary of visual intelligence and translate core research breakthroughs directly into state\-of\-the\-art foundation models and real\-world capabilities. **What you will do** -------------------- * **Frontier Research:** Drive novel research at the intersection of foundation models, multimodal understanding, complex visual reasoning, and spatial intelligence. * **Architecture \& Training Innovations:** Conceive and build novel model architectures, pre\-training methodologies, and scalable post\-training techniques (e.g., preference tuning, reasoning\-focused RL) to systematically advance model capabilities. * **Large\-Scale Experimentation:** Design, execute, and analyze large\-scale distributed training experiments on modern accelerator clusters to push the frontier of model performance. * **Data\-Centric Intelligence:** Pioneer innovative approaches to multimodal data curation, synthetic data generation, automated filtering, and rigorous benchmark evaluation. * **Breakthrough to Capability:** Collaborate with cross\-functional research and systems engineering teams to turn fundamental algorithmic breakthroughs into robust, scalable foundation model capabilities deployed at scale. **What we are looking for** --------------------------- * Ph.D. or equivalent industry research track record in Machine Learning, Computer Vision, Natural Language Processing, or a related quantitative discipline. * Rigorous foundational understanding of deep learning principles, transformer/multimodal architectures, and modern large\-scale training dynamics. * Deep proficiency in Python and modern deep learning frameworks (PyTorch or JAX). * Demonstrated ability to independently define research agendas, design rigorous empirical experiments, and solve open\-ended, frontier\-level problems. **Nice to have** ---------------- * **Specialized Domain Expertise:** Deep theoretical and practical expertise in at least one of the following: foundation models, multimodal reasoning, visual/spatial intelligence, reinforcement learning, or post\-training * **Proven Research Impact:** Strong track record demonstrated through first\-author publications at top\-tier venues (e.g. NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, CVPR, ICCV, ECCV) or key technical contributions to high\-profile foundation model releases. * **Distributed Systems \& Scale:** Hands\-on experience training, profiling, and scaling models across large distributed GPU or TPU clusters (e.g., FSDP, Megatron\-LM, DeepSpeed, Ray). * **Data \& Evaluation:** Demonstrated experience developing large\-scale multimodal data pipelines, synthetic reasoning trace generation, or designing rigorous evaluation suites for frontier models.

jobs.title: Senior AI Engineer (REMOTE)
jobs.description: **Position Summary:** The Senior AI Engineer is a hands\-on individual contributor who builds, trains, and evaluates machine learning models. The role combines knowledge engineering and data analysis with applied reinforcement learning, and owns work end to end, from data and experiment design through training, evaluation, and reporting. The ideal candidate brings practical reinforcement learning experience, strong engineering discipline, and the ability to collaborate closely with domain experts and communicate results to technical and non\-technical audiences. ### **Key Responsibilities** * Work with domain experts to capture specialized knowledge and represent it in structured, usable form. * Analyze source material and datasets for quality, consistency, and coverage, and resolve issues with the appropriate stakeholders. * Perform exploratory and statistical analysis to inform data, modeling, and evaluation decisions. * Create and curate training and evaluation datasets, using both automated and human validation. * Design reinforcement learning environments, reward functions, and verifiers. * Train and fine\-tune language models using supervised and reinforcement learning methods such as PPO, DPO, and GRPO. * Establish baselines, run ablations, and diagnose training issues such as reward hacking, instability, and data leakage. * Follow the research literature and bring promising techniques into practice. * Manage experiments rigorously, including versioned configurations, reproducible runs, experiment tracking, and compute budgeting. * Design and extend evaluation frameworks, metrics, and benchmarks. * Compare models and approaches through structured experiments and A/B testing. * Document results, failures, and next steps in clear technical write\-ups. * Present findings to engineers, domain experts, and business leaders in language each audience can act on. ### **Requirements \& Qualifications** * Bachelor’s degree in computer science, machine learning, statistics, or a related field; MS or PhD preferred. Equivalent hands\-on experience will be considered. * 3\+ years of hands\-on experience training or fine\-tuning language models. * Demonstrated reinforcement learning experience, including designing an environment and reward function end to end and training a policy in it. * Working knowledge of policy optimization methods for language models, such as PPO, DPO, or GRPO, including their failure modes. * Strong Python and PyTorch skills, with fluency in the Hugging Face ecosystem and parameter\-efficient fine\-tuning techniques. * Experience building and evaluating LLM\-based agents or multi\-turn systems. * Experience designing evaluations for language models, including held\-out sets and automated grading. * Ability to analyze complex, detailed documentation and translate it into precise, structured, testable form. * Clear technical writing, with the ability to explain an experiment and its results concisely. * Comfort working directly with domain experts who are not machine learning practitioners. * Experience working with healthcare data or in another highly regulated industry is highly preferred. * Experience training models to produce structured or schema\-constrained output is highly preferred. * Experience with a broad range of reinforcement learning algorithms and advanced reward design is highly preferred. * Experience with knowledge representation approaches such as knowledge graphs or ontologies is highly preferred. * Experience generating and validating synthetic data for model training is highly preferred. * Publications or open\-source contributions in reinforcement learning, language model fine\-tuning, or model evaluation is highly preferred. * Experience handling sensitive data, including protected health information (PHI) under HIPAA is highly preferred. * Timely and regular attendance. * Equivalent combination of education and experience will be considered * To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. ### **Special Considerations and Prerequisites** * Practices and adheres to EnableComp’s Core Values, Vision and Mission. * This is a 100% hands\-on individual contributor role. The AI Engineer owns experiments from design through code, training, and results. * Expect roughly half of the role to focus on reinforcement learning and model training, with the remainder split between knowledge engineering, data analysis, and evaluation. * Success requires sustained, close collaboration with domain experts and a genuine working understanding of the subject matter. * The underlying knowledge evolves over time. The AI Engineer must design data, training, and evaluation approaches that adapt to change without starting over. * All work must comply with HIPAA and EnableComp data policies, using de\-identified or synthetic data wherever possible. We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

jobs.title: Engramme Visionary Explorers (EVE)
jobs.description: Engramme Visionary Explorers is our flagship fellowship for exceptional emerging talent with the curiosity, energy, and perseverance to tackle foundational problems in AI. Over six months in our offices in San Francisco, you’ll work alongside Engramme’s researchers and engineers to help build Large Memory Models. You’ll turn ideas into experiments, test assumptions, and contribute to systems designed to expand what humans and AI can remember, learn, and accomplish. We are looking for people who bring fresh perspectives, learn quickly, and sustain their focus through difficult problems. **About Engramme** ------------------ Engramme is a Frontier AI lab spun out of Harvard focusing on AI x Human Memory. Persistent memory is a fundamental open problem at the heart of AI. Our vision is to build models of human memory, and to endow humans with perfect and infinite memory. Before starting Engramme, the founding team has produced and commercialized extensive research in machine learning and neuro\-science inspired memory models: * Gabriel Kreiman (CEO \& Co\-founder): Professor of Neuroscience and AI, Harvard Medical School. Led key research on brain memory consolidation at Harvard University. * Spandan Madan (CTO \& Co\-founder): PhD in Computer Science from Harvard, designed AI models which were commercially deployed at Adobe, Fujitsu, and Meta. **What You’ll Do** ------------------ * Develop and pursue a focused research or engineering project with the Engramme team. * Explore how AI systems can form, organize, retrieve, and use memories. * Build prototypes, run experiments, and develop evaluations. * Share findings, seek feedback, and turn promising results into the next algorithms. **What We’re Looking For** -------------------------- You may be an undergraduate student, Masters student or PhD student. You may be an early\-career researcher, an engineer, a recent graduate, or a self\-directed builder with compelling work to show. We are particularly interested in people who demonstrate: * Strong foundations in programming, mathematics, or a relevant scientific discipline. * Evidence of initiative through research, publications, software, independent projects, or other substantial work. * Intellectual honesty, resourcefulness, and persistence. * A deep interest in memory, intelligence, and technology that augments human capabilities. Prior AI research experience is valuable, but applicants from adjacent disciplines and unconventional backgrounds are encouraged to apply. **What to Submit** ------------------ Apply below with your CV and links to relevant work you are proud of.

jobs.description: At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. We design cutting\-edge tech to make travel smoother and more memorable, and we create groundbreaking solutions for our partners. Our diverse, vibrant, and welcoming community is essential in driving our success. This Senior Software Developer role is part of the BEX Product team which sits within our Technology division. The team delivers end\-to\-end Brand Expedia experiences across Home, Attach, and Trip Management, with a focus on creating differentiated lodging experiences and supporting travelers, particularly families and One Key members. In this role, you will design, develop, and maintain high\-quality software solutions that empower travel growth and enhance user experiences. **What you will do** * + Design, build, and evolve full\-stack products and services, contributing to system design, API design, data modeling, user interfaces, and technical implementation. + Develop high\-quality production software using appropriate frontend and backend technologies, with an emphasis on maintainability, performance, accessibility, security, and automated testing. + Translate customer, product, and design requirements into intuitive traveler experiences and resilient service integrations across the Trips Experience domain. + Own features and services through the full lifecycle: technical design, implementation, testing, deployment, monitoring, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement. + Collaborate with product managers, designers, data partners, and engineers across Brand Expedia to clarify problems, evaluate trade\-offs, and deliver measurable outcomes. + Lead technical discussions and design reviews, establish practical engineering standards, and make thoughtful decisions in ambiguous or evolving problem spaces. + Improve system reliability and operational excellence through observability, performance tuning, automation, incident response, and post\-incident learning. + Use experimentation, product analytics, and operational metrics to validate hypotheses, prioritize work, and measure the impact of delivered experiences. + Contribute to a culture of engineering excellence through code reviews, documentation, knowledge sharing, mentoring, and inclusive collaboration. If you want to make a real impact alongside innovative, dedicated teammates while contributing to a trusted platform that’s becoming the operating system for on\-demand care, Experity is the place to grow your career. **Experity offers the following:** * **Benefits** – Comprehensive coverage starts first day of employment and includes Medical, Dental/Orthodontia, and Vision. * **Ownership** \- All Team Members are eligible for synthetic ownership in Experity upon one year of employment with real financial rewards when the company is successful! * **Employee Assistance Program** \- This robust program includes counseling, legal resolution, financial education, pet adoption assistance, identity theft and fraud resolution, and so much more. * **Flexibility** – Experity is committed to helping team members face the demands of juggling work, family and life\-related issues by offering flexible work scheduling to manage your work\-life balance. * **Paid Time Off (PTO)** \- Experity offers a generous PTO plan and increases with milestones to ensure our Team Members have time to recharge, relax, and spend time with loved ones. * **Career Development** – Experity maintains a learning program foundation for the company that allows Team Members to explore their potential and achieve their career goals. * **Team Building** – We bring our Team Members together when we can to strengthen the team, build relationships, and have fun! We even have a family company picnic and a holiday party. * **Total Compensation** \- Competitive pay, quarterly bonuses and a 401(k) retirement plan with an employer match to help you save for your future and ensure that you can retire with financial security. **Compensation:** Budgeted between $140,750 and $190,000 dependent upon applicable experience. **Remote:** Experity offers Team Members the opportunity to work remotely or in an office. **Responsibilities:** *Data Engineering \& Platform* * Lead the architecture and hands\-on delivery of scalable batch and near\-real\-time ETL/ELT pipelines and data platform services. * Define robust integration patterns for databases, APIs, applications, CDC/event streams, and external sources across Experity's enterprise data platform. * Design reusable, governed data models, curated data products, and semantic\-ready datasets for analytics, reporting, AI/ML, and operational applications. * Solve complex transformation and processing challenges using Python, SQL, Snowflake, and distributed data technologies; contribute production\-quality code. Drive architectural decisions and tradeoffs for scalability, availability, resiliency, performance, maintainability, and cost efficiency. * *Engineering Excellence \& DataOps* * Define reusable frameworks, libraries, reference architectures, and engineering patterns adopted across data engineering teams. * Advance automated testing, CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code, and DataOps standards; improve developer workflows using AI\-assisted engineering tools with appropriate review and controls. * Establish observability, data freshness, service\-level objectives, alerting, and automated recovery patterns for critical data pipelines. * Lead resolution of high\-impact production issues, cross\-system root\-cause analysis, and preventive architectural improvements. Drive measurable improvements in Snowflake and cloud compute efficiency, query performance, storage, and platform operating costs. * *Data Quality, Governance \& Security* * Set technical standards for data quality, validation, lineage, reconciliation, and trusted data delivery across critical domains. * Partner with Data Architecture, Governance, and Security teams to design discoverable, governed, reusable data assets and consistent access patterns. Design healthcare data solutions with privacy, security, and applicable compliance requirements embedded from the outset. * *Technical Leadership \& Collaboration* * Serve as a technical authority for cross\-team design reviews, architecture decisions, code quality, and engineering best practices. * Mentor Senior and other Data Engineers through design guidance, pairing, code reviews, and technical knowledge sharing; lead through influence rather than direct reports. * Partner with Data Scientists and Machine Learning Engineers on reliable feature * pipelines, ML\-ready datasets, and governed data access for Generative AI and agentic applications. * Translate ambiguous product and business needs into practical architecture, phased * delivery plans, and measurable technical outcomes. Communicate architectural decisions, tradeoffs, risks, and operational practices clearly to engineering and non\-engineering stakeholders. * **Education and Experience:** * Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related technical field. * 8\+ years of experience building and operating production\-grade data platforms, including demonstrated ownership of complex systems or cross\-team technical initiatives. * Expert proficiency in Python and SQL, with strong software design, testing, debugging,and code review practices. * Deep hands\-on experience with Snowflake, including data modeling, query optimization, performance, and cost management. * Experience architecting CDC, Kafka, Flink, or comparable distributed event and streaming solutions. * Strong experience with AWS, including S3, Lambda, Glue, Kinesis, or equivalent cloud services. * Proven experience designing high\-volume batch and near\-real\-time ETL/ELT architectures and reusable analytical data models. * Experience with orchestration technologies such as Airflow or equivalent platforms. * Experience establishing CI/CD, Git\-based workflows, automated testing, and Infrastructure as Code practices. * Strong command of data quality, governance, security, observability, production operations, and reliability engineering. * Demonstrated ability to lead technical decisions across teams, mentor engineers, and communicate tradeoffs effectively. A hands\-on, full\-stack mindset and willingness to own complex problems end\-to\-end, from design through production operations. * **Preferred:** * Experience with dbt and dimensional modeling or semantic\-layer design. * Experience using AI\-assisted development tools responsibly to improve engineering velocity, code quality, testing, and operational efficiency. * Experience supporting Machine Learning, Generative AI, feature engineering, and AIready data access patterns. * Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, or CloudFormation. * Experience with metadata management, data catalogs, lineage, data observability, and data product governance. * Experience in Healthcare, HealthTech, SaaS, or other regulated industries. jobs.title: Senior Engineer, AI Accounting
jobs.description: **Overview** Exponent is the fastest\-growing financial technology platform built exclusively for franchise and multi\-location brand operators. We offer three integrated products — industry\-leading financing programs including a charge card, acquisition and build\-out loans, and an AI\-powered Accountant — giving operators a single platform to manage spend, access growth capital, and automate their financial operations. We have secured significant equity and credit capital and are backed by leading institutional investors and family offices who operate large franchise portfolios. **Role Description** The role will own core systems inside our AI\-powered Accountant — the product that ingests a franchise operator’s POS, banking, payroll, and processor data, classifies and reconciles it, and automates the monthly close. You will be hand\-on, working alongside a tightly knit, experienced engineering team that ships to production every day. This is a individual contributor role with a path to leading engineers as the team grows. **What You’ll Do** **Own systems end to end:** Design, build, ship, and operate backend systems in production \-from schema to deploy to on\-call. You own what you built after it goes live. **Make unreliable data reliable:** Integrate against difficult third\-party APIs and design ingestion that is idempotent by default — deduplication, safe replay, historical backfill — so every source can be re\-pulled and re\-processed without corrupting the ledger. **Keep every account in sync:** Own the background job infrastructure that keeps thousands of accounts in sync — scheduling, locking, retries, failure handling, and the observability to know when a sync silently stopped. A stuck job is a product bug, not an ops chore. **Put LLMs and ML into the product path:** LLMs and ML models already do the classification and reconciliation work in the product, and we are taking it from build to first pilots now — the point where the decisions about output validation, confidence thresholds, fallbacks, and failure handling actually get made. You will make them. Make a probabilistic component behave inside a system that has to be deterministic where it matters. **Help build a world class growth company:** We are a small, experienced team with broad scope. Every engineer owns what they ship and is expected to exercise judgment rather than wait for direction. Get deep on how technology enables Exponent and its customers to move faster with better experiences and results. **Requirements** * 4\+ years of full stack engineering, with end\-to\-end ownership of systems shipped to production * Ruby on Rails, or equivalent depth in another server\-side framework with a demonstrated ability to ramp quickly * PostgreSQL: schema design, indexing, transactional correctness * Third\-party API integration against unreliable sources: incomplete documentation, no webhook support, undocumented format changes, duplicate or partial data * Idempotent data ingestion (deduplication, replay, historical backfill) and background job infrastructure (scheduling, locking, retry and failure handling) * Production experience with LLMs or ML in a product path, including output validation and failure handling **Preferred Requirements** * POS or restaurant data systems: Square, Toast, Qu, Revel, delivery platform payouts, processor settlement files * Accounting platform integration: QuickBooks Online, Sage Intacct, NetSuite, Restaurant365 * Financial data aggregators: Plaid, Rutter, Stripe * Ledger, double\-entry, or reconciliation system design * Classification model work with measurable evaluation * CSV and file\-based import pipelines at scale Pay: $150,000\.00 \- $200,000\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) * Dental insurance * Paid time off * Professional development assistance * Vision insurance Work Location: Hybrid remote in New York, NY 10016

jobs.title: Senior Full Stack Engineer
jobs.description: **About FacilityOS** ==================== FacilityOS is a fast\-growing company redefining how facilities operate—bringing safety, security, and daily operations into one unified platform used by organizations around the world. As we continue to scale globally, we’re building a team of driven, curious people who want to make an impact. You’ll be part of a dynamic, collaborative culture where individuals are trusted to take ownership, solve meaningful problems, and grow in their careers. Our team comes together in\-office twice a week to connect, collaborate, and build momentum. If you’re looking to do your best work alongside a great team in a high\-growth environment, FacilityOS is the place to build your career. **About the Role:** We are looking for a highly capable Sr. Full Stack Engineer who can ramp up quickly, collaborate effectively with the existing team, and begin contributing meaningful delivery outcomes within the first few weeks. This role is well suited for someone who is comfortable navigating legacy systems, applying strong architectural principles, and making thoughtful technical decisions that improve delivery throughput without compromising quality. The ideal candidate brings strong backend engineering experience, sound judgment, and the ability to work independently while staying closely aligned with team standards and architectural direction. This role is a hybrid position where you’ll be required to come into our office three (3\) times a week. **Duties and Responsibilities:** * Design, develop, review, and maintain backend web applications and services across the FacilityOS platform. * Quickly develop a working understanding of existing platform architecture, legacy components, integration points, and modernization opportunities. * Collaborate with the engineering team to make sound technical decisions that align with established architectural principles and delivery goals. * Contribute to legacy modernization efforts using incremental, low\-risk approaches such as the Strangler Fig pattern where appropriate. * Maintain high code\-quality standards through code reviews, unit testing, static code analysis, and the adoption or improvement of engineering tools and standards. * Participate actively in peer code reviews, providing constructive feedback and helping promote maintainable, testable, and scalable solutions. * Troubleshoot and resolve application issues across environments, including staging and production, with a focus on root\-cause analysis and sustainable fixes. * Work directly with engineering leads, product stakeholders, and project managers to support business operations and project delivery. * Research, evaluate, and recommend innovative application, automation, and architectural improvements that would benefit the FacilityOS platform. **Skills and Qualifications:** * Minimum of 6 years of proven experience in backend .NET Framework / .NET Core web application development using C\#. * Minimum 5 years of experience developing web applications using Angular and Typescript * Proven ability to quickly understand complex legacy systems, identify key integration points, and contribute effectively with limited ramp\-up time. * Strong experience using object\-oriented programming, design patterns, and clean architecture principles to build maintainable, testable software. * Proven experience writing unit tests and applying quality\-focused development practices. * Proven experience designing and building RESTful services. * Experience in designing jobs.title: Senior AI Data Center Network Engineer
jobs.description: **CACTAVO AI — Senior AI Data Center Network EngineerPosition Summary \& Scale** * **Scale \& Infrastructure**: Architect and manage large\-scale AI data center networks supporting dense GPU clusters (such as 160 nodes / B300 GPUs, scaling up to 1,280\+ GPUs) optimized for heavy AI/ML workloads. * **Core Responsibilities**: Design, deploy, and maintain high\-performance AI Network Interface Cards (NICs), ensure strict SLA compliance, and optimize ultra\-low latency fabrics. * **Timeline / Context**: Target operational deployment set for November 2026\. **Key Technical Domains** * **Network Protocols \& Routing**: VLAN, BGP, OSPF, LACP, ECMP, TCP/IP. * **Hardware \& Interconnects**: 200G / 400G / 800G optics (DAC/AOC), Leaf\-Spine architecture. * **AI Transport \& Congestion Control**: RoCEv2 / RDMA, PFC (Priority Flow Control), ECN (Explicit Congestion Notification), QoS (Quality of Service). * **InfiniBand Fabrics**: NDR / XDR, Subnet Manager, Fabric management. * **Ecosystem \& Vendors**: NVIDIA Spectrum, Quantum switches, ConnectX, BlueField DPU / NICs, Linux (Ubuntu/Rocky Linux). * **AI Frameworks \& Performance**: NCCL, GPUDirect RDMA, AllReduce / All\-to\-All communication primitives. * **Automation \& Operations**: Ansible, Python, SONiC, Cumulus, VXLAN, EVPN, VRF, ACL, BMC / OOB (Out\-of\-Band management). * **Telemetry \& Monitoring**: Telemetry, Prometheus, Grafana dashboards for CACTAVO AI Infrastructure. **Key Engineering Focus Areas \& Technical Challenges** **1\. High\-Density Cluster Architecture** * Deployment and management of 160\-node B300 AI clusters, ensuring fault\-tolerant, high\-bandwidth Leaf\-Spine topologies. **2\. RoCEv2 \& InfiniBand Optimization** * Fine\-tuning RoCEv2 parameters (PFC, ECN, QoS) to eliminate micro\-bursts, packet loss, and PFC pause storms. * Managing InfiniBand Fabric Subnet Managers to maintain optimal paths and congestion notification. **3\. GPU Performance \& Collective Communication** * Troubleshooting NCCL collective communication bottlenecks (e.g., AllReduce) using benchmarking tools like nccl\-tests, iperf3, and ib\_write\_bw to maximize GPU interconnect efficiency. **4\. Advanced Virtualization \& Segmentation** * Implementing complex data center overlay networks using VRF, VXLAN, and EVPN across CACTAVO AI infrastructure. **5\. Multi\-Vendor Integration** * Integrating NVIDIA Quantum and Spectrum switches alongside legacy or multi\-vendor gear (such as Cisco) tailored for high\-performance GPU/HPC workloads. **Key Operational Metrics \& Troubleshooting Scenarios** * **160\-Node B300 Cluster Design**: End\-to\-end network validation for large\-scale AI training nodes. * **RoCEv2 PFC/ECN Tuning**: Mitigating network congestion and preventing catastrophic PFC storms. * **NCCL AllReduce Optimization**: Resolving bottlenecks to achieve targeted performance gains (e.g., target 40% efficiency boost). * **High\-Speed Interconnects**: Managing 400G/800G links and Forward Error Correction (FEC) configurations. * **NVIDIA Ecosystem Maintenance**: Deep configuration of Spectrum, Quantum, and InfiniBand fabric layers. * **GPU Workload Synergy**: Aligning network paths directly with GPU compute demands across CACTAVO infrastructure. Pay: $68,900\.00 \- $83,100\.00 per year Application Question(s): * Have you deployed NVIDIA Spectrum? * Have you deployed Quantum? * Have you deployed InfiniBand? Work Location: In person

jobs.title: AI Design Engineer
jobs.description: **AI DESIGN ENGINEER** **Custom Millwork, Casework \& Fixtures** **Location: Tacoma, WA · Full\-Time · On\-Site** **Travel: Some travel to El Paso, TX and Phoenix, AZ** **Reports to: Director of AI \& Automation and Director of Operations** **Industry: Commercial Construction \& Manufacturing** **Compensation: $105,000 – $165,000 plus bonus** It's 11:40 on a Tuesday night, and you're doing it again. The house is quiet. You've got an AI model open on one monitor and a reception desk elevation on the other. You're trying to get the model to read an architect's PDF, find the casework, and give you a cabinet schedule your engineering software can actually use. It half\-works. You're grinning anyway. At 7:00 tomorrow morning you'll walk into a drafting room where that same architect's PDF gets redrawn by hand, line by line. The submittal goes out, comes back covered in redlines, goes out again, comes back again. Someone re\-keys dimensions that already exist in three other files. The most experienced engineer in the building carries the shop's construction standards in their head, and nobody has written them down because nobody has the time. You mentioned AI in a meeting once. Someone called it "your computer thing," and the room moved on. You're not crazy. You're early. We've been looking for you. **This Industry Still Draws Like It's 1998\.** Here it is plainly. Custom millwork, cabinetry, and commercial construction have worked the same way for a long time. Drafting is still manual. Design intent arrives as a PDF and a skilled person redraws it. A single wall\-paneling submittal has to show every joint condition, the panel core, veneer species and cut, leaf and panel matching, room\-match sequencing, grain direction, blocking heights, and the hardware schedule. Every line is drawn by a human, and when the architect changes one dimension, a human redraws all of it. Engineering is still translation. Product libraries help. But every custom reception desk, feature wall, art display, and curved transaction top still starts with a person converting someone else's drawing into parts, joinery, and machining. Manufacturing is still manual everywhere except the robots. The CNC router is the future. The tape measure, the paper traveler, and the re\-keyed cut list are not. That isn't where this industry is going. Frontier doesn't intend to wait for a software vendor to deliver the future in a version 14\.0 update. **We Don't Want Someone to Use Better Software. We Want Someone to Change the Industry.** This is not a CAD manager job. We're not looking for someone to maintain our libraries, run our upgrade cycle, or train people on new buttons. We want the person who is going to work out what engineering, drafting, and design look like when AI is part of the crew, prove it on real projects that get built on our floor and installed in real buildings, and then watch the rest of the industry try to catch up. That's the job: you, Frontier, and the tip of the spear. **Ownership Is Making a Bet. The Bet Is You.** Most manufacturers our size put their big money into equipment: a new CNC router, a panel saw, an edgebander line, a robot cell. We buy machines too. We're manufacturers, and we love machines. But Frontier's ownership believes the bigger opportunity is this one. Changing how we engineer, draft, and design is a bigger lever than the next large piece of capital equipment. That isn't a line in a slide deck. It's how ownership thinks about where money goes. Frontier is an aggressively AI\-forward company with AI\-forward ownership. Our leadership doesn't just "support" AI. They use it, they understand it, and they fund it the way manufacturers fund equipment. We've already hired a Director of AI \& Automation to drive AI across the business. This role takes that same commitment to the core of what we make: the drawings, the engineering, and the design behind every piece of millwork that leaves our shop. You will work for that Director, alongside the leadership of our cabinet engineering and drafting team. **Efficiency That Grows the Shop** The point of making drafting and engineering faster is not to shrink the team. It is to take the capacity we free up and put it into more work, more complex projects, and more people growing into this craft in a technological world. Every hour we pull out of redraw, re\-keying, and tribal\-knowledge bottlenecks is an hour we can put into taking on more volume, training the next generation of engineers and drafters, and opening roles that did not exist when every line had to be drawn by hand. Frontier intends to grow and expand the operation. AI is how we create the room to do that without burning out the people who already carry the standards in their heads. This role amplifies craftspeople. It does not replace them. The efficiency pickups fund growth, new opportunities, and a bigger shop that can compete on both craft and technology. **Signs This Is You** * You have a folder somewhere n the software vendors. Nobody has written it. That's the job. If you need clean, structured data and a defined process before you can do anything, this isn't the role. If you look at a stack of redlined PDFs and see the next ten years of your career, we should talk. What you will have is something almost nobody in this industry gets: ownership that understands what you're trying to do, funds it like equipment, and will clear obstacles out of your way. And a clear mandate: the wins you create are meant to help us grow, not just do the same work with fewer people. **About Frontier Door \& Cabinet** We are builders. True American manufacturers. Frontier Door \& Cabinet has been in business for nearly 30 years. We started as a garage operation and grew into one of the largest specialty contractors in the Pacific Northwest, focused on Division 08 (doors, frames, and hardware) and Division 12 (cabinets and countertops) for commercial construction, with operations in Tacoma, El Paso, and Phoenix. Our facilities run CNC routers, panel saws, and edgebanders, and our estimating team quotes nearly every available project in our markets. Cabinets get installed. Projects have deadlines, budgets, and general contractors who don't care about your technology roadmap. They care that the casework matched the submittal and showed up on time. That pressure is exactly why AI matters so much here. The gap between where this industry is and where it could be is enormous, and we intend to be the company that closes it first, and to use that advantage to expand what we can take on. **What We Offer** * Competitive salary ($105,000 – $165,000 depending on experience) plus bonus * Health, dental, and vision insurance * 401(k) * A real budget for AI tools, hardware, training, and industry events (IWF, AWFS, AWI), funded the way we fund production equipment * Direct access to ownership and the leadership team, without layers in between * The chance to build something the whole industry ends up copying, and to help grow a real manufacturing operation while you do it **How to Apply** Send your resume and answers to two questions. No cover letter. 1\. Show us the most interesting thing you've built with AI on your own time. A repo, a screen recording, a screenshot, or a photo of the whiteboard all work. We want proof that you build things. 2\. Name the first drafting or engineering task you'd eliminate, and tell us how you'd do it. If you've spent years thinking "this could all be so much better" while the rest of the shop kept doing it the old way, this is your chance to stop thinking it and start building it. **The Fine Print: The Software** Software isn't the point of this job. But you should know we speak the language, and that you'll be walking into a familiar world. The people we want have lived inside some combination of these: * Microvellum on AutoCAD / BricsCAD: parametric casework engineering, shop drawings, CNC output * Cabinet Vision: design\-to\-manufacture for cabinets and casework * AlphaCAM: CNC router and stone programming, nesting * SolidWorks (and SWOOD): complex fixtures and mixed wood, metal, and glass assemblies * AutoCAD, Revit, Rhino \+ Grasshopper, Inventor * Bluebeam Revu: submittals, redlines, and revision tracking **Also familiar:** TopSolid'Wood, imos iX, 2020 / Design Flex, Moraware CounterGo, SlabSmith, digital templating (Prodim, LPI) **On the AI side:** whatever is best this month. Python, LLM APIs, agents, AutoLISP, .NET, the SolidWorks API. You don't need all of them. You need to know why each one still takes so many clicks and have a theory about how few it should take. *Frontier Door \& Cabinet, Inc. is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status.*
