jobs.title: Quadrants: Compiler Lead
jobs.description: **What Quadrants is** --------------------- Quadrants is an open\-source translation layer that turns ordinary Python into optimized machine code at runtime, across CPU (Arm64, x86\) and GPU (AMDGPU, CUDA, Metal, Vulkan) backends. CUDA is the primary target, with x86 the strong runner\-up, especially for real\-time simulation. The others drive adoption and support fast prototyping for research. The ambition is explicit: build the best “Python compiler” in the world for physics and performance\-critical numerical computing. We are fully committed to it, and we intend to beat leading alternatives like Nvidia Warp, Numba, or Triton. It’s a standalone project with its own roadmap, built in the open. Genesis, our physics simulator, is its first and top\-priority user, the source of its hardest workloads and its benchmarks. But Quadrants is general\-purpose infrastructure for anyone writing performance\-critical numerical Python, not an internal tool that happens to be public. The bet: high\-performance code should feel natural to write. Engineers write plain Python in a NumPy or PyTorch style, and Quadrants makes it fast. **The role** ------------ You own Quadrants end to end: the API, the IR and lowering, the optimization passes, the numerical primitives, and the roadmap. Our ultimate objective: engineers write for readability and maintainability, never for performance. They write the version of an algorithm they are most comfortable with, and Quadrants rebuilds it into kernels that run as if an expert had hand\-tuned them. Performance is the compiler’s job, not theirs. Getting there is a frontier problem, part research and part engineering, and we intend to define the state of the art on it, relentlessly pushing the limit further. It calls for two things at once: the low\-level GPU and compiler skill to make a single kernel optimal, and the ability to keep the whole system coherent as it grows. The core tradeoff is settled: usability comes first. When usability and performance collide, usability wins, unless the cost is severe. We will limit what the system supports to go fast (static shapes and fixed\-size allocation baked into kernels, say), but never the convenience of the API itself. Experts who want maximum performance and full control over the generated code get lower\-level escape hatches, down to inline assembly, C, or PTX. Your mandate is to build the best open\-source Python compiler for physics simulation out there. No limit on what that takes. If it means replacing the entire engine, your call. Either way, you keep Quadrants healthy and unblocking the company in the meantime. **What you’ll own** ------------------- * **API \& authoring experience.** The surface that physics and numerical\-computing engineers write against, and, as an open\-source library, the product’s face to the world. Idiomatic, natural to Python users, never a separate language bolted onto Python. Clean decorators, legible constraints, sharp errors, real escape hatches. * **IR, lowering \& backends.** A stable IR that lowers to multiple backends, with room to grow and the door kept open for differentiable simulation. Today the computation graph is expressed through Quadrants’ own constructs. Recovering it automatically from ordinary Python is hard, and a long\-term goal rather than today’s reality. * **Optimization.** Turn naive code into strong execution plans: vectorization, register and shared\-memory usage, barriers and atomics, cooperative threading, dead\-buffer and redundant\-traffic elimination, dropping needless synchronization. Move low\-level optimization off users and into the platform. * **Primitives.** Cholesky, eigendecomposition, matmul, reductions, solver kernels. Each owned with its correctness, benchmarks, and regression tracking. * **Watching Genesis and the compiler together.** Hunt for performance wins on both sides, in Genesis and in Quadrants itself. Propose API changes that cut duplication, improve readability, and reduce platform\-specific special\-casing. Less to maintain, more that simply works. * **The project as a product.** Benchmark real workloads, track performance over time, catch regressions early. Stay close to users (Genesis first), find friction and missing abstractions, drive adoption, set direction. **Who you are** --------------- You reason about whole systems and have taste for where complexity should live. You measure before you optimize, and you reach for memory traffic and launch overhead before FLOPs. You have opinions about API design. You write tests and benchmarks as you go, not afterward. The ground that judgment stands on: * **GPU.** What optimal looks like and why: access patterns, registers, shared memory, barriers, atomics, threading. CPU intuition a plus. * **Python \& API taste.** Idiomatic Python. A feel for what’s natural to Python users. APIs that free users rather than constrain them. * **Compilers.** The path from authoring to kernels (IR, lowering, optimization), weighed against maintainability. And how you work: proactive and largely self\-directed. You fetch context across the company instead of waiting for it. You’re comfortable talking to the engineers who use what you build, and at ease designing in the open for users you’ll never meet. Ready to grow into leading a small team (a couple of people, near term). **What great looks like** ------------------------- People adopt Quadrants from outside Genesis. Engineers write clearer code with less boilerplate. Kernels keep getting faster. Performance is tracked, not guessed. The architecture gets easier to extend, not harder. **What we’re uncompromising about** ----------------------------------- How you work is up to you. What matters is that your ownership grows over time: blind spots shrink, the parts you can vouch for expand, technical debt goes down, the core stays sound. That takes treating understanding as real work, not overhead. You read and challenge the codebase instead of just stacking features on it. You take nothing you did not write for granted. You watch the competition and what’s coming next, and you bring it in and ship it. Use AI agents if they help. They are productivity tools, not code owners. You are.

Learn more about our culture, AI innovation and sustainability commitments through our Careers site and Sustainability Report. **What Happens After You Apply** After you apply, here's what you can typically expect: * Our Talent Acquisition team reviews your application with the hiring team. * A Talent Acquisition Partner will review your application and, if your background is aligned, schedule a Zoom interview. * Next, you'll meet the hiring manager and other members of the interview team. * We aim to keep the process focused and respectful of your time, with no more than five interviews in most cases. * After interviews are complete, our team will follow up with the final steps. Get notified about relevant opportunities . **Be the one building what's next \- where AI, experience and impact come together.** ===================================================================================== **Employee Referral** If a Genesys employee referred you, please apply using the link they shared so we can connect your application to their referral. **About Genesys:** Genesys® empowers more than 8,000 organizations worldwide to create the best customer and employee experiences. As a result, organizations can drive customer loyalty, growth and retention while increasing operational efficiency and teamwork across human and AI workforces. To learn more, visit www.genesys.ai. **Reasonable Accommodations:** If you require a reasonable accommodation to complete any part of the application process, or are limited in your ability to access or use this online application and need an alternative method for applying, you or someone you know may contact us at reasonable.accommodations@genesys.com . jobs.title: Mechanical Design Engineer
jobs.description: *Mechanical Design Engineer \- Growth to Technical Leadership* For 20 years, Gray Matter Research has designed and built specialized equipment for neurophysiology laboratories, ranging from large equipment to complex, precision miniature instruments. We are a small, profitable, founder\-owned company that grew out of a neuroscience lab at Montana State University. Our work is highly specialized, hands\-on, and technically varied, with products used by researchers around the world. **The Role** We are hiring a Mechanical Design Engineer to work closely on the design, customization, documentation, and release of our products. You will work directly with customers, suppliers, fabricators, and our machine shop partner while gradually taking on greater responsibility for engineering projects and day\-to\-day technical work. This is not a narrow design role. We are looking for someone who enjoys both engineering and the practical side of bringing a product to life: understanding a customer's need, developing a solution, creating manufacturable designs, solving problems during production, and supporting the finished product. The person in this role will have the opportunity to learn the products and business while gradually taking on more responsibility and independence. Over time, this position may grow into broader technical leadership, customer and vendor relationships, business responsibilities, and potentially an ownership opportunity. What that path could look like will be discussed openly as the role develops. **Location:** On\-site, in person 619 N. Church Ave., Unit 1 Bozeman, MT 59715 **Schedule:** Salaried position, approximately 30 hours per week. **Reports to:** Founder and Owner **What You Will Do**  Design and customize products for individual customers, from initial quote through released drawings, bills of materials, and build instructions.  Develop precision mechanical parts and assemblies using SolidWorks.  Take projects from customer need through concept, design, prototype, production, and delivery.  Work hands\-on with the products you design, including assembly, testing, prototyping, 3D printing, and occasional machining.  Turn repeat products into well\-documented platforms using parametric CAD models, configurations, template drawings, and repeatable build documentation.  Help develop and launch new product lines from prototype through production.  Work closely with our machine shop partner and other suppliers on manufacturability, tolerances, quotes, lead times, and quality.  Communicate directly with customers to understand their technical needs and support equipment after delivery.  Improve engineering documentation, procedures, and design standards so critical company knowledge is captured and transferable.  Help guide interns, technicians, or junior engineers as appropriate.  Gradually take on more responsibilities, including quoting, project prioritization, vendor relationships, customer accounts, and technical decision\-making. Because we are a small company, everyone occasionally helps outside a narrowly defined job description. We value people who are comfortable pitching in when needed, but the primary focus of this position is engineering, product development, and technical problem\-solving. **What We Are Looking For**  Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering or a closely related field.  Approximately 3–7 years of professional mechanical design or product\-development experience. We are open to candidates outside this range when their experience is a strong fit.  Strong SolidWorks expertise, including parametric and configuration\-driven modeling, surface modeling, and preparation of clear, machinist\-ready drawings.  Strong understanding of GD\&T, materials, fasteners, mechanisms, and precision mechanical design.  Practical design\-for\-manufacture experience, particularly with machined and assembled parts.  Experience working directly with machinists, fabricators, or manufacturing partners.  Experience taking products from concept through prototype and production.  Strong troubleshooting and problem\-solving skills.  Excellent fine motor skills and attention to detail for the assembly and testing of intricate miniature equipment.  Ability to move comfortably between custom one\-off projects and standardized products.  Strong written and verbal communication skills.  Ability to document technical work clearly for customers, suppliers, and teammates.  Ability to take ownership of projects while also collaborating closely with the founder.  Interest in taking on greater technical and business responsibility over time. **Nice to Have**  Experience with scientific instrumentation, laboratory equipment, medical devices, precision manufacturing, or other low\-volume, high\-mix products.  Experience with machining and 3D printing.  Experience with animal\-research or biomedical equipment.  Curiosity about neuroscience and research applications.  Experience mentoring technicians, interns, or junior engineers.  Experience with MRI/CT\-based modeling in tools such as 3D Slicer.  Exposure to quoting, pricing, or customer\-facing technical sales.  Understanding of sterile technique and products used in surgical procedures.  Familiarity with basic electronics, PCB design, or MATLAB.  Interest in learning more about the business side of a small engineering company. **What We Offer**  Salary: $64,000–$83,000 per year for 30 hours per week, depending on experience. This is equivalent to approximately $85,000–$110,000 annually on a full\-time basis.  Flexible schedule: An approximately 30\-hour workweek that allows room for life outside of work.  Room to grow: The opportunity to take on greater engineering, customer, and business responsibility as your experience with Gray Matter Research grows.  Long\-term opportunity: For the right person, the role may eventually develop into technical leadership and potentially an ownership opportunity.  Real responsibility: You will make meaningful design decisions, work directly with customers, and have influence over existing and future product lines.  Interesting work: You will solve unusual engineering problems and see your designs move from concept to finished product.  Stability: A profitable company with a 20\-year history.  Benefits: Two weeks of paid time off plus paid holidays, a SIMPLE IRA with a 3% employer match, and a flexible schedule.  We do not currently offer employer\-sponsored health insurance. We are especially interested in someone who wants more than a narrowly defined engineering position—someone who enjoys hands\-on product development, is interested in understanding how a small technical business operates, and would like the opportunity to grow their responsibility over time. If that sounds like the kind of engineering career you are looking for, we would like to hear from you. Job Type: Full\-time Pay: $64,000\.00 \- $110,000\.00 per year Benefits: * Paid time off * Retirement plan Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Field Technician II

Technician, Systems Engineer, and other Service Delivery leadership tracks. **FIELD ROLE \-ONLY CONSIDERING LOCAL CANDIDATES** **Key Responsibilities:** * Serve as the primary escalation point for oversight. * Configure, maintain, and troubleshoot network infrastructure including firewalls, switching, VLANs, and wireless (Meraki, Fortinet, and/or Palo Alto), escalating advanced network engineering as needed. * Administer Microsoft 365 and Entra ID at an advanced level, including Conditional Access policy design, Intune device compliance/configuration profiles, and hybrid identity troubleshooting. * Lead implementation and tuning of endpoint and email security tooling (EDR, MFA/identity platforms, mail filtering) and respond to elevated security alerts in coordination with Harbor IT's security operations function. * Apply and reinforce HIPAA/PHI handling requirements and life sciences and healthcare\-specific operational constraints across all client work, and coach junior staff on life sciences and healthcare\-adjacent client sensitivities. * Use RMM and PSA tooling (e.g., N\-Able RMM, Auvik, ConnectWise Manage) to manage tickets, backups, patching, and monitoring alerts to Harbor IT SLA standards, with authority to adjust monitoring/automation configurations. * Serve as the senior technical liaison with third\-party vendors (ISPs, hardware/software vendors, line\-of\-business application providers), driving resolution on vendor\-dependent issues. * Create, maintain, and quality\-review internal and client\-facing documentation, including network diagrams, asset inventories, and standard operating procedures, setting the documentation standard for the Pod. * Identify recurring issues, inefficiencies, or improvement opportunities in client environments and bring proposed solutions, not just problems, to the Pod Manager and Account Team (CSM and CIO). * Participate in and help coordinate the emergency on\-call rotation, responding to after\-hours incidents, outages, and critical client escalations, often as the first point of technical escalation for on\-call Field Technician I staff. * Mentor and onboard Field Technician I staff, including shadowing, knowledge\-sharing sessions, and structured feedback on troubleshooting methodology and client\-facing communication. * Maintain reliable transportation and travel flexibility to support client sites across the Boston/Cambridge area and the broader New England service territory, including coverage across multiple Practice 3 sites as needed. **Qualification nt, and hybrid identity configurations. * Hands\-on experience administering Windows Server environments including Active Directory, Group Policy, DNS/DHCP, and server virtualization technologies (VMware and/or Hyper\-V). * Working experience supporting MacOS workstations and Apple Business Manager enrolled devices in a mixed\-OS environment. * Hands\-on configuration and troubleshooting experience with networking infrastructure: firewalls, managed switching, VLANs, and wireless (Meraki, Fortinet, and/or Palo Alto experience strongly preferred). * Practical experience with modern endpoint and mail security tooling: EDR/antivirus/mail filtering platforms (e.g., SentinelOne, Umbrella, Microsoft Defender for Endpoint, Proofpoint, Mimecast, Barracuda), MFA and identity platforms (e.g., Duo, Okta, Entra ID). * Familiarity with backup, storage, and disaster recovery technologies (e.g., Veeam, Cove, Datto, cloud backup platforms), including experience validating backup jobs and executing restores. * Basic scripting/automation familiarity (PowerShell or equivalent) for repeatable troubleshooting, reporting, or provisioning tasks a plus. * Confidence with AI\-enabled tooling and use cases in an MSP context, with strong emphasis on security, data governance, and IP protection when evaluating or recommending AI use. * Demonstrated ability to lead a technical project from scoping through completion, including client communication and status reporting. * Proven ability to mentor or informally lead junior technical staff, with sound judgment on when to resolve independently versus escalate. * Comfort working in life sciences and healthcare\-adjacent environments with strong working knowledge of HIPAA, PHI handling, and clinical/lab operational constraints. * Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and critical thinking skills, with the ability to diagnose issues spanning multiple systems and vendors. * Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to translate technical issues into plain language for non\-technical clinical and administrative staff and to communicate confidently with client stakeholders. * Self\-motivated with strong time management and the ability to manage multiple concurrent projects and priorities in a fast\-paced, ever\-changing environment. * Focus on continuous professional development in the technology industry, with a demonstrated track record of achieving relevant technical certifications. **Education \& Experience:** * Associate's degree or equivalent (4\+ years) working experience in IT support/engineering, with at least 1\-2 years functioning at a Field Technician I level or equivalent. * 5\+ years of experience in a customer service or client\-facing technical support role. * Certifications preferred: Microsoft (MD\-102, AZ\-104\), Cisco/Meraki (CCT, ECMS, CCNA), VMware (VCTA/VCP), Okta certifications. * Permanent work authorization in the United States required. * Driver's license with reliable transportation required. **Work Environment:** * Reports to the Pod Manager within Harbor IT's Practice 3 Life Sciences service delivery organization. * Typically required. * Participates in and helps coordinate a scheduled emergency on\-call rotation covering after\-hours incidents, often as the first point of technical escalation. **Benefits:** * Competitive salary commensurate with experience * Comprehensive benefits package including health, dental, and vision insurance. * 401(k) retirement plan with company match * Unlimited PTO and holidays * Professional development opportunities Compensation: 90\-110K

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, WarehouseOS
jobs.description: **About WarehouseOS** --------------------- WarehouseOS is the warehouse management system fulfillment teams run their day on. It’s the software floor staff hold in their hands for an entire shift, and what warehouse managers rely on to plan, monitor, and improve operations. Our customers range from fast\-growing brands to established third\-party logistics providers moving thousands of orders a day. We build software for real\-world warehouse environments where reliability, clarity, and speed matter. WarehouseOS is part of a broader software strategy at Hoj Innovations, a company with more than six decades of experience designing, installing, and optimizing warehouse operations. Across more than 100,000 completed projects, Hoj has developed deep operational expertise in a category increasingly shaped by software. WarehouseOS is the starting point for building software capabilities that can serve the company’s wider portfolio over time. We are looking for people who want to help shape that future. **About the role** ------------------ We are hiring our first Staff Software Engineer to lead WarehouseOS workstreams, from clarifying ambiguous problems through rollout and production follow\-through. You will report directly to the Director of Software Engineering, who also leads product direction, and partner with our Principal Technical Program Manager on sequencing, dependencies, and coordination across workstreams. We are deliberately moving more technical decision\-making from the Director into the engineering team. You’ll make technical calls without routine sign\-off. When a decision would shift priorities, commitments, or spend, you’ll bring in the people who own those. This is a hands\-on individual\-contributor role. You will write production code while leading technical work, reviewing changes, and helping other engineers grow. The balance will shift with the work. The role is based in Salt Lake City, Utah and requires a full\-time in\-office presence. The salary range is **$145,000–$180,000**, depending on experience and qualifications. **The work ahead** ------------------ The work spans an established product, modernization of older systems, and new capabilities. Our .NET services support warehouse order flow, device traffic from the floor, and integrations with customer and partner systems. The challenges include developing a sustainable approach to retaining and accessing growing volumes of historical warehouse data, evolving existing systems without disrupting warehouse operations, and making production easier to understand and support. These problems require investigation and judgment, not a predetermined architecture or a mandate to rewrite everything. **In this role, you will:** --------------------------- * Lead engineering workstreams, taking ownership of technical delivery, rollout readiness, and production follow\-through. * Make and document technical decisions about implementation approaches, component boundaries, data models, APIs, and testing strategies. Revisit tradeoffs when evidence or requirements change. * Break work into pieces other engineers can own, provide context for them to make decisions, and help resolve technical obstacles. * Partner with the Director on customer needs, scope, priorities, and risk, and with the Principal Technical Program Manager on sequencing and cross\-workstream dependencies. * Share code\-review responsibility, mentor engineers through review and pairing, and establish review practices proportionate to the risk of a change. * Build and evolve production services with attention to data integrity, reliability, maintainability, and performance under real warehouse load. * Improve observability, runbooks, release practices, and incident response, and address technical debt where it meaningfully reduces risk or enables delivery. **What success looks like in your first six months** ---------------------------------------------------- Working with the Director and the team, you will establish priorities and aim to: * Lead a workstream from design through production, with clear tradeoffs, meaningful ownership by other engineers, and a supported rollout. * Establish a practical design\-review approach that enables more engineers to make sound decisions independently. * Identify and improve a specific reliability or delivery problem with the team, establishing a baseline and demonstrating the improvement. **We’re looking for someone who:** ---------------------------------- * Has a degree in computer science or a related technical field, or equivalent demonstrated experience. * Has 8\+ years of professional software development experience, including multiple projects led from design through production. * Has designed, shipped, and operated production systems, and can explain the alternatives considered, the tradeoffs made, and what happened after release. * Has deep experience with C\# and ASP.NET Core, or a comparable modern backend stack with the ability to come up to speed quickly. * Can turn an incompletely defined problem into a practical technical approach, accounting for scope, risk, dependencies, and the realities of an existing system. * Understands relational data deeply and can reason about integrity, consistency, and performance under real load. * Writes clearly and helps other engineers grow through design discussions, documentation, code review, and pairing. * Disagrees constructively, seeks relevant expertise, and changes course when better evidence or reasoning emerges. * Has used modern delivery and observability tooling to improve how a team builds and operates software, not just to complete individual tasks. * Is comfortable in a growing organization where some systems and practices are established and others still need to be built. **Even better if you:** ----------------------- * Have experience in warehouse management, logistics, supply chain, fulfillment, industrial automation, or other operations\-heavy software. * Have built or operated integrations with hardware, scanners, mobile devices, or customer and vendor systems. * Have worked with microservice or event\-driven architectures and understand where they help and where they add unnecessary complexity. * Have experience running software on Linux in production, including containers and cloud infrastructure. * Have led incident reviews or improved on\-call practices to reduce recurring operational problems. * Use AI development tools thoughtfully to improve productivity while maintaining quality and accountability. **Benefits and perks** ---------------------- * Flex PTO * Medical, dental, and vision coverage, including mental health support, medical advice line access, flexible spending accounts, and parental leave * Disability and life insurance options * Employer dollar match to HSA and 401(k) * Team\-building events and monthly catered office lunches **Optional: share a technical decision** ---------------------------------------- If you’d like, include a few paragraphs about a technical decision where there was meaningful disagreement or where you changed your mind. Describe the options, how you reached a decision, how you worked with others, and what you learned from the outcome. An anonymized example is welcome. Please do not include confidential information from a current or former employer.

jobs.description: **A path for every ambition.** At HUB, we believe the best work happens when people are given real space to grow and then given the autonomy to exercise it. With over $5 billion in revenue and almost 20,000 employees in 600 offices throughout North America, HUB has grown substantially, in part due to our industry leading success in mergers and acquisitions. **Position Overview** ===================== HUB is seeking an AI Engineer to join the RPA \& Automation team within our centralized technology organization, part of HUB’s AI \& Automation organization. This is a hands\-on build role responsible for designing, building, and shipping production\-grade AI applications that deliver measurable value across HUB’s business lines. HUB runs Claude as its primary model today, and the stack is expected to evolve toward agentic systems. The ideal candidate is an experienced software engineer with direct, hands\-on experience building and shipping AI applications, skills, and plug\-ins in a governed, regulated environment, who is productive from the first weeks and ready to grow into agent development. The AI Engineer professionalizes experimental AI prototypes into governed, tested, enterprise\-ready applications, and owns the enterprise standards and governance for HUB’s skills, plug\-ins, and MCP wherever they are used across HUB. The role scales these capabilities to the business through HUB’s native AI ecosystem. The team builds the simple to moderate skills, plug\-ins, and MCP connections directly. Where a build requires deep engineering, such as net\-new backend, new infrastructure, or complex integration, Enterprise Engineering executes it to the team standard and returns it to the catalog to be governed and published. **Key Responsibilities** ======================== **Build AI Applications** * Build reusable skills and package them as plug\-ins, then compose them into governed AI applications that HUB business lines use * Configure and tune foundational models (Claude, Gemini) for HUB use cases, with system and prompt design * Build retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG), embeddings, and multi\-step workflows over governed enterprise data * Take business\-built AI prototypes and productionize them into reliable, governed applications **Own the AI Asset Platform** * Own and govern the skill and plug\-in marketplace and the MCP catalog: intake, publish, version, and maintain * Set and enforce the enterprise standards and governance for skills, plug\-ins, and MCP wherever they are used across HUB, on any surface including Claude Code, and including builds executed by other engineering teams * Does not build or operate the Claude Code developer\-guardrail layer day to day; that is Enterprise Engineering’s, built against the standard this role sets * Apply access control, least\-privilege, and audit to AI assets, partnering with Security and Cloud on identity and credentials * Build simple to moderate skills, plug\-ins, and MCP connections directly; route complex builds that need new infrastructure or deep integration to Enterprise Engineering, then govern and publish the result **Quality, Evaluation, and Governance** * Stand up evaluatio as the AI stack evolves toward agents * Collaborative mindset across analysts, architects, business partners, and Enterprise Engineering **What We Offer You** ===================== At HUB International, we’re invested in your success, both inside and outside of work. Our benefits include: * Competitive base salary plus performance\-based bonus * Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage * 401(k) with company match * Paid time off and company holidays * Hybrid work arrangement based out of our Chicago office * Professional development and certification reimbursement * Opportunity to shape HUB’s enterprise AI application and asset platform and build across a modern stack spanning Claude, RAG, and agentic tooling **JOIN OUR TEAM** Do you believe in the power of innovation, collaboration, and transformation? Do you thrive in a supportive and client focused work environment? Are you looking for an opportunity to help build and drive change in a rapidly growing and evolving organization? When you join **HUB International**, you will be part of a community of learners and doers focused on our Core Values: entrepreneurship, teamwork, integrity, accountability, and service. *The expected salary range for this position is $ 135,000 to $160,000 and will be impacted by factors such as the successful candidate’s skills, experience and working location, as well as the specific position’s business line, scope and level.* *HUB International is proud to offer comprehensive benefit and total compensation packages which could include health/dental/vision/life/disability insurance, FSA, HAS and 401(k) accounts, paid\-time\-off benefits such as vacation, sick, personal, floating holidays and company holidays. In addition, eligible annual bonuses, equity and commissions may be available for some positions.* **What we offer you** We invest in your growth. HUB offers structured training, licensing support, and ongoing development opportunities designed to accelerate your career. Benefits and programs vary based on employment status, role, location, and applicable eligibility requirements. * Competitive pay with comprehensive health benefits, retirement savings matching, and company\-paid life and disability plans * Generous paid time off, paid parental leave and a wellbeing program designed to support real work/life balance * A collaborative, high\-performing culture with meaningful engagement, community impact through HUB Gives and genuine room to grow your career **The HUB difference** HUB International is one of North America’s largest insurance brokers, delivering risk management, insurance, employee benefits, retirement and wealth management solutions to businesses and individuals across the United States and Canada — through locally led teams backed by national expertise, giving you the agility of a local partner and the reach of a global organization. **Equal Employment Opportunity:** HUB International Limited is an Equal Opportunity Employer. jobs.title: Scientific AI Engineer
jobs.description: Company Description By working at Harvard University, you join a vibrant community that advances Harvard's world\-changing mission in meaningful ways, inspires innovation and collaboration, and builds skills and expertise. We are dedicated to creating a diverse and welcoming environment where everyone can thrive. **Why join Harvard Medical School?** Harvard Medical School's mission is to nurture a diverse, inclusive community dedicated to alleviating suffering and improving health and well\-being for all through excellence in teaching and learning, discovery and scholarship, and service and leadership. You’ll be at the heart of biomedical discovery, education, and innovation, working alongside world\-renowned faculty and a community dedicated to improving human health. This is more than a job \- it’s an opportunity to shape the future of medicine. **About the Department of Immunology:** Position open for a Scientific AI Engineer, to work in the context of the ImmGen consortium at Harvard Medical School. ImmGen is an NIH\-funded consortium of Immunology and Computational biology labs who pool expertise to decipher gene expression and it regulation in the immune system, whose data have become a valuable resource for the Immunology research community worldwide. The group wishes to develop a data analysis AI agent that will harness ImmGen data together with external databases to answer user questions formulated by scientists in natural language and return data\-grounded visualizations and contextualization. Job Description We are seeking an autonomous Scientific AI Engineer who will work closely with the existing ImmGen computational team and immunologists to design and implement this agent. They will integrate ImmGen’s existing data resources and analytical capabilities with the AI\-powered interface. They will not be expected to acquire or manage ImmGen data, nor rebuild analytical tools. Instead, they will determine how to expose, adapt, orchestrate, and extend those tools so they can be reliably accessed through natural\-language interaction, using MCP strategies that can be exploited by AI agents. **The position will:** * Work closely with ImmGen scientists and data analysts to understand existing datasets, metadata, documentation, tools, APIs, and access mechanisms, adapt and wrap existing ImmGen data so they can be invoked reliably by LLM\-based agent that calls on public analytical and visualization tools. * Collaborate with ImmGen scientists to define supported use cases, desired answer formats, and appropriate scientific language and graphics. * Map existing and potential researcher questions to the appropriate existing ImmGen resources and analytical workflows. * Develop the software interfaces, APIs, schemas, computational guardrails and orchestration logic required to connect the agent to ImmGen’s existing infrastructure. * Implement safeguards against hallucinated results, invalid comparisons, inappropriate statistical interpretations, and unsupported biological claims. * Ensure that the agent does not automatically initiate unduly expensive computes. * We are looking for a team player eager to participate in the exciting re\-writing of scientific data propagation. Qualifications **Basic Qualifications:** * Minimum of five years’ post\-secondary education or relevant work experience. **Additional Qualifications and Skills:** * Advanced degree or equivalent professional experience in computational biology, bioinformatics, genomics, or a related field. * Strong Python programming skills and experience with scientific computing libraries such as pandas, NumPy, SciPy, scikit\-learn, Scanpy, Bioconductor, or equivalent tools. * Strong software\-engineering skills, including experience with APIs, data schemas, testing, version control, logging, documentation, and reproducible workflows. * Experience integrating software with existing scientific data platforms, analytical pipelines, web services, or computational tools. * Hands\-on experience with LLM applications, including tool/function calling, retrieval\-augmented generation, structured outputs, agent orchestration, or natural\-language\-to\-SQL/code systems. Additional Information * **Term:** This is a 2\-year term position from the date of hire, with the possibility of extension, contingent upon work performance and continued funding to support the position. * **Standard Hours/Schedule:** 35 hours per week. * **Visa Sponsorship Information:** Harvard University is unable to provide visa sponsorship for this position. * **Pre\-Employment Screening:** Identity * **Interview Format:** The interview process will include both virtual and in\-person components (e.g., initial virtual screening followed by on\-campus final interviews). * **Staying Informed About Your Application:** Due to the high volume of applications, we may not always be able to reach out right away, but you can track your status anytime through the Careers@Harvard portal. \#LI\-DK1 **Work Format Details** This position has been determined by school or unit leaders that all duties and responsibilities must be performed at a Harvard or Harvard\-designated location. Certain visa types may limit work location. Individuals must meet work location sponsorship requirements prior to employment. **Salary Grade and Ranges** This position is salary grade level 057\. Please visit Harvard's Salary Ranges to view the corresponding salary range and related information. **Benefits** Harvard offers a comprehensive benefits package that is designed to support a healthy work\-life balance and your physical, mental and financial wellbeing. Because here, you are what matters. Our benefits include, but are not limited to: * Generous paid time off including parental leave * Medical, dental, and vision health insurance coverage starting on day one * Retirement plans with university contributions * Wellbeing and mental health resources * Support for families and caregivers * Professional development opportunities including tuition assistance and reimbursement * Commuter benefits, discounts and campus perks Learn more about these and additional benefits on our Benefits \& Wellbeing Page. **EEO/Non\-Discrimination Commitment Statement** Harvard University is committed to equal opportunity and non\-discrimination. We seek talent from all parts of society and the world, and we strive to ensure everyone at Harvard thrives. Our differences help our community advance Harvard's academic purposes. Harvard has an equal employment opportunity policy that outlines our commitment to prohibiting discrimination on the basis of race, ethnicity, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, religion, disability, or any other characteristic protected by law or identified in the university's non\-discrimination policy. Harvard's equal employment opportunity policy and non\-discrimination policy help all community members participate fully in work and campus life free from harassment and discrimination.

jobs.title: Senior AI Infrastructure Engineer
jobs.description: **About Hellyeah AI** Hellyeah is the agentic operating system for distribution. AI agents plan, execute and optimize growth work, and humans approve it. A small engineering team runs several live products, with coding agents as part of how we ship. **The role** You will own the platform our products and agents run on: the gateway every model call passes through, the runtime for our production agents, and the clusters, data stores, pipelines, secrets and release paths underneath. We're hiring two engineers, one in San Francisco and one in Shanghai. One will lean toward the AI platform and the other toward the core platform. You'll share ownership and on\-call, and work closely with our CTO. This role is onsite five days a week. On\-call includes nights and weekends, and days often run past 10 hours. **Why this role:** You'll own the whole platform, work directly with our CTO, and build the agents that run it. We run production AI across text, speech and video, mostly through third\-party model APIs, with some self\-hosted serving. The gateway supports internal teams, our products and customers. We do not train models. If you only want to work on model training, look elsewhere. If you want to make a multi\-provider AI stack reliable, secure and affordable, keep reading. Product teams own product features. IT support, marketing sites and SEO sit outside this role. **What you'll do** *The AI platform* * **Run the model gateway.** Own routing, fallbacks, provider failover, rate limits and rollouts for 90\+ model deployments across OpenAI, Anthropic, Azure, Google and AWS Bedrock. Benchmark new providers on latency, quality, cost and failure behavior before they take traffic, and escalate to vendors when they fall short. * **Make the gateway multi\-tenant.** Give each team and customer the right keys, routes, limits and usage metering, and reconcile usage against provider invoices. * **Run the AI developer platform.** Own shared coding\-agent access, including seats, quotas and per\-user limits, plus the remote workspaces our engineers use. One heavy user should never slow down everyone else. * **Run production agents safely.** Own sandboxing, credential scoping and pinned releases for long\-running agents on Kubernetes. * **Automate your own job.** Expect to build a lot of autonomous infra workflows and infra agents that take on routine requests and alerts, with a person approving risky actions. * **Own infrastructure and AI spend.** Reconcile provider bills against usage, tie spend to a team and product, and catch anomalies early. Right\-size clusters, spend vendor credits before they expire, and handle quota and billing escalations with cloud and model vendors. *The core platform* * **Keep clusters and cloud healthy.** Debug and upgrade EKS, AKS and bare\-metal k3s through Argo CD and Kustomize. Manage AWS, Azure and GCP through reviewed Terraform. * **Run the edge.** Own Cloudflare across a dozen domains: DNS, WAF, TLS, CDN and object storage, plus GeoDNS, load balancers, egress IPs and email authentication. * **Ship new services fast.** Point a coding agent at an open\-source repo and have it in production the same day: manifests or Helm, pinned images, Postgres and Redis, SSO, DNS, TLS, secrets and backups, all through GitOps. Make it highly available when it needs to be, and give each service a named owner. Build production infrastructure for new product launches the same way. * **Hack your way to a solution.** When something blocks you, read the source, patch it, work around it or build what's missing. jobs.description: **Great Purpose. Great People. Great Opportunities.** **At Imagine Learning, we Empower Potential** \- in students, educators, and each other. As the leading provider of digital\-first K–12 curriculum solutions, we’re committed to igniting learning breakthroughs that spark curiosity, creativity, and confidence. Every day, our team designs innovative tools that help educators personalize instruction and engage students in meaningful ways. We’re shaping the future of learning through our **Curriculum\-Informed AI™** approach \- technology that understands instructional context, respects educator judgment, and transforms how teachers personalize learning at scale to unlock each student’s potential. Together, we’re reimagining what’s possible and **transforming education**. That same spirit of innovation and purpose drives our team culture. At Imagine Learning, you’ll find opportunities for meaningful work, continuous growth, and connection with passionate colleagues who care deeply about making a difference. We celebrate collaboration, embrace change, and believe in lifelong learning \- for our students and ourselves. Imagine Learning offers flexible work arrangements across the U.S. and internationally. U.S.\-based employees located in or around Tempe, AZ (HQ), Austin, TX, Petaluma, CA, Rock Rapids, IA, or Stamford, CT, typically work on a hybrid schedule at one of our office locations. **Imagine Your Impact****.** Come help us explore what’s possible with AI\-powered research and development in education. We’re building a small, entrepreneurial team with room to experiment, big problems to solve, and a shared drive to make a difference. You’ll dig into emerging technology, turn ideas into working prototypes, and learn alongside colleagues who are as curious and committed as you are. We’re looking for people who take initiative, bring energy to hard problems, and care about seeing the work through. If you’re excited to go deep on AI, share what you discover, and move quickly with a team that builds and learns together, you’ll have a hand in shaping this work from the start. Bring your curiosity, your ideas, and your determination to make things better for students and educators. The AI Engineer explores new AI capabilities for education at Imagine Learning. On a small, co\-located R\&D team, this hands\-on role turns experiments into prototypes and reliable software. We seek an inventive engineer who wants to push beyond established solutions, improve learning, and collaborate closely with product and research colleagues. Success requires comfort with ambiguity, disciplined evaluation, and rapid learning. For more information on what it’s like to work at Imagine Learning, including our culture, benefits, and products, visit us**HERE****.** To learn more about a typical applicant journey at Imagine Learning, click**HERE*****.*****Position** **Information**: This is a regular, full\-time position, reporting to the Software Engineering Manager UK. **Compensation**: Base pay is anticipated to be between $129,339\.00 and $200,000\.00 per year. Eligible employees may also receive incentive/commission/annual bonus pay based on individual and/or company performance. Compensation may vary based on factors such as, but not limited to, individual skills, experience, training, education/certifications, geographic location, internal equity, and local market conditions. **Location:** This US\-based position is hybrid, and a coworking space will be provided in the Boston, MA area. **Travel:** This role may require limited travel of approximately 10% or less, with occasional travel to Connecticut and, less frequently, Tempe, Arizona. Be sure you have a valid driver’s license, automobile insurance, and a clean driving record for at least the preceding 39 months. **Benefits:** Imagine Learning provides a comprehensive benefits program to eligible employees, including:* Multiple health, dental, and vision plans, including medical plans with zero employee premiums * 401k plan with a company match * 16 paid holidays, which include 2 floating holidays and a winter shutdown from Christmas Eve through New Year’s Day * Paid Time Off * Comprehensive maternity and fertility/family building benefits * Paid bonding leave when a new child joins your family * Access to on\-demand mental health resources * Life and short and long\-term disability insurance * Pre\-tax savings plans * Paid volunteer time off * A wide variety of professional development programs, including tuition reimbursement * Work from home opportunities that foster work/life balance **Envision Your Experience****.** In this role you’ll have the opportunity to:* Prototype AI applications and agentic workflows using model APIs, tool calling, retrieval, structured outputs, and state management. * Compare models and architectures for each use case; apply fine\-tuning or other model adaptation when evaluation demonstrates an advantage. * Build evaluation datasets, automated checks, and human review workflows to measure quality, robustness, and regressions. * Diagnose failures through traces and error analysis; improve grounding, tool reliability, context handling, and recovery from unexpected outputs. * Design sandboxed execution with least\-privilege access, network and filesystem restrictions, secrets protection, and resource limits for agent tools and generated code. * Test prompt injection, data leakage, and unintended actions; implement output validation, isolation boundaries, and auditable execution with security partners. * Measure latency, throughput, and inference costs; collaborate with application engineers and learning researchers on testable, observable software. * Test emerging techniques, document findings and limitations, and help the team decide what to pursue, revise, or stop. * Other duties as required. **Share Your Expertise****.** Experience, education, and qualifications essential for success in this role, include:* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field and at least 5 or more years of software or machine learning engineering experience; or an acceptable combination of education and experience. * Hands\-on experience building LLM applications with tool use, retrieval, structured outputs, and evaluation; ability to explain failures and improvements. * Strong Python or TypeScript skills; experience with APIs, asynchronous code, data models, testing, cloud services, and debugging across system boundaries. * Practical understanding of sandboxing, isolation, access controls, secrets management, and security risks in agentic systems. * Strongly preferred: experience with multimodal or voice AI, agent orchestration, model adaptation, or evaluation infrastructure; active experimentation with emerging AI methods. * Preferred: experience and understanding of agentic toolkits or frameworks such as Deep Agents, LangChain, LangGraph, OpenClaw, Hermes, or comparable tools. At Imagine Learning, we believe our work is strongest when people feel respected, supported, and encouraged to contribute their unique perspectives. We strive to create a welcoming workplace where employees can learn from one another, grow together, and build educational experiences that reflect the world of our learners. Imagine Learning is an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to providing equal employment and advancement opportunities to qualified individuals. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, ancestry, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, lactation, or related medical conditions), gender identity or expression, transgender status (including whether or not you are transitioning or have transitioned), sexual orientation, marital status, religion (including religion dress and grooming practices), age 40 and over, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information (including results of genetic testing and characteristics), veteran and/or military status, or service in the military, and any other basis or status protected under applicable federal, state, or local laws. ***To all recruitment agencies:*** *Imagine Learning does not accept agency resumes* *without our express written permission**. Please do not submit candidates for consideration via our online application system, to Imagine Learning employees, or to any other* *organization location* *without written authorization to do so**. Imagine Learning is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.* We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. jobs.title: Senior Memory Characterization & Reliability Engineer
jobs.description: **Job Details:** ================ **Job Description:** -------------------- **The Role and Impact:** Intel Foundry is seeking a **Senior Memory Characterization \& Reliability Engineer** to join our Memory Technology Development organization. In this role, you will drive reliability assessment, silicon characterization, technology qualification, and certification activities for advanced embedded memory technologies. You will work across process development, device engineering, product engineering, design technology co\-optimization (DTCO), and foundry customer teams to ensure memory technologies meet quality, reliability, and technology readiness objectives. This position offers a unique opportunity to influence next\-generation semiconductor technologies from development through production readiness. Successful candidates will combine strong technical expertise with a data\-driven approach to problem\-solving and the ability to effectively collaborate across highly cross\-functional engineering organizations. **What You’ll Do** **Key responsibilities will include but not limited to:** * Develop and execute reliability qualification and certification methodologies for advanced embedded memory technologies. * Define, analyze, and interpret reliability stress tests, characterization data, and qualification results to assess technology readiness. * Investigate reliability risks, performance degradations, and failure mechanisms using statistical analysis and engineering fundamentals. * Lead cross\-functional root cause investigations involving process integration, device engineering, product engineering, and design teams. * Partner with technology development organizations to identify, prioritize, and implement reliability and quality improvements. * Establish reliability metrics, qualification criteria, and certification requirements supporting technology development milestones. * Generate data\-driven recommendations used for technology certification and product readiness decisions. * Drive continuous improvement initiatives that enhance memory reliability, quality, yield, and manufacturability. * Communicate technical findings, reliability assessments, and recommendations to engineering leadership and key stakeholders. Support foundry customer engagement activities related to memory qualification, reliability requirements, and technology readiness. * **Behavioral traits that we are looking for:** * Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with a disciplined, data\-driven approach. * Curiosity and a passion for understanding complex technical challenges and failure mechanisms. * Ability to independently drive ambiguity toward clear conclusions and actionable recommendations. * Strong collaboration and relationship\-building skills across diverse technical organizations. * Effective written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to present complex technical concepts clearly. * Sound engineering judgment and attention to detail. * Ownership mindset with a commitment to delivering high\-quality results. * Adaptability and resilience in a fast\-paced technology development environment. Continuous learning mindset and enthusiasm for advancing semiconductor technology. * Intel invests in our people and offers a complete and competitive package of benefits employees and their families through every stage of life. * See Intel Benefits for more details. **Qualifications:** ------------------- You must possess the below minimum qualifications to be initially considered for this position. Preferred qualifications are in addition to the minimum requirements and are considered a plus factor in identifying top candidates. **Note:** **For information on Intel’s immigration sponsorship guidelines, please see** **Intel U.S. Immigration Sponsorship Information** **Minimum Qualifications and Experience** : Masters in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Physics, Materials Science, or a related discipline with 8\+ years of semiconductor industry experience. OR Ph.D. in the same disciplines with 4\+ years of semiconductor industry experience. Your experience listed above will be in the following: * Experience in memory technology development. Proficiency with JMP and Python or AI\-assisted data analysis. * **Preferred Qualifications and Experience** : * Experience in memory design, characterization, validation, modeling, product development, quality, reliability, or technology development. * Strong understanding of SRAM and/or Fuse/Antifuse design fundamentals, silicon characterization techniques, and variability analysis. * Experience with Si technology development. * Knowledge in silicon transistor device physics. * Familiarity with technology certification, PDK development, or product deployment processes. * Programming experience in Python, JSL, SQL, or data analytics frameworks. * Experience with semiconductor transistor or interconnect reliability mechanisms, statistics and modeling. Previous related work experience in a semiconductor foundry preferred. * **Why Join Intel Foundry?** At Intel Foundry, you'll work at the forefront of semiconductor innovation, supporting technologies that power the world's most advanced computing solutions. You'll collaborate with experienced engineers and manufacturing leaders while gaining hands\-on exposure to cutting\-edge processes, industry\-leading quality systems, and opportunities for professional growth. Join a team committed to solving complex technical challenges and delivering excellence at scale. **Job Type:** ------------- Experienced Hire **Shift:** ---------- Shift 1 (United States of America) **Primary Location:** --------------------- US, California, Folsom **Additional Locations:** ------------------------- US, California, Santa Clara, US, Oregon, Hillsboro **Posting Statement:** ---------------------- All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, religious creed, sex, national origin, ancestry, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, military and veteran status, marital status, pregnancy, gender, gender expression, gender identity, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by local law, regulation, or ordinance. **Position of Trust** --------------------- N/A **Benefits** ------------ We offer a total compensation package that ranks among the best in the industry. It consists of competitive pay, stock bonuses, and benefit programs which include health, retirement, and vacation. Find out more about the benefits of working at Intel . Annual Salary Range for jobs which could be performed in the US: $164,100\.00\-219,550\.00 USD The range displayed on this job posting reflects the minimum and maximum target compensation for the position across all US locations. Within the range, individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Your recruiter can share more about the specific compensation range for your preferred location during the hiring process. **Work Model for this Role** This role will be eligible for our hybrid work model which allows employees to split their time between working on\-site at their assigned Intel site and off\-site. \* Job posting details (such as work model, location or time type) are subject to change. * ADDITIONAL INFORMATION: Intel is committed to Responsible Business Alliance (RBA) compliance and ethical hiring practices. We do not charge any fees during our hiring process. Candidates should never be required to pay recruitment fees, medical examination fees, or any other charges as a condition of employment. If you are asked to pay any fees during our hiring process, please report this immediately to your recruiter.

jobs.description: About Us: **Intermountain Electric (IME)** brings decades of experience as a trusted leader in electrical contracting. Founded in 1946, we began as a small company in Denver, CO, and have since grown to be part of the largest specialty contractor in North America. Today, we work with owners and contractors nationwide, delivering complex construction solutions across various industries, including aviation, mission critical, entertainment, and healthcare. At IME, our people are our most valuable asset. We are committed to fostering a culture that prioritizes safety, quality, and professional growth. Joining IME is more than just finding a job—it's about building a career with opportunities to advance and make an organizational impact. Power your future with IME and be a part of a team that drives success in every project. About this Role: For 80 years, Intermountain Electric, Inc. (IME) has been a trusted partner on the front lines of some of the most essential electrical projects, delivering safe, smart, and reliable electrical solutions through our people and partnerships, the IME Way. Through strategic planning, collaboration, and technical excellence, and guided by our values of Integrity, Safety, Ingenuity, Relationships, Craftsmanship, and Spark, we empower our professionals to innovate, support our field teams, and strengthen the partnerships that move our work forward. Join a team where your expertise fuels the systems that keep communities running! **Position Summary** The Project Engineer plays a key role in delivering large\-scale, mission\-critical electrical projects, including data centers, by supporting engineering and technical activities from concept through completion. They plan, schedule, forecast, resource, and manage project execution to ensure quality, accuracy, and successful outcomes on complex, fast\-paced construction projects. Through collaboration, innovation, and proactive problem\-solving, they drive continuous improvement and contribute to the successful delivery of highly coordinated electrical systems. What You'll Do: **Key Responsibilities** **Project Planning \& Ingenuity** * Demonstrate craftsmanship and attention to detail by thoroughly analyzing and interpreting construction drawings to ensure a complete understanding of project scope. * Assist in reviewing plans and specifications, developing detailed checklists that highlight contractual and technical items requiring ongoing attention—supporting integrity and accountability from the outset. * Collaborate with cross‑functional project teams to contribute to cost estimates and schedule development, applying ingenuity and analytical thinking to support well\-coordinated, schedule\-driven project planning. **Project Progress \& Craftsmanship** * Prepare clear, accurate statements of work, submittals, and change management documentation, promoting transparent communication and trust across project stakeholders. * Inspect equipment, materials, workmanship, and completed construction with a commitment to exceptional craftsmanship and quality, ensuring full compliance with project specifications. * Maintain precise and organized project records to track progress, changes, and compliance—reinforcing integrity, accuracy, and reliability in large, document\-heavy projects. **Safety Leadership** * Champion a safety‑first culture, modeling behaviors that protect people, projects, and communities. * Actively promote and ensure compliance with all safety regulations, standards, and best practices, reflecting our unwavering commitment to safety and care for others. * Monitor ongoing work to verify that materials, methods, and installations align with safety requirements and approved specifications. **Industry Engagement \& Relationships** * Serve as a brand ambassador, representing the company with professionalism, integrity, and ethical leadership in all interactions. * Build and strengthen relationships with clients, subcontractors, suppliers, and industry partners, fostering long‑term collaboration and trust. * Cultivate industry connections and stay engaged with market trends, helping position the company as a respected and reliable leader in electrical contracting. * Bring spark and enthusiasm to teamwork, collaboration, and external engagement—contributing energy, curiosity, and pride in our work. *Additional duties as assigned.* What You'll Bring: **Knowledge, Skills \& Abilities** * Strong capability in due diligence and risk assessment, supporting sound decision‑making and project integrity. * Impeccable ethics and professionalism with internal teams and external partners. * Strong analytical, organizational, and interpersonal skills that support work in fast\-paced, schedule sensitive environments. * Excellent communication skills, with the ability to clearly explain complex technical information to diverse audiences. * Willingness to travel frequently to construction sites to stay engaged, visible, and connected to project t ndustry and market trends. * Thorough knowledge of safety standards and best practices in electrical construction. **Education \& Experience** * Demonstrated hands‑on experience with exposure to larger\-scale or more complex commercial or mission critical construction projects * Experience contributing to projects with defined schedules, multiple phases, or coordination across trades. * Bachelor’s degree in Construction Management, Civil Engineering, or a related field preferred; equivalent combinations of relevant education, training, and applied project experience will be considered. What You'll Get: **Working Conditions**: The majority of the time you will work in a typical office environment. Occasionally, you may travel to a construction job site. When on construction job sites you will encounter typical construction conditions including extreme temperatures, noise, dust, mud debris, welding, leading edge, trenching, and shoring, sometimes in a confined space. You may be required to visit multiple locations during any one day. **Benefits Overview:** IME provides an industry\-leading comprehensive benefits package. Full\-time employees are eligible to choose from a variety of healthcare coverage options, which become effective the first of the month after hire. In addition, employees are offered a substantial amount of PTO and are immediately eligible to make contributions to a generously matched and fully vested 401k. **Salary Range:** $74,800 \- $101,200*\*Final salary and rates are based on education, experience, skills relevant to the role, and internal equity.\** Established in 1946, IME is part of Quanta Services, the largest specialty contractor in North America. We base our business model on always doing the right thing and pride ourselves in finding the best processes and practices in everything we do. As an electrical contractor, we install and service the power and lighting to commercial and industrial buildings in the Western US. The statements included in this job description are not intended to be all\-inclusive and other duties may be assigned as required. Intermountain Electric, Inc. (IME) is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants and to creating an environment free of discrimination and harassment. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran. IME will provide reasonable accommodations to applicants and employees who are qualified for a job so that they may perform the essential duties of the position. IME strives to provide a safe work environment for its employees. Under applicable laws and regulations, IME conducts background checks on all final candidates. **Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment Visa at this time.** Compensation Range: The anticipated compensation for this position is \- depending on experience and qualifications. With deep domain expertise and extensive engineering capabilities, Invio partners with clients from early\-stage product design and R\&D through to full\-scale automation. Customers value Invio’s commitment to precision, quality, efficiency, and safety, and rely on its innovative, scalable solutions to support long\-term growth. Headquartered in Michigan, Invio Automation is supported by a vast design library, a growing North American presence with global reach, and a team of over 600 experienced professionals across the Midwest and northeast. Invio operates through two integrated segments: * The **Solutions Segment** delivers engineered systems for precision manufacturing, including robotic cells, multi\-station assembly lines, and other automation solutions. * The **Technologies Segment** focuses on advanced autonomous systems and ergonomic tooling, including heavyweight Autonomous Mobile Robots (AMRs), Automated Guided Vehicles (AGVs), turnkey assembly solutions, and custom lift\-assist tools for safety\-critical applications. Together, these segments enable Invio to deliver tailored automation solutions that improve performance and achieve high efficiency across the production lifecycle. Visit https://invioautomation.com/ for more information. **DESCRIPTION** The primary responsibility of this position is to collect, organize, and interpret technical and operational data and use that information to develop accurate 2D layouts and 3D CAD models of manufacturing equipment, production lines, and industrial facilities. These models will serve as the foundation for simulations and digital twin applications performed by a separate engineering department. The role requires strong CAD modeling capabilities, attention to detail, and the ability to translate existing drawings, technical documentation, and physical measurements into accurate, simulation\-ready digital models. **ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES** Data Collection and Preparation * Gather and consolidate technical information from engineering drawings, existing CAD files, equipment specifications, facility layouts, and customer documentation. * Coordinate with engineering teams, customers, and other stakeholders to obtain missing information. * Review and validate collected information to ensure completeness, consistency, and accuracy. * Organize and maintain technical data and CAD files for future use. 2D and 3D Modeling * Develop and maintain accurate 2D layouts of manufacturing facilities, production lines, equipment, and workstations. * Create 3D CAD models of machines, automation systems, production cells, and manufacturing environments. * Convert, modify, and simplify existing CAD models to meet simulation requirements. * Ensure models accurately represent equipment dimensions, positioning, clearances, and relevant mechanical interfaces. * Establish and maintain standardized CAD model libraries to improve efficiency and reuse. Simulation Model Preparation and Support * Collaborate with the simulation engineering department to understand model requirements, formats, and specifications. * Prepare and deliver 2D and 3D models suitable for use in simulation and digital twin software. * Ensure geometric accuracy, model completeness, and compatibility with downstream simulation tools. * Update models based on feedback and evolving project requirements. * Support the simulation team by providing additional technical information and model adjustments when required. **Qualifications:**To perform this job successfully, an individual must be professional, proactive and positive, with internal and external customers and coworkers. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform essential functions. **Required:** * Technical education or degree in Mechanical Engineering, Mechanical Design, CAD Technology, or a related field. * Experience developing 2D layouts and 3D CAD models. * Proficiency in CAD software such as AutoCAD, SolidWorks, Inventor, or equivalent platforms. * Ability to interpret engineering drawings, equipment specifications, and manufacturing layouts. * Understanding of manufacturing equipment, industrial automation systems, and production environments. * Strong attention to detail and ability to organize technical information. * Effective communication and collaboration skills. **Preferred:** * Experience in industrial automation or manufacturing systems integration. * Familiarity with digital twin and manufacturing simulation environments. * Experience preparing and simplifying CAD models for simulation applications. * Experience working with large facility layouts and complex equipment assemblies. * Familiarity with 3D scanning, point clouds, or reverse engineering. **EDUCATION** Prefer a Bachelor’s degree in mechanical, electrical, or manufacturing engineering with at least 10 years of experience. **INVIO AUTOMATION’S CORE VALUES*** We take pride in the ***reliability*** of our team and the difficult problems we solve for customers. * We deliver ***real customer value*** that positively impacts the lives of those around us. * We are ***dependable***.
