jobs.title: GTM Engineer
jobs.description: **About JustPark** JustPark is the premier partner offering both B2B solutions for destinations and B2C services for drivers. From venues and councils to private driveways, our platform makes it simple for drivers to find, book, and pay for parking—while empowering our operating partners to deliver exceptional parking experiences. We are two trailblazing companies become one. ParkHub revolutionized event parking in the US, optimizing venue operations for a smoother, stress\-free experience. JustPark transformed parking in the UK, turning the hunt for a spot into a simple, seamless task. Together we offer a full\-service, frictionless parking solution for both businesses and consumers. **About the role** This is a builder’s seat inside the commercial organization, and it is central to where we are taking the US commercial team. You will design and build the agentic workflows and agents that change how the team works day to day, and you will own the marketing and sales systems they run on. You report to the VP of Revenue Operations. Agentic workflows and agents are the heart of this role. We want the repetitive work out of the commercial team’s day — researching and enriching accounts, surfacing signals worth acting on, drafting outreach, keeping records current, preparing reps before a call. You decide what is worth building, build it, and prove it on something real before scaling it. Everything you ship is internal and keeps a person in the loop. You work with the data team — you do not own the data layer. We are building a data layer as a company and the data team owns it. You are its most demanding internal customer: you bring the commercial requirements, shape what the commercial side needs from it, and build on top of what they deliver. You own the marketing and sales systems. The commercial team spans Business Development, Account Executives across Events and Commercial Real Estate, Account Management and North American Marketing, built from two companies that recently became one. You own the architecture of the stack those teams run on and the integrations between them. We have a Salesforce administrator for day\-to\-day configuration and user requests, so you are not the ticket queue. There is no roadmap waiting for you and no vendor already chosen — you set the direction with your VP. This role is remote within the US, with regular travel to our Dallas–Fort Worth hub. You cannot automate a workflow you have never watched someone do, so expect real time sitting with reps. **Requirements** ### **Position Responsibilities:** **Agentic workflows and agents** * Find the commercial workflows where an agent or automation earns its place, starting from where the team actually loses time * Design and build internal agentic workflows end to end, with clear boundaries for what runs autonomously and what gets drafted for a person to review * Evaluate and monitor what you ship — accuracy, adoption, time saved — so a degrading agent is caught by you rather than reported by a frustrated rep * Keep pace with a tooling market that moves monthly, without rebuilding the stack every time something new appears **Marketing and sales systems** * Own the architecture of the commercial stack — CRM, marketing automation, call intelligence, enrichment and engagement tooling — and the integrations between them, so a record created in one place is correct everywhere it matters * Own lifecycle and routing logic — how a lead becomes an account, how it reaches the right rep, and what happens when it does not * Partner with our Salesforce administrator, who owns configuration and user requests, while you own architecture and anything that needs building rather than configuring * Make the build\-versus\-buy call on new tooling, and be honest when buying is the right answer **Working with the data team, and the commercial team** * Bring the commercial requirements to the data team and shape what the commercial side needs from the data layer they own * Build the enrichment, scoring and signal detection that feed the BDR and AE motion on top of what the data team delivers * Make commercial reporting trustworthy — attribution, funnel conversion, activity and pipeline metrics leadership can act on without a caveat * Sit with BDRs, AEs, Account Managers and Marketing to understand their actual workflow before automating any part of it, and partner with Revenue Enablement so what you ship arrives with training rather than a link in Slack **Who thrives here** We hire for four things across the commercial team. They apply to an engineer sitting inside it as much as to anyone carrying a number. * **Growth mindset.** You ship, watch what happens, and change it. You will be wrong about which workflows matter most — find that out in two weeks, not a quarter. * **Team player.** You build with the commercial team rather than for them, and take “this is slower than doing it myself” as information rather than user error. * **Daily work ethic.** A lot of this job is unglamorous: the backfill, the field cleanup, the integration that breaks at an awkward time. The impressive parts only stand up if it is done. * **Coachability.** You are the most technical person in a commercial room, which makes it easy to stop listening. You ask what people actually need. **What success looks like** This is a build role, so the milestones are about shipping rather than surveying. * By day 30 — You have sat with reps in every commercial role watching them work, mapped the stack and where it breaks, and met the data team to understand what the data layer will provide and when. You have a prioritised list of workflows worth automating, agreed with the VP. * By day 60 — The first agentic workflow is live with the team it was built for, however small. The highest\-cost systems and integration problems are fixed or scheduled. * By day 90 — Agents are in production and used daily, with evaluation and monitoring behind them, and you can show what they save. Commercial reporting is trusted, and you have a sequenced plan for what comes next. ### **Requirements** * Based in the US with the ability to travel regularly to our Dallas–Fort Worth hub; US work authorization * 3\+ years in GTM engineering, revenue operations engineering, marketing operations or sales systems, in a role where you built rather than only configured * You write code and you use low\-code, and you know which one a problem deserves. Comfortable in Python or TypeScript against APIs, and equally comfortable solving something in a day with Clay, n8n, Zapier or Workato * Hands\-on experience building with LLMs and agent tooling — prompting, retrieval, tool use, evaluation — and a clear view of where they work and where they do not * Deep working knowledge of Salesforce beyond the admin surface — data model, automation, integration patterns — and experience architecting a marketing automation platform and its CRM integration * Strong data fundamentals: SQL and a real understanding of data modelling, enough to be a credible partner to a data team rather than only a consumer of what it produces * Able to translate between a commercial problem and a technical one in both directions, and to say no to a request that would create more mess than it solves * Clear writer. You document what you build so it outlives your memory of it * Nice to have: internal agents or automation a sales team actually adopted; consolidating systems after a merger; exposure to events, hospitality, commercial real estate, municipal government, parking or venue technology **Benefits** **What We Offer:** Recharge your batteries * Unlimited PTO policy * Complimentary in\-office barista (Dallas office) * Catered breakfast \& lunch Tuesday–Thursday (Dallas office) * Weekly social events at the office (Dallas office) Investment in you and your wellbeing * Comprehensive medical \& dental coverage through Blue Cross Blue Shield and Mutual of Omaha * Multiple healthcare plan options including low\-deductible and HSA, plus broad supplemental benefits * Employee Assistance Program * Subscriptions to mental health assistance platforms We look out for your family * Generous parental leave policy * Fertility support via ARC Fertility * Pet insurance and discount plans Look after the pennies * 401(k) retirement and savings plan * Travel stipend for local employees Success is best when it's shared * Regular social activities and ad hoc celebrations

jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer
jobs.description: Overview: Kastle Systems is a leader in managed security solutions, offering cutting\-edge technologies to enhance the safety and security of commercial buildings, residential complexes, and government facilities. We are on a mission to deliver scalable, innovative security services with our powerful tech stack, open platform, and managed service business model. We are a fast\-growing security technology company specializing in enterprise\-grade physical access control systems and deep platform integrations. Our solutions protect critical infrastructure, commercial real estate, healthcare facilities, and government campuses worldwide. We build proprietary hardware\-software ecosystems and partner with leading identity providers, PIAM platforms, and building management systems to deliver seamless, intelligent security operations at scale. We are looking for a Senior Data Engineer with proven people management experience to join our engineering organization and help us unlock the full potential of the data our systems generate — from access events and device telemetry to integration pipelines and compliance reporting. In addition to a collaborative work environment in a cutting\-edge industry, we provide excellent benefits (Comprehensive Medical/Dental/Vision, 401K, Tuition/Training Assistance, BrightHorizons Lifestyle Assistance, Wellness Program, etc.). Ths role would also offer a hybrid work environment with the flexibility to balance in\-office and remote work. We are proud to be a Certified Great Place to Work with awards for being a Top Work Place with Top Diversity, Equity, \& Inclusion practices! Please visit Kastle Careers to learn more about working with Kastle. Responsibilities: **Role overview** As a Senior Data Engineer, you will design, build, and maintain the data infrastructure that powers our access control platform. You will lead a small team of data and analytics engineers, set technical standards, and serve as the connective tissue between our security hardware, cloud platform, and the enterprise systems our customers integrate with. You will own the data pipelines that ingest millions of daily access events, deliver actionable intelligence to customers, and feed the compliance and audit workflows our enterprise clients depend on. You will also own the data management layer for our core business systems — ERP, CRM, and customer support platforms — using advanced SQL to model, reconcile, and govern customer, contract, order, billing, and service data so that product, operations, finance, and sales teams work from a single trusted source of truth. **Key responsibilities** **Data Engineering \& Architecture** * Design and maintain scalable ETL/ELT pipelines ingesting access events, device telemetry, and identity data from distributed physical access control systems * Architect and evolve our cloud data platform (AWS/Azure/GCP) including data lake, warehouse, and streaming components * Build and maintain real\-time data pipelines using Kafka, Kinesis, or equivalent to support live event dashboards and alerting * Develop data models for access control entities: doors, readers, credentials, cardholders, zones, schedules, and audit logs * Own the integration data layer connecting our platform with PIAM, LDAP/Active Directory, HR systems, and building management systems (BMS) * Own ERP and CRM data management: design and maintain data models, master data (customers, sites, accounts, contracts, products, orders, invoices, and service entitlements), and pipelines between ERP, CRM, support/ticketing, and our access control platform * Write, tune, and review advanced SQL (complex joins, window functions, CTEs, stored procedures, views) to support operational reporting, finance and sales analytics, and data reconciliation across systems * Lead ERP, CRM, and support platform data migrations and implementations, including data mapping, cleansing, deduplication, validation, cutover, and post\-go\-live reconciliation * Establish master data management (MDM) practices and data stewardship standards, including golden\-record definitions, ownership, and change control across ERP and CRM systems * Ensure data quality, lineage, and observability across all production pipelines * Implement and enforce data governance, retention, and security policies in alignment with SOC 2, GDPR, and FedRAMP requirements **Technical Leadership \& Management** * Lead, mentor, and grow a team of 3–6 data and analytics engineers * Conduct regular 1:1s, performance reviews, and career development planning for direct reports * Define and uphold engineering best practices: code review standards, testing requirements, CI/CD pipelines, and documentation * Partner with product managers and solutions architects to translate customer requirements into technical roadmap items * Collaborate with firmware and embedded systems engineers to define data schemas and transmission protocols for access control hardware * Drive incident response for BigQuery, or Redshift * Deep experience with data pipeline orchestration tools (Apache Airflow, Prefect, Dagster, or equivalent) * Proficiency with streaming and event\-driven architectures (Kafka, Kinesis, Spark Streaming) * Strong understanding of REST API integration patterns and experience building data connectors for enterprise SaaS systems * Hands\-on experience managing data in ERP and CRM platforms (e.g., NetSuite, SAP, Microsoft Dynamics 365, Oracle, Salesforce, HubSpot), including data extraction, transformation, and integration via native APIs, connectors, and SQL * Proven experience leading or supporting ERP, CRM, or support platform data migrations or implementations, including data mapping, cleansing, validation, and reconciliation * Working knowledge of master data management, data stewardship, and cross\-system data synchronization for customer, product, contract, and financial data * Familiarity with identity and access management concepts: LDAP, Active Directory, SCIM, OAuth 2\.0, SAML * Experience designing data systems that comply with security and regulatory frameworks (SOC 2, ISO 27001, NIST, GDPR) * Demonstrated ability to manage and deliver projects with cross\-functional stakeholders in an agile Clarify requirements and acceptance criteria, design and implement changes across the relevant AI, backend, data, and UI components, and support their operation after release. * Build and evaluate AI workflows. Deploy, troubleshoot, and improve containerized application workloads, including configuration, networking, storage, resource usage, observability, and rollout and recovery behavior. Coordinate with platform teams on shared infrastructure. * Review and improve implementation quality. Review human\-written and AI\-generated code for correctness, security, reliability, and maintainability. Trace changes across components, challenge assumptions in the code and its tests, and address underlying causes of defects. * Protect company data and user access. Build integrations that respect user permissions, preserve data integrity, and handle AI\-driven actions and failures safely, in partnership with security and data owners. * Strengthen software engineering practices. Improve existing workflows through meaningful automated tests, code review, error handling, CI/CD, documentation, and operational visibility. Keep solutions understandable and proportionate to the problem. * Make capabilities clear and usable. Carry features through UI integration and documentation, and keep ownership, dependencies, readiness, rollout status, and known limitations visible to the team. **Qualifications** ------------------ * 5\+ years of professional software engineering experience designing, building, and maintaining production applications or services, including independent ownership of substantial features or services from design through deployment and ongoing support. * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical software engineering experience. * Hands\-on Kubernetes experience deploying, operating, and troubleshooting containerized applications. * Strong programming and debugging skills, with depth in Python or TypeScript and the ability to contribute across Python services and TypeScript/React web applications. * The ability to read unfamiliar code, identify consequential defects and architectural weaknesses, and explain why a proposed correction is sound. * Practical experience integrating large language models (LLMs) or agent workflows into applications, including evaluating their behavior and limitations. * Experience using AI\-assisted development tools while independently reviewing, debugging, and validating the resulting code. * Solid software engineering fundamentals across API design, data modeling, distributed systems, authentication and authorization, testing, version control, and CI/CD. * Experience moving prototypes into maintained production systems, with attention to security, failure handling, performance, and operability. * Clear communication and the ability to support contributors with different technical backgrounds. This role is ideal for a licensed professional who brings electrical systems expertise, sound judgment, and a strategic mindset to guide clients through complex facility decisions. You will lead and contribute to Facility Condition Assessments (FCA), feasibility studies, capital planning, and master planning efforts such as translating electrical system findings into actionable insights. Working closely with project managers, clients, and multidisciplinary teams, you will provide technical leadership and help shape long\-term investment strategies for public and institutional assets. **Duties and Responsibilities** * Lead and perform assessments of electrical distribution, lighting, emergency power, low\-voltage, and related building systems * Interpret existing conditions and translate findings into clear recommendations, renewal priorities, and capital improvement strategies * Provide electrical engineering and code expertise for feasibility studies, adaptive reuse evaluations, and long\-range planning * Prepare and oversee technical reports, assessment summaries, and client\-facing deliverables * Support master planning, including electrical capacity, equipment lifecycle, facility prioritization, and phasing strategies * Collaborate with project managers, clients, consultants, and agencies to align technical findings with project goals * Participate in stakeholder meetings, workshops, and presentations to communicate findings and recommendations * Conduct field investigations and site visits to validate existing electrical conditions * Perform design and constructability reviews of third\-party documents, as applicable * Mentor junior staff and contribute to continuous improvement of assessment tools, standards, and reporting processes **Education and Experience** * Bachelor’s degree from an accredited four\-year college or university in Electrical Engineering or a related field, or equivalent experience required. * 8\+ years of relevant experience, with a focus on existing buildings, assessments, or advisory services * Strong knowledge of electrical distribution, lighting, emergency power, applicable codes, and building systems * Experience with Facility Condition Assessments, feasibility studies, or capital planning is highly desirable * Experience with arc flash studies is a plus * Proficiency in Revit and/or AutoCAD for review and limited production support * Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite; strong report\-writing skills required * Experience with asset inventories or capital planning platforms is a plus * Knowledge of energy efficiency and electrical system renewal strategies is a plus * Professional Engineer (PE) license in Electrical Engineering required; California licensure preferred **Knowledge and Skills** * Ability to synthesize complex building data into clear, strategic recommendations * Strong verbal and written communication skills, particularly in technical reporting and client presentations * Sound professional judgment and problem\-solving ability in existing building conditions * Ability to lead technical efforts while collaborating across multidisciplinary teams * Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple assignments and priorities * Commitment to integrity, quality, and client service **Licenses and Certifications** * State of California Professional Engineer (PE) license or Engineer in Training (EIT) certification is preferred. * A valid driver’s license with an acceptable motor vehicle record, free from suspensions or restrictions, is required. **Travel Requirement** This position is office based in the San Diego, CA Regional Office. Conditions may occasionally include exposure to outdoor elements, hot and cold temperatures, wet conditions, noise, atmospheric conditions, and cramped quarters. The noise level in the work environment is regularly moderate and occasionally loud. When visiting active construction sites, appropriate personal protective equipment may be required. **Physical Requirements** While performing the duties of this job, the employee is required to regularly sit, talk, listen, and use hands to finger, feel, and handle; frequently stand, walk, and reach with hands and arms; and occasionally climb or balance and stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl. Must frequently lift and/or move up to 5 pounds and occasionally lift and/or move up to 20 pounds. **ABOUT OUR COMPANY** Founded in 1950, Kitchell began as a commercial contracting business and over the years developed new talents and enterprises, acquiring complementary businesses and expertise to remain competitive. Today, Kitchell Corporation serves as the holding entity for several companies that are integral to Kitchell's core business, as well as those that operate independently. We provide a wide range of services within the built environment, including general contracting, construction management, development, facilities management, engineering, architecture, and myriad other services. Our employees manage projects from our main offices located in Arizona, California, and Texas. We offer an entrepreneurial environment that fosters personal and professional growth through in\-house education programs, formal and informal mentoring, and cross\-training opportunities. At Kitchell, we prioritize internal growth and building careers from within. We consistently rank among the top places to work, thanks to our tenured staff and outstanding benefits that are designed to enrich our employees’ physical, mental, emotional, and financial well\-being. These benefits include company performance bonuses, discretionary stock options, incentive bonuses, health, and life insurance, health savings accounts (HSA) with wellness incentives, flexible spending accounts (FSA), 401(k) plans with a 4% company match, tuition reimbursement, weight loss programs, discounted auto insurance, identity theft protection, rewards programs, and much more. *Kitchell is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action employer and will consider all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, protected veteran status, or disability status.* *The annual base salary range for this role is currently $110,000 \- $133,000\. The Company’s salary ranges are determined by role, level, location, and alignment with market data. Individual pay is determined through interviews and an assessment of various factors, including job\-related skills, relevant education and experience, abilities of the applicant and equity with other team members. The annual base salary range listed here is subject to change at any time, in the Company’s discretion, and does not alter in any way the at\-will nature of the employment relationship.*

Perform other job\-related duties as assigned. **Minimum Qualifications** * Bachelor's degree in Engineering or equivalent combination of education and relevant SMT manufacturing experience. * 7\+ years of SMT manufacturing experience with increasing levels of technical responsibility. * Demonstrated experience leading NPI activities in an EMS or electronics manufacturing environment. * Strong knowledge of SMT processes including printing, placement, reflow, AOI, SPI, AXI, and process validation. * Experience with SMT machine programming and optimization. * Strong understanding of PCB fabrication, assembly documentation, and manufacturing data. * Proven problem\-solving and root cause analysis skills. * Ability to work independently and lead cross\-functional projects. **Preferred Qualifications** * Fuji and/or Universal Instruments programming expertise. * PARMI and/or Saki inspection experience. * Aegis FactoryLogix MES experience. * IPC\-A\-610, IPC\-7711/7721, IPC\-CID, or related certifications. * Experience supporting aerospace, defense, medical, or other high\-reliability manufacturing environments. * Lean Six Sigma certification. * Experience implementing automation and Industry 4\.0 initiatives. * Customer\-facing engineering experience. * Valid U.S. Passport. **WORKING CONDITIONS** Typical working conditions at Kitron are indoors, safe, well lit, temperature controlled, low exposure to noxious fumes or offensive odors, clean and sanitary conditions with average light industrial noise. Production areas have machinery with moving parts. Static dissipative smock, and shoes are required. Offices with locking doors, meeting rooms, and common printing areas are well lit, clean, low noise, and temperature controlled with no exposure to noxious fumes or offensive odors. **PHYSICAL DEMANDS** * Stand * Walk * Sit * Climb * Stoop/Kneel * Crouch/Crawl * Talk/Hear/Comprehend English Vision * \- Near Far Color Dexterity * \- Fingers Manual * Lift/Carry without assistance * Arm/Hand Steadiness **Pre\-Employment Requirements** All offers of employment are contingent upon successful completion of a background check and pre\-employment drug screening. Accordingly, if reasonable accommodation is required to fully participate in the job application or interview process, to perform the essential functions of the position, and/or to receive all other benefits and privileges of employment, please contact Human Resources at 814\-467\-9779\.* *The employee must be able to perform the essential job duties/functions of the position satisfactorily and, if requested, reasonable accommodations will be made to enable employees with disabilities to perform the essential functions of their job, absent undue hardship.*

jobs.title: Principal Engineer, Enterprise Scalability (Remote - East Coast Only)
jobs.description: *At Klaviyo, we value the unique backgrounds, experiences and perspectives each Klaviyo (we call ourselves Klaviyos) brings to our workplace each and every day. We believe everyone deserves a fair shot at success and appreciate the experiences each person brings beyond the traditional job requirements. If you're a close but not exact match with the description, we hope you'll still consider applying. Want to learn more about life at Klaviyo? Visit* *klaviyo.com/careers* *to see how we empower creators to own their own destiny.* At Klaviyo, we help businesses build stronger relationships with their customers. As our customers grow, our platform needs to support greater data volumes, more demanding workloads, and increasingly complex operations—with the performance and reliability they depend on. Engineering at this scale takes technical depth, sound judgment, and close collaboration. You'll work across teams to solve challenging problems, turn architectural improvements into production results, and help build a platform ready for our largest customers. **Your Impact** --------------- We are seeking a senior technical leader to own Klaviyo's approach to enterprise scalability, performance, reliability, and multi\-region readiness. Reporting to a VP of Engineering, you will be a senior individual contributor with no direct reports. You will lead through technical expertise, hands\-on engineering, and influence, partnering across teams to deliver improvements that matter to our customers. You will identify and remove major bottlenecks, drive platform\-wide architectural changes, and establish clear measures of readiness for our largest tenants and most demanding workloads. Your work will span system design, profiling, implementation, and production rollout. You will also help teams adopt practical tools and repeatable patterns that make performance and reliability part of everyday engineering. This role suits an experienced engineer who can move between deep technical investigation and clear executive communication, make and defend architectural decisions, and build alignment across teams. **Reports to:** VP of Engineering **Direct reports:** None **What You'll Do** ------------------ * **Define what scale readiness means.** Establish measurable targets for latency, throughput, error rates, and capacity. Build a shared scorecard and align teams on service\-level objectives, error budgets, and performance expectations for critical enterprise workloads. * **Remove the bottlenecks that matter most.** Use production data, profiling, and reproducible benchmarks to identify constraints. Partner with service owners to implement fixes and verify improvements under representative workloads. * **Drive architectural change.** Design and implement sharding, partitioning, caching, back\-pressure, and workload isolation strategies. Advance multi\-region readiness and build safe paths for high\-volume data migrations. * **Make scale engineering repeatable.** Create lightweight benchmarks, profiling harnesses, and test environments that teams can use independently. Pair with engineers to turn successful fixes into reusable patterns. * **Build readiness into delivery.** Lead scalability reviews and establish clear, proportionate release gates that surface risks early and help teams ship confidently. * **Turn incidents into lasting improvements.** Lead technical deep dives, identify systemic causes, and work with teams to deliver and validate fixes that reduce recurring incidents. * **Apply AI where it improves outcomes.** Use AI\-assisted profiling, workload modeling, synthetic traffic, anomaly detection, and guided runbooks to improve investigation and response. Establish explicit guardrails, evaluate results, and measure operational impact. * **Connect engineering decisions to customer needs.** Communicate priorities, tradeoffs, and results clearly to engineers and executives, tying technical investments to customer experience, enterprise growth, and operating efficiency. **What You'll Bring** --------------------- * **Deep experience scaling multi\-tenant SaaS.** You bring 12\+ years of relevant engineering experience, with a track record of removing significant bottlenecks and demonstrating measurable production impact. * **Strong performance and distributed systems expertise.** You have hands\-on experience with performance engineering, capacity planning, sharding and partitioning, caching, back\-pressure, tenant isolation, multi\-region architectures, and large\-scale migrations. * **Engineering depth from diagnosis through delivery.** You can investigate unfamiliar systems, test hypotheses, write production code, and work with service owners to roll out changes safely. * **Sound technical judgment.** You use evidence to weigh architectural tradeoffs and know when to address an immediate constraint versus invest in a broader platform change. * **Leadership across organizational boundaries.** You align teams around shared   AI fluency.** You have applied AI tools or automation to engineering work and can evaluate their usefulness, limitations, and operational risks. You are curious about new approaches and disciplined about validating them. **What Success Looks Like in 6–12 Months** ------------------------------------------ * A company\-wide scale scorecard is adopted and reviewed regularly, with agreed targets and clear ownership for critical enterprise workloads. * Two to three high\-impact bottlenecks are removed, with reproducible benchmarks demonstrating sustained improvements. * Our largest customer workloads show measurable improvements in tail latency, throughput, and error rates. * Multi\-region readiness and high\-volume migration plans have clear priorities, tested assumptions, and actionable next steps. * Teams use shared benchmarks and readiness checks to catch regressions earlier, and repeat P0 incidents decline. * AI\-assisted tools demonstrate measurable value in investigation or incident response, such as faster regression isolation or fewer noisy alerts, with appropriate controls and observability. We use Covey as part of our hiring and / or promotional process. For jobs or candidates in NYC, certain features may qualify it as an AEDT. As part of the evaluation process we provide Covey with job requirements and candidate submitted applications. We began using Covey Scout for Inbound on April 3, 2025\. Please see the independent bias audit report covering our use of Covey here. *This role may require up to 10% travel for purposes such as new hire onboarding, client or partner work if applicable, team meetings, and industry events. Travel is coordinated in advance.* **Get to Know Klaviyo** We're Klaviyo (pronounced clay\-vee\-oh). We empower creators to own their destiny by making first\-party data accessible and actionable like never before. We see limitless potential for the technology we're developing to nurture personalized experiences in ecommerce and beyond. To reach our goals, we need our own crew of remarkable creators—ambitious and collaborative teammates who stay focused on our north star: delighting our customers. If you're ready to do the best work of your career, where you'll be welcomed as your whole self from day one and supported with generous benefits, we hope you'll join us. *AI fluency at Klaviyo includes responsible use of AI (including privacy, security, bias awareness, and human\-in\-the\-loop). We provide accommodations as needed.* *By participating in Klaviyo's interview process, you acknowledge that you have read, understood, and will adhere to our* *Guidelines for using AI in the Klaviyo interview Process**. For more information about how we process your personal data, see our* *Job Applicant Privacy Notice**.* *Klaviyo is committed to a policy of equal opportunity and non\-discrimination. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, ethnicity, citizenship, national origin, color, religion or religious creed, age, sex (including pregnancy), gender identity, sexual orientation, physical or mental disability, veteran or active military status, marital status, criminal record, genetics, retaliation, sexual harassment or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.* *IMPORTANT NOTICE: Our company takes the security and privacy of job applicants very seriously. We will never ask for payment, bank details, or personal financial information as part of the application process. All our legitimate job postings can be found on our official career site. Please be cautious of job offers that come from non\-company email addresses (@klaviyo.com), instant messaging platforms, or unsolicited calls.* **By clicking "Submit Application" you consent to Klaviyo processing your Personal Data in accordance with our Job Applicant Privacy Notice. If you do not wish for Klaviyo to process your Personal Data, please do not submit an application.***You can find our Job Applicant Privacy Notice* *here* *and* *here* *(FR).*

jobs.title: Senior Robotics Software Engineer
jobs.description: **Join Komatsu and Be Part of Something Big!** **Job Overview** ---------------- This position requires problem solving skills with the ability to provide conceptual and strategic solutions. Desired personal qualities include a willingness to seek out challenges and new experiences, and a passion for achieving established goals. This position requires personal interaction with others to achieve desired results, and the integrity to place emphasis on how results were achieved as well as the results themselves. Success in this position demands a positive attitude toward change and a willingness to embrace best practices. **Key Job Responsibilities** ---------------------------- * Develop machine automation \& autonomy software including perception, mapping, localization, and path planning using geometric based, machine learning and fusion techniques for underground machines * Drive all aspects of automation \& autonomy software development including requirement review, effort estimation, design, reviews, programming, functional testing, and release. * Design, program, and unit test efficient software that satisfies programming standards, conforms to defined architectural structure, and meets functional requirements. * Design software interfaces to integrate custom and COTS (Commercial Off\-The\-Shelf) sensors * Perform reviews and functional testing of peer software as needed to support team based agile software practices. * Coach entry to mid\-level engineers in robotics software development * Comply with version management and development branching policies using Git. * Implement effective Change Management to achieve the desired organizational outcomes by successfully changing behaviors as needed. * Travel Requirements: Up to 10% of domestic, international, and underground mine travel is required. **Qualifications/Requirements** ------------------------------- Basic Qualifications: * Bachelor’s, Master’s, or Ph.D. in Robotics, Computer Vision, Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Mechatronics, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field. * Bachelor’s degree with 8\+ years or Master’s degree with 6\+ years of industry experience in Robotics, Autonomous Vehicles, or Autonomous Systems, with expertise in Perception, Localization/Positioning, Path Planning, and Autonomous Navigation. * Demonstrated success designing, developing, and sustaining complex, mission\-critical, high\-reliability robotics software systems deployed in production environments. * Expert\-level proficiency in C\+\+ development on Linux platforms, with a proven ability to architect scalable, maintainable, and high\-performance software solutions. * Strong technical leadership experience driving large complex robotics projects from concept definition and research through implementation, validation, deployment, and field support, delivering measurable business and customer impact. * Hands\-on experience with ROS2, CUDA, DDS, and distributed robotic software architectures. * Experience integrating and utilizing multiple sensing technologies, including LiDAR, cameras, radar, IMUs, and other sensors. * Excellent communication and collaboration skills with a demonstrated ability to work effectively across multidisciplinary teams including software, controls, embedded systems, hardware, systems engineering, and product management. * Customer\-focused, collaborative team player with strong accountability and ownership, consistently delivering high\-quality results while meeting project commitments and deadlines. Preferred Qualifications: * Experience with real\-time sensor fusion, machine learning and deep learning techniques * Experience with Unreal Engine or other simulation environments * Experience in team leadership, specifically mentoring and coaching engineers in the deployment of complex robotics software systems * Experience developing with MATLAB, and Python beneficial * Experience working with GPUs, and CPUs is a plus * Familiarity with safety critical system design and industry standards is a plus. * Knowledge of common machine control sensors, actuators, and other typical control devices. * Excellent verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills. * Demonstrated ability to deliver high\-quality results while adapting to priorities in a fast\-paced, deadline\-driven environment. **Key Skills Required by Komatsu** ---------------------------------- **COLLABORATION** Working together with one or more people to complete a project or task or develop ideas or processes. **ADAPTABILITY** Having the ability to adjust to changes in their environment. **HUNTER MENTALITY** A combination of traits that can help someone achieve their goals with consistency and precision. **BUSINESS ACCUMEN** Having the ability to understand business situations and make sound decisions that lead to successful outcomes. **APPLICATION OF KNOWLEDGE** Being able to use what you’ve learned to make decisions and complete tasks in different situations. **LEADERSHIP** The ability to guide, influence or lead others to accomplish a shared goal. **Company Benefits** Komatsu provides an extensive and robust employee benefits package that is designed to enhance the well\-being of our employees and family members. We embrace a positive and empowering employee experience with a culture that prides itself on a diverse and inclusive environment. * Health benefits: Medical, dental, vision, HSA, wellness programs, etc. * 401k and/or employee savings programs * Employee time off (vacation and designated holidays) * Employee and family assistance programs * Disability benefits * Life insurance * Employee learning and development programs **Diversity \& Inclusion Commitment** At Komatsu, we come from diverse backgrounds, with unique perspectives, experiences, and contributions. We are committed to creating a workforce that is reflective of the communities we work and live in. We believe that our people are part of our shared purpose. Connected by our core values of ambition, perseverance, collaboration and authenticity, we are committed to continually advancing in our support of diversity and inclusion. United, we are on a journey towards a sustainable future that creates value together. **Company Information** Komatsu develops and supplies technologies, equipment and services for the construction, mining, forklift, industrial and forestry markets. Headquartered in Tokyo, Japan, Komatsu employs more than 64,000 people worldwide, operating in more than 140 countries. For more than a century, the company has been creating value for its customers through manufacturing and technology innovation, partnering with others to empower a sustainable future where people, business and the planet thrive together. Since the company’s founding in 1921, Komatsu has been committed to supporting individuals and communities through job training, skills development and giving back. As a Komatsu employee, you will be encouraged to grow alongside our global company, contributing to a more sustainable future for all. If you are looking for a company that values your talent and potential, join Komatsu to be a part of something big and help advance modern society. Learn more at www.komatsu.com. **EEO Statement** Komatsu is an Equal Opportunity Workplace and an Affirmative Action Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status.

jobs.title: Principal AI Security Engineer
jobs.description: **Who We Are** At Kyndryl, we design, build, manage and modernize the mission\-critical technology systems that the world depends on every day. So why work at Kyndryl? We are always moving forward – always pushing ourselves to go further in our efforts to build a more equitable, inclusive world for our employees, our customers and our communities. **The Role** **Why Kyndryl** Kyndryl's Security \& Resiliency practice helps clients anticipate, protect against, withstand, and recover from cyber threats and operational disruption. We bring together deep technical expertise, modern platforms, and a culture of continuous learning to build secure and resilient environments. At Kyndryl, curiosity, collaboration, and customer focus are central to how we work. We invest in skills and give people opportunities to learn, contribute, and grow. **The Role** Kyndryl is seeking a Principal AI Security Engineer to secure internal AI solutions, agents, copilots, model platforms, and frontier AI capabilities. This hands\-on senior technical role will write code, build controls, integrate them into enterprise platforms, and translate security requirements into reusable guardrails and measurable risk reduction. **What You Will Do** * Design, develop, test, and deploy controls for AI applications, agents, copilots, and shared AI platforms. * Build reusable services, APIs, libraries, policy checks, automation, and platform integrations. * Implement identity, authorization, secrets, data access, tool\-use, egress, rate\-limiting, logging, and human\-approval controls. * Perform AI threat modeling and technical security reviews and drive remediation. * Build adversarial tests and automated checks for prompt injection, unsafe tool execution, misuse, and control bypass. * Integrate AI security telemetry, detections, alerts, and response workflows. * Lead through engineering depth, reusable patterns, mentoring, and enterprise influence. Kyndryl currently does not require employees to be fully vaccinated against COVID\-19, however, if you are hired to work at a client, customer, or partner location, you may be required to show proof of vaccination to align with their respective COVID\-19 vaccination policies. Those who believe they are eligible may apply for a medical or religious accommodation prior to the start of employment. **Who You Are** **Required Qualifications** * 10 or more years of experience in security engineering, application security, product security, cloud security, software engineering, platform engineering, or a related field. * Experience implementing authentication, authorization, secrets management, API security, logging, monitoring, and secure development controls. * Experience implementing technical controls that are unique to the evolving AI risk landscape. * Experience with Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud, Infrastructure as Code, and CI/CD. * Ability to conduct threat modeling and convert findings into working engineering solutions. Development experience in Python, Java, C\#, Go, or JavaScript/TypeScript. * **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience developing or securing generative AI applications, agents, copilots, or machine learning platforms. * Experience with AI gateways, model routing, RAG, vector databases, orchestration, MCP, or model\-serving platforms. * Experience with AI red teaming, adversarial testing, prompt injection defenses, or automated control validation. Relevant security, cloud, application security, or AI engineering certifications. * The base compensation range for the position in the U.S. is \- $179,760 to $341,520 based on a full\-time schedule reflects the minimum and maximum target compensation Kyndryl, in good faith, believes it may pay for the role at the time of this posting. Your actual compensation may vary depending on multiple factors legally permitted in the applicable jurisdiction, including, but not limited to, geography, relevant job\-related skills, education and experience, certification and licenses, internal pay equity, and market and business consideration. The pay or salary range will not be below any applicable state, city or local minimum wage requirement. There is a different applicable compensation range for the following work locations: California (San Francisco Bay Area): $215,640 to $409,800 California (All Other): $197,640 to $375,600 Colorado: $179,760 to $341,520 Massachusetts/ Virginia: $179,760 to $375,600 New York City: $215,640 to $409,800 Washington: $197,600 to $375,600 Washington DC: $197,640 to $375,600 This position will be eligible for Kyndryl’s discretionary annual bonus program, based on performance and subject to the terms of Kyndryl’s applicable plans. You may also receive a comprehensive benefits package which includes medical and dental coverage, disability, retirement benefits, paid leave, and paid time off. Note: If this is a sales commission eligible role, you will be eligible to participate in a sales commission plan in lieu of the annual discretionary bonus program. Applications will be accepted on a rolling basis. **Equal Opportunity Employer** All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran. **Being You** Diversity is a whole lot more than what we look like or where we come from, it’s how we think and who we are. We welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. But we’re not doing it single\-handily: Our Kyndryl Inclusion Networks are only one of many ways we create a workplace where all Kyndryls can find and provide support and advice. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you – and everyone next to you – the ability to bring your whole self to work, individually and collectively, and support the activation of our equitable culture. That’s the Kyndryl Way. **What You Can Expect** With state\-of\-the\-art resources and Fortune 100 clients, every day is an opportunity to innovate, build new capabilities, new relationships, new processes, and new value. Kyndryl cares about your well\-being and prides itself on offering benefits that give you choice, reflect the diversity of our employees and support you and your family through the moments that matter – wherever you are in your life journey. Our employee learning programs give you access to the best learning in the industry to receive certifications, including Microsoft, Google, Amazon, Skillsoft, and many more. Through our company\-wide volunteering and giving platform, you can donate, start fundraisers, volunteer, and search over 2 million non\-profit organizations. At Kyndryl, we invest heavily in you, we want you to succeed so that together, we will all succeed. **Get Referred!** If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address.

jobs.title: Sr. Engineer - Software Development
jobs.description: **Where Ambition Meets Innovation** Build a career that matches all your initiative with an impressive dose of innovation. From cutting\-edge resources and a collaborative environment to the freedom to make an impact and more, you’ll find the ingredients you need at LPL Financial to shape your success while helping clients pursue their financial goals. **Job Overview:** We are seeking a Sr. Software Engineer to join our Prospect and Client Management team. In this role, you will design, develop, and lead the implementation of large\-scale enterprise services using AWS cloud\-native technologies to manage participant data for millions of advisors. You will contribute to distributed systems architecture, implement CQRS and event sourcing patterns, support real\-time event streaming, and deploy containerized applications in AWS environments. **Responsibilities:** * Design, develop, test, and maintain cloud\-native services hosted in AWS. * Build, deploy, and support containerized applications in AWS EKS environments using Helm charts, blue/green deployment strategies, and auto\-scaling capabilities. * Develop and maintain infrastructure as code using Terraform for AWS services including EKS, Lambda, API Gateway, DynamoDB, ElastiCache, and RDS. * Design and implement RESTful APIs that support versioning and backward compatibility requirements. * Participate in event storming, domain modeling, architecture discussions, and technical design reviews with cross\-functional teams. * Implement CQRS, event sourcing, and event\-driven architectures to support scalable and resilient business services. * Contribute to application performance, reliability, security, and operational excellence initiatives. * Support integration and modernization efforts across enterprise platforms and services. **What Are We Looking For?** We are seeking professionals who consistently pursue greatness, act with integrity, are driven to help our clients succeed, win together, and create and share joy. The ideal candidate brings strong experience building distributed systems, collaborates effectively across technical and business teams, and delivers scalable, resilient solutions that support business growth and client success. **Requirements:** * 10\+ years of experience in software engineering, including progressive technical lead responsibilities within enterprise technology environments. * Experience with at least one of the following technologies: C\# 10\+, .NET Core, Python, or Java. * 5\+ years of experience with AWS services including EKS/ECS, Lambda, DynamoDB, ElastiCache Redis, RDS Aurora, and API Gateway. * 3\+ years of experience implementing CQRS and Event Sourcing patterns. * Experience with caching and event streaming technologies such as Kafka or similar platforms. **Preferences:** * Proficiency with Infrastructure as Code using Terraform. * Experience working with PostgreSQL and SQL Server databases. * Familiarity with legacy system integration and migration strategies. * Knowledge of event sourcing data modeling and schema evolution. * Experience with AI\-assisted software development practices. \#LI\-Hybrid **Pay Range:** $106,100\.00 \- $176,900\.00### Actual base salary varies based on factors, including but not limited to, relevant skill, prior experience, education, base salary of internal peers, demonstrated performance, and geographic location. You evaluate models, providers, and tools against demonstrated quality, integration effort, operating cost, and long\-term maintainability. * **Hands\-on technical leadership.** You stay close enough to the work to review code and architecture, challenge assumptions, and resolve difficult technical problems. You set clear standards while developing your team's judgment and ownership. A bachelor's or master's degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Data Science, Engineering, or a related field is preferred. Equivalent practical experience is equally valued. #### **Nice to have** * Experience with large\-scale or real\-time data and inference systems. * Experience with retrieval\-augmented generation or AI workflow orchestration. * Experience in marketplaces, social commerce, or recommendation\-driven products. \#LI\-CW1 ### **What we offer for full\-time salaried employees** * The opportunity to be part of the leading global company in creator commerce * A remote\-first, productivity\-first environment * Competitive compensation and benefits package to meet the needs of you and your family * 401(k) with LTK company matching * Medical Insurance, Vision Insurance, Dental Insurance * Paid Maternity Leave and Paid Paternity Leave * Summer Fridays and Flexible PTO * For temporary full\-time employees, benefits eligibility may vary ### **About LTK** Founded in 2011, LTK is the global technology platform purpose\-built to empower lifestyle creators to monetize their content. jobs.title: Senior DC Power Electronics Verification & Validation Engineer
jobs.description: Description: **About us:** LayerZero Power Systems, Inc. is a leader in power management products for mission and process critical applications. Our customer base is comprised of companies in the computer service provider (on\-line commerce, streaming, hosting, etc.), semiconductor manufacturing and financial sectors. LayerZero provides innovative products to ensure user safety and ultimate reliability of computers, servers, communication gear, and other critical equipment. LayerZero manufactures best\-in\-class products representing high\-end solutions. LayerZero Power Systems is on a trajectory of sustained growth, with a loyal base of existing Fortune 100 customers and an expanding portfolio of new customers. We are seeking a Senior DC Power Electronics Verification \& Validation Engineer to establish and execute the testing, validation, and troubleshooting capabilities for a new 50–150 kW, three\-phase AC\-to\-high\-voltage DC power converters. This role will be responsible for specifying and procuring test equipment, executing design verification and validation testing, and diagnosing and resolving hardware and system\-level issues in prototype and production units. The engineer will work closely with power electronics design, controls, mechanical engineering, and manufacturing teams to identify failures, determine root causes, verify corrective actions, and improve product performance and reliability. The position combines hands\-on electrical engineering, high\-power test development, instrumentation, hardware troubleshooting, and production support. The successful candidate will be comfortable working directly with prototype hardware, electrical schematics, circuit boards, power semiconductor devices, control interfaces, and high\-voltage DC systems. The engineer will help transition the product from initial prototypes through design qualification and production release, establishing repeatable verification methods and production test capabilities suitable for annual volumes exceeding 1,000 units **Key Responsibilities** **Test Laboratory Development and Equipment** * Define laboratory requirements and specify test equipment, instrumentation, fixtures, and supporting infrastructure for high\-power AC/DC converter development. * Identify vendors, evaluate equipment capabilities, prepare technical specifications, and support capital equipment procurement. * Install, commission, and validate test equipment, including programmable AC sources, regenerative or electronic DC loads, power analyzers, oscilloscopes, high\-voltage differential probes, current probes, thermal instrumentation, and data acquisition systems. * Establish safe, repeatable test setups for high\-voltage DC and high\-current AC/DC applications. * Develop laboratory procedures, equipment maintenance practices, calibration requirements, and electrical safety controls. **Design Verification and Product Validation** * Develop and execute verification and validation plans based on product requirements, design specifications, operating limits, and applicable industry standards. * Test sample performance across the specified operating envelope, including input voltage, output voltage, load, efficiency, power quality, transient response, and thermal performance. * Characterize startup, shutdown, steady\-state operation, dynamic load response, and transitions between operating conditions. * Test protection functions and fault responses, including overcurrent, overvoltage, overtemperature, abnormal operating conditions, and controlled fault injection where appropriate. * Evaluate electrical noise, switching behavior, transient events, and other performance characteristics using appropriate instrumentation. * Document test configurations, procedures, measured results, deviations, and pass/fail determinations. Maintain traceability between requirements, test cases, and results. * Identify design limitations and collaborate with engineering teams to resolve issues before product qualification and release. * Perform initial power\-up, commissioning, and functional testing of prototype converter assemblies, circuit boards, power modules, and complete systems. * Diagnose electrical and functional failures using schematics, oscilloscope measurements, waveform analysis, circuit measurements, and other diagnostic techniques. * Troubleshoot power conversion circuits, gate\-drive circuits, power semiconductor devices, DC\-link components, sensing circuits, auxiliary power supplies, protection circuits, and control interfaces. * Isolate root causes and distinguish between hardware defects, control or firmware issues, component limitations, assembly problems, and test setup errors. * Perform or coordinate component replacement, soldering, board rework, wiring modifications, and other prototype repairs within established safety and engineering controls. * Re\-test repaired or modified hardware to verify corrective actions and document findings for design engi ired Qualifications** * Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or a related engineering discipline, or equivalent practical technical experience. * Significant hands\-on experience testing, troubleshooting, or validating power electronics equipment, including inverters, AC/DC converters, DC/DC converters, industrial power supplies, or comparable systems. * Strong understanding of three\-phase AC systems, high\-voltage DC systems, switching power conversion, electrical measurements, and power semiconductor devices. * Demonstrated ability to diagnose electrical hardware failures using schematics, oscilloscopes, differential probes, current probes, power analyzers, and other laboratory instrumentation. * Experience specifying, selecting, integrating, or commissioning electrical test equipment and instrumentation. * Ability to develop and execute structured test procedures, analyze results, document findings, and maintain requirements traceability. * Understanding of electrical protection, thermal behavior, transient response, and safe testing practices for high\-voltage/high\-current equipment. * Strong technical communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with design engineers, controls engineers, and manufacturing personnel. * Ability to work directly with hardware in a laboratory environment and support prototype and production troubleshooting as required. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience with power converters rated 50 kW or greater, particularly three\-phase AC\-to\-high\-voltage DC conversion. * Experience with 480 VAC three\-phase systems and DC buses operating in the 800 VDC range or higher. * Experience testing power converters across efficiency, power quality, transient response, thermal performance, protection, and fault operating conditions. * Experience with programmable AC sources, regenerative DC loads, high\-power test benches, and automated measurement systems. * Familiarity with Python, LabVIEW, MATLAB, or similar tools for test automation, data acquisition, and analysis. * Experience with prototype PCB debugging, component\-level repair, soldering, and hardware rework. * Experience with EMC testing, electrical safety qualification, reliability testing, FMEA, and root\-cause analysis. * Experience developing manufacturing test systems and supporting NPI through production release. * Familiarity with applicable IEC, UL, and IEEE requirements for power conversion equipment. **Success Criteria** * Establish a functional, safe, and properly equipped high\-power test laboratory. * Execute repeatable verification and validation testing against defined product requirements. * Rapidly identify, diagnose, and document prototype hardware failures and their root causes. * Verify that design modifications resolve identified problems. * Establish reliable production test procedures and support manufacturing readiness. * Improve product quality and engineering productivity through effective test methods, failure analysis, and documented corrective actions. **What We Offer:** * Competitive pay with performance incentives * 100% company\-paid medical, dental, and vision * 401(k) with company match * 4 weeks PTO, 10 paid holidays, and 2 floating holidays **Why You Will Love Working with Us:** * Impact: Develop your skills and expertise in a rapidly growing industry, with your work directly influencing the success of mission\-critical projects. * Innovation: Immerse yourself in an environment that celebrates forward\-thinking and continuous improvement. * Collaborative spirit: Work closely with engineers, marketers, and other professionals to bring ideas to life. * Grow with us: We are committed to your personal and professional development, offering endless opportunities to improve your skills and advance your career ***At LayerZero, we are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We welcome and celebrate diversity, and we are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.***

jobs.title: Director, Product Management - CDA & AI
jobs.description: Lineage is the largest and most dynamic temperature\-controlled warehousing \& logistics company in the world, reimagining the global food supply chain to eliminate waste and help feed the world. We are a trusted, innovative partner to our customers, connecting them to communities worldwide with efficient supply chain solutions that preserve and protect food. Our Product Management team drives this vision by leading Lineage's technology transformation \- changing how customers and partners engage, how warehouses operate, how energy is used, and how food is processed and transported. We define, design, develop, and deliver transformative technology products that modernize the food supply chain through data\-driven insights, intuitive digital experiences, and resilient solutions deployed at scale. Role Overview We are seeking a Director of Product Management to lead our Data Solutions portfolio \- the central data repositories that serve as Lineage's source of truth and the business tools built on top of them, including metricsOne, our proprietary KPI and performance management platform, and our enterprise reporting and analytics products. These products power decision\-making and business management across every function and region of the company, from warehouse floor operations to the executive team, and form the data foundation for Lineage's analytics and AI ambitions. In this role, you will take ownership of an established team of product managers and an existing product portfolio in active use worldwide, and you will be accountable for its next chapter: sharpening the strategy, raising the bar on product quality and adoption, evolving the platform to support advanced analytics and AI\-driven capabilities, and ensuring that the business trusts \- and acts on \- the data these products deliver. You will operate at the intersection of product, data engineering, data science, and every business function that runs on our data.**Duties and Responsibilities** * Own the multi\-year vision, strategy, and roadmap for Lineage's Data Solutions portfolio, spanning central data repositories, enterprise reporting, KPI and performance management tools, and analytics products. * Lead, coach, and develop an existing team of product managers and business analysts; set clear priorities, raise the standard of product craft, and build a healthy pipeline of talent. * Treat the data platform as a product: define and prioritize the capabilities, data domains, and quality standards required to serve both today's reporting needs and emerging analytics and AI use cases. * Partner with data engineering, data science, and enterprise architecture to align platform investment with product strategy, balancing new capability delivery against reliability, scalability, and technical debt. * Champion data trust across the enterprise \- partner with data governance, finance, and operations stakeholders to ensure consistent definitions, certified metrics, and a single source of truth for business\-critical reporting. * Drive adoption and measurable business impact: establish success metrics for the portfolio, instrument usage, retire low\-value assets, and hold the team accountable for outcomes rather than output. * Engage stakeholders from frontline warehouse leaders to the C\-suite to understand decision\-making needs, translate them into product requirements, and communicate the "why" behind roadmap choices. * Coordinate with product leaders across the technology organization to align roadmaps, share data capabilities, and ensure cohesive execution across interconnected products. * Facilitate annual and quarterly planning for the portfolio, making transparent trade\-offs across value, scope, budget, resources, dependencies, and timelines. * Manage relationships with third\-party development teams and technology vendors that contribute to the portfolio, ensuring quality and value for investment. **Required Qualifications** * 10\+ years of product management experience, including 3\+ years directly managing and developing product managers. * Demonstrated success owning data, analytics, or business intelligence products \- e.g., data platforms, enterprise reporting, KPI/dashboarding tools, or data\-as\-a\-product initiatives \- at enterprise scale. * Strong technical acumen with modern cloud data platforms (e.g., Snowflake or equivalent), BI and visualization tools, and the fundamentals of data modeling, pipelines, and governance; able to engage credibly with engineers and data scientists. * Proven ability to inherit an existing product portfolio and team, quickly build credibility, and drive a step\-change in strategy, execution, and outcomes. * Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to convey complex data concepts to non\-technical audiences and to influence stakeholders at every level, including the C\-suite. * Proven ability to lead change in large, complex, global organizations, and comfort operating in a fast\-paced, highly visible environment. * Ability to travel up to 10% of the time. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience delivering AI/ML\-enabled product capabilities or preparing data platforms to support machine learning and generative AI use cases. * Experience in logistics, supply chain, or other operationally intensive industries; warehouse operations exposure is a plus. * Experience with enterprise information management domains such as financial, operational, HR, or ESG reporting. * Familiarity with Atlassian tools (JIRA, Confluence) and analytical tools (SQL, Excel). * Experience working with geographically distributed teams and third\-party development partners. **Why Join Us?** At Lineage, you'll have the opportunity to make a global impact by transforming the food supply chain. Data is the lifeblood of our business, and this role sits at its center \- you'll shape how one of the world's largest warehousing companies measures, manages, and improves its operations, while building the data foundation for the next generation of analytics and AI at Lineage. Why Lineage? This is an excellent position to begin your career path within Lineage! Success in this role enables greater responsibilities and promotions! A career at Lineage starts with learning about our business and how each team member plays a part each and every day to satisfy our customers' requirements. Beyond that, you'll help us grow and learn on our journey to be the very best employer in our industry. We'll ask you for your opinion and ensure we do our part to keep you developing and engaged as we grow our business. Working at Lineage is energizing and enjoyable. We value respect and care about our team members. Lineage is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer and is committed to compliance with all federal, state, and local laws that prohibit workplace discrimination and unlawful harassment and retaliation. Lineage will not discriminate against any applicant on the basis of race, color, age, national origin, religion, physical or mental disability or any other protected status under federal, state and local law. Benefits Lineage provides safe, stable, reliable work environments, medical, dental, and basic life and disability insurance benefits, 401k retirement plan, paid time off, annual bonus eligibility, and a minimum of 7 holidays throughout the calendar year.

jobs.title: Tier 1 Help Desk Technician

We're looking for someone confident in their technical skills, who communicates well, and is committed to providing excellent support. As a frontline technician, you will often be the first voice our clients hear, so patience and professionalism on the phone matter as much as technical ability. You'll work alongside experienced engineers and other Tier I IT Support Desk Technicians. You will contribute mostly to daily support tasks across Microsoft 365, VoIP telecom, and entry\-level security issues, but you will be challenged with involvement in larger projects as your knowledge and skills grow. This position begins as a temporary, evaluation\-based role with the expectation of transitioning into an existing full\-time Tier 1 position based on performance, team fit, and experience. frontline technical support via phone, email, and on\-site visits * Answer and work inbound support calls: log the ticket, troubleshoot, and resolve the issue whenever possible before escalating to a higher\-tier technician. * Handle common Tier 1 requests such as password resets, account lockouts, and Microsoft 365 user issues * Work entry\-level VoIP/telecom tickets, such as adding or changing extensions, resetting voicemail, and setting up call forwarding * Monitor and manage support queues through our internal HubSpot ticketing system. * Triage entry\-level cybersecurity events and switches, firewalls) * Basic familiarity with hosted VoIP phone systems (e.g., 3CX, RingCentral, 8x8, or similar), or a demonstrated ability to learn one quickly * A sense of urgency and ownership: license and insurability to drive company vehicle **Preferred:** * Prior MSP experience * Familiarity with Ubiquiti, Arista, Meraki, MikroTik * Understanding of DNS services and products * Basic understanding of cybersecurity fundamentals (phishing, MFA, compromised accounts) * Certifications: A\+, Network\+, MCP **Temporary Employment Details** * This role begins as a full\-time, hourly position (40 hours per week) * The temporary period is intended for training, onboarding, and mutual evaluation * Duration: Minimum of 60 days, up to a maximum of 180 days * Time Off: 1 day of PTO ability and team alignment are often transitioned to full\-time within the first 90 days. **What We Offer** **Pay:** $24\.00 \- $28\.75 per hour during the temporary period; $50,000 \- $60,000/year once converted to full\-time salaried.
