jobs.title: Embedded Software Engineer
jobs.description: **Wanna join the adventure?** Loft Orbital is making space simple. We build and operate reliable, shareable satellites that give customers a faster, simpler path to orbit. By combining flight\-proven spacecraft platforms with our own hardware and software, we make it easier to deploy missions in space. As an **Embedded Software Engineer**, you'll develop the low\-level software that brings our spacecraft hardware to life. You'll focus on hardware abstraction layers (HALs), device drivers, and hardware interfaces, working closely with hardware, FPGA, and systems engineers to integrate and debug complex electronics. This role is ideal for an engineer who enjoys digging into the details, solving problems at the hardware/software boundary, and seeing their code fly in space. ### **About this role:** * Design, develop, and maintain hardware abstraction layers (HALs), device drivers, and board support packages (BSPs). * Develop and optimize hardware interfaces, peripherals, and data transfer mechanisms. * Lead hands\-on board bring\-up, hardware/software integration, and low\-level debugging. * Write reliable, maintainable C/C\+\+ software for embedded Linux and/or RTOS platforms. * Diagnose complex issues using hardware documentation, debugging tools, and direct hardware testing. * Develop unit and integration tests to validate software on target hardware. * Collaborate with hardware, FPGA, and systems engineers to deliver robust, flight\-ready solutions. ### **Must Haves:** * 5\+ years of professional embedded software development experience in C and/or C\+\+. * Strong hands\-on experience designing and developing HALs and low\-level device drivers. * Experience with BSPs, register\-level programming, and hardware/peripheral configuration. * Proven experience with board bring\-up, hardware/software integration, and low\-level debugging. * Experience with embedded Linux and/or RTOS platforms. * Understanding of hardware interfaces and protocols such as UART, SPI, I²C, DMA, Ethernet, LVDS, or SpaceWire. * Experience with debugging tools such as GDB, JTAG, logic analyzers, or oscilloscopes. * Ability to read schematics and datasheets and troubleshoot issues across hardware and software. * Strong problem\-solving skills, ownership, and ability to work across multidisciplinary teams. ### **Nice to Haves:** * Linux kernel internals, kernel\-space driver development, and device trees. * Embedded Linux build systems such as Yocto or Buildroot. * ARM\-based SoCs and FPGA integration. * Aerospace, spaceflight, or safety\-critical software experience. * Radiation mitigation techniques, including Single Event Upset (SEU) handling. * Embedded virtualization or hypervisor experience. ### **Some of Our Awesome Benefits:** * 100% company\-paid medical, dental, and vision insurance option for employees and dependents * Flexible Spending (FSA) and Health Savings (HSA) Accounts offered with an employer contribution to the HSA * 100% employer paid Life, AD\&D, Short\-Term, and Long\-Term Disability insurance * Flexible Time Off policy for vacation and sick leave, and 12 paid holidays * 401(k) plan and equity options * Daily catered lunches and snacks * International exposure to our team in France * Fully paid parental leave; 14 weeks for primary caregiver and 10 weeks for secondary caregiver * Carrot Fertility provides comprehensive, inclusive fertility healthcare and family\-forming benefits with financial support * Off\-sites and many social events and celebrations * Relocation assistance when applicable $150,000 \- $190,000 a year State law requires us to tell you the base compensation range for this role, which is $150,000 \- $190,000 per year, determined by your education, experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities. The salary range for this role is intentionally wide as we evaluate individuals based on their unique experience and abilities to fit our needs. Most importantly, we are excited to meet you, and see if you are a great fit for our team. What we *can’t* quantify for you are the exciting challenges, supportive team, and amazing culture we enjoy. *\***Research shows that while men apply to jobs where they meet an average of 60% of the criteria, women and other underrepresented people tend to only apply when they meet 100% of the qualifications. At Loft, we value respectful debate and people who aren’t afraid to challenge assumptions. We strongly encourage you to apply, even if you don’t check all the boxes.* **Who We Are** Loft: Space Made Simple. Founded in 2017, Loft provides governments, companies, and research institutions with a fast, reliable, and simple way to deploy missions in orbit. We integrate, launch, and operate spacecraft, offering end\-to\-end missions as a service across Earth observation, IoT connectivity, on\-orbit AI, national security missions, and more. Leveraging our existing space infrastructure and an extensive inventory of satellite buses, Loft is reducing years\-long integration and launch timelines to months. With more than 30 missions flown, Loft’s flight heritage and proven technologies enable customers to focus on their mission objectives. With a growing fleet on track to reach 30 satellites by 2027, we are scaling up quickly across our offices in San Francisco, CA \| Golden, CO \| and Toulouse, France to meet accelerating demand for space infrastructure. *As an international company your resume will be reviewed by people across our offices so please attach a copy in English.* We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

jobs.title: AI Engineer, Medical Vision Language Models
jobs.description: Lumexa Imaging is one of the country's largest providers of outpatient medical imaging. With over 5,000 team members and more than 185 outpatient imaging centers across 13 states, our team conducts more than 4 million outpatient studies annually. We are the partner of choice for health systems and radiologists, delivering best\-in\-class clinical excellence, operations, and state\-of\-the\-art technology across our platform. Lumexa Imaging is hiring an early\-career AI Engineer to help build, adapt, and deploy vision language models (VLMs) and imaging foundation models for clinical radiology. You will work hands\-on using agentic coding tools (Claude Code, OpenAI Codex) to transition ideas from radiologists into validated, deployed models. This is a build\-focused role centered on model development and deployment. Initial priorities include building clinical LLM pipelines (prior report summarization, scanned document summarization, and relevant prior selection) on infrastructure shared with our VLM work. **Why this role is a rare opportunity:** You will have access to a large, growing repository of clinical imaging and reporting data. A central part of this job is leveraging this real\-world, domain\-specific data, consistent with applicable privacy, security, and governance requirements, to develop, adapt, and evaluate AI models beyond what is possible using public data alone. You will work closely with the Chief Clinical AI Officer, the Clinical Applications team, and Infrastructure and Information Security. **Essential Duties and Responsibilities:** * VLM Development and Adaptation: Fine\-tune and adapt open VLMs (e.g., Qwen\-VL, LLaVA\-Med, MedGemma, InternVL) and imaging foundation models for report drafting, impression generation, finding detection, and prior comparison. Apply parameter\-efficient methods (LoRA, QLoRA) and full fine\-tuning under senior guidance. * Vision Encoders and Representation Learning: Work with vision encoders, contrastive image\-text models (CLIP, SigLIP), and self\-supervised approaches (JEPA). Build and maintain embedding pipelines for retrieval, cohort discovery, case similarity search, and drift detection * Data Curation: Curate and version datasets from our internal PACS and reporting systems, including DICOM header, burned\-in pixel, and paired\-report de\-identification * Agentic Engineering: Use Claude Code and OpenAI Codex daily to build, test, and maintain code. Maintain project context (CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md), and help build and run MCP servers for internal system access * Deployment and MLOps: Deploy models via containerized inference and GPU serving (vLLM, Triton), support CI/CD pipelines, and monitor production models for drift and performance * Evaluation: Build automated evaluation harnesses for clinical accuracy, negation, laterality, and hallucination scoring against radiologist ground truth * Workflow Automation: Build agentic and LLM driven tools for operational workflows, such as converting unstructured requests into RIS scheduling actions and supporting intelligent operations dashboards **Required Qualifications:** * Hands\-on experience fine\-tuning transformer models in PyTorch (vision, multimodal, or language) using Hugging Face, MONAI, or similar (via internships, research, open\-source work, or projects) * Working knowledge of embeddings and vector search * Experience with open VLMs such as Qwen\-VL or LLaVA * Daily use of agentic coding tools (Claude Code, OpenAI Codex) * Familiarity with Docker and GPU\-based model serving * Comfort working with real\-world data and a reproducible approach to experiments **Preferred Qualifications:** * Hands\-on experience with vision encoders and contrastive models (CLIP, SigLIP, JEPA) * Exposure to medical VLMs, imaging foundation models, or self\-supervised methods (DINOv2, MAE) * Experience building MCP servers in Python or TypeScript * Familiarity with medical imaging formats (DICOM, HL7, FHIR) and HIPAA/PHI handling * Awareness of MLOps tooling (MLflow, Weights \& Biases, model registries) * Awareness of FDA considerations for clinical AI (510(k), PCCP) **Education/Licensing/Certification:** Degree in Computer Science, Biomedical Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience) **Experience (years and type):** Experience 0 to 3 years (internships, research, or projects count) **Travel Required (% of time):** Minimal, up to 10% **Physical Requirements \& Work Environment:** Standard remote office work Lumexa Imaging provides a competitive compensation program to attract, retain, and motivate a high\-performance workforce. Lumexa Imaging is an equal opportunity employer.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Forecasting & Real-Time Optimization
jobs.description: At Lyft, our purpose is to serve and connect. We aim to achieve this by cultivating a work environment where all team members belong and have the opportunity to thrive. Marketplace teams are at the heart of Lyft's products and decision\-making. We're looking for passionate, driven engineers to build systems that empower our users (both drivers and riders) to make the most effective use of Lyft's products and experiences by making them more predictive, personalized, and adaptive. The ideal candidate enjoys solving problems with distributed computing for ML and forecasting models, and finding patterns and insights in real\-world data while building reliable systems, and is excited about working in a fast\-paced, innovative, and collegial environment. The Forecasting and Real\-Time Optimization Platform (FORTOP) team in Lyft's Rideshare Experience \& Marketplace (REM) org provides reliable, real\-time market supply and demand signals and forecasts that power the systems making critical automated decisions for Lyft's business. These signals feed many of Lyft's most important marketplace products, including Dynamic Pricing, Real\-Time Supply Management, Fulfillment, and more. As a Senior Software Engineer on FORTOP's forecasting team, you'll lead the design and operation of the production systems that turn streaming marketplace data into accurate, reliable forecasts: real\-time feature pipelines, model training and inference infrastructure, backtesting and evaluation tooling, and the serving layer that downstream products query continuously. You'll work closely with our scientists to take models from prototype to production, and with downstream teams to define the contracts and reliability guarantees they build on. The work involves forecasting both rider demand and driver supply as they shift with traffic, holidays, and major events, and keeping systems correct and fast during the peaks when they matter most. **Responsibilities:** --------------------- * **Lead projects end to end:** Drive multi\-engineer projects from proposal and technical design through launch. Break work into milestones, align dependencies with partner teams, and own estimates. * **Architect ML systems:** Design and evolve streaming feature pipelines, training and inference workflows, and signal serving, and lead design reviews with attention to latency, correctness, scalability, and cost. Reduce complexity by consolidating or sunsetting components. * **Partner with science to ship:** Partner with scientists to design/productionize ML models. Build the rollout tooling (shadow, canary, rollback) and the backtesting and experimentation infrastructure that make launches safe and fast. * **Own signal contracts:** Define and maintain the interfaces, data contracts, and SLAs between forecasting signals and downstream consumers such as Dynamic Pricing and Driver Incentives. * **Operate what you build:** Monitor system health (latency, freshness, error rates) and signal quality (accuracy, bias, drift), and prepare systems for peak events. Take part in on\-call, lead post\-incident investigations, and drive action items to completion. * **Code quality:** Write well\-tested, maintainable code and give code reviews that improve the work of others. Coach teammates on testing and engineering practices. * **Collaborate across functions:** Work with Product, Science, and partner engineering teams to frame problems, shape the roadmap, and make clear tradeoffs between accuracy, latency, and complexity. * **Grow the team:** Mentor engineers, take part in hiring and onboarding, and share knowledge through design docs, runbooks, and tech talks. **Experience:** --------------- * 5\+ years of software engineering industry experience, including building and operating backend or data systems in production * BS/MS or equivalent in Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or related field or relevant work experience * Experience designing and leading delivery of large\-scale distributed systems, and owning their reliability through monitoring, on\-call, and incident response * Solid distributed systems fundamentals: fault tolerance, delivery semantics, and consistency tradeoffs * Track record of leading ambiguous, multi\-engineer projects and mentoring other engineers * Clear written communication, including design docs that align stakeholders * Preferred: Experience building production ML models and infrastructure, such as model choice, feature engineering and pipelines, training and inference pipelines, model serving, or ML platforms * Preferred: Hands\-on experience with stream or large\-scale batch processing (Flink, Beam, Spark, or similar) and distributed messaging (Kafka, Kinesis, or similar) * Preferred: Experience with time series forecasting systems, or familiarity with backtesting and forecast evaluation (error metrics, bias, calibration) * Preferred: Experience with online experimentation or real\-time decision systems such as pricing, dispatch, or marketplace balancing * Preferred: Comfort using AI\-assisted development tools to move faster without compromising quality **Benefits:** ------------- * Great medical, dental, and vision insurance options with additional programs available when enrolled * Mental health benefits * Family building benefits * Child care and pet benefits * 401(k) plan with company match to help save for your future * In addition to 12 observed holidays, salaried team members have discretionary paid time off, hourly team members have 15 days paid time off * 18 weeks of paid parental leave. Biological, adoptive, and foster parents are all eligible * Subsidized commuter benefits * Monthly Lyft credits and complimentary Lyft Pink membership Lyft is an equal opportunity employer committed to an inclusive workplace that fosters belonging. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regards to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, age, genetic information, or any other basis prohibited by law. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Lyft highly values having employees working in\-office to foster a collaborative work environment and company culture. This role will be in\-office on a hybrid schedule — Team Members will be expected to work in the office 3 days per week on Mondays, Wednesdays, and Thursdays. Lyft considers working in the office at least 3 days per week to be an essential function of this hybrid role. Your recruiter can share more information about the various in\-office perks Lyft offers. Additionally, hybrid roles have the flexibility to work from anywhere for up to 4 weeks per year. \#Hybrid The expected base pay range for this position in the San Francisco area is $148,000 \- $185,000, not inclusive of potential equity offering, bonus or benefits. Salary ranges are dependent on a variety of factors, including qualifications, experience and geographic location. Your recruiter can share more information about the salary range specific to your working location and other factors during the hiring process.

jobs.title: Senior Full Stack Engineer
jobs.description: **Grow Your Career. Make a Difference. Join MDK.** At MDK, technology does more than support the work. It helps move our business and clients forward. We’re seeking a Senior Full Stack Engineer who brings strong technical judgment, practical problem\-solving, and a commitment to building reliable solutions. In this role, you’ll develop, maintain, and modernize MDK’s legal case\-management platform. You’ll work across front\-end applications, back\-end services, integrations, and databases. You’ll also help shape technical solutions, improve system reliability, and mentor junior developers while partnering with business and technical teams. **A Culture of Collaboration, Growth, and Belonging** At MDK, a law firm built on purpose and progress, we believe people thrive when they feel respected, connected, and empowered to grow. Our culture is rooted in creativity, support, and open communication, where learning is continuous and every team member is encouraged to bring their whole self to work. We value diverse perspectives and foster belonging through cross\-team collaboration and employee\-led programs that reflect who we are. From wellness initiatives to community engagement, MDK is a place where people feel seen and supported. What makes MDK’s culture compelling: * Professional growth supported by regular one\-on\-one conversations with leaders * Flexibility and time off that prioritize real work\-life balance * Volunteer Time Off that connects employees with causes they care about * Inclusive programs like our Culture Council, affinity groups, book club and Art@MDK * A collaborative environment built on shared success and open feedback **Your Role in Action** * Design, develop, maintain, and improve software across MDK’s legal case\-management platform. * Build and support back\-end services, Web APIs, background processes, and responsive web applications using C\#, .NET, and modern front\-end technologies. * Design and optimize SQL Server databases, T\-SQL queries, stored procedures, views, indexes, and data models. * Integrate internal applications with third\-party systems through APIs, file exchanges, queues, and document\-automation tools. * Modernize established applications through practical, incremental improvements while maintaining production stability. * Improve automated testing, CI/CD pipelines, code\-quality controls, and repeatable deployment processes. * Monitor production performance, lead root\-cause analysis, and implement lasting solutions to system issues. * Provide technical guidance and mentorship through code reviews, design discussions, documentation, and collaboration with junior developers. * Partner with business and technical teams to understand needs, recommend practical solutions, and explain technical decisions clearly. * Support MDK’s mission, values, initiatives, and team goals through collaboration, accountability, and technical leadership. *The responsibilities defined above are not an all\-inclusive list, but a general summary of typical duties. Individuals in this position may be asked to perform a wide range of related tasks.* **Your Background \& Skills** * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. * Minimum of 10 years of professional software development experience, including substantial full stack responsibility. * Deep experience with C\# and .NET, including .NET Framework and modern .NET technologies such as ASP.NET Core and Web API. * Strong front\-end development experience with Angular, React, or Vue, along with TypeScript, HTML, and CSS. * Advanced SQL Server and T\-SQL experience, including database design and performance tuning. * Hands\-on experience with Elasticsearch, including indexing, mappings, queries, aggregations, or observability use cases. * Experience with Git, automated testing, and CI/CD pipelines, preferably in Azure DevOps. * Demonstrated ability to design solutions across multiple applications and translate business needs into workable technical plans. * Experience mentoring developers and improving team coding, design, testing, and documentation practices. * Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical information clearly to technical and non\-technical audiences. * Demonstrated professionalism, sound judgment, integrity, and discretion when handling confidential or sensitive information. * Strong collaboration and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to challenge existing approaches when appropriate and recommend practical solutions. * Experience with WPF, Azure services, Power BI, SSIS/SSRS, document automation, message queues, Playwright, or AI\-assisted development tools is preferred. **Your Work Style** Success in this role also comes from how you approach your work, decisions, and team. You: * Bring flexibility and adaptability, staying open to new ideas and better ways of working. * Approach complex problems with curiosity, sound judgment, and a desire to keep learning. * Take ownership of your work and remain effective when priorities or technical challenges change. * Collaborate openly, share knowledge, and provide constructive guidance to others. * Communicate respectfully, listen to different perspectives, and explain technical decisions clearly. **Your Schedule \& Benefits** Our team works Monday through Friday during general business hours. After a successful orientation period, we offer a hybrid schedule that provides flexibility to work both from home and in the office. MDK provides a comprehensive benefits package, which includes: * Medical, dental, and vision insurance * Company\-paid disability and life insurance * 401(k) plan with employer contribution * Paid time off We also offer additional ways to support your well\-being and growth, including: * Paid time to volunteer in the community * Paid holidays * Casual dress code * Opportunities for career development and advancement Please see more about our benefits on our website: www.mdklegal.com **Focused on Purpose. Driven by People.** Founded in 2002, MDK is a legal and professional services firm that supports the mortgage servicing and vacation ownership industries. With a coast\-to\-coast footprint, we deliver consistent, high\-quality support across the country. Our approach combines deep legal expertise, business insight, and innovative technology to help clients optimize operations, maintain compliance, and drive growth. We help clients solve complex challenges by blending legal insight with business strategy. That work starts with our people. When you join MDK, you become part of a team that’s creating uncommon paths to success—for our clients, for our colleagues, and for the future of legal services. **Ready to take the next step? Apply now to join Team MDK** Learn more about MDK by visiting www.mdklegal.com or visit us on LinkedIn or Instagram. MDK Legal and affiliates are Equal Opportunity Employers. We have a no tolerance policy for discrimination at our workplace. We are committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodations to all applicants. We respect everyone from fair wages to equal opportunities for growth and movement here at MDK.

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.description: The **Forward\-Deployed AI Engineer** will transform MISO’s most important business challenges into practical, production\-ready AI solutions. Working side‑by‑side with domain experts, this role blends data, AI, and software engineering to rapidly design, build, and deploy intelligent applications and agents. You will own the full lifecycle from problem discovery through production adoption, ensuring each solution delivers clear and measurable business value. By developing secure, reliable, and reusable AI components within MISO’s enterprise standards, this role accelerates innovation and reduces reliance on external vendors. Success in the first year is demonstrated by faster delivery of priority AI use cases, measurable improvements in decision quality and operational efficiency, and solutions that meet defined performance and governance criteria in production. Ultimately, the engineer empowers internal teams to independently operate and extend these solutions while contributing reusable patterns and assets that strengthen MISO’s broader AI ecosystem. Some of the impactful contributions you’ll make as MISO’s **Forward\-Deployed AI Engineer** include: * Partnering directly with the business to understand real workflows, uncover operational challenges, and translate domain expertise into clear technical requirements and actionable solution designs. * Leading AI and agentic solution delivery end‑to‑end \- from discovery and architecture through data integration, testing, deployment, observability, and continuous improvement. * Rapidly producing working increments using governed production or representative data, demonstrating visible progress to domain experts on a frequent, iterative cadence. * Designing and implementing AI applications, copilots, agents, retrieval pipelines, APIs, and automation that integrate seamlessly with MISO’s enterprise technology environment and standards. * Establishing robust evaluation methods and safety measures that validate accuracy, reliability, hallucination risk, workflow completion, and business usefulness against defined thresholds. * Building solutions using composable architectures, reusable services, and model‑agnostic patterns that reduce lock‑in and enable scaling across the enterprise. * Ensuring long‑term sustainability by creating runbooks, documentation, and reusable assets, and by pairing with internal engineers to transfer knowledge and ensure independent operation. * Delivering measurable business outcomes (including faster delivery from discovery to production, improved decision) making and efficiency, and AI solutions that teams can operate and extend without ongoing reliance on the Forward‑Deployed AI Engineer. You’ll need the following skills to be successful as our **Forward\-Deployed AI Engineer**: * Strong foundational education in computer science, engineering, data science, or a related technical field, with an advanced degree preferred. * Extensive experience (15\+ years) across software, data, AI/ML engineering, solution architecture, or product engineering, including hands‑on delivery of production AI/ML solutions. * Deep proficiency in modern programming languages—especially Python—and strong SQL skills, with the ability to design secure, scalable back‑end services and APIs. * Expertise integrating applications with enterprise data sources, APIs, cloud services, and distributed systems, ideally within a Microsoft Azure environment. * Demonstrated experience with cloud‑native engineering practices, CI/CD, automated testing, observability, production support, and containerization technologies. * Strong applied knowledge of generative AI, agent orchestration, retrieval‑augmented generation, prompt/context engineering, and AI evaluation frameworks. * Ability to translate complex business workflows into robust technical solutions by working directly with domain experts and converting operational needs into actionable requirements. * Familiarity with AI observability, governance, human‑in‑the‑loop workflows, and model reliability practices to ensure safe and effective production AI operations. Appropriate level will be determined based upon experience and knowledge. Transformative innovation is happening in the electric industry, from digitalizing homes and distributed resources to renewable energy and an ever\-changing grid. MISO manages the electricity superhighway in the Central U.S. and through use of groundbreaking research and advanced technology, our highly skilled employees ensure power flows reliably to 45 million Americans. Operating the electricity grid, running a robust energy market, planning for a bright future – it’s what our immensely hardworking and dedicated team does every day. The base salary compensation range being offered for this role is $190,000 \- $215,000 USD annually. Base salary range for this position is included in accordance with requirements of various state/local pay transparency legislation. Please note that salaries may vary for different individuals in the same role based on several factors, including but not limited to location of the role, individual competencies, education/professional certifications, and qualifications/experience. Position is also eligible for an annual bonus if individual performance and company objectives are met. At MISO we offer a comprehensive benefits package, including 401k, vacation, sick and safe time, available on your first day of employment. \#DiscoverMISO \#MISOCareers \#lifeatMISO \#weareMISO MISO, What We Do (https://vimeo.com/935124142/5c8d23402d) \#LI\-ONSITE \#LI\-JH1 #### **Experience** Preferred* 15 year(s): Extensive experience across software, data, AI/ML engineering, solution architecture, or product engineering, including hands on delivery of production AI/ML solutions. #### **Education** Preferred* Bachelors or better in Engineering or related field * Bachelors or better in Data Science or related field * Bachelors or better in Computer Science or related field Equal Opportunity Employer This employer is required to notify all applicants of their rights pursuant to federal employment laws. For further information, please review the Know Your Rights (https://www.eeoc.gov/poster) notice from the Department of Labor.

jobs.description: **Who We Are:** Founded in 1969, Metro Sales Inc. built its reputation selling office supplies and equipment across the Twin Cities. Decades later, we've grown into one of the largest office technology and solutions providers in the Midwest. Today, MSI Metro Sales Inc., **a 100% Employee\-Owned Company**, stands as an industry leader in hardware, software, and managed services. **MSI Metro Sales Inc.** is seeking an **Employee\-Owner, Software Developer,** to join our **Roseville, MN Managed IT team**. Our team builds for every side of the business, internally and externally for our clients. Under the guidance of a senior developer, you'll write and review code with AI assistance, deploy to Azure via GitHub. Build AI tools and internal software that support our Technicians, Service Desk, and Sales. Utilize Claude or other AI tools that work with our managed services platforms, internal apps and APIs for internal and external customer’s data. relocation is not budgeted for this role, local candidates will be given priority consideration. * Applicants must be authorized to work for ANY employer in the U.S without requiring sponsorship now or in the future. **Preferred Qualifications:** * Experience building MCP servers, Claude skills, or AI agents that use tools, LLM APIs or AI coding assistants. * Retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG) and measuring whether retrieval improves output. * Azure: Container Apps, Key Vault, Entra ID app registrations, Application Insights, or infrastructure as code in Bicep or Terraform. * Exposure to workflow automation in n8n, Power Automate, or similar tools and Docker and GitHub Actions pipelines. * MSP platforms: ConnectWise Manage, N\-central, IT Glue, Huntress, or SentinelOne. * Web development with React and a Node backend (Fastify or Express) and an ORM such as Drizzle or Prisma. * C\# and .NET beyond the basics: ASP.NET Core web APIs, WPF desktop apps, or PowerShell modules tested with Pester. * Supported Help desk, networking, or systems administration. * OpenTelemetry or other observability tooling. * Strong written communication, including clear documentation and pull request descriptions. **Candidates with** a shareable link of the code written (GitHub, a portfolio, or a project write\-up) any builds with an LLM or AI coding tool, will be prioritized. **What We Offer:** * Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance * Short\- and Long\-Term Disability Program * Life Insurance * Educational Development Benefits * Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP) \+ Gainshare \- **because your success is also your investment** * 401(k) \+ Match * Paid Time Off (PTO) * **Paid Volunteer Days! \- give back alongside your peers in the community** **Compensation Range: $70,000 \- $90,000 per year** **MSI Metro Sales Inc. jobs.description: **Do you want your voice heard and your actions to count?** Discover your opportunity with Mitsubishi UFJ Financial Group (MUFG), one of the world’s leading financial groups. Across the globe, we’re 150,000 colleagues, striving to make a difference for every client, organization, and community we serve. We stand for our values, building long\-term relationships, serving society, and fostering shared and sustainable growth for a better world. With a vision to be the world’s most trusted financial group, it’s part of our culture to put people first, listen to new and diverse ideas and collaborate toward greater innovation, speed and agility. This means investing in talent, technologies, and tools that empower you to own your career. Join MUFG, where being inspired is expected and making a meaningful impact is rewarded. The selected colleague will work at an MUFG office or client sites four days per week and work remotely one day. A member of our recruitment team will provide more details. **Job Summary:** The Red Team Analyst supports MUFG Red Team operations by executing adversary‑emulation activities focused on AI‑enabled technologies. This role is designed for early‑career professionals with a computer science background and practical coding experience, enabling them to develop offensive security skills while contributing to risk reduction across the enterprise. Under the direction of senior operators, the analyst participates in threat‑led assessments, AI security testing, and purple team exercises, helping identify how real‑world adversaries could exploit application logic, automation pipelines, and AI‑assisted capabilities. **Primary Responsibilities:** Adversary Emulation \& Testing Support * Participate in Red Team missions designed to simulate real‑world attacker behavior against MUFG applications and platforms. * Execute assigned activities during: + adversary simulation and emulation (ASE) + assumed‑breach scenarios + purple team and control‑validation exercises * Safely conduct testing activities aligned to approved scopes, deconfliction requirements, and operational guardrails. AI \& Automation Workflow Testing * Support adversarial testing of AI‑enabled capabilities, including: + prompt injection and misuse scenarios + unintended data access or disclosure via AI tools + bypass of AI guardrails and safety controls * Assist in assessing AI‑assisted developer tools, copilots, and automation platforms. * Help evaluate how AI interacts with identity, permissions, APIs, and data sources. Tooling \& Research * Research emerging attacker techniques targeting: + modern application stacks + CI/CD and developer tooling + AI/LLM systems * Contribute to Red Team playbooks, test cases, and repeatable workflows. * Support senior operators in engagement reporting and evidence collection. * Participate in post‑engagement discussions with defensive and engineering teams. * Develop and operationalize custom ML/LLM models for cybersecurity use cases * Advance preventative, detective, and responsive security controls through applied AI innovation * Evaluate emerging AI capabilities for cybersecurity and mature predictive, proactive threat response **Required Qualifications:** * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, or equivalent practical experience. * Demonstrated experience through internships, co‑ops, academic projects, or personal work. * Strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and willingness to learn adversarial thinking. * Hands\-on experience with agentic AI, LLMs, and custom ML model development * Proficiency with open\-source AI frameworks and tooling (e.g., PyTorch, TensorFlow, SageMaker) **Preferred Qualifications:** * Familiarity with: + REST APIs, OAuth/OIDC, JWT + CI/CD pipelines or DevOps tooling * Hands‑on experience using or experimenting with AI/LLM tools or prompt‑driven workflows. * Familiarity with enterprise cloud AI platforms (e.g., Azure AI Foundry, AWS Bedrock, or GCP Vertex AI) **Other:** * As per MUFG’s work policy for all personnel, candidates must work onsite for 4 days and 1 day remotely. * The typical base pay range for this role is between $80K \- $100K depending on job\-related knowledge, skills, experience, and location. We will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with criminal histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws (including (i) the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, (ii) the City of Los Angeles’ Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, (iii) the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance, and (iv) the California Fair Chance Act) to the extent that (a) an applicant is not subject to a statutory disqualification pursuant to Section 3(a)(39\) of the Securities and Exchange Act of 1934 or Section 8a(2\) or 8a(3\) of the Commodity Exchange Act, and (b) they do not conflict with the background screening requirements of the Financial Industry Regulatory Authority (FINRA) and the National Futures Association (NFA). jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description: **America is strongest when ability can rise** The right person can change the trajectory of a team, a company, or an entire field. Yet most hiring still filters on what is easiest to read: the right degree, the right employer, the right network. Those are poor proxies for what someone can actually do. When they miss real ability, a company loses performance and an idea goes unbuilt. MeritFirst builds objective, efficient ways for people to demonstrate critical thinking, problem\-solving, adaptability, and execution, so companies can hire on demonstrated ability rather than pedigree. For the worker, that means upward mobility. For the company, better performance. At scale, national growth. **The role** Our product has to produce a signal that deserves to influence real decisions about people. Candidates need to trust that they got a fair chance to show what they can do. Employers need to trust that the signal predicts performance better than the credentials they already use. Earning both takes careful product judgment, rigorous measurement, and software that is reliable and explainable. As a Senior Software Engineer, you will own major parts of that system end to end, from the candidate experience and assessment engine to employer workflows and evaluation. You will join a small team and work directly with our founder, candidates, and customers. Roadmaps here do not arrive fully specified. You'll decide what should exist, ship the first version, watch how it behaves, and improve it quickly. You will also make the engineers around you better through the systems you architect and the code you review. We use AI heavily. However, if you can't reason about and explain each line of your code, your work isn't ready. Our standard is a system we understand, can explain, test, and trust. **What we're working on** * Hands\-on challenges that show how candidates work with AI * Voice and video interviews * Scoring that employers can audit and candidates can trust * Integrations with the hiring tools employers already use Stack: TypeScript, Next.js, Postgres, and Vercel. Engineering team size: 3\. Location: onsite in Austin, Texas. **What you'll do** * **Own an area end to end.** Early on, you'll take on one of our highest\-leverage product areas: its design, code, production health, and roadmap. * **Lead technical design.** Turn ambiguous problems into written designs, make the tradeoffs explicit, and align the team before the big work starts. * **Build evaluation worth trusting.** Make results consistent, auditable, and hard to game. Use AI where it measurably helps, and build the evals that prove it. * **Close the learning loop.** Connect assessment results, employer decisions, and on\-the\-job outcomes so the product gets more predictive over time. * **Treat trust as a technical requirement.** Reliability, security, and privacy are product properties from day one. * **Raise the bar.** Give code reviews that teach, mentor other engineers, and help hire the people who join next. **You'll thrive here if you** * Have led the design and delivery of significant production systems, and operated them long enough to live with your decisions. * Have deep expertise in one part of the stack and can work across the rest. * Debug relentlessly: form hypotheses, follow evidence, and dig beneath frameworks and libraries until you understand the issue. * Know when to build the simplest thing that works vs. when to invest in a foundation. * Have built software before LLMs and treat AI\-written code like code from a stranger. * Have made other engineers better through design review, code review, or mentorship. * Communicate clearly, disagree directly, and can explain a technical tradeoff to a non\-engineer. **This probably isn't the role if you** * Want requirements and architecture fully specified before you start. * Want to lead others without staying hands\-on in the code. * Love building something new but lose interest in maintaining what you ship. * Want a predictable 9\-to\-5\. * Are more excited by the idea of meritocracy, or by AI hype, than by the hard work of building something people can trust. **How we hire** Our process tests demonstrated ability, not pedigree or interview polish. Some steps may be with AI and some without. We want to see your foundations, how you reason, and how you use modern tools without giving up judgment. Along the way, you'll use the MeritFirst product yourself.

systems through integration, test, and transition to Operations. ### **Systems Engineer, Data Systems Responsibilities:** * Define and own end\-to\-end hardware system architecture for ground truth Speech, Health) to translate data collection requirements into system\-level specifications * Develop system\-level requirements and allocate performance budgets across custom sensor platforms, synchronization hardware, and data infrastructure to meet ground truth quality targets * Lead architectural trade\-off analyses across competing design dimensions including data throughput, synchronization precision, calibration accuracy, latency, and cost * Drive alignment on data systems architecture decisions across hardware, firmware, software, and operations teams through written proposals and cross\-functional reviews * Establish and maintain system integration frameworks that enable early detection of cross\-subsystem risks in data collection pipelines * Define and oversee bring\-up and validation strategies for complex multi\-sensor data capture platforms * Lead systems through integration, test, and transition to Operations, ensuring production readiness and operational sustainability * Develop long\-term data systems platform roadmaps that anticipate ML/CV feature requirements and inform hardware and infrastructure decisions * Mentor other engineers on systems architecture methodology and contribute to raising the technical bar across the data systems organization * Demonstrate a service mindset by staying hands\-on with day\-to\-day work and supporting tasks at all levels—no task is too small or too senior for this role ### **Minimum Qualifications:** * 8\+ years of experience in hardware systems architecture or systems engineering for consumer electronics, wearables, or mobile computing platforms * Experience defining system\-level requirements and allocating performance budgets across heterogeneous hardware subsystems including compute, power, thermal, and sensing * Experience leading cross\-functional hardware architecture decisions from concept through mass production, including silicon bring\-up and system validation * jobs.title: Cyber Security Operations Center Analyst / AI-Automation Engineer
jobs.description: Job ID JR116338 **Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for** ***all*****.** Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever. The Cyber Security Operations Center (CSOC) Analyst / AI\-Automation Engineer is a hybrid cybersecurity role that combines security operations, threat investigation, detection engineering, and AI\-enabled automation development. You will investigate and respond to cyber threats. You will also improve how Cyber Defense operates by automating repetitive analyst workflows, engineering automated responses, strengthening detections, and building AI\-assisted capabilities that increase speed, consistency, and scale. This is not a traditional SOC analyst role. When you find a repetitive process, you will ask whether it can be automated. When you find a detection gap, you will help engineer the fix. When you develop an effective investigation technique, you will turn it into a reusable playbook, automation, or AI\-enabled capability. Success means handling security events well and leaving the Cyber Defense organization more capable after every investigation: defend today while engineering a better defense for tomorrow. This role is part of the CSOC's move toward new hybrid roles and supports a 16x5 operating schedule. **Responsibilities:** * **Cyber Defense Operations:** Investigate, triage, and respond to security alerts and incidents across endpoint, identity, network, cloud, email, and data\-security environments. Hunt for malicious or anomalous activity, and correlate telemetry across security platforms to determine scope, impact, and the right response. Implement and continuously improve incident response and investigation playbooks. Partner with threat intelligence, detection engineering, incident response, vulnerability management, and other security teams on complex investigations. * **Detection \& Response Engineering:** Develop and tune detections based on emerging threats, attack techniques, intelligence, and lessons learned from investigations. Identify detection gaps and recommend improvements to telemetry, correlation, and response logic. Translate analyst knowledge and investigation techniques into repeatable detection and response capabilities. Use frameworks such as MITRE ATT\&CK to structure detection and threat\-hunting coverage. * **Automation \& Engineering:** Identify repetitive analyst work and decide whether to automate, eliminate, redesign, or keep it manual, based on volume, risk, and how often the process changes. Build scripts, playbooks, and integrations with Python, PowerShell, REST APIs, SOAR, and workflow platforms that connect security tools, telemetry sources, and case\-management systems. Engineer them to production standard, with error handling, retries, idempotent actions, structured logging, and alerts when an automation fails or silently stops. Add proportionate safeguards to automated response: human approval for disruptive actions such as host containment, account disablement, or mailbox purges, plus exclusion lists, action limits, and tested rollback. Manage automation as code, with source control, peer review, non\-production testing, and change\-managed promotion. Use least\-privilege service identities and managed secrets, and maintain credentials and API permissions over their full lifecycle. Own what you build by documenting it, monitoring its health, and maintaining it as upstream tools change. Measure outcomes such as analyst hours returned, time to triage and respond, consistency, and error rates. Focus especially on the risk that automation might close cases needing advancement. * **AI\-Enabled Security Operations:** Design, build, and operate AI agents that support investigation, enrichment, threat analysis, and response by querying SIEM, EDR, identity, threat intelligence, and case\-management systems. Build the agent tools with MCP and platform APIs, using narrowly scoped, least\-privilege access and separating read\-only from state\-changing actions. Match autonomy to each use case so that AI informs judgment while policy\-based controls govern high\-impact decisions. Encode analyst expertise as reusable instructions and skills grounded in trusted sources such as runbooks and prior cases. Defend against prompt injection from untrusted content. Evaluate agents against historical analyst ground truth and run them in shadow mode before granting autonomy. Log prompts, tool calls, and evidence so every AI\-influenced action is auditable. Require cited evidence and validation before AI analysis drives decisions. Look for places where AI can augment analyst judgment, not just automate existing processes. * **Continuous Improvement:** Treat every investigation as an opportunity to improve the broader defense capability. Document investigation  en communication and documentation skills. **Preferred Qualifications:** * **Security automation and detection:** Experience building SOAR and security automation workflows. Also experience building or maintaining security detections, including detection\-as\-code practices, and a background in cloud and identity security. * **Software development practices:** Familiarity with Git and version control, testing, APIs, and CI/CD. * **Platform integration:** Experience integrating security platforms with ticketing, case\-management, or workflow systems. * **AI and LLM workflows:** Experience building AI agents or LLM\-powered workflows for security or IT operations, using a framework or platform such as Claude Agent SDK or Azure AI Foundry. Also experience building or integrating MCP servers or other tool\-calling interfaces for LLMs. * **AI quality and certifications:** Familiarity with RAG, AI evaluation methods, or LLM observability. Relevant certifications are a plus, such as GCIH, GCIA, GCFA, GCTI, OSCP, Security\+, CISSP, or cloud security certifications. jobs.description: Job ID JR103415 Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for all. Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever. As a SoC Physical Design Engineer in the Heterogeneous Integration Group (HIG), you will drive the implementation of advanced HBM SoC logic/base die designs from netlist to GDSII. You will work closely with RTL design, verification, DFT, IP providers, packaging/assembly, and manufacturing teams to deliver best‑in‑class PPA (performance, power, area) and robust signoff collateral for tape\-out. This is a hands‑on role with opportunities to own blocks or top‑level integration across multiple product generations. Key Responsibilities Own physical implementation for SoC blocks and/or top\-level, including floor\-planning, placement, CTS, routing, and physical optimization to meet PPA targets. Drive timing closure (setup/hold) across multi\-mode/multi\-corner (MMMC) scenarios; partner with RTL, architecture, and STA/signoff to converge designs. Integrate and implement complex IP (e.g., controllers, microcontrollers, NOC, interfaces, MBIST/DFT logic, buffers, PHY‑adjacent logic) with focus on robust physical integration and timing/power integrity. Perform and/or coordinate physical signoff, including DRC/LVS, IR drop/EM, and timing signoff, addressing violations efficiently. Partner with DFT teams to ensure scan/MBIST requirements are physically realizable and do not compromise PPA or schedule. Work with packaging, assembly, test, probe, and manufacturing collaborators to ensure builds meet manufacturability and quality requirements. Support tape\-out execution (checklists, ECO flows, signoff reviews) and contribute to post\-silicon debug by correlating silicon behavior with PD/STA/power analysis. Identify flow gaps and improve productivity through scripting/automation and best\-practice methodology development. (LLM's) Required Qualifications Strong experience in SoC physical design implementation from netlist to GDSII on advanced nodes and complex designs. Proficiency with industry EDA tools (e.g., Cadence Innovus/Tempus, Synopsys ICC2/PrimeTime, Siemens Calibre or equivalent). Solid understanding of STA fundamentals, clocking, constraints (SDC), and common closure techniques (buffering, path shaping, useful skew, etc.). Experience with power intent and power delivery considerations (e.g., UPF/CPF concepts, power grid planning, power gating implications). **Familiarity with physical verification/signoff concepts:** DRC, LVS, ERC, parasitic extraction awareness, and signoff handoff quality. Preferred Qualifications Experience with HBM / DRAM adjacent SoC designs, or memory\-subsystem\-heavy SoCs. jobs.description: Job ID JR116368 **Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for** ***all*****.** Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever. Micron is seeking a Principal AI Security Technologist to lead the next phase of a security transformation that is already underway. You will own the target\-state AI and data architecture for Micron's converged security operations, spanning Physical Security, SOC/GSOC, Threat Intelligence, and Insider Risk, and drive AI agents and automation from pilot into production at global scale. In this role you will be a part of a team that will be redesigning how security work gets done. The foundation is in place: a unified security data platform bringing together access control, video, alarm, and sensor data; early AI agents supporting operator triage and investigation; and a roadmap toward risk\-based, intelligence\-led operations. We need a Principal AI Security Technologist to take that foundation and scale it into a fully converged, AI\-supported security ecosystem. This role is chartered to fundamentally change how security work is performed, not to maintain tools or make incremental improvements. You will decide which work machines should do, which work people should do, and how the two fit together, then deliver it! **Responsibilities:** * **Own the security transformation roadmap.** Carry forward and evolve the multi\-year roadmap that moves Physical Security, SOC/GSOC Operations, Threat Intelligence, and Insider Risk from reactive, manual processes to technology\-enhanced, intelligence\-led capabilities. Keep it tied to operational priorities and measurable outcomes. * **Set the converged security architecture.** Define and govern the target\-state AI and data architecture so that physical security systems, SOC tooling, intelligence platforms, and insider risk capabilities operate as one ecosystem. Make the hard calls on data models, integration patterns, platform choices, and where AI should and should not sit in the workflow. * **Scale AI agents and automation.** Identify security tasks suited to AI agent automation or AI\-assisted execution, including triage, enrichment, correlation, and investigation preparation. Take agent capabilities from pilot to production with the evaluation, guardrails, and human oversight needed for security\-critical decisions. * **Shift from alerts to risk.** Lead the move from rule\-based alerting to risk\-based assessment and prioritization across physical, intelligence, and insider domains. Use multi\-signal correlation to detect emerging threats earlier and with fewer false positives. * **Deliver and measure outcomes.** Lead initiatives from concept through production and enterprise scale. Define and track success metrics for workload reduction, detection accuracy, response speed, and risk visibility. Retire legacy tools and manual workflows as new automated capabilities mature. * **Provide technical leadership.** Mentor engineers and data scientists on the team, partner with IT, cybersecurity, legal, and privacy team members, and represent the program's technical direction to senior leadership. **Minimum Qualifications:** * 10\+ years in security technology, security engineering, or security operations, including significant time in an architect or technical lead role. * Hands\-on experience applying AI agents, machine learning, or advanced analytics to security or adjacent operational problems, with at least one capability delivered to production. * Strong understanding of enterprise physical security systems (access control, video management, intrusion and alarm systems) and security operations center workflows. * Experience designing data and integration architectures that bring together data from multiple operational systems. * Demonstrated ability to translate security risk and operational needs into technical and automated solutions, and to lead multi\-functional teams through delivery. **Preferred Qualifications:** * Experience with converged security, fusion\-center operations, and high\-security industrial environments, including semiconductor or manufacturing. * Experience deploying LLM\-based agents in production, including evaluation, guardrails, and human\-in\-the\-loop design. * Familiarity with cloud data platforms, data lakes, and lakehouse architectures. * Knowledge of security risk frameworks, governance, privacy, and responsible AI, particularly for workforce and video data. * Relevant security, cloud, or technology certifications such as CISSP, CPP, PSP, or cloud architecture credentials, advanced education, or equivalent experience. We drive strategic cybersecurity initiatives that strengthen enterprise resilience, advance Zero Trust principles, and ensure security capabilities evolve alongside emerging threats, cloud adoption, and AI technologies! **About the Role** ------------------ As a Principal Cybersecurity Domain Architect, you will serve as the technical authority for Network Security, Endpoint Security, and Detection \& Response! This is a deep, focused role for an architect who wants authority and mastery in a defined lane rather than breadth across the entire enterprise. You will set the direction for how Micron designs, deploys, and operates its network, endpoint, and detection and response capabilities, and be the go\-to design authority that engineering, operations, and security leadership rely on within these domains. jobs.title: Principal Design Engineer
jobs.description: Job ID JR115220 Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for all. Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever. Micron’s Non\-Volatile Engineering Group (NVEG) develops best\-in\-class NAND memory products in die size, performance, reliability and power! NVEG is embedding AI across the entire design flow, and we are looking for engineers who use AI daily and actively reshape engineering workflows around it. **Position Overview:** As a Principal Design Engineer on the NAND datapath team, you will lead architecture and design of the internal datapath between the page buffer and IO: wave\-pipelined buses, flop\-to\-flop timing, FIFOs, dataline sensing, column repair and clocking. You will use AI daily to accelerate design, timing closure and verification, help bring STA\-based semi\-custom methodology into a simulation\-only flow, and set technical direction as a recognized leader! **What’s Encouraged Daily:** **Datapath architecture:** Define, design and verify internal datapath blocks (page buffer\-to\-IO data buses, wave pipelines, FIFOs, SER/DES front ends and datapath clocking) to meet bandwidth, timing and power targets. **Timing closure:** Architect and close wave\-pipelined and flop\-to\-flop paths, including setup/hold, skew/jitter budgets, PVT delay tracking, and delay trims across PVT and aging. **Dataline sensing:** Design dataline sense amps and precharge/latch sensing, covering offset, Monte Carlo/high\-sigma margin, coupling and IR drop. **Array repair \& redundancy:** Design column repair, fuse/repair storage and redundancy muxing with no bandwidth or timing penalty; verify all repair configurations with test, PE and FW. Use AI daily for RTL generation, scripting, and timing/waveform analysis. Develop specs and checklists that AI can process. Build agents to automate timing, Monte Carlo, and repair\-coverage checks. **Semi\-custom methodology:** Lead the move from SPICE\-only closure to a semi\-custom flow with characterized custom cells, SDC/STA sign\-off, STA\-to\-SPICE correlation, and synthesis/APR/ECO flows. **Physical co\-design:** Drive floorplan, bus routing and RC\-aware delay matching with layout, and correlate post\-layout timing. **AI \& technical leadership:** Champion AI adoption and standard processes, define interface specs with multi\-functional teams, support silicon debug, and mentor engineers. **Minimum Qualifications:** 8\+ years in memory datapath, SRAM or high\-speed custom design. BS/MS in EE or related field Deep expertise in flop\-to\-flop and wave\-pipelined timing closure (setup/hold, skew, min/max delay, PVT margin). Experience in sense amp, dataline or SRAM read/write design, including Monte Carlo/high\-sigma verification. Proven collaboration with layout on floorplanning, extraction and post\-layout timing correlation. Daily hands\-on AI use, with concrete examples of AI\-based workflows (prompts, scripts or agents) that improved productivity or design outcomes. **Preferred Qualifications:** **NAND/DRAM/SRAM periphery experience:** page buffer, column decoder, global data bus, or array\-to\-IO pipeline. Memory repair and redundancy design, and its impact on yield, area, timing and test time. Timing\-adjustment techniques (delay trims, DLL/DCC, training) and aging effects (NBTI/HCI). Building AI agents, LLM/RAG pipelines or ML models for IC design, verification or debug. Sophisticated CMOS device physics, mismatch modeling (BSIM), and low\-power techniques (clock/power gating, leakage). Solid understanding of STA and semi\-custom flows mixing custom and standard\-cell logic. AI agents are becoming part of how work gets done, and adversaries are learning to attack them and to attack with them. This role exists to protect those systems and to make sure we can detect, contain, and recover when they are targeted. As a Staff AI Security Engineer, you build the tools, solutions, architectures, and frameworks that secure our sanctioned AI estate and defend against agentic threats across their full lifecycle, from prevention through response and recovery. This is a hands\-on, individual\-contributor role on the Cyber Defense and Resiliency team, working with the Senior Manager, Technical Network Security. You spend most of your time building, and your work sets the technical direction that others follow. You operate where emerging AI capability meets practical security engineering! On one side you build and operate the protective controls that keep our approved AI solutions safe to use. On the other you translate novel agentic attack patterns into working defenses, automated response actions, and reusable frameworks that the broader organization can adopt. You are comfortable moving fast in an area where the playbooks are still being written, and you bring rigor to a space that rewards it. **Responsibilities:** * Build and harden security tools that protect AI agents, model\-backed services, and supporting infrastructure by securing system configurations, access, and integrations. * Operate and mature AI guardrails, including in\-line model protections, prompt\-injection defenses, and data\-loss prevention, in partnership with AI enablement and governance teams. * Design detection capabilities for agentic threats, including prompt injection, tool/function abuse, identity and credential misuse, data exfiltration, and agent memory or context manipulation. * Develop automated, machine\-speed response and containment tools with tiered authority for reversible and irreversible actions. * Enable rapid, scalable revocation of compromised agent access and credentials, while restoring agent configurations, tool registries, and supporting services to a known\-good state. * Create and document reusable architectures, reference designs, and frameworks that enable consistent security and defense of agentic systems across the organization. * Partner with detection and response, threat intelligence, platform engineering, and AI enablement teams to operationalize solutions and serve as a technical authority who strengthens organizational capabilities. jobs.description: The Behavior team at Motional is responsible for developing the prediction, planning, and sim agent capabilities that enable our autonomous vehicles to navigate complex, dynamic environments safely, comfortably, and confidently. Our work spans understanding and anticipating the behavior of other road users, making intelligent driving decisions, and generating safe, efficient, and natural vehicle trajectories. We combine cutting\-edge machine learning, robotics, large\-scale data, and rigorous evaluation to advance the capabilities of our production autonomous driving system. We are looking for a highly motivated, technically strong engineer to lead evaluation initiatives across Prediction and Planning. In this role, you will define how we measure, understand, and improve autonomous driving behavior, bridging the gap between individual model performance and real\-world system outcomes. You will drive the development of advanced evaluation methodologies, performance metrics, data mining strategies, and scalable tools to identify system limitations, assess dataset coverage, and guide model development. You will work closely with machine learning engineers, roboticists, safety, and cross\-functional teams to tackle challenging, open\-ended problems and establish the quantitative foundations that drive improvements in safety, comfort, and driving performance. Your work will directly influence how we develop, evaluate, and deploy the next generation of autonomous driving capabilities. What You'll Do * Act as the central authority on evaluation for our Behaviors teams, bridging the gap between model development and system\-level autonomous behavior. * Drive the evaluation strategy for our prediction and planning models, including open\-loop and simulation\-based assessments. * Design and implement advanced metrics to measure model impact on overall system behavior, leveraging ML\-based approaches for robust, end\-to\-end model evaluation. * Incorporate concepts such as counterfactual reasoning and reaction time analysis into our evaluation frameworks to better understand system behavior. * Develop the strategy for data mining and assess the coverage of our training and evaluation datasets across Prediction and Planning. * Build necessary tooling and pipelines, identify gaps in our processes, and collaborate with machine learning engineers and roboticists to solve open\-ended problems. * Cross\-functional collaboration: Partner with Safety, Infrastructure, Operations, Legal, and the other Systems teams to drive design improvements and ensure features generate a net positive effect on system safety, comfort, and assertiveness and meet our launch criteria. What We're Looking For: * Bachelor's degree and 7\+ years of experience in Computer Science, Systems Engineering, Robotics, or a similar technical field (or Master's/PhD and 5\+ years of experience). * Strong foundation in probability/statistics, data science, and scientific rigor applied to complex, multi\-agent systems. * Proficiency in Python, SQL, and data analysis (visualization, statistics) in production environments. * Experience defining performance targets and acceptance criteria spanning safety, comfort, and assertiveness, producing the analysis and evidence to justify them. * Demonstrated ability to tackle technical challenges, analyze cross\-disciplinary problems, and propose innovative, maintainable solutions. * Proven ability to lead initiatives, drive alignment, and ensure stakeholder engagement throughout the development process. * Working expertise in hazard and safety analysis methods such as STPA, HAZOP, FMEA, and hazard analysis and risk assessment. Ideally, You Also Have: * Experience using statistical and ML methods to quantify performance, detect regressions, and reveal patterns of system behavior at scale. * Deep experience with Prediction and/or Planning for autonomous robotics, including evaluating ML\-based systems in production environments. * Experience with public AV datasets and benchmarks (e.g., Waymo Open Dataset, nuScenes, etc.) and a deep understanding of standard industry metrics for trajectory forecasting and motion planning. * Prior experience using or building data pipelines at scale. * Excellent communication skills, capable of articulating complex concepts to technical peers and executive leadership alike, with a proven ability to collaborate across distributed teams. * Familiarity with SOTIF, ISO 26262, UL4600, and AVSC behavior competencies and other industry standards. **Motional is a driverless technology company making autonomous vehicles a safe, reliable, and accessible reality. We're driven by something more.** **Our journey is always people first.** We aren't just developing driverless cars; we're creating safer roadways, more equitable transportation options, and making our communities better places to live, work, and connect. Our team is made up of engineers, researchers, innovators, dreamers and doers, who are creating a technology with the potential to transform the way we move. **Higher purpose, greater impact.** We're creating first\-of\-its\-kind technology that will transform transportation. To do so successfully, we must design for everyone in our cities and on our roads. We believe in building a great place to work through a progressive, global culture that is diverse, inclusive, and ensures people feel valued at every level of the organization. Diversity helps us to see the world differently; it's not only good for our business, it's the right thing to do. **Scale up, not starting up.** Our team is behind some of the industry's largest leaps forward, including the first fully\-autonomous cross\-country drive in the U.S, the launch of the world's first robotaxi pilot, and operation of the world's longest\-standing public robotaxi fleet. We're driven to scale; we're moving towards commercialization of our technology, and we need team members who are ready to embrace change and challenges. Formed as a joint venture between Hyundai Motor Group and Aptiv, Motional is fundamentally changing how people move through their lives. Headquartered in Boston, Motional has operations in the U.S and Asia. For more information, visit www.Motional.com and follow us on Twitter, LinkedIn, Instagram and YouTube. *Motional AD Inc. is an EOE. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. To comply with Federal Law, we participate in E\-Verify. All newly\-hired employees are queried through this electronic system established by the DHS and the SSA to verify their identity and employment eligibility.*

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, AI
jobs.description: Muck Rack is trusted by thousands of organizations around the world to understand how their brands show up across news, social media and AI\-generated answers. Our AI\-powered platform connects the entire PR workflow in one place, helping communications teams manage media relationships, understand the conversations shaping their brands, take action and measure their impact. Combined with analyst\-led Media Intelligence and advisory services, Muck Rack turns signals into insights and insights into action. Founder\-controlled and growing profitably and sustainably, we have the freedom to build forward\-thinking products, put our customers first, and offer an inclusive culture that welcomes diverse perspectives. Our Agents team at Muck Rack is building AI for PR and communications professionals. Our first agent helps customers understand their media coverage. Next, we're building agents that can plan and carry out multi\-step workflows. You'll take features from idea to production, working across our Python agent runtime, MCP server, and Django/Vue application. You'll help decide how the technology works, ship it to real customers, and learn from how they use it. You'll help shape what we build next and how we build it. You'll work with new models, solve real customer problems, and take your ideas from experiment to production. If you want to build agents people actually rely on, we'd like to meet you. **What You'll Do** ------------------ * **Build agents that take action.** Build tools, prompts, guardrails, and multi\-turn workflows with memory. Please note that this is what we expect the process to look like; we may ask you for supplemental information or require an additional step before making a final decision. * 30\-minute interview with a member of our Talent Team * A 1 hour zoom interview with the hiring manager * Peer interviews with several team members * 30\-minute Executive Interview * 30\-minute Bar Raiser ### **Travel \& Team Engagement Expectations** This role requires up to 10% travel for team collaboration, customer engagements, and company events. As part of our commitment to building strong connections across our fully distributed team, attendance at our annual company offsite (typically held in Mexico) is expected. ### **Salary** * The anticipated salary range for this role in Ireland is €95,000–€110,000 annually, depending on experience. * The anticipated salary range for this role in United Kingdom is £105,000–£115,000 annually, depending on experience. * The anticipated salary for this role in Bulgaria is €6,500\+ gross per month, depending on experience. ###### **Individual compensation decisions are based on a number of factors, including experience level, skillset, and balancing internal equity relative to peers at the company. We expect the majority of the candidates who are offered roles at our company to fall healthily throughout the range based on these factors. We recognize that the person we hire may be less experienced (or more senior) than this job description as posted. If that ends up being the case, the updated salary range will be communicated with you as a candidate.** **Why Muck Rack?** ------------------ **Remote Work, Forever** * Fully distributed team with a permanent remote setup * Home office stipend, phone and internet reimbursement, coworking membership * Virtual and in\-person team bonding (lunches, events, competitions) **Transparent \& Fair Compensation** * Competitive geo\-neutral pay in the U.S. * Annual reviews to ensure equity and market alignment * Standardized bonus or commission structure * 401(k) with employer contributions * Equity opportunities **Health \& Wellness** * Comprehensive medical, dental, vision, disability, and life insurance for employees and dependents * 100% premium coverage for individuals on high\-deductible plans * 24/7 Virtual Care and Employee Assistance Program * Employer\-funded HSA contributions and other pre\-tax benefits * Quarterly wellness stipend and free Headspace subscription **Time Off \& Family Benefits** * 4\+ weeks of PTO, plus paid sick and mental health days * 13 paid holidays with the option to swap for personal days * Up to 16 weeks of fully paid parental leave **Learning and Development** * Transparent pathways for internal mobility and promotion * Bi\-annual performance reviews, team workshops, and leadership training * Unlimited access to Coursera and O'Reilly * 2 additional PTO days annually for learning and development **Inclusive, Customer\-First Culture** * Commitment to equity and valuing diverse perspectives * Agile, founder\-led company focused on collaboration and innovation * Trusted by 3,000\+ companies worldwide *Note: Benefits and compensation reflect offerings for U.S.\-based employees.
