jobs.title: Applied AI Engineer
jobs.description: We are building a practical AI capabilities for airline employees and customers. We are looking for an engineer who enjoys turning existing AI models, company knowledge and business systems into useful, reliable applications. You will help take ownership of our growing AI knowledge base and the software that makes it useful. Projects include crew assistance, document and image understanding, multilingual information retrieval, and customer\-facing connections to flight information and booking services. The focus is applying existing models and tools to real problems. You will work with a small team, contribute directly to technical decisions, and follow projects from early prototypes through testing, deployment and ongoing improvement. **What you will do** * Build and maintain our AI knowledge corpus: collect, clean, organize and update documents and structured information while preserving sources, versions and access permissions. * Improve retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG), including document processing, embeddings, search and the quality of information supplied to models. * Integrate and maintain models such as Qwen for vision and Gemma for answer generation, including local deployment on Apple silicon. * Work with our application developers on Apple Intelligence and the Foundation Models framework. * Develop Model Context Protocol (MCP) and API integrations for customer\-facing services such as flight schedules, fare search and booking workflows, using authoritative business systems for current information. * Create repeatable evaluations, investigate incorrect answers and integration failures, and improve accuracy, response time and reliability. * Document your work and build maintainable systems with appropriate security, privacy and monitoring. **What we are looking for** * Demonstrated ability to build working software, including an LLM application, retrieval system, AI integration or substantial related project. * Strong programming and debugging skills, particularly in Python, with experience using APIs, processing data and working with Git. * Practical understanding of how language models use retrieved information and tools, including their limitations. * Ability to turn an unclear business request into a manageable implementation and explain technical choices clearly. * Care with source accuracy, confidential information and testing. * Independence, curiosity and willingness to maintain and improve what you build. **Helpful experience** * Qwen, Gemma or comparable open\-weight models. * RAG pipelines, vector search, reranking and automated evaluations. * MCP servers, tool calling, authentication and business\-system integrations. * Swift, iOS/macOS development, Apple Intelligence, Foundation Models or MLX. * Local or offline AI deployment, multilingual applications, document processing or computer vision. * Airline, travel, commerce or other operational systems. You do not need experience with every technology listed. Strong engineering fundamentals and evidence of useful work matter more than a particular degree or an extensive list of AI tools. **How we work** We encourage using AI tools for development, research, documentation and content preparation. You should be comfortable using them to move faster while understanding, testing and taking responsibility for the resulting work. This role offers direct ownership, access to real airline problems and the opportunity to help shape a growing internal AI capability. Pay: $150,000\.00 \- $175,000\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) * Dental insurance * Health insurance * Paid time off * Vision insurance Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Infrastructure Engineer
jobs.description: **Position Summary:** The National Association of REALTORS® (NAR) seeks a Infrastructure Engineer to support, secure, and modernize enterprise infrastructure across Microsoft Azure, data center, server, identity, network, wireless, backup, and Microsoft 365 environments. This role is responsible for maintaining system availability, performance, reliability, and security; troubleshoots complex issues; improves automation and disaster recovery readiness; and partners with Infrastructure, Cybersecurity, Application, and business teams. The Cybersecurity team defines and approves security policy, while this role implements, operates, and maintains approved controls. The ideal candidate is a collaborative problem solver who thrives in a fast\-paced environment, brings a modern infrastructure mindset, and is passionate about cloud, automation, cybersecurity, and emerging technologies. **Duties and Responsibilities:** * Systems, Cloud, and Identity: Administer and troubleshoot Microsoft Azure, Windows and Linux servers, Active Directory, Entra ID/Azure AD, DNS, DHCP, Group Policy, SQL databases, Microsoft 365 integrations, and related hybrid services. * Virtualization and Patching: Manage Nutanix Acropolis provisioning, capacity, and performance. Perform server patching, operating system upgrades, and security updates through scheduled change controls and defined patching service levels. * Security Platforms: Experience administering secure web gateways, zero\-trust access, endpoint security, or enterprise security platforms. Implement approved security baselines, vulnerability remediation, access controls, endpoint hardening, and incident\-response support in coordination with Cybersecurity. * Network and Wireless: Configure and troubleshoot Palo Alto firewalls, NAT, threat\-prevention features, Arista and Cisco switches, VLANs, routing, spanning tree, port security, QoS, firmware, and Aruba wireless controllers, access points, SSIDs, guest access, and RF performance. * Backup, Recovery, and Availability: Manage Commvault backup scheduling, monitoring, disaster recovery planning, recovery testing and restoration activities. Maintain and continuously improve disaster recovery readiness to ensure critical systems can be recovered within defined recovery objectives. Proactively identify and remediate system, network, security, performance, and capacity issues before business impact. * Automation and Monitoring: Automate recurring tasks with PowerShell and infrastructure\-as\-code tools such as Bicep or Terraform. Review alerts, monitor infrastructure health and performance trends, establish operational baselines, and improve service reliability. * Projects and Documentation: Support infrastructure projects, migrations, upgrades, cloud adoption, network vendor consolidation, and platform standardization from planning through implementation. Maintain procedures, diagrams, inventories, and technical standards. * Support and Collaboration: Provide Tier 2 and Tier 3 support, work with outside vendors, communicate technical concepts to nontechnical stakeholders, and participate in the on\-call rotation. **Basic Qualifications:** * Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or equivalent work experience. * Five or more years of experience as a Systems Engineer or Infrastructure Engineer, or similar enterprise infrastructure role. * Strong knowledge of Azure, Windows and Linux servers, Active Directory, Group Policy, DNS, DHCP, SQL databases, Microsoft server technologies, and enterprise infrastructure operations. * Hands\-on knowledge of TCP/IP, routing, VLANs, firewall administration, enterprise security principles, PowerShell automation, and monitoring and alerting platforms. * Experience administering secure web gateway, zero\-trust access, or similar security platforms. * Strong problem\-solving, organizational, documentation, collaboration, vendor\-management, and communication skills. **Preferred Qualifications:** * Experience with Nutanix Acropolis, Microsoft Azure administration, hybrid cloud connectivity, Commvault, Palo Alto Networks, Arista or Cisco switching, and Aruba wireless infrastructure. * Experience with infrastructure migrations, network vendor consolidation, platform migrations, or multi\-vendor\-to\-standardized\-platform transitions. * Relevant certifications such as Microsoft Azure Administrator (AZ\-104\), Zscaler Certified Administrator, Commvault, Palo Alto PCNSA/PCNSE, Cisco CCNA, or Aruba credentials. **Work Environment and Additional Requirements:** * On\-site presence at NAR's DC office three days per week. * Participation in a scheduled on\-call rotation and approved evening or weekend maintenance windows. * Occasional lifting and handling of data center hardware and equipment. * Ability to travel up to 5% for business, training, or project\-related activities. **Compensation:** $115,000\- $135,000 NAR provides comprehensive benefits including health/dental/vision insurance. NAR is on a hybrid schedule and in the office 3 days a week. **Organizational Overview:** The National Association of REALTORS® (NAR) is a team of professionals dedicated to providing world\-class service to approximately 1\.5 million REALTORS® working in the United States and around the world. The real estate industry is fast\-paced and fast\-changing\-\-each year, our members participate in the sale, lease, and management of real estate. As in every industry, our members’ value proposition is constantly being challenged by innovation. It is our mission to empower REALTORS® as they preserve, protect and advance the right to real property for all. We cannot do that without the ideas, passion, and commitment from our talented employees. As our greatest assets, employees are offered their pick of competitive benefits/perks and flexible work options.

jobs.title: Junior Data Scientist
jobs.description: **Job Title: Junior Data Scientist** **Employment Type: Full\-Time (W2\)** **Candidate must be open to relocate.** We are seeking motivated and aspiring Data Scientists to join our growing consulting team. This opportunity is ideal for recent graduates and early\-career IT professionals who are passionate about data science, machine learning, artificial intelligence, and data\-driven decision\-making. **Responsibilities** Collect, clean, preprocess, and analyze structured and unstructured datasets. Develop and implement machine learning models to solve business problems. Perform exploratory data analysis (EDA) to identify trends, patterns, and insights. Build predictive models and evaluate their performance using appropriate statistical techniques. Develop data visualizations and dashboards to communicate findings effectively. Collaborate with data engineers, software developers, business analysts, and stakeholders to deliver data\-driven solutions. Optimize machine learning models for scalability, accuracy, and performance. jobs.title: Software Engineer, Roku
jobs.description: **Company Description** NBCUniversal is one of the world's leading media and entertainment companies. We create world\-class content, which we distribute across our portfolio of film, television, and streaming, and bring to life through our global theme park destinations, consumer products, and experiences. We own and operate leading entertainment and news brands, including NBC, NBC News, NBC Sports, Telemundo, NBC Local Stations, Bravo, and Peacock, our premium ad\-supported streaming service. We produce and distribute premier filmed entertainment and programming through our powerhouse film and television studios, including Universal Pictures, DreamWorks Animation, and Focus Features, and the four global television studios under the Universal Studio Group banner, and operate industry\-leading theme parks and experiences around the world through Universal Destinations \& Experiences, including Universal Orlando Resort, home to Universal Epic Universe, and Universal Studios Hollywood. NBCUniversal is a subsidiary of Comcast Corporation. Visit www.nbcuniversal.com for more information. Our impact is rooted in improving the communities where our employees, customers, and audiences live and work. We have a rich tradition of giving back and ensuring our employees have the opportunity to serve their communities. We champion an inclusive culture and strive to attract and develop a talented workforce to create and deliver a wide range of content reflecting our world. **Job Description** The Media Group at NBCU supports a powerhouse collection of consumer\-first brands including Peacock, NBC, Bravo, NBC Sports, and NBCU International. With unequalled scale, our teams make the most out of every opportunity to collaborate and learn from one another. We’re always looking for ways to innovate faster, accelerate our growth and consistently offer the very best in consumer experience. But most of all, we’re backed by a culture of respect. We embrace authenticity and inspire people to thrive. We're looking for a Roku Software Engineer to own and evolve our Roku channel, from the SceneGraph UI layer down to the playback pipeline and the APIs that feed it. Roku is one of the largest surfaces in our streaming footprint, and it's also the most constrained: the same channel has to feel fast on a top\-tier Roku Ultra and on a five\-year\-old Roku Express with a fraction of the memory. This role is for someone who treats those constraints as the interesting part of the job. You'll be measuring texture memory and node counts, chasing down rebuffer events in HLS manifests, and working with backend teams to shape the microservice responses that make a channel launch in under two seconds instead of six. * Design, build, and ship features in BrightScript and SceneGraph, with a strong bias toward maintainable, well\-factored component architecture rather than monolithic screens. * Own video playback quality end to end: startup time, ABR behavior, seek responsiveness, trick play, DRM handshakes, and graceful failure and recovery. * Profile and tune channel performance against real device constraints: memory ceilings on legacy hardware, render thread contention, task node usage, image and texture budgets, and cold\-start latency. * Instrument and act on QoE telemetry (startup time, rebuffer ratio, exit\-before\-video\-start, bitrate distribution), and drive those numbers down over time. * Partner with backend teams to define and refine the microservice and BFF APIs that power the channel: catalog, playback authorization, entitlement, continue\-watching, recommendations, and search. * Implement and maintain Roku platform integrations: deep linking, Roku Search and content feeds, Continue Watching, Roku Pay / Instant Signup, and the Roku Advertising Framework. * Build and maintain internal tooling and automation scripts in JavaScript/TypeScript: build and packaging steps, feed and manifest validators, release utilities, device\-farm and smoke\-test harnesses, and whatever else removes manual toil from the team's day. * Own the channel's CI/CD pipeline: automated builds, test execution, static analysis, artifact packaging, sideloading to test devices, and promotion through environments. You treat pipeline code as real code, with the same review and maintenance standards. * Shepherd releases through Roku channel certification, including performance and memory requirements, and manage the beta\-to\-production promotion process. * Establish and uphold engineering standards: code review, automated testing, static analysis, and clear documentation. * Debug production issues across the stack using the Roku debug console, profiler, ECP, and network capture, and turn root causes into durable fixes. **Qualifications** * 3\+ years of software engineering experience, including shipping production Roku channels with BrightScript and SceneGraph. * Demonstrated experience with performance tuning on constrained devices. You can talk specifically about a ti d startup latency, or eliminated frame drops, and how you measured it. * Strong grounding in software engineering best practices: separation of concerns, testability, meaningful abstractions, code review discipline, and refactoring as a habit rather than a project. * Hands\-on experience with video playback and streaming formats: HLS and/or DASH, adaptive bitrate behavior, manifest structure, buffering strategy, and DRM (Widevine and PlayReady on Roku). * Practical experience consuming and integrating with RESTful APIs in a microservice architecture, including pagination, caching, retry and backoff strategies, error contracts, and versioning. * Working proficiency in JavaScript and TypeScript (Node.js) for internal tooling and build automation. You can write a maintainable CLI or script that other engineers will actually use, not just a one\-off. * Hands\-on experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, CircleCI, or similar), including automated testing, build artifacts, and multi\-environment deployment. * Comfort with debugging tooling and telemetry: you're at home in a debug console, a profiler, and a dashboard. * Clear written and verbal communication, especially when explaining tradeoffs to non\-client engineers. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience with the Node\-based Roku toolchain: BrighterScript, Rooibos (or another BrightScript test framework), roku\-deploy, and ropm. * Experience with reusable workflow patterns, composite actions, or shared pipeline libraries across multiple repositories. * Familiarity with SSAI/CSAI, VAST/VMAP, and ad\-supported playback flows. * Background in another living\-room platform (tvOS, Android TV / Fire TV, Vizio, Tizen, or webOS), and an understanding of where Roku differs. * Experience with CDNs, edge caching, and manifest manipulation. * Familiarity with QoE analytics platforms such as Conviva, Mux, or Datadog RUM. * Experience defining backend contracts (REST or GraphQL) alongside server teams rather than just consuming them. * Accessibility experience: captions, audio description, and voice navigation on TV platforms. **Hybrid:** This position currently has a hybrid schedule, which requires contributing from the office a minimum of four days per week. The Company reserves the right to change in\-office requirements at any time. This position is eligible for company sponsored benefits, including medical, dental, and vision insurance, 401(k), paid leave, tuition reimbursement, and a variety of other discounts and perks. Learn more about the benefits offered by NBCUniversal by visiting the Benefits page of the Careers website. Salary range: $105,000 \- $145,000 **Additional Information** As part of our selection process, external candidates may be required to attend an in\-person interview with an NBCUniversal employee at one of our locations prior to a hiring decision. NBCUniversal's policy is to provide equal employment opportunities to all applicants and employees without regard to race, color, religion, creed, gender, gender identity or expression, age, national origin or ancestry, citizenship, disability, sexual orientation, marital status, pregnancy, veteran status, membership in the uniformed services, genetic information, or any other basis protected by applicable law. NBCUniversal will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories, or arrest or conviction records, in a manner consistent with relevant legal requirements, including the City of Los Angeles' Fair Chance Initiative For Hiring Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act, where applicable. If you are a qualified individual with a disability or a disabled veteran and require support throughout the application and/or recruitment process as a result of your disability, you have the right to request a reasonable accommodation. You can submit your request to AccessibilitySupport@nbcuni.com.

jobs.title: Plant Engineer - Boiler Specialist
jobs.description: Welcome to the intersection of energy and home services. At NRG, we’re all about propelling the next generation of leaders forward. We are driven by our passion to create a smarter, cleaner and more connected future. We deliver innovative solutions that make our customers’ lives easier—helping them power, protect, and intelligently manage their homes and businesses. To do this, we need creative and talented people to join our company. We offer a dynamic work environment and a unified and inclusive culture. NRG fosters a strong sense of belonging that leads to better collaboration and business performance. Our company programs are designed to help employees develop the skills they need for success now and in the future. In everything we do, we aim to champion our employees and bring value to our customers, investors and society. More information is available at www.nrg.com. Connect with NRG on Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn and X. **Job Purpose:** ---------------- Provide support for process improvements, performance monitoring, root cause analysis, engineering and construction activities, and operating and maintenance functions to ensure safe and efficient plant operation. **Emphasis****:** ***Boiler and High Energy Piping Systems*** **Essential Functions:** ------------------------ * Provide direction to operations and maintenance departments to insure that plant equipment remains reliable. This includes both technical and financial decisions which impact the overall unit availability and cost control. * Provide technical support, testing and inspection expertise within their assigned process areas to ensure safe, reliable, and efficient plant operation. * Optimize station equipment operation to meet key performance indicators * Develop O\&M and Capital budgets for the process equipment. Assemble ten year plans and budgets for projects to establish accurate projected cash flows out into the future. * Develop strategic plans for equipment overhauls to optimize equipment life and time between overhauls. * Develop outage schedules, coordinate and perform outage inspections for all steam cycle equipment. * Utilize predictive and preventative maintenance (PM/PDM) techniques and non\-destructive examination data (NDE) to evaluate boiler and piping repair plans. * Conduct root cause analysis of equipment problems and provide recommendations to prevent future incidents. Assemble all equipment failure reports. * Develop, review \& revise station procedures \& technical instructions and documentation of equipment testing and inspections. * Provide engineering, design, economic justification, and specify parts and materials for projects and modifications. Implement projects and process modifications. * Conduct or procure training as required within their process. * Interface with outside engineering resources on an “as\-needed” basis. * Work effectively in a team environment as a leader, member and/or facilitator. * Perform other duties and assignments as required. **Essential Functions for Emphasis:** ------------------------------------- **Boiler Engineering:** * Understanding of the boiler construction materials and inspection techniques as applied to reliable operation including ASME BPV code, ASME B31\.1 etc. * Develop plans using past inspections and recommendations from the boiler OEM, plant inspections and failure analyses. * Support the ongoing inspections and repairs of the High Energy Piping and Flow Accelerated Corrosion programs. * Verify boiler contractors welding processes and inspection requirements meet standards. **BOP:** * Knowledge of the concepts, construction, and operation of the turbine process steam cycle as it relates to a fossil steam power plant including basic thermodynamics. * Experience in maintenance and operation of all plant air supply systems, including station air, instrument air, and sootblowing air where applicable. * Knowledge and experience of service water systems, including low pressure systems, high pressure systems, closed cooling water systems, domestic (potable) water systems and circulating water systems. * Experience in the operation and maintenance of various fire protection systems used at a power plant. * Knowledge and experience in facilities management, which includes station heating, cooling, ventilation, plumbing and building envelope repairs. * Operations and maintenance of dust control technologies such as dust collection bag houses, dust transport systems, dust suppression systems, and passive dust control technologies. * Experience managing small to large outages, including specification development, station representative during installation, coordinate start\-up and testing. * Experience in performing inspections on fans, pumps, ash handling systems, soot blowing equipment. **Boiler:** * Knowledge in applicable codes and repair methods on boilers and high energy piping (ASME, NBIC.etc.) * Knowledge in Non\-Destructive Examinations (NDE). * Provide technical oversight on contractors during outages to ensure proper QA/QC procedures are followed. * Knowledge in coal mill and boiler operation, inspections, maintenance and performance testing. **QUALIFICATION GUIDELINES** Any combination equivalent to, but not limited to, the following: **Required:** Engineering or Technical Degree with a minimum of five years experience in technical support of plant processes. Extensive work related experience may be substituted for Engineering or technical degree. **Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:** ------------------------------------ * Thorough understanding of Power Plant processes and equipment and the interrelationships between them. * Ability to effectively supervise, train and direct others (peers, employees, contractors/vendors) in an understandable, clear and consistent manner * Ability to read and understand technical information, prints and engineering data, interpret charts, graphs, and gauge scales. Ability to troubleshoot and repair equipment and systems. * Risk management \- able to make good judgment on utilization of sometimes limited resources. * General to thorough knowledge in root cause analysis and proficient in technical report writing. * Proficient in the use of PC, and Windows \& Microsoft Office applications with particular emphasis on spreadsheet, scheduling, equipment performance and word processing programs. * Strong written and verbal communication skills. **Physical Requirements/Working Conditions:** --------------------------------------------- * This position is a combination of work in office and industrial settings. * Must be able to wear required personal protection equipment (PPE) such as hard hats, safety glasses, goggles, face shields, hearing protection, respirators, fall protection harnesses, and other PPE as required. * Duties require extensive manual dexterity in usage of computer terminal and keyboard, while sitting for long periods of time preparing budgets, work scopes, outage schedules, and other reports as needed. * May be required to perform equipment inspections by climbing vertical ladders in excess of 20 feet and stairways in excess of 50 feet, using step stool, kneeling, bending, walking over uneven surfaces such as loose rock, open grating, up and down staircases. * May also be required to operate mobile equipment such as zoom booms or scissor lifts to reach heights to inspect equipment, which includes pushing or pulling equipment into place, climbing into a basket, and riding in the basket while the equipment is operation. * The compartments where certain equipment may be located may exceed temperatures of 130°F. * May be required to prepare and conduct training, including mentoring individuals one\-on\-one. In conducting training, the specialist may be required to carry training materials, and to stand for extended periods of time. * This position may require some domestic travel. To the extent permitted by law and any applicable collective bargaining agreement, employees are subject to periodic random drug testing, and post\-accident and reasonable suspicion drug and alcohol testing. EOE AA M/F/Protected Veteran Status/Disability. Level, Title and/or Salary may be adjusted based on the applicant's experience or skills. jobs.description: NVIDIA is seeking a Senior GenAI Algorithms Engineer to advance the state of the art in foundation model development, training, and deployment. jobs.title: Software Engineer 5 - Android (DVX Mobile Core)
jobs.description: At Netflix, our mission is to entertain the world. Together, we are writing the next episode \- pushing the boundaries of storytelling, global fandom and making the unimaginable a reality. We are a dream team obsessed with the uncomfortable excitement of discovering what happens when you merge creativity, intuition and cutting\-edge technology. Come be a part of what’s next. The DVX Mobile Core team is responsible for developing and advancing the architecture of our member app for Android . We aim to leverage the systems and infrastructure that is broadly available at Netflix and figure out the best ways to adopt and apply it on Android. The Core team works with a wide range of engineering groups within the company to enable easier and more efficient patterns and canvases to be deployed to our members. Some of these changes are purely engineering\-based, for example to improve key user metrics, while others serve to adopt cleaner development patterns for downstream product engineering. We are part of a global, diverse organization that includes people of all genders, sexual orientations, upbringings, nationalities, ages, and socioeconomic \& educational backgrounds. We encourage engineers passionate about building well\-structured mobile experiences to apply. What this role is: * You'll own major, multi\-quarter initiatives that make other engineers faster and more confident. Today, that work falls into four themes: * Architecture. Product teams duplicate effort and step on each other. You'll help build coherent, reusable architecture, including server\-driven UI, a data\-centric approach to app development, modularization, and unidirectional state flow, so teams can move independently at scale. * Quality. Regressions are too easy to ship and too hard to see. You'll help make quality measurable through testing, trusted telemetry, and clear reliability standards in a high\-commit\-volume codebase. * Player. Product teams should spend their time on differentiated viewing experiences, not plumbing. You'll help deliver a reliable, extensible player framework they can build on. Innovation. Engineering across Mobile can move faster. You'll turn emerging technologies, including AI, into practical tools that accelerate it. * What you'll do: * Own outcomes end to end * Take ambiguous problems from idea to adoption: define scope, design the solution, document key trade\-offs, deliver, and measure whether it worked. * Influence technical roadmaps and drive forward\-looking technical solutions with minimal supervision. * Run projects like an owner: break work into milestones, surface risk early and manage cross\-team dependencies. * Ship the pragmatic solution and change course when the evidence says so. * Build what others build on * Design and build UI infrastructure and architecture that make the right way the easy way. * Write the documentation and migration paths that let other teams adopt your work without you in the room. * Raise the quality bar with testable code, automated tests (JVM unit, Espresso, Paparazzi bitmap diffs), and telemetry that make regressions visible. * Elevate the people around you * Treat engineers as your customers. Understand their use cases, and let them shape the solution. * Mentor less\-experienced engineers and help set the technical bar for the team. Track emerging Android technologies, and turn the promising ones into real tools and modernized code. * You're likely a fit if you have: * Owned something big. You've led a multi\-month, cross\-team technical initiative from ambiguity to adoption, and you can tell us how you scoped it, planned it, and measured its impact. * Driven your own agenda. You've spotted a problem nobody assigned you, built the case, and delivered the fix. * Run projects with discipline. You have a record of delivering in milestones, early risk communication, and delivering results. * Deep Android expertise. You're strong in Kotlin and Jetpack Compose, and you've applied architecture patterns (MVVM, unidirectional flow, modularization) in a large codebase. You can work in Java and GraphQL when needed. * Practical judgment. You weigh business, user, and architectural trade\-offs, and you know when good enough is right. * Clear communication. You build trust across product, design, and engineering by being curious, direct, and selfless. Bonus: server\-driven UI, Circuit, Paparazzi, media playback or player frameworks, telemetry and reliability engineering, or AI\-assisted development workflows. * Why this role: * A rare moment. You'll help lay the mobile foundation for one of the world's most\-used entertainment apps. * Leverage. One good framework multiplies the output of 100\+ engineers and reaches hundreds of millions of members. * Real ownership. You'll get the business context you need and decide scope, design, and trade\-offs. * Hard problems, good people. You'll work with talented peers across a wide range of devices and network conditions, in a culture of open communication where you value others' opinions to cover your blind spots. * A high\-performance culture. If you've read about Netflix's culture and think you'd thrive in it, we'd like to talk. Generally, our compensation structure consists solely of an annual salary; we do not have bonuses. You choose each year how much of your compensation you want in salary versus stock options. To determine your personal top of market compensation, we rely on market indicators and consider your specific job family, background, skills, and experience to determine your compensation in the market range. The range for this role is $388,000\.00 \- $558,000\.00\. This compensation range will vary based on location. Netflix provides comprehensive benefits including Health Plans, Mental Health support, a 401(k) Retirement Plan with employer match, Stock Option Program, Disability Programs, Health Savings and Flexible Spending Accounts, Family\-forming benefits, and Life and Serious Injury Benefits. We also offer paid leave of absence programs. Full\-time hourly employees accrue 35 days annually for paid time off to be used for vacation, holidays, and sick paid time off. Full\-time salaried employees are immediately entitled to flexible time off. See more details about our Benefits here . Netflix is a unique culture and environment. Learn more here . Inclusion is a Netflix value and we strive to host a meaningful interview experience for all candidates. If you want an accommodation/adjustment for a disability or any other reason during the hiring process, please send a request to your recruiting partner. We are an equal\-opportunity employer and celebrate diversity, recognizing that diversity builds stronger teams. We approach diversity and inclusion seriously and thoughtfully. jobs.title: Sr. Software Engineer
jobs.description: **Senior Software Engineer, Records Platform (T3\)** **About Neumo** Neumo builds the cloud software that powers government. More than 4,500 state, local and federal agencies across North America run on our platforms, processing over 900 million transactions and collecting $44 billion in revenue for the communities they serve. When a county records a deed, a family orders a birth certificate, or a business files a local tax return, that transaction often runs through our systems. That comes with a particular kind of engineering responsibility. Our platforms are systems of record for legally binding documents and public funds. Correctness is not negotiable, downtime has civic consequences, and the data we hold is expected to remain accurate and retrievable for decades. **Summary** The Senior Software Engineer designs, builds and maintains features for Neumo’s Records platform (Land Records, Vital Records and Search). County recorders and clerks use it to record deeds, index documents, issue certified birth, death and marriage certificates, and give the public secure access to records that go back generations. Every recorded document has legal weight, so correctness, security and reliability are essential. Records is a key area of investment for Neumo. We are evolving it from a tightly coupled, manually configured platform that depends on specific peripherals into a best\-in\-class product that meets customers where they are. Positioned between the Software Engineer and Staff Engineer roles, the Senior Software Engineer owns features from design through production and makes sound technical decisions within their area. They raise code quality on the team and help newer engineers grow. This role requires strong skills in .NET, SQL Server and cloud technologies, plus the judgment to work effectively in Neumo’s AI\-assisted, agentic delivery model. The Senior Software Engineer reports to a Software Engineering Manager on the Records platform. **Duties and Responsibilities** * Design, build, test and maintain features within the Records platform, such as eRecording and eSubmission, automated indexing, search, certified copy requests, property fraud alerts, and ID verification and payment integrations. * Contribute to platform modernization by decoupling tightly coupled components, replacing manual configuration with configurable, self\-service setup, and reducing dependencies on specific peripherals. * Take on meaningful parts of our modernization work, resolving compatibility issues and validating changes. * Build self\-service configurable features that support each jurisdiction’s statutes, workflows and level of digital maturity without custom code. * Develop and tune search features, including indexing, relevance and query performance, for large volumes of recorded documents. * Support customer migrations by building and testing data migration tooling, with a focus on data accuracy and record integrity. * Work from approved specifications in Neumo’s agentic delivery model. Use AI agents to draft code and tests, then review, correct and own what ships. * Conduct thorough code reviews, including reviews of AI\-generated code, and hold a high bar for correctness, maintainability and test coverage. * Troubleshoot and resolve complex production issues related to performance, reliability and data quality, and take part in on\-call rotations and post\-incident reviews. * Contribute to CI/CD pipelines, automated testing and monitoring to support reliable, repeatable releases. * Participate in sprint planning and backlog refinement. Give realistic estimates and raise risks early. * Document key design decisions and platform knowledge, and share expertise through pairing and walkthroughs so critical knowledge doesn’t live with one person. * Mentor Software Engineers and newer team members on coding practices, debugging, testing and how the Records platform works. * Partner with product managers, QA, architects, Staff and Principal Engineers, and implementation teams to clarify requirements and keep designs consistent with Neumo’s platform direction. * Build on Neumo’s shared enterprise services, such as identity and access, payments, notifications, reporting and search, instead of rebuilding them within Records. * Follow secure development practices, including vulnerability scanning, secrets management and access control, in line with the frameworks our government customers require. **Qualifications** * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field, or equivalent experience. * 5\+ years of experience in full\-stack development and cloud software, with a focus on Microsoft technologies. * Advanced coding skills in .NET, including both .NET Framework and modern .NET. Experience with Python, Node.js/TypeScript, Java and React is a plus. * Strong experience with SQL Server, plus working knowledge of NoSQL databases, cloud storage and data management best practices. * Experience with Azure or AWS and cloud\-native design patterns, such as microservices, serverless architecture, distributed caching and containerization. * Hands\-on experience with search platforms such as Elasticsearch, Solr or Lucene, including indexing and performance tuning. * Experience upgrading or modernizing legacy applications while keeping them stable in production. * Experience with high\-volume data processing and data migrations. * Experience using AI\-assisted development tools, and the judgment to review generated code critically. * Experience working in Agile environments, with a collaborative approach to problem\-solving and mentoring. * Understanding of security and compliance standards, such as SOC 2 and PCI, and how they apply to engineering design. * Clear communication skills, with the ability to explain technical issues and trade\-offs to engineers, product partners and leadership. **Nice to Have** * Experience with land records, vital records, recording or county clerk systems. * Experience with document management, OCR, imaging or scanning technologies. * Experience integrating with hardware peripherals, or moving away from hardware\-dependent designs. * Experience with eRecording standards or submitter integrations. * Experience with multi\-tenant SaaS platforms. * Experience with spec\-driven development or agentic coding tools, such as Claude Code, Cursor or GitHub Copilot agents. * Experience with public\-sector security frameworks, such as StateRAMP/GovRAMP or FedRAMP. **Neumo Summary** With the backing of four decades of public sector expertise and corporate capability, Neumo has successfully supported government services. Neumo was honored and recognized for four (4\) consecutive years as a GovTech 100 Company representing the top 100 companies focused on making a difference in and selling to state and local government agencies across the United States. Neumo is committed to helping communities thrive and brings a wealth of experience combined with innovation. Today, Neumo offers more administrative and financial support to government officials than any other organization. And with a responsive, client\-focused approach, we foster partnerships that give our customers the certainty they need to accomplish more. Neumo offers a competitive benefits and compensation package and are looking for team members who will thrive in our dynamic environment. Neumo is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Selection for a position will be made without regard to race, religion, national origin, sex, political affiliation, marital status, non\-disqualifying physical handicap, and age.

This role requires deep expertise in cloud\-based micro service architecture and technology. It also requires leadership skills: influencing team decisions, championing quality and mentoring Senior Engineers, many of whom work alongside newer team members. The Staff Engineer reports to a Software Engineering Manager on the Records platform. The manager leads people and delivery, and the Staff Engineer leads on technical depth and direction. **Duties and Responsibilities** * Serve as technical lead on key Records projects. Work with cross\-functional teams to gather requirements, shape solutions and guide implementation from design through production. * Design, build and maintain advanced features within the Records platform, such as eRecording and eSubmission, automated indexing, search, certified copy requests, property fraud alerts, and ID verification and payment integrations. * Provide technical direction for the broader modernization. That includes decoupling tightly coupled components, replacing manual configuration with configurable, self\-service setup, and removing dependencies on specific peripherals. * Design for configurability across jurisdictions, so the platform fits each county’s statutes, workflows and level of digital maturity without custom code. * Own the technical direction for Records search, including indexing strategy, relevance, query performance and scaling for large volumes of recorded documents. * Design data migration approaches that move customers and their historical records onto the modern platform with full data accuracy and record integrity. * Partner with Senior Engineers, product, architects and leadership to create, refine and document technical standards, including standards for search and related infrastructure. * Write and maintain architecture decision records so the reasons behind key choices outlast any one person. * Set the code review and quality bar for the team, including review standards and test strategies for AI\-generated code under Neumo’s agentic delivery model. * Help the team work well from approved specifications. Write precise specs, show how to direct AI agents effectively, and make sure engineers own what ships. * Conduct thorough code reviews, troubleshoot complex issues, and resolve hard performance, reliability and data quality problems. * Lead the technical response to serious production incidents, and make sure post\-incident follow\-up actually improves the platform. * Contribute to CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure\-as\-code, automated testing and observability to support reliable, repeatable releases. * Mentor Senior Engineers on design, code quality and development standards, and help them grow into technical leaders. * Reduce key\-person risk by documenting platform knowledge and spreading expertise through pairing, design reviews and walkthroughs. * Build on Neumo’s shared enterprise services, such as identity and access, payments, notifications, reporting and search, instead of rebuilding them within Records. Partner with Platform Engineering where Records needs something new. * Embed secure development practices, including vulnerability scanning, secrets management and access control, in line with the frameworks our government customers require. * Stay current with emerging technologies in search, cloud and AI\-assisted engineering. Run small, deliberate experiments and br ooks Like** *First 30 days.* You understand the Records monolith: its main domains, where they’re tightly coupled, and which customers and workflows depend on each. You’ve mapped how the platform talks to printers, scanners and other peripherals today, and where those dependencies are hard\-coded. You’ve walked through the current UI with staff and public users to see where the experience breaks down. You know where manual configuration slows down onboarding and support. You’ve built working relationships with your manager, product, architects and the engineers on the team, and you’ve seen the agentic delivery flow end to end. *By 60 days.* You’ve proposed a domain\-by\-domain modernization plan that ranks domains by customer value, risk and coupling, and names the first domain to pull out of the monolith. You’ve written architecture decision records for the key patterns: * **Service boundaries and APIs.** * **Data ownership.** When to use specific databases. * **A peripheral abstraction layer.** This lets the platform work with any standard printer or scanner rather than specific models. * **The modern React UI approach.** Including a shared component library and accessibility standards. You’ve also outlined the design for self\-service configuration, so customers and implementation teams can set up workflows, fees and document types without engineering help. Code review and testing standards, including for AI\-generated code, are documented and in use. *By 90 days.* The first domain is being extracted from the monolith and is close to production, with data migration and rollback plans in place. A working proof of concept shows the platform using standard printer and scanner protocols on at least two device types it couldn’t use before. The first modern UI screens are built on the shared component library and validated with real users. Senior Engineers are leading parts of this work with your guidance, and the full modernization has a clear technical path. *By the end of year one.* * **Domains.** Several domains run as independent services, with a published roadmap for the rest of the monolith. * **Peripherals.** The platform is peripheral\-agnostic in production. New customers can use their existing printers and scanners without custom work, and hardware\-related support tickets are going down. * **UI.** Key staff and public workflows run on the modern UI, with measurably better usability, accessibility and task completion times. * **Self\-service.** Customers can configure common settings themselves, which shortens onboarding and reduces requests to engineering. * **Upgrade and search.** The .NET upgrade is complete, and search performance and data migration quality have measurably improved. * **Team.** Senior Engineers are visibly stronger technical leaders, and modernization standards are being used as the model across Records. **Neumo Summary** With the backing of four decades of public sector expertise and corporate capability, Neumo has successfully supported government services. Neumo was honored and recognized for four (4\) consecutive years as a GovTech 100 Company representing the top 100 companies focused on making a difference in and selling to state and local government agencies across the United States. Neumo is committed to helping communities thrive and brings a wealth of experience combined with innovation. Today, Neumo offers more administrative and financial support to government officials than any other organization. And with a responsive, client\-focused approach, we foster partnerships that give our customers the certainty they need to accomplish more. Neumo offers a competitive benefits and compensation package and are looking for team members who will thrive in our dynamic environment. Neumo is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Selection for a position will be made without regard to race, religion, national origin, sex, political affiliation, marital status, non\-disqualifying physical handicap, and age.

jobs.title: Thermal Design Engineer II / Senior Thermal Design Engineer
jobs.description: **Company Overview** Nitricity is a startup addressing climate change, and we are looking for your help! We are innovating in an essential chemical industry that supports global food systems. The bedrock of modern agriculture is the production, distribution, and application of the essential nutrients found in fertilizers. However, nitrogen fertilizer is currently made in coal\- and gas\-fired facilities located hundreds to thousands of miles away from the farmers who need it. The $120B industry is responsible for as much as 6% of global CO2eq emissions. Nitricity Inc. has developed a new technology that produces fertilizer using air, water, and renewable electricity (e.g., solar). Growers will have access to a more reliable, low cost, and environmentally friendly fertilizer supply. We are actively growing our team to help us turn this vision into a reality. **Position Description** The Thermal Design Engineer, CFD will be part of Nitricity's core product engineering team developing megawatt\-scale chemical production facilities. Our process converts air into fixed nitrogen in a plasma, producing gas streams at thousands of degrees that must be cooled quickly enough to preserve the nitric oxide we create while recovering as much high\-grade heat as possible. Getting this right is central to the efficiency and cost of our product. In this role, you will be our lead for computational fluid dynamics of high\-temperature, chemically reacting air. You will build CFD models that couple fluid flow, heat transfer, and detailed chemical kinetics, and use them to guide the design of our reactors, quench systems, and heat recovery equipment. You will work closely with experts in chemical, mechanical, and electrical engineering and with our test team to validate models against pilot and laboratory data. This position reports to Nitricity's Chief Science Officer. **Responsibilities** * Build, run, and validate CFD models of high\-temperature air flows (up to several thousand K) exiting Nitricity's plasma reactors, including turbulent reacting flow, quench, and heat transfer. * Couple detailed and reduced chemical kinetic mechanisms for N2/O2/NOx chemistry to flow solvers to predict NO formation, NO decomposition during cooling, and overall fixation yield. * Use simulation results to drive the design of reactors, quench sections, and heat recovery equipment that capture high\-grade heat while preserving product. * Develop and reduce kinetic mechanisms as needed, and perform sensitivity and reaction pathway analysis to identify the steps that control yield and energy efficiency. * Partner with the experimental team to plan diagnostics and test campaigns (temperature, species, and pressure measurements) that validate and calibrate models. * Conduct conjugate heat transfer, thermal stress, and materials temperature assessments for components exposed to high\-temperature, oxidizing gas. * Translate CFD and kinetics results into design recommendations, technical specifications, and clear documentation for engineering and leadership. * Establish simulation best practices at Nitricity, including meshing standards, solver settings, verification and validation workflows, and model version control. * Work with outside engineering firms and software vendors, and help scale models from laboratory and pilot systems to megawatt\-scale commercial plants. **Required Qualifications** * BS in Mechanical, Chemical, or Aerospace Engineering or a related field with 2\+ years of relevant experience, or MS, with a focus on fluid mechanics, heat transfer, combustion, or reacting flows. * Hands\-on experience running reacting\-flow CFD simulations of high\-temperature gas flows using a commercial or open\-source package (ANSYS Fluent, STAR\-CCM\+, CONVERGE, OpenFOAM, or similar). * Strong grounding in turbulence modeling, turbulence\-chemistry interaction, radiation, and heat transfer. * Working knowledge of chemical kinetics and experience coupling finite\-rate chemistry to flow simulations, using tools such as Cantera, CHEMKIN, or equivalent. * Proficiency with 3D CAD (SolidWorks, Onshape, or similar), including parts, assemblies, and engineering drawings, and preparing geometry and meshes for simulation. * Working knowledge of GD\&T, materials selection, and design for manufacturing for components operating at high temperature. * Experience validating simulations against experimental data and communicating uncertainty clearly. * Scripting skills in Python or similar for pre/post\-processing, automation, and parametric studies. * Work well in focused teams with multiple disciplines and thrive in a fast\-moving start\-up environment. * Enthusiasm for high\-impact, hard tech solutions. **Preferred Qualifications** * Proficiency with ANSYS simulation tools (Fluent, CFX, Chemkin\-Pro, and/or Mechanical). * Experience with AI\-enabled modeling and simulation workflows, such as machine learning surrogate models, reduced\-order models, AI\-assisted design optimization, or automated parametric studies. * Experience with high\-temperature air chemistry, NOx formation and destruction (Zeldovich and related mechanisms), plasma\-assisted chemistry, or non\-equilibrium flows. * Experience with rapid quench, gas\-phase reactor design, or hypersonic and arc\-heated flows. * Experience with mechanism reduction, chemical reactor network modeling, or 0D/1D reactor models alongside full CFD. * Background designing heat exchangers or heat recovery equipment for industrial processes. * Familiarity with HPC environments and cloud\-based simulation workflows. **Compensation and Benefits\*** * Annual Base Salary $110,000/yr \- $150,000/yr * 3 weeks of paid vacation (accruing) * Medical and dental insurance * 401k plan with matching * Parental leave * Commuter benefits * *Benefits are subject to change over time and may require employment in CA to be eligible.* Nitricity Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, creed, gender, religion, marital status, registered domestic partner status, age, national origin, ancestry, physical or mental disability, medical condition, sex, genetic information, sexual orientation, military and veteran status or any other consideration made unlawful by federal, state, or local laws. It also prohibits unlawful discrimination based on the perception that anyone has any of those characteristics, or is associated with a person who has or is perceived as having any of those characteristics.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Entitlements & Spend Platform
jobs.description: **About Orb:** We're a team that cares deeply about the work, the people we do it with, and the customers we do it for. Everyone at Orb has real ownership over their work, direct access to customers, and a voice in how the company grows. We're building the revenue design platform that helps teams automate billing, evolve pricing, and grow revenue with confidence. Looking ahead, joining forces with Adyen expands what we can build and raises the ceiling on the problems we get to solve for customers. The challenges are uniquely interesting, and you'll be surrounded by thoughtful, ambitious people who move fast and hold a high bar. For San Francisco Bay Area, New York, and Amsterdam residents, we've built a hybrid work culture where we are in office 3 days/week. Our values, *customer centricity, minutes matter, run with it, attention to detail, and go further together* are at the core of everything we do. **About the role:** Every usage\-based business eventually asks the same three questions in real time: what has this customer consumed, what are they entitled to, and what should happen next? This team owns the runtime layer where billing state becomes something customers can act on — alerting, spend controls, entitlement checks, and usage analytics. This is a foundational role. Enterprise and AI customers increasingly treat entitlements, spend controls, and real\-time analytics as a single problem rather than three separate features, which makes this one of the highest\-leverage areas of Orb's roadmap. You'll help set the direction, the primitives, and the interfaces other teams build against. The work sits squarely at the intersection of infrastructure and product. On one side, it's real systems engineering: alerts, balances, and entitlement checks computed against actual tiers, credits, and commits, fast and reliably enough to stand behind latency guarantees. On the other, it's a customer\-facing product surface where API design, clarity, and getting the primitives right matter as much as the systems underneath. You'll spend as much time understanding what customers are trying to do as you will building the thing that does it. You'll build the system customers rely on to know, in real time, what's been consumed, what's allowed, and what should happen next — the reactive side that alerts the moment a limit is crossed, and the proactive side that serves live balance and entitlement state on demand. Because it runs against Orb's real pricing, credits, and commits, customers can put it directly in the critical path of their own spend and access decisions — the layer they reach for as they scale. **In this role, you will:** * Own a product surface end to end — from customer conversations and product design through API design, implementation, and rollout * Design and ship alerting and analytics that are granular, flexible, and fast enough to carry contractual latency SLAs * Build the entitlement and spend\-control primitives (credit balances, allocations, usage\-percentage alerts, rate limits) that enforce against Orb's real billing state in real time * Shape the roadmap, primitives, and interfaces other teams build against — foundational decisions that are still open * Collaborate across PM, design, sales, and customer success, and work directly with enterprise and AI customers to turn their pain points into what we build **About you:** * 8\+ years of software engineering experience, with a track record of owning products or systems end to end * Energized by ambiguity and ownership — you want a say in what gets built, not just how * Strong product instincts and genuine customer empathy; you like being close to customers and to the business impact of your work (this is revenue\-adjacent, and people trust these numbers) * Comfortable designing APIs and data models that other teams and customers depend on * Enough systems depth to reason clearly about real\-time and low\-latency tradeoffs — this team leans product, but the engineering is real * Attention to detail across API design, product UX, and everything in between **Orb's Tech Stack:** At Orb, we believe great engineers can learn any stack, so you do not need experience with these specific tools and we encourage you to apply regardless. * **Frontend:** Typescript \+ React \+ Tailwind CSS * **Backend:** Python * **Datastores:** PostgreSQL \+ Clickhouse * **Streaming Platforms:** Kafka \+ Spark Streaming * **Cloud Platform:** AWS **Why Adyen x Orb?** This is an exceptional opportunity to join a solid, established company with a startup mindset, characterized by small teams, direct communication, and work on important challenges. You'll have direct access to massive global datasets (e.g., payments, identity data) and the ability to see your team's work have an immediate impact at scale. While this is a San Francisco\-based role, we recognize that global mobility matters—especially for candidates navigating complex situations. Adyen has deep roots in Europe and a strong global presence, and we're open to future relocation conversations to our offices if better supports your personal or professional goals in the future. Our aim is to build a lasting foundation for you at Adyen x Orb—starting in San Francisco, but with the flexibility to adapt as life evolves. *The annual base salary range for this role is $212,800 \- $293,000 plus RSUs; to learn more about our compensation philosophy, please click* *here**. This position is based out of the San Francisco office.*

The Senior Maintenance Engineer may be asked to perform tasks as required by management, deemed as a reasonable request. This job description is a summary of the typical functions of the role, not an exhaustive or comprehensive list of possible role responsibilities, tasks, and duties, and is subject to review. In the event the operation is undergoing its initial startup, the daily responsibilities for this role may be different while supporting the needs of a facility in its initial stages of starting its operations. Once the facility is commissioned, the roles defined in this job description will become the daily responsibilities for the Senior Maintenance Engineer. **About You** To qualify for this position, you must meet the following requirements: * An Associate's or Vocational degree in an electrical or mechanical related discipline or advanced training with a minimum of five years experience. * A minimum of five years of direct experience in the mechanical or electrical field. * Strong electrical experience preferable within a FMCG environment. * Knowledge / experience working with controls, analyzing faults and providing solutions. * Experience with both reactive and preventative maintenance. * Strong organization and communication skills, and the ability to work in a multi\-disciplined team of varying levels of technical experience. * This role involves working at height using a variety of access equipment, so you need to be comfortable working at heights. * Good technical ability relating to automation hardware and software. * Sound analytical skills with an eye for detail; good problem\-solving ability and a practical approach. * Experience working with computerized maintenance management systems. * Numerate and PC literate, including G\-Suite and MS Office programs. *This role will require flexibility due to us being a 24/7 operation and a shift pattern will be put in place that will require working nights, and weekends.* **What do I get in Return** 401k Plan; 100% match up to 5% of earnings; Paid Vacation and Sick Days; 10 Paid Public Holidays; Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance; Medical and Dependent Care; Flexible Spending Accounts Health Reimbursement Account; Company Contribution of 50% of Annual Deductible; Company Paid Life Insurance; Short and Long Term Disability Insurance; Employee Assistance Program *Ocado is an equal opportunity employer. jobs.title: Systems & Network Engineer
jobs.description: OnTrac is hiring a Systems \& Network Engineer! Are you eager to join a dynamic and expanding company where you can both learn and make a meaningful impact? If you possess a strong sense of empathy, enjoy assisting others, thrive in a fast\-paced environment, and excel at problem\-solving, we encourage you to apply today to connect with a recruiter! Founded in 1986, OnTrac has evolved into the leading provider of same\-day and next\-day delivery services in the U.S. for premier e\-commerce and product\-supply businesses, including five of the largest retailers in the U.S. **Location:** Combination of REMOTE and ON\-SITE work supporting corporate offices, branches sort centers and a remote/hybrid workforce at locations across the US requiring up to 50% travel. Must be located within an hour of a major airport such as: Philadelphia, PA; Washington, DC, Atlanta, GA; Nashville, TN; Columbus, OH; Chicago, IL; etc. **Compensation:** The expected starting base pay range for this position is $125,600 \- $157,000, with full potential base salary range over a successful candidate’s tenure in the position of $125,600 \- $188,400\. Actual compensation will be determined based on experience, skills, internal equity, and other job\-related factors. This position may also be eligible for bonus, commission, or other incentive compensation in accordance with the terms of the applicable plan of up to a 15% Bonus Target. **Employment Logistics:** The Systems \& Network Engineer is responsible for designing, implementing, and maintaining the organization’s IT infrastructure, including servers, networks, and related systems. This position also ensures high availability, security, and performance of critical systems while supporting strategic technology initiatives and providing advanced technical expertise. **Unpacking the Benefits:** Employees are eligible for a comprehensive benefits package which may include: * Medical, dental, and vision insurance * Life and short\- and long\-term disability coverage * 401(k) retirement savings plan with company match * Flex vacation in states other than CA, CO, IL, MA, MT, and NE, with accruals up to 96 hours for first year of employment with tenure\-based increases up to 160 hours * Two (2\) floating holidays per year * Paid sick leave\* * Six (6\) paid company holidays * Two (2\) weeks paid pregnancy disability leave, four (4\) weeks paid parental bonding leave * Additional wellness and employee assistance programs Benefits eligibility and offerings are subject to the terms and conditions of the applicable plans and company policies. **The Must\-Haves:** * Bachelor’s degree or equivalent and 8 years of relevant experience in installing, configuring, maintaining, and troubleshooting servers, networks, and related systems in a corporate enterprise environment. * Extensive understanding of industry principles and terminology. * Knowledge of standard office software and technologies. * Strong written and verbal communication skills. * Ability to maintain professionalism at all times. * Ability to work collaboratively in a team environment. * Ability to work in a fast\-paced environment, prioritize tasks, and maintain accuracy. * Demonstrated hands on experience with Fortinet Analyzer and Manager, GCP, AWS, Azure, Fortigate, Meraki switching and wifi. **Your Mission in Motion:** A summary of key responsibilities for the role is outlined below. Additional duties may be assigned as needed to support business objectives. Extensive travel (up to 50%) to company sites. * Network infrastructure management: Design, configure, and maintain network infrastructure, including routers, switches, firewalls, and VPNs. * Systems, storage \& virtualization: Administer and optimize servers, storage systems, and virtualization platforms to support reliable and efficient operations. * Performance monitoring \& issue resolution: Monitor system and network performance, proactively identifying and resolving issues. * Infrastructure security \& compliance: Implement and maintain measures that protect systems and data while ensuring compliance with regulatory requirements and company IT standards. * Technology projects \& migrations: Collaborate with IT teams on infrastructure projects, upgrades, and migrations. * Documentation \& advanced technical support: Maintain documentation for network architecture, system configurations, and processes while providing advanced technical support and guidance to IT staff and end users. * It is the responsibility of every position to understand and adhere to the security guidelines outlined in OnTrac’s Acceptable Use policy and to conduct their activities accordingly. **Paving your way to your success:** * You collaborate effectively within a team environment to support infrastructure operations and technology initiatives. * You thrive in a fast\-paced environment, procedures for new assignments, using sound judgment to select, adapt, and evaluate advanced techniques. * You deliver innovative solutions to challenging issues, applying established principles while helping guide the development of new policies and ideas. **Disclosures:** * \*Washington state employees are eligible for up to 56 hours of paid sick leave annually. * The salary range above represents the national range for this position. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or age. Join us in our commitment to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace. If you are excited to be part of our team and contribute to our talent acquisition efforts, we invite you to apply.

jobs.title: Lead Engineer, AI Platform
jobs.description: OneMagnify is an AI native, platform\-enabled B2B digital agency operating at the intersection of data, technology, and creativity. We help complex organizations drive measurable business outcomes by building smarter customer experiences and delivering highly integrated solutions across digital, media, and technology. By combining deep industry expertise with advanced analytics and artificial intelligence, we enable our clients to make better decisions, move faster, and compete more effectively in dynamic markets. **Role Summary** As Lead Engineer, AI Platform, you will own the architecture and evolution of the enterprise AI platform that powers AI agents across OneMagnify products and client solutions. This role sits at the center of engineering, product, data, and AI delivery, translating emerging AI capabilities into reliable, production\-ready systems. You'll guide both technical direction and execution, helping teams deploy AI workflows that are secure, measurable, and trusted at scale. Your work will shape how OneMagnify builds, governs, and operates AI across the organization. **The Impact You'll Have** AI agents are becoming a core part of how businesses automate work, deliver customer experiences, and make decisions. You'll create the platform foundation that enables product and engineering teams to move AI solutions from experimentation into reliable, enterprise\-grade production environments. Your work will directly support client\-facing applications, AI\-powered workflows, and digital platforms where reliability, safety, and performance matter. From connecting agents to enterprise knowledge to establishing evaluation frameworks and governance controls, you'll help ensure AI solutions deliver measurable business outcomes while operating within clear guardrails. This role also plays a critical part in OneMagnify's integrated delivery model. You'll collaborate with product, engineering, data, security, and delivery teams to create shared capabilities that accelerate innovation while maintaining the scalability, governance, and operational discipline expected of enterprise software platforms. **What You'll Do** **Shape the AI Platform Strategy** * Own the architecture for agent orchestration, multi\-agent workflows, tool integrations, and human approval processes across the enterprise AI platform. * Evaluate models, frameworks, platforms, and vendors, making decisions that balance scalability, reliability, quality, and cost. * Partner with product and engineering leaders to ensure the platform supports current and future AI use cases. **Build Enterprise Knowledge \& Context Systems** * Design and implement retrieval pipelines and vector\-based knowledge systems that connect AI agents to enterprise data and content. * Determine when prompting, retrieval\-augmented generation, or model customization delivers the best business outcome. * Enable product teams to build AI experiences grounded in accurate, relevant enterprise knowledge. **Establish AI Quality, Safety \& Governance** * Create the frameworks used to evaluate AI performance, including offline and online evaluations, regression testing, red teaming, and release quality gates. * Design safeguards such as least\-privilege access, sandboxing, audit trails, approval workflows, and usage controls. * Define measurable standards that allow teams to confidently deploy AI solutions into production environments. **Operate a Scalable Enterprise Platform** * Lead the operation of a multi\-region cloud platform with accountability for availability, performance, disaster recovery, security, and cost management. * Build observability capabilities including metrics, tracing, telemetry, alerting, and service\-level objectives. * Lead incident response practices, on\-call operations, escalation processes, and continuous improvement through post\-incident reviews. **Lead Engineering Excellence** * Mentor and develop engineers on the AI Platform team while establishing engineering standards and best practices. * Collaborate with engineering, product, and delivery teams to accelerate platform adoption and successful implementation. * Serve as a trusted technical leader for complex architectural decisions and cross\-functional trade\-offs. **What You'll Need** * Experience in integrated marketing, digital agency, marketing services, or consulting environments. * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience. * 10\+ years of software engineering experience, including 3\+ years as a technical lead, architect, or similar leadership role supporting production systems. * Experience building and operating 24x7, multi\-region enterprise SaaS platforms on AWS, Google Cloud, or Azure, including infrastructure as code and disaster recovery planning. * Strong production operations expertise, including observability, metrics, logging, distributed tracing, alerting, service\-level objectives, incident response, and postmortem practices. * Experience designing and operating production AI and LLM\-based systems, including agent orchestration, multi\-agent architectures, tool integrations, context engineering, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) implementations. * Expertise with AI platforms such as Amazon Bedrock, Google Vertex AI, Azure AI Foundry, or similar enterprise AI ecosystems. * Experience building retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG) solutions and working with vector databases and knowledge retrieval systems. * Deep understanding of AI evaluation, testing, governance, and safety practices, including evaluation datasets, LLM\-as\-judge frameworks, regression testing, and agent containment strategies. * Hands\-on experience incorporating AI\-assisted development workflows into CI/CD pipelines, including validation, review, and approval processes. * Experience integrating enterprise data platforms and designing secure multi\-tenant SaaS environments with identity management, role\-based access controls, and tenant isolation. * Fluency in Python, TypeScript, SQL, and Git\-based CI/CD practices. * Proven ability to influence technical direction and collaborate effectively across engineering, product, security, and delivery teams. **Future\-Ready Skills (Nice to Have)** * Experience building self\-service or low\-code platforms that enable governed AI agent creation and deployment. * Familiarity with managed agent runtimes and agent frameworks from major cloud providers. * Knowledge of security, governance, and AI risk frameworks such as SOC 2, ISO 27001, NIST AI RMF, or ISO/IEC 42001\. * Experience working within agency, consulting, client delivery, or automotive\-focused environments. * Working knowledge of fine\-tuning approaches, including supervised fine\-tuning, LoRA/PEFT, and preference tuning. * Experience with additional backend languages such as Java, Go, or C\#. * Experience using AI\-enabled engineering workflows, automation, and platform engineering practices to improve development velocity and quality. **Benefits** We believe great work happens when people have the support and flexibility they need to thrive. Our benefits include medical, dental, and vision coverage, a 401(k) retirement plan, paid holidays, and Flexible Time Off (FTO) so you can take time away to recharge when you need it. We also offer additional programs focused on wellness, financial security, and professional growth. **We are an equal opportunity employer** We believe that innovative ideas and solutions start with unique perspectives. That's why we're committed to providing every employee a workplace that's free of discrimination and intolerance. We're proud to be an equal opportunity employer and actively search for like\-minded people to join our team. We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform job functions, and to receive benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

We help complex organizations drive measurable business outcomes by building smarter customer experiences and delivering highly integrated solutions across digital, media, and technology. Working alongside our AI Platform team, you'll create the systems that enable AI agents to operate reliably, securely, and at scale in real\-world business environments. retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG), embeddings, vector databases or vector search, and GraphQL or REST APIs. * Experience building automated evaluation frameworks, testing LLM outputs, and
