jobs.title: Sr. Full Stack Software Engineer – AI Agents
jobs.description: OVERVIEW We are seeking a senior full stack software engineer to join our contractor program supporting a customer engagement that builds applications around multi\-agent systems developed with Google's Agent Development Kit (ADK) on Google Cloud Platform. This role is ideal for an engineer who can build the whole application: the agents, the backend services and APIs behind them, and the web interface that users work in. The candidate should have built agents with ADK, deployed them to production on GCP, and operated them afterward, including the evaluation and feedback loops that keep agent behavior reliable over time. The successful candidate will use AI coding tools, with several agents running at once, as a standard part of daily engineering practice. This engineer will work closely with our technical lead, other engineers, and customer stakeholders to ensure project success from initial definition through final delivery. REQUIRED CREDENTIALS * Professional full stack software engineering experience, including production delivery on Google Cloud Platform * Hands\-on experience building and deploying AI agents with Google's Agent Development Kit (ADK) * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS * ADK agent development, including agent definitions, tool design, and session and state management * Design and implementation of multi\-agent systems, including delegation between agents, sequential, parallel, and loop workflows, and clear boundaries for each agent's context and responsibility * Feedback loops for agent quality: evaluation sets, automated scoring of agent output, tracing, and using the results to revise prompts, tools, and agent structure * Frontend development with TypeScript and a modern component framework, including integrating a UI with agent and REST APIs, streaming responses, and authenticated sessions * Backend service and API development, including relational database design (for example PostgreSQL) with versioned schema migrations * Authentication and authorization for web applications and agent tool calls, using OAuth 2\.0 / OIDC and JWT * Deployment and operation of agents and application services on GCP using Cloud Run and Agent Engine * Gemini models on Vertex AI, including prompt design, function calling, and structured output * Tool integration for agents over MCP and REST APIs * Daily use of Claude and other AI coding assistants for design, implementation, testing, and review, including running multiple agents concurrently, with the judgment to verify and correct generated output * Automated testing and CI/CD across the stack, including frontend and end\-to\-end tests and regression evaluation of agent behavior USEFUL QUALIFICATIONS * Agent\-to\-Agent (A2A) protocol * Retrieval and grounding with Vertex AI Search or vector search * Observability for agents and services with Cloud Trace, Cloud Logging, and OpenTelemetry * Pub/Sub, Memorystore, and BigQuery * Integration of agents with Gemini Enterprise * Google Cloud Professional certifications SCOPE OF WORK * Design the multi\-agent architecture for the solution, including agent roles, delegation, tool boundaries, and state handling * Implement agents and tools with ADK, including integrations with customer and third\-party systems over REST and MCP * Build the web frontend and the backend services that expose the agents to users, including the user workflows and the APIs they run against * Deploy agents and application services to GCP on Cloud Run and Agent Engine, with CI/CD and managed environments and releases * Build and maintain evaluation suites and feedback loops that measure agent output, surface regressions, and drive changes to prompts, tools, and agent structure * Instrument agents and services with tracing and logging so that behavior in production can be inspected and debugged * Use Claude and multi\-agent workflows to accelerate design, implementation, test generation, and code review across the full stack, with the engineer remaining accountable for the correctness of all delivered code * Deliver unit, integration, end\-to\-end, and agent evaluation test coverage, participate in code reviews, and document the architecture and operating procedures for our team and the customer's

jobs.title: Site Reliability Engineer
jobs.description: **Site Reliability Engineer****The Opportunity** We are looking for a highly capable engineer to join our Platform and Site Reliability engineering team. You will be responsible for building, maintaining and operating the infrastructure platform on which all Ookla services are built. In this role, you will build, maintain, and support a massive\-scale dynamic infrastructure that is relied on by hundreds of millions of users around the world. You will obsess over systems performance, scalability, reliability, observability, and security. Most importantly, you will help deliver critical application functionality and help make the internet experience better for our users to help us achieve our goal of better connectivity for all. We are committed to providing you a flexible work environment where individuality, fun, and talent are all valued equally. If you consider yourself innovative, adept at collaboration, and you care deeply about the work you do, we want to talk! **Key Responsibilities*** Maintaining a distributed, global ecosystem of thousands of cloud instances, containerized workflows, serverless applications, Linux servers, and associated infrastructure supporting billions of requests daily. * Maintaining transactional database infrastructure using MySQL, PostgreSQL, and managed services such as RDS/Aurora. * Supporting the use of NoSQL data storage engines such as DynamoDb and MongoDB. * Building and supporting data stream processing with Kinesis or Kafka. * Supporting data engineering and big data toolchains such as Spark. * Supporting production systems in a 24x7x365 environment, including on\-call responsibilities. * Providing architectural and operational support to software engineers in a wide variety of focus areas. * Support software and data engineering teams and guiding operational best practices. * Implementation and oversight of security programs including vulnerability remediation, patch management, IDS/IPS, penetration testing, and interfacing with our corporate InfoSec team. * Supporting the development to production code deploy pipeline for a range of production applications. * Providing the tooling and guidance for the software and data engineering team to implement our monitoring and observability best practices. * Assisting development teams with troubleshooting. **Job Qualifications** We are looking for the right person, not the exact list of requirements. If you believe your life experience has prepared you for similar challenges, we’d like to hear from you.* 4\+ Years Systems/Platform engineering experience * Experience building globally\-distributed systems * Strong understanding of security best practices * Infrastructure as Code: Terraform, Cloudformation * Branching and Merge based Source Code Configuration Management: Git, Github * Configuration management systems such as Chef or Ansible * Container\-based architectures including Docker, Kubernetes * Proficiency in one or more high level programming languages such as Typescript, Go, Python, PHP, Ruby, Java, etc. * Experience with AWS and other Cloud infrastructure platforms * Comfort writing SQL queries and analyzing query performance * Comfortable learning and working with new technologies in an ever\-changing environment * Strong verbal and written communication skills * Strong time management skills and a self\-driven work ethic **About** Ookla, an Accenture company, is a global leader in connectivity intelligence that brings together the trusted expertise of Speedtest®, Downdetector®, Ekahau®, and RootMetrics® to deliver unmatched network and connectivity insights. By combining multi\-source data with industry\-leading expertise, we transform network performance metrics into strategic, actionable insights. Our solutions empower service providers, enterprises, and governments with the critical data and insights needed to optimize networks, enhance digital experiences, and help close the digital divide. At the same time, we amplify the real\-world experiences of individuals and businesses that rely on connectivity to work, learn, and communicate. From measuring and analyzing connectivity to driving industry innovation, Ookla helps the world stay connected. **About Accenture** Accenture helps the world’s leading enterprises reinvent by building their digital core and unleashing the power of AI to create value at speed for organizations across industries. Our strategy is to be the reinvention partner of choice for our clients and lead in the safe, widespread adoption of AI, and to be the most client focused, AI\-enabled, great place to work in the world. We bring together the talent of our approximately 799,000 people with proprietary assets and platforms, deep process and industry expertise, and leading ecosystem relationships to deliver end\-to\-end solutions and measurable outcomes at scale. Through our Reinvention Services, we offer broad expertise across Cybersecurity, Digital Core, Finance, Industry and Enterprise, Song, Supply Chain and Engineering, and Talent, with advanced capabilities in AI and Data, Industry and Process, and Technology. We serve approximately 9,000 clients and generated approximately $70 billion in FY25 revenue. Visit us at accenture.com. **Compensation Range** Ookla provides a range for the base pay. Factors that may be used to determine your actual pay may include your specific job related knowledge, skills, experience, and geographic location. The salary compensation for this role is $90,000 \- $100,000\. Individual pay within the compensation range for this business unit specific role is determined based on a variety of factors including experience, scope of the role, capabilities to perform the role, education and training, as well as business and company performance. We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

jobs.title: Transformation Leads Regional Manager
jobs.description: Go To Market \- San Francisco and New York City **About the team** ------------------ OpenAI’s Transformation Leads help customers rethink what their business could do with AI. We work with executives and Heads of AI to build business reinvention roadmaps. For this, we provide Leadership Advisory and Collaborative Design support, with the objective to secure and accelerate new business models, including process redesign and culture change. **About the role** ------------------ You’ll manage our Transformation Leads in America West and personally advise senior customers at our Executive Briefing Center in San Francisco. You’ll help a leadership team work through a business or cultural question and leave with a decision they can act on. When the question calls for deeper work, you’ll design and own the workshop that follows. You’ll be based in San Francisco and meet customers across the US West region. **In this role, you will** -------------------------- * Lead executive workshops where leaders try AI on their own work, as they might with an AI chief of staff. In change workshops, bring the people who do the work together to redesign a process, question an incentive, or test a new offering. Agree on who will try it and how they’ll judge the result. * Represent OpenAI on stages in front of large audiences and in smaller leadership meetings. Develop original ideas from customer work and bring them to life in talks and internal and external media contributions such as blog articles and podcasts. * Bring Product a concrete example of how a customer’s needs are changing. Work with the account team on the customer plan, while our Applied AI Architects and Forward\-Deployed Engineers lead the technical work and our Deployment Leads ensure the rollout. * Build and manage the West team while carrying your own customer engagements. Assign priorities, support them with your presence and guidance and coach them to excel in their role. * Work with regional peers and partners to share approaches that led to customers’ success. jobs.title: Senior Engineering Manager, AI Platform
jobs.description: **About OpenLoop** ------------------ OpenLoop was co\-founded by CEO, Dr. Jon Lensing, and COO, Christian Williams, with the vision to bring care anywhere. Our telehealth support solutions are thoughtfully designed to streamline and simplify go\-to\-market care delivery for companies offering meaningful virtual support to patients across an expansive array of specialties, in all 50 states. OpenLoop is building the future of healthcare infrastructure. We're hiring a Senior Engineering Manager to build and lead our Applied AI team, the engineers who ship the LLM\-based agents and assistants our operations, clinical and patient\-facing teams use every day. This is a leadership role with real technical depth. You'll hire and grow a team of Senior, Staff and Senior Staff Applied AI Engineers, own delivery of production AI systems, and set the standards for how we build, evaluate and safely run AI on patient data. You don't need to write production code daily, but you need to be credible in architecture and eval reviews and know what good looks like. **What You'll Do** * **Build \& Lead the Team:** Hire, onboard and develop a team of Applied AI Engineers across Senior, Staff and Senior Staff levels, and grow it from a single pod into multiple teams as the work expands. * **Own Delivery of Production Agents:** Drive the roadmap and execution of LLM\-based agents and assistants that real users rely on, from scoping to launch to ongoing operation. * **Set the Technical Bar:** Partner with Staff\+ engineers on architecture for agent runtime and orchestration, retrieval, model access and observability. Make the call on trade\-offs when the team needs one. * **Evaluation as a Standard:** Make evaluation sets, regression tests and AI\-graded evals a required part of how the team ships, so we can show improvement with numbers and catch regressions before users do. * **Reliability, Cost \& Operations:** Own the operational health of AI systems in production, including on\-call, incident response, provider fallbacks, model version upgrades and AI spend by agent and use case. * **Security, Privacy \& Safety:** Make sure every AI system protects patient data (PHI), follows least\-privilege access, and defends against misuse such as prompt injection. Partner with Security and Compliance on HIPAA requirements. * **Workflow \& Use Case Prioritization:** Work with Product and Operations leaders to find where agents can reliably take over human workflows, where they should hand off to a person, and which bets to make first. * **Cross\-functional Leadership:** Explain AI capabilities, risks and timelines in plain language to product, operations, clinical and executive stakeholders, including when the honest answer is "the AI isn't ready for this yet." * **Team Health \& Process:** Run planning, prioritization and delivery rituals that keep a senior team shipping fast without burning out. Give clear, direct feedback and build career paths. * Other duties as assigned. **Who You Are** --------------- ### **Required Qualifications** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field * **Proven Engineering Experience:** 10\+ years of software engineering experience, including 3\+ years managing engineers directly (hiring, performance management, career development). * **Production LLM Experience:** Led or built LLM\-based systems in production that real users relied on, not only demos, prototypes or personal projects. * **Senior Team Leadership:** Experience managing senior and Staff\-level engineers and earning their technical trust. * **Technical Depth:** Enough hands\-on understanding of agent runtime, evaluation, retrieval and observability to review designs, challenge assumptions and make sound architecture calls. * **Evaluation Rigor:** You hold teams to measuring whether AI systems work with evaluation data, rather than "it seemed to work." * **Engineering Fundamentals:** Strong grounding in production engineering across testing, services, APIs, deployment, incident management and on\-call. * **Data \& Security Fluency:** Experience leading teams that handle sensitive data with a security\-first mindset. * Comfort building in a greenfield space, and clear communication with technical and non\-technical partners ### **Preferred Qualifications** * **Regulated\-Industry Experience:** Healthcare (PHI, HIPAA), finance or insurance. * **GCP Experience:** Leading teams that run production services on Google Cloud. * **Scaling Teams:** Grew an engineering team from zero, or from one team to several. * **Model Operations:** Led migrations between model versions or providers. * **Classic ML Background:** Machine learning experience beyond LLMs. * **Internal Platforms:** Led a platform used by other engineering teams. **Our Benefits** In addition to a competitive base pay, for salaried positions you would also be eligible for: * Medical, Dental, and Vision plans * Flexible Spending/Health Savings Accounts * Flexible PTO * 401(k) \+ Company Match * Life Insurance, Pet insurance, and more **Our Company** --------------- We have a relatively flat organizational structure here at OpenLoop. Everyone is encouraged to bring ideas to the table and make things happen. This fits in well with our core values of Autonomy, Competence and Belonging, as we want everyone to feel empowered and supported to do their best work. Sound like a good fit? We’d love to meet you.

This role is responsible for resolving escalated technical issues, maintaining client IT environments, implementing solutions, and ensuring reliable, secure IT operations. The ideal candidate has solid technical fundamentals, strong troubleshooting skills, and the ability to work independently while knowing when to escalate more complex issues. Equally important is a professional, customer\-focused approach and the ability to communicate technical information clearly to non\-technical users. Key ResponsibilitiesTechnical Support \& Troubleshooting * Resolve Level 2 escalations from the service desk, including complex desktop, laptop, application, connectivity, and user\-access issues. * Troubleshoot Windows operating systems, Microsoft 365 applications, printing, networking, and endpoint performance problems. * Diagnose and resolve Active Directory, Microsoft Entra ID, authentication, permissions, and Group Policy issues. * Troubleshoot VPN connectivity, Wi\-Fi, DNS, DHCP, and basic LAN/WAN connectivity issues. * Support user onboarding, offboarding, workstation deployments, migrations, and hardware replacements. * Document troubleshooting steps, resolutions, and follow\-up recommendations in the ticketing system. * Recognize recurring issues and recommend permanent solutions rather than relying on workarounds. Systems Administration \& Infrastructure * Administer and support Microsoft 365, including Exchange Online, Teams, SharePoint, OneDrive, and user licensing. * Support Windows Server environments, Active Directory, Group Policy, file and print services, and permissions. * Assist with server maintenance, patching, monitoring, and routine infrastructure administration. * Support endpoint management, software deployment, patch management, and antivirus/EDR platforms. * Monitor backup systems, review job failures, troubleshoot issues, and assist with restore testing. * Support firewalls, switches, wireless access points, VPNs, and other common SMB network infrastructure. * Assist with IT projects, technology refreshes, cloud migrations, and infrastructure upgrades. Security \& Best Practices * Support MFA, conditional access, endpoint protection, and other standard security controls. * Assist with security incident triage, suspicious email investigations, and endpoint remediation. * Identify outdated systems, configuration weaknesses, and potential security risks. * Follow established security policies, change management procedures, and documentation standards. Client Service \& Teamwork * Provide professional, responsive, and friendly support to end users and client contacts. * Communicate technical issues, timelines, and resolutions clearly and proactively. * Take ownership of assigned tickets and follow through until resolution or appropriate escalation. * Maintain accurate documentation of client environments, configurations, and procedures. * Work collaboratively with other engineers and service desk staff. * Participate in scheduled client\-site visits and occasional after\-hours maintenance when required. Required Qualifications \& Technical Skills * 3\+ years of professional IT support experience, ideally within an MSP or multi\-client IT environment. * Strong working knowledge of Windows 10/11 and Microsoft 365 administration. * Practical experience with Active Directory, Microsoft Entra ID, Group Policy, DNS, and DHCP. * Experience troubleshooting networking fundamentals, including TCP/IP, VPNs, Wi\-Fi, and switching. * Familiarity with Windows Server administration and common small\-to\-mid\-sized business infrastructure. * Experience with remote monitoring and management (RMM), professional services automation (PSA), ticketing, and remote support tools. * Working knowledge of endpoint security, MFA, patching, and backup solutions. * Strong analytical troubleshooting skills and the ability to work independently on escalated issues. * Excellent written and verbal communication skills. * A customer\-first mindset, strong organizational skills, and attention to detail. * Valid driver's license and reliable transportation for client\-site visits. Preferred Qualifications * Previous experience working for a small or mid\-sized MSP. * Experience with Microsoft 365 administration and cloud identity management. * Familiarity with virtualization platforms such as VMware or Hyper\-V. * Exposure to Microsoft Intune and endpoint management. * Experience with business\-class firewalls, managed switches, and wireless infrastructure. * Familiarity with backup and disaster recovery platforms. * Microsoft, CompTIA, or networking certifications such as MS\-900, AZ\-900, Network\+, Security\+, or equivalent practical experience. What Success Looks Like * Independently resolves the majority of assigned Level 2 technical issues. * Reduces unnecessary escalations by using sound troubleshooting and research skills. * Maintains clear, accurate, and useful ticket documentation. * Provides a consistently positive experience for clients. * Follows established processes while identifying opportunities to improve them. * Helps maintain stable, secure, and well\-documented client environments. * Demonstrates initiative, accountability, and a willingness to learn. What We Offer * A collaborative, close\-knit team with direct access to experienced engineers and leadership. * Exposure to a broad range of technologies and client environments. * Opportunities to develop technical skills and take ownership of projects. * A client\-focused environment where quality of service matters more than ticket volume alone. * Competitive compensation based on experience and technical ability. * Benefits and professional development opportunities, as applicable. Who Will Thrive in This Role? We are looking for someone who enjoys solving problems, takes pride in doing things the right way, and understands that excellent IT support requires both technical ability and strong client relationships. You should be comfortable working independently, managing competing priorities, and supporting a variety of business environments. You do not need to know everything, but you should have a strong technical foundation, a methodical troubleshooting approach, and the judgment to recognize when an issue requires additional expertise. If you are a dependable, technically capable IT professional looking to grow, we would like to hear from you. Pay: $55,000\.00 \- $65,000\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) * Dental insurance * Health insurance * Paid time off * Vision insurance Work Location: Hybrid remote in Tampa, FL 33611

Our mission is to increase the efficiency of the global supply chain by automating the manual workflows that slow supply chain teams down. Our flagship platform provides end\-to\-end visibility, and control. As companies across the physical economy look to drive efficiency, many are turning to Pallet to lead the way. With deep supply chain expertise and cutting\-edge AI capabilities, we're positioned to build the next $10B company powering the physical economy. Then you'll design integrations, debug production systems, and ship AI\-powered workflows into environments that are often undocumented, fragmented, and business\-critical. You'll own deployments from initial discovery through production launch, spending time with customers both remotely and onsite, solving complex operational problems and turning those solutions into reusable product capabilities. deployments from problem definition through production, designing, prototyping, building, and deploying AI agents and workflows that change how work gets done and run reliably at scale. * Embed in customer workflows and build relationships from ICs and operators up to executives, turning messy business requirements into clear technical solutions that solve the underlying problem, not just the first request. * Make design decisions across agent behavior, application logic, data, evals, security, and reliability, and set the patterns for how Pallet agents are deployed in production. * Connect Pallet agents to the systems, APIs, and data customers already rely on, working directly with their engineering and ops teams to get around technical constraints. * Stay accountable after launch by debugging failures, evaluating and improving agent quality, and working with Engineering and Product to clear anything blocking a successful deployment. * Turn what you learn in the field into reusable agents, integrations, evals, and frameworks, and bring recurring needs and product gaps back to Product and Engineering to shape the core platform. **Who You Are** * 1\+ years of experience building and owning production systems in high\-growth startups or similarly demanding environments. * Strong experience working with APIs, integrations, authentication systems, and event\-driven architectures. * Proven ability to debug complex systems in production. * Comfortable operating in ambiguous environments where documentation is incomplete, and requirements evolve Most of our team works in office five days a week. For select roles, we hire remotely across the U.S. Remote employees come to one of our offices for their first week to onboard and meet the team, and we cover the full trip. Every role is different. Travel expectations are always shared upfront in the job description and confirmed in your first call with us. **Equal Opportunity** Pallet is an Equal Opportunity Employer. jobs.title: Platform Engineer
jobs.description: Paperless Parts is the SaaS\-based intelligence layer for modern manufacturing, enabling our customers to innovate faster in the physical world. You'll be an active member of the team taking our SaaS platform to manufacturing shops. As a Platform Engineer I, you will help build and maintain a platform that is scalable, secure, and resilient. You will play a crucial part in supporting the automation and tooling that makes our entire engineering team more efficient. This is an entry\-level position on our engineering career pathway. You'll participate fully in the life of the team — joining sprint ceremonies, completing assigned sprint work, and growing into the on\-call rotation — while building the foundation to advance toward Platform Engineer II and beyond. This role is perfect for early\-career engineers who are passionate about cloud technologies and eager to develop their skills in a collaborative environment. ### **Why You'll Love Working Here** * **Customer\-Centric Focus:** We put our customers at the center of everything we do. Your work will directly contribute to their success. * **Meaningful Challenges:** We enable critical industries like medical devices, aerospace, and defense, which require robust, secure, and scalable solutions. * **Collaborative and Inclusive Culture:** Our culture emphasizes collaboration, continuous learning, and mutual respect. We believe that diverse teams build better products. * **Learning Opportunities:** You'll grow your skills through close mentorship from senior engineers and a clearly defined engineering career pathway. * **Modern Technology:** Gain hands\-on experience with modern web application stacks, cloud technologies like AWS, and observability and CI/CD tools. ### **What You'll Work On** * Develop and maintain infrastructure as code, including writing, testing, and deploying new Terraform modules to manage production cloud resources on AWS, including EC2, S3, IAM, and VPC * Enhance our CI/CD pipelines using industry\-standard tools like Jenkins * Build new dashboards and set up monitoring with Datadog to ensure the health and performance of key applications. * Write and maintain automation scripts in Python or Bash to streamline routine operational tasks. * Work with containerization technologies and concepts using Docker * Use AI\-assisted coding tools as part of your everyday workflow to write, test, and review code more effectively * Participate in sprint ceremonies and deliver assigned sprint work, with code reviewed and supported by senior engineers * Join the team's on\-call rotation and learn to respond to alerts as you grow into the role ### **What You'll Bring** * A Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. * 0\-1 years of professional experience in software, platform, or DevOps engineering; internship or co\-op experience counts. * Working knowledge of a programming or scripting language, with Python as a plus. * Basic understanding of and comfort with Linux/Unix command\-line tools. * Familiarity with modern infrastructure tools, including cloud providers (e.g., AWS, Azure, or GCP), containerization (e.g., Docker), infrastructure as code (e.g., Terraform), and CI/CD (e.g., Jenkins). * A demonstrated, passionate desire to learn about cloud computing, DevOps principles, and infrastructure automation. * Strong problem\-solving skills and attention to detail. * Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written, and a collaborative mindset — you ask clarifying questions and contribute to team discussions. * A strong sense of reliability and ownership of your assigned work, with enthusiasm for learning and applying new technologies. ### **Why Join Us?** * **Real\-World Impact:** You will contribute to solutions that empower critical industries and drive innovation. * **Learning and Development:** You will work with experienced professionals who will support your growth along a defined engineering career pathway. * **Supportive Culture:** You will join a team that values your contributions and invests in your success. If you're an ambitious early\-career engineer eager to apply your knowledge of cloud infrastructure, gain hands\-on experience, and build your career in platform engineering, we'd love to hear from you! **Salary range:** $106,000 \- $144,000 The job posting range is the lowest to highest salary we in good faith believe we would pay for this role at the time of this posting. We may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range, and the range may be modified in the future. We recognize that people work well in different environments and have intentionally designed our office to provide collaborative spaces and quiet focus areas. Our height\-adjustable desks are set up with additional monitors, and employees are provided with the latest Apple technology to support productivity. Our headquarters is located in downtown Boston, MA and easily accessible to most transit routes (Red/Blue/Orange/Green Line/South Station/North Station). **Encinitas Office:** Our California office is our newest office which seats our West Coast sales team. Paperless Parts is an Equal Opportunity \& Affirmative Action Employer. jobs.title: Forward Deployment (FD) Agentic Solutions Consultant - Sales
jobs.description: About Patra: Patra is an outcome\-focused operating partner working exclusively for the insurance industry. Combining expert global teams, process intelligence, and purpose\-built technology, Patra delivers measurable results to clients. With 20 years of deep domain expertise, exceptional client retention rates, and significant sustained investment in AI, Patra partners with agencies, brokers, MGAs, MGUs, and carriers to transform how insurance operations are delivered. Core Duties: **Role summary** Every Patra client runs its insurance operations a little differently, shaped by its own people, systems, and book of business. As a Forward Deployed (FD) Agentic Solutions Consultant – Sales, you will partner with Patra’s Client Experience (CX) and Sales teams to show clients what their operations could look like when targeted processes are reengineered with agentic AI. You will join client conversations to listen closely to how work gets done today, ideate with the client and the account team on where agents can take on that work, and rapidly turn those ideas into working agentic AI prototypes and future\-state journey maps, often in days rather than months. Your prototypes make the opportunity tangible: a client can watch real agents run the reengineered process in a synthetic version of their world, test it against realistic scenarios, and commit to it. They then become the blueprint for Patra’s FD squads, the forward\-deployed delivery teams that build them into POC and production systems. The role suits a curious, client\-facing builder who understands insurance operations, can translate a messy manual process into a clear agent\-plus\-expert design, and is happiest putting a working prototype in front of a client and collaborating with sales team to gain client commitments that can be actualized. **Key responsibilities****Discover alongside CX and Sales** * Join client meetings and working sessions with CX and Sales to understand the client’s goals, pain points, and how targeted processes such as submission intake, enrichment, classification, quoting, bind checking, policy checking, and certificates run today. * Listen for where agentic AI can create the most value, and help the account team qualify and prioritize which processes to pursue first. * Capture current\-state journey maps that show the steps, handoffs, systems, documents, and people involved. **Ideate and prototype** * Facilitate ideation with clients and account teams on how a process could be reengineered with agentic AI, and capture the result as a future\-state journey map. * Rapidly build working agentic AI prototypes, often in days: real agents built with real AI tools, running in a synthetic environment of mock systems, documents, and data that mirrors the client’s operation. * Design the agent\-plus\-expert model each prototype demonstrates: what the agent does, what a human reviews, and where it escalates. * Iterate quickly on client feedback until the prototype tells a clear, credible story. **Demonstrate value and win commitment** * Present prototypes and journey maps to client stakeholders, from operations leads to executives, in plain business terms. * Partner with Sales to build the business case: estimated cost replaced, cycle time cut, errors avoided, and the baseline KPIs a POC would measure. * Help shape proposals, POC scope, and success criteria so client commitments are realistic and deliverable. **Hand off and harvest** * Hand off prototypes, journey maps, and requirements to FD squads so they can move quickly into POC and production builds. * Apply Patra’s AI governance standards to prototyping work, including approved models and tools, and using synthetic data in place of real client data. * Build and maintain a reusable library of prototypes, synthetic data sets, and journey\-map templates, and share field insights with Patra’s product team. **Required qualifications*** 8\+ years in insurance operations, distribution, or Insurtech, with direct exposure to agency, broker, MGA, or carrier workflows. * 2\+ years designing, building, or owning AI or automation solutions as a product manager, solutions or sales engineer, or consultant, with at least some taken into production. * Demonstrated ability to rapidly build working agentic AI prototypes with real AI tools, such as Claude, ChatGPT and the OpenAI API, Microsoft Copilot Studio, n8n, LangGraph, or comparable agent frameworks and low\-code platforms, including the synthetic data and mock systems they run against, rather than slides or click\-through demos. * Hands\-on understanding of LLM\-based systems: agent workflow design, retrieval (RAG), prompt and schema design, and evaluation. * Strong discovery and listening skills: able to facilitate client working sessions, uncover how a process really runs, and translate it into current\- and future\-state journey maps. * Experience partnering with Sales, CX, or account teams in pre\-sales, solution design, or client advisory settings. * Ability to frame the business case for automation in terms of cost, cycle time, and accuracy, ideally backed by results you have delivered. * Experience working with cross\-functional teams of engineers, product managers, and operations staff. * Comfort presenting prototypes and business cases to client executives, including the C‑suite. * Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience. **Preferred qualifications*** Line\-of\-business knowledge in one or more of Patra’s markets: Retail P\&C, also known as personal lines (auto, home, umbrella); Commercial P\&C, including E\&S and specialty lines such as D\&O, EPL, Tech E\&O, cyber, and professional liability; and Retail Employee Benefits (group health, life, disability, and voluntary benefits). * A portfolio of agentic AI prototypes you can walk us through, ideally for insurance or other document\-heavy service operations. * Experience with document\-heavy workflows across lines: applications and submissions, bind bundles, policy documents, endorsements and renewals, certificates, and benefits enrollment and census data. * Enterprise AI governance experience: usage policies, model approval, vendor vetting, and risk frameworks. * Technical depth in Python and AWS, plus familiarity with the systems insurance operations run on, such as CRMs, agency and policy management systems, benefits administration platforms, and integration and API tools. * Graduate coursework or a degree in computer science, AI, or machine learning. * Partner or channel experience with wholesalers and brokerages. * Experience working with global delivery teams across the US, India, and the Philippines. **Location and logistics** -------------------------- * **Travel:** Periodic client on\-site visits for discovery sessions, ideation workshops, and prototype presentations; up to 25%. * **Hours:** Primarily aligned with US client and Sales team schedules, with occasional overlap with India and Philippines delivery teams during handoffs. Equal Employment Opportunity: Patra Corporation is an equal opportunity employer committed to celebrating diversity and creating a safe and inclusive environment for all employees.

jobs.title: Sr Product Manager - DTC
jobs.description: Are you obsessed with data, partner success, taking action, and changing the game? If you have a whole lot of hustle and a touch of nerd, come work with Pattern! We want you to use your skills to push one of the fastest\-growing companies headquartered in the US to the top of the list. Pattern accelerates brands on global ecommerce marketplaces leveraging proprietary technology and AI. Utilizing more than 66 trillion data points, sophisticated machine learning and AI models, Pattern optimizes and automates all levers of ecommerce growth for global brands, including advertising, content management, logistics and fulfillment, pricing, forecasting and customer service. Hundreds of global brands depend on Pattern’s ecommerce acceleration platform every day to drive profitable revenue growth across 60\+ global marketplaces—including Amazon, Walmart.com, Target.com, eBay, Tmall, TikTok Shop, JD, and Mercado Libre. To learn more, visit pattern.com or email press@pattern.com. Pattern has been named one of the fastest growing tech companies headquartered in North America by Deloitte and one of best\-led companies by Inc. We place employee experience at the center of our business model and have been recognized as one of Newsweek’s Global Most Loved Workplaces®. As a Senior Product Manager for DTC at Pattern, you will own the strategy and roadmap for the software that powers our direct\-to\-consumer fulfillment operation. You will lead a dedicated engineering team through two\-week sprints to build and scale order management, guided pick, pack, and ship workflows, carrier and rate optimization, and DTC inventory replenishment tools. This role sits at the intersection of high\-volume fulfillment operations and rapid technology expansion, driving measurable gains in order accuracy, ship speed, and cost per order across our growing warehouse network. ### **What is a day in the life of a Sr Product Manager \- DTC?** * Connect daily with the offshore engineering team (8:00 to 9:00 AM MT) to facilitate standups, unblock technical decisions, and keep execution aligned with the roadmap. * Run sprint planning, write user stories and acceptance criteria, assign sprint points, and lead retrospectives every two weeks. * Partner with UX designers to design and refine guided tools for warehouse associates across picking, packing, labeling, and replenishment. * Work with Warehouse Operations, Client Services, and Finance to identify DTC pain points, prioritize requirements, and run User Acceptance Testing (UAT). * Analyze order, carrier, and labor data to find opportunities in carrier selection, packaging, same\-day ship cutoffs, and cost per order. * Turn operational problems into business cases with clear success metrics, and present tradeoffs and roadmap decisions to leadership. ### **What will I need to thrive in this role?** * 5\+ years of product management experience, including at least 2 years owning a product area in DTC or ecommerce fulfillment, warehousing, WMS/OMS, or supply chain. * Track record of owning a multi\-quarter roadmap end to end, from discovery through launch and adoption, with measurable business outcomes. * Proven experience leading engineering teams through the full Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) and two\-week sprint cycles, including distributed teams across time zones. * Working knowledge of DTC fulfillment: order orchestration, pick/pack/ship, carrier rate shopping, cartonization, inventory slotting and replenishment, and ecommerce platform integrations (e.g., Shopify). * Strong data skills: comfortable writing SQL in Snowflake, building analyses in Excel or Google Sheets, and using AI development assistants (e.g., Claude, Cursor). * Ability to influence without authority and align engineering, design, operations, and executive stakeholders around a shared direction. ### **What does high performance look like?** * Ship DTC releases that move core metrics: order accuracy, on\-time ship rate, cost per order, and units per labor hour. * Replace manual processes, spreadsheets, and workarounds with automated, in\-house software that scales with order volume. * Deliver sprint commitments on time while keeping team velocity and quality high. * Set a clear DTC product vision and multi\-quarter roadmap that leadership and operations trust. * Anticipate operational constraints ahead of peak season and have solutions in place before volume hits. * Raise the bar for product practice on the team through strong documentation, prioritization, and mentorship of peers. ### **What is my potential for career growth?** * Own a core product line within a fast\-growing tech business expanding 30 to 40% annually. * Direct exposure to enterprise\-level DTC fulfillment scaling, double\-digit facility network expansion, and warehouse automation. * Path to Principal or Group Product Manager roles with ownership across multiple fulfillment product areas. * Professional network development through close collaboration with  akes profitable, productive, and innovative contributions, and actively pursues improvements to Pattern's processes and outcomes. * **Data Fanatics** \- A data fanatic is someone who recognizes problems and seeks to understand them through data, draws unbiased conclusions based on data that lead to actionable solutions, and continues to track the effects of the solutions using data. * **Partner Obsessed** \- An individual who is partner obsessed clearly explains the status of projects to partners and relies on constructive feedback, actively listens to partner's expectations, and delivers results that exceed them, prioritizes the needs of your partners, and takes the time to create a personable experience for those interacting with Pattern. * **Team of Doers** \- Someone who is a part of a team of doers uplifts team members and recognizes their specific contributions, takes initiative to help in any circumstance, actively contributes to supporting improvements, and holds themselves accountable to the team as well as to partners. ### **What is the hiring process?** * Phone Interview * Video Interview * Top\-Grading Interview / Panel Interview * On\-Site Visit / Final Interview * Reference Checks * Executive Review * Offer ### **How can I stand out as an applicant?** **Strong Nice\-to\-Haves:** * Experience building or implementing WMS/OMS, carrier rate\-shopping, or cartonization software. * Prior background at high\-volume DTC brands, ecommerce platforms (e.g., Amazon, Shopify, Walmart), or 3PLs. * Experience preparing fulfillment systems and teams for peak season volume. * Background in high\-volume outbound fulfillment at Amazon, Shopify, Walmart or similar scale, particularly within robotics\-enabled facilities (e.g., Amazon Robotics/AR) or automated material\-handling environments. * Hands\-on experience using modern AI tools (e.g., Claude, Cursor) to accelerate product workflow and problem\-solving. **Interview Standout Tips:** * Walk through a product area you owned: the problem, the metrics, the decisions you made, and the results. * Demonstrate how you turned an ambiguous operational problem into structured software requirements and a shipped solution. * Show a clear track record of leading distributed offshore engineering and design teams across multiple time zones. * Be ready to discuss tradeoffs between speed, cost, and accuracy in a high\-volume fulfillment operation. **Why should I work at Pattern?** Pattern offers big opportunities to make a difference in the ecommerce industry! We are a company full of talented people that evolves quickly and often. We set big goals, work tirelessly to achieve them, and we love our Pattern community. We also believe in having fun and balancing our lives, so we offer awesome benefits that include: * Unlimited PTO * Paid Holidays * Onsite Fitness Center * Company Paid Life Insurance * Casual Dress Code * Competitive Pay * Health, Vision, and Dental Insurance * 401(k) match. Pattern matches 100% of the first 3% in eligible compensation deferred and 50% of the next 2% in eligible compensation deferred. Pattern provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability, status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

jobs.title: Sr Software Engineer
jobs.description: **The Company** PayPal has been revolutionizing commerce globally for more than 25 years. Creating innovative experiences that make moving money, selling, and shopping simple, personalized, and secure, PayPal empowers consumers and businesses in approximately 200 markets to join and thrive in the global economy. We operate a global, two\-sided network at scale that connects hundreds of millions of merchants and consumers. We help merchants and consumers connect, transact, and complete payments, whether they are online or in person. PayPal is more than a connection to third\-party payment networks. We provide proprietary payment solutions accepted by merchants that enable the completion of payments on our platform on behalf of our customers. We offer our customers the flexibility to use their accounts to purchase and receive payments for goods and services, as well as the ability to transfer and withdraw funds. We enable consumers to exchange funds more safely with merchants using a variety of funding sources, which may include a bank account, a PayPal or Venmo account balance, PayPal and Venmo branded credit products, a credit card, a debit card, certain cryptocurrencies, or other stored value products such as gift cards, and eligible credit card rewards. Our PayPal, Venmo, and Xoom products also make it safer and simpler for friends and family to transfer funds to each other. We offer merchants an end\-to\-end payments solution that provides authorization and settlement capabilities, as well as instant access to funds and payouts. We also help merchants connect with their customers, process exchanges and returns, and manage risk. We enable consumers to engage in cross\-border shopping and merchants to extend their global reach while reducing the complexity and friction involved in enabling cross\-border trade. Our beliefs are the foundation for how we conduct business every day. We live each day guided by our core values of Inclusion, Innovation, Collaboration, and Wellness. Together, our values ensure that we work together as one global team with our customers at the center of everything we do – and they push us to ensure we take care of ourselves, each other, and our communities. **Job Summary:** As a Sr Software Android Engineer on the Venmo Business Profiles team, you will help build the future of commerce on Venmo. You will design and deliver reliable, intuitive mobile experiences that help businesses create profiles, showcase products and services, connect with customers, and grow through Venmo. You will collaborate with product managers, designers, backend engineers, and other mobile engineers to solve complex problems across business onboarding, storefronts, search, social proof, payments, and account management. You will shape technical direction, improve Android architecture, strengthen engineering quality, and mentor other engineers while delivering experiences used by millions of people. This is an opportunity to work on a highly visible product at the intersection of commerce, payments, and social connection. You will help extend Venmo beyond peer to peer payments and make it easier for businesses to participate in the global economy. **Job Description:** **Essential Responsibilities:** * Delivers complete solutions spanning all phases of the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC) (design, implementation, testing, delivery and operations), based on definitions from more senior roles. * Advises immediate management on project\-level issues * Guides junior engineers * Operates with little day\-to\-day supervision, making technical decisions based on knowledge of internal conventions and industry best practices * Applies knowledge of technical best practices in making decisions **Minimum Qualifications:** * 3\+ years relevant experience and a Bachelor’s degree OR Any equivalent combination of education and experience. **Additional Responsibilities \& Preferred Qualifications****:** At Venmo, we are creating a product that people love. We strive to create a delightful user experience while connecting the world and empowering people through payments. We are looking for intellectually curious people who want to be inspired and inspire others to change the world. Engineering is a craft, and at Venmo we want the internals of our software to be as elegant as the end user experience we are designing. We spend our days scaling our infrastructure and building new features to meet and exceed our user’s needs and wants. We teach and learn from one another and push each other to be at our creative and analytical best. As a member of Venmo Engineering, you will act as a subject matter expert. We are looking for technologists with the highest levels of technical talent, programming, and communication skills with a keen desire to deeply understand our product and how to make our systems stronger and more resilient. Come join our team! What you will do Lead engineering efforts and team level processes by defining it and Automation tests. Strong knowledge of common design patterns, algorithms, and object\-oriented programming with expertise in design patterns such as MVC and MVVM. Work Permit and Relocation Prerequisites: Must already possess valid authorization to work in the country where the position is advertised/located. Relocation support will not be provided for this role. **Subsidiary:** Venmo **Travel Percent:** 0 Visa Sponsorship through PayPal is not available for this position now or any time in the future. * The base pay for this role will depend on where you work and the relevant experience and expertise you bring. The expected range of pay for this role by location is: **Primary Location \| Pay Range:** Austin, Texas: ($130,500\.00 \- $193,600\.00 Annually) **Additional Location(s) \| Pay Range:** No other locations are assigned to this requisition currently. Additional compensation for this role may include an annual performance bonus, equity, or other incentive compensation, as applicable. PayPal does not charge candidates any fees for courses, applications, resume reviews, interviews, background checks, or onboarding. When making an application directly, we will never ask you to share passwords, one\-time passcodes (OTP), or verification codes. Any such request is a red flag and likely part of a scam. All communication regarding your application will come from official PayPal email domains. If you suspect fraudulent activity, please report it immediately. To learn more about how to identify and avoid recruitment fraud please visit https://careers.pypl.com/contact\-us. For the majority of employees, PayPal's balanced hybrid work model offers 3 days in the office for effective in\-person collaboration and 2 days at your choice of either the PayPal office or your home workspace, ensuring that you equally have the benefits and conveniences of both locations. **Our Benefits:** At PayPal, we’re committed to building an equitable and inclusive global economy. And we can’t do this without our most important asset\-you. That’s why we offer comprehensive, choice\-based programs, to support all aspects of personal wellbeing—physical, emotional, and financial—delivering meaningful value where it matters most. We strive to create a flexible, balanced work culture with a holistic approach to benefits, including generous paid time off, healthcare coverage for you and your family, and resources to create financial security and support your mental health. **Who We Are:** **Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion** PayPal provides equal employment opportunity (EEO) to all persons regardless of age, color, national origin, citizenship status, physical or mental disability, race, religion, creed, gender, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity and/or expression, genetic information, marital status, status with regard to public assistance, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law. In addition, PayPal will provide reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities. If you are unable to submit an application because of incompatible assistive technology or a disability, please contact us at paypalglobaltalentacquisition@paypal.com. **Belonging at PayPal:** Our employees are central to advancing our mission, and we strive to create an environment where everyone can do their best work with a sense of purpose and belonging. Belonging at PayPal means creating a workplace with a sense of acceptance and security where all employees feel included and valued. We are proud to have a diverse workforce reflective of the merchants, consumers, and communities that we serve, and we continue to take tangible actions to cultivate inclusivity and belonging at PayPal. Any general requests for consideration of your skills, please Join our Talent Community. We know the confidence gap and imposter syndrome can get in the way of meeting spectacular candidates. Please don’t hesitate to apply.

jobs.title: DevOps Engineer
jobs.description: **DevOps Engineer** **Location:** Burlingame, CA **Department:** ESS Engineering **Reports to:** Senior Manager, Software Engineering **Position Type:** Full\-time **About the Company** Peak Energy is the first American venture to advance globally proven sodium\-ion battery systems as the storage standard for the new era of renewable energy on a resilient grid. Sodium\-ion is cheap, readily available, and safe — making it the leading contender in a rapidly evolving market. Our leadership team is powered by decades of expertise in scaling gigawatt\-level innovation at world\-class companies such as Tesla, Northvolt, Apple, Powin, Enovix, Zipline, Solid Power, SunPower, and Fluence. We are backed by strategic investment and product partners including TDK Ventures, Eclipse Ventures, and GM Ventures. We recently announced America's first sodium\-ion grid storage factory in Sacramento with production starting Q1 2027, and over $1B in signed customer commitments including Jupiter Power and Energy Vault. **About the Role** Peak Energy is looking for a DevOps Engineer to build and scale the cloud infrastructure, deployment pipelines, and automation systems supporting our grid\-scale battery storage technology. As Peak grows from pilot deployments to gigawatt\-scale production, our software infrastructure must scale alongside our products. You'll help establish the foundation that enables our engineering teams to develop, test, and deploy software efficiently and reliably. This is a hands\-on infrastructure engineering role focused on cloud services, Infrastructure as Code, database provisioning, CI/CD pipelines, and deployment automation. You'll build and maintain the systems that connect our development environments, manufacturing operations, and deployed battery systems to the cloud. You'll work closely with software, test, and manufacturing engineering teams to improve automation, reliability, and scalability across our software infrastructure. **What You'll Do** * Design, build, and maintain cloud infrastructure supporting Peak's battery storage software, data pipelines, and engineering applications. * Develop and maintain automated CI/CD pipelines for software builds, pipelines and integrations with EMRs and other clinical systems * Work with the core team on our search and chat system, and bring real customer feedback into the product * Debug and resolve customer issues quickly, and own them until they are fixed * Help drive customer success: onboarding, training, and increasing usage * Make general solutions from one\-off customer problems, so each deployment with backend work, data and APIs * Comfortable working directly with customers, including non\-technical ones * Energized by open\-ended problems and takes ownership without needing to be guided * HIPAA * Strong product taste * Ambitions to start your own company someday, and we’ll support that path * Preferred to be based in SF but remote also considered. **What you get** * Direct, daily work jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer
jobs.description: We are modernizing Pearson's content platform into a set of shared platform services. You will be one of the principal engineers leading that work hands\-on. You design the target systems and move content and users onto them safely. Full stack here goes beyond front end and back end: the work spans user interfaces, workflow orchestration, AI, backend services, and cloud infrastructure. You will stay deep in design and implementation while raising the technical judgment and execution of the engineers around you. **What you will own** * The technical plan and delivery for several technology tracks, such as consolidations, migrations, and other large\-scale initiatives, from target design through launch. * Migrations of large volumes of content and data, such as assessment items or media assets, with verification that nothing is lost or broken for downstream products. * Shared capabilities that should be built once and used everywhere, like media handling, search, rendering, or AI content services, exposed through clean APIs. * An honest, costed view of the technical debt in your systems and what to fix first. * Escalated incidents on your systems: you are the technical point of contact when one has business impact, and you stay on it through root cause and the fix that prevents a repeat. * Security and stability for the applications you own. That covers runtime and framework upgrades, vulnerability and penetration test remediation, secure data handling, and disaster recovery plans that are documented, exercised, and audit ready. * Shared standards across teams for design patterns, tooling, reliability, observability, performance, and evaluation, including how AI\-powered workflows are measured, tested, and kept safe. * The long\-term technical roadmap for your area, and the subject\-matter expertise that comes with it. **How you will work** This is a hands\-on engineering role, not an architecture role. You will not be embedded in a single team; you will work across the platform on initiatives and technical problems that matter most to leadership. You own the designs, the code on the critical path, and the engineering calls that decide whether an initiative succeeds. You should enjoy defining the problem as much as solving it. * Write production code where the risk is highest and review the hardest changes from other engineers. * Unblock hard technical problems that span systems, teams, or domains. * Work with engineering managers, product managers, architects, and quality engineering. When long\-term initiatives and current delivery compete for the same people or code, make the tradeoff visible and help decide it. * Work directly with the people who use the platform across Pearson's lines of business, and separate the foundational problems from the incremental ones before the team commits. * Spot opportunities that cut across team and product boundaries, bring stakeholders to a shared direction, and carry the work from exploration through launch and iteration. * Make high\-consequence technical decisions under ambiguity, balancing speed and learning against scalability, simplicity, and long\-term maintainability. Hold views grounded in evidence, and change them when the evidence changes. * Evaluate frameworks, tools, and vendors, and pilot practices like contract testing, automated regression, and zero\-downtime migration before teams adopt them. * Run technical feasibility reviews for new AI capabilities, and work with internal teams and external partners to assess and co\-develop them. * Use AI coding tools daily, particularly for large upgrades and refactors, and help teams adopt them with sound review habits. * Act as a technical multiplier: review critical designs, mentor engineers, and improve engineering practices. Success includes the senior engineers around you becoming owners of these systems too. **Minimum qualifications** * 12\+ years building and operating production software, including 4\+ years at staff or principal level, or as technical lead across several teams or a large multi\-service system. * Led a re\-platforming or legacy migration of a production system with active users and data, through to switching off the old system. * Led the design and delivery of technically complex, user\-facing systems. * Upgraded or migrated production systems off an end\-of\-life runtime or framework. * Full\-stack depth in our core stack: Java and Spring Boot, Node.js and TypeScript, and React, with MongoDB and event\-driven services (SQS, SNS, Kafka) behind APIs with many consumers. * Production experience on AWS, especially ECS Fargate, Lambda, S3, and API Gateway, with observability (New Relic, CloudWatch), CI/CD (GitHub Actions), and infrastructure as code (Terraform). * Writes clear design documents and migration plans, explains tradeoffs to engineering, product, and executive audiences, and influences without authority, especially when the decision carries real uncertainty. We will ask you to walk us through a document you wrote. * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or an equivalent combination of education and experience. **Preferred qualifications** * Content platform experience: authoring and content management, digital asset management, content transformation pipelines, content delivery, or assessment systems. * Content and learning standards such as EPUB, XML/XSLT, QTI, or LTI. * Built or operated an LLM\-backed feature in production, using Python and services such as AWS Bedrock or Azure OpenAI, and understands the problems AI brings: nondeterminism, evaluation, latency, and safety. * Moved a product off a commercial platform, such as a DAM or CMS, onto in\-house services. * Search and caching with OpenSearch or Solr and Redis. * Worked with distributed teams and delivery partners across US and India time zones. **About PSG\-CP** Pearson is the world's lifelong learning company. PSG\-CP (Pearson Software Group \- Content Platform) builds and runs the platform behind how Pearson creates, delivers, and measures learning content, for every Pearson line of business. Apply now and help shape the future of learning. Compensation at Pearson is influenced by a wide array of factors including but not limited to skill set, level of experience, and specific location. As required by the California, Colorado, Hawaii, Illinois, Maryland, Minnesota, New Jersey, New York State, New York City, Vermont, Washington State, and Washington DC laws, the pay range for this position is as follows: The full\-time salary range is between $150,000 \- 170,000\. This position is eligible to participate in an annual incentive program, and information on benefits offered is here. Applications will be accepted through 12th of December. This window may be extended depending on business needs. **Who we are:** At Pearson, our purpose is simple: to help people realize the life they imagine through learning. We believe that every learning opportunity is a chance for a personal breakthrough. We are the world's lifelong learning company. For us, learning isn't just what we do. It's who we are. To learn more: We are Pearson. Pearson is an Equal Opportunity Employer and a member of E\-Verify. Employment decisions are based on qualifications, merit and business need. jobs.title: Sr. Software Engineer, Backend
jobs.description: **The Team \+ The Role** ------------------------ The Core team builds features and platform capabilities that power critical areas of the Pendo product experience. Our work supports high\-stakes customer use cases, drives how our systems evolve, and creates a consistent experience across the platform. We operate in complex product areas where delivery speed, system reliability, and long\-term maintainability are equally important. As a Sr. Software Engineer, you own complex technical challenges and drive solutions independently. You apply sound engineering judgment, partner with product and design, and take accountability for outcomes, not just output. You break ambiguous work into small, continuously shippable increments, bring others along, and improve the codebase as you deliver. This role is based in our Raleigh office. **What this looks like day\-to\-day** ------------------------------------- * **End\-to\-end feature ownership:** Own complex, ambiguous features from problem definition through delivery. Break work into small, independently shippable increments to maintain consistent progress and deliver customer value. * **Production\-quality engineering:** Write reliable, maintainable production code and select testing approaches based on risk and system impact. Apply safe rollout patterns, including feature flags and incremental deployments, to reduce delivery risk. * **Production reliability:** Respond quickly to production issues within your area of ownership and drive them to resolution. Identify root causes and implement improvements that prevent recurring problems. * **AI\-enabled development:** Integrate AI tools into daily engineering workflows for code generation, debugging, test writing, and task decomposition. Share effective practices that improve how the team uses AI to build and deliver software. * **Technical collaboration:** Provide actionable code reviews and contribute constructively to engineering discussions and planning. Partner with product, design, and fellow engineers to align technical decisions with product outcomes. * **Continuous improvement:** Identify recurring friction in code, tests, tooling, and development processes. Proactively implement improvements that strengthen engineering quality and team efficiency. * **Clear technical communication:** Create documentation, commit messages, and technical notes that make decisions and implementation details easy to understand. Maintain enough written context for teammates to continue work without requiring verbal handoffs. **Who You Are** --------------- Beyond the qualifications, we hire through a specific lens. These aren't buzzwords; they're the things we'll actually look for in how you talk about your work. You're a builder, not a maintainer. You're most energized when there isn't a clear path yet, and you get to define it. You don't wait for direction; you identify gaps, shape solutions, and drive them forward. At Pendo, great Sr. Software Engineers don't just follow instructions; they operate as strategic advisors, influencing decisions, guiding stakeholders, and elevating how we work. You're AI\-curious \- genuinely. You're not using AI tools occasionally. You're rewiring how you work around them. You're faster, sharper, and more prolific because of it, and you bring that energy to everything — how you approach your work, how you prep, how you communicate, how you think. We want someone who sees AI as a multiplier, not a shortcut. **Must\-haves** --------------- * 5\+ years of software engineering experience delivering customer\-facing SaaS product features in production environments. * Strong proficiency in at least one backend programming language: Go, Java, Python, or C\+\+. * Deep understanding of scalable web architecture, API design, and performance optimization. * Experience with AWS or GCP cloud platforms and both SQL and NoSQL databases. * Demonstrated ability to independently structure ambiguous technical work into small, deliverable increments and drive execution through completion. * Experience designing and implementing unit, integration, and end\-to\-end tests, with sound judgment about when to apply each approach. * Familiarity with safe deployment and rollout practices, including feature flags, canary releases, or comparable approaches. * Active use of AI tools in software development workflows. * Strong written and verbal communication skills, with demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively across engineering, product, and design teams. * Bachelor's degree or higher in Computer Science, or equivalent practical experience. **Nice\-to\-haves** ------------------- * Experience improving team\-level engineering tooling, development processes, or developer workflows beyond individual feature delivery. * Experience mentoring engineers and strengthening team capabilities through technical documentation, constructive code reviews, or knowledge sharing. * Experience contributing to shared platform capabilities that support multiple product areas. **About Pendo** --------------- Pendo was founded in 2013 by former product managers, who combined their heads and hearts to build something they wanted but never had as product managers: a simple way to understand and attack what truly drives product success. Our mission is to improve society's experience with software. Come join one of the fastest\-growing startups, supported by best\-in\-class institutions like Battery Ventures, Salesforce Ventures, Spark Capital and Meritech. **Pendo Core Values:** Bias to Act, Hone Your Craft, The Team is Pendo, and Maniacal Focus. **Location:** Pendo is a hybrid culture. In\-office 3 days per week unless designated remote. **Compensation:** The expected salary range for this role to be performed in Raleigh, NC is $135,000 \- $150,000\. **Benefits:** Highly competitive, employer\-heavy coverage (including $0 premium options), strong 401(k) match, equity, and flexible time off. **EEOC:** We are an equal opportunity employer and believe having diverse teams where everyone brings their whole self to Pendo is key to our success. We welcome all people of different backgrounds, experiences, abilities and perspectives. **Accessibility:** Pendo is committed to working with, and providing access and reasonable accommodation to, applicants with mental and/or physical disabilities. jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer
jobs.description: Position Summary Penn Foster Group is seeking an experienced Senior Data Engineer to help shape the future of our enterprise data platform and AI strategy. This is a highly visible technical Leadership role responsible for architecting, building, and evolving our modern cloud data platform while establishing engineering standards, mentoring a growing team, and driving innovation across the organization. As a Senior Data Engineer, you will serve as a Senior Technical expert for our Databricks Lakehouse platform, providing hands\-on Leadership across data ingestion, transformation, governance, analytics enablement, and AI\-ready data products. You will partner closely with Business Intelligence, Product, Platform Engineering, Security, Data Governance, and MLOps teams to build trusted, scalable, and governed data solutions that power enterprise analytics, machine learning, and generative AI. This role combines deep technical expertise with Leadership, mentoring, and strategic influence. You'll help establish the long\-term technical direction of Penn Foster Group's data ecosystem while coaching and developing engineers, driving engineering excellence, and implementing modern data engineering best practices. Why Join Penn Foster Group? Penn Foster Group is in the midst of an exciting enterprise\-wide data platform modernization journey. We are investing in a modern cloud\-native architecture built on Databricks, Azure, and AI\-enabled technologies that will become the foundation for analytics, operational reporting, machine learning, and generative AI across the company. This is a unique opportunity to join at a transformational point in our technology journey. Rather than simply maintaining existing systems, you'll help define the future of our data platform—shaping architecture, engineering standards, governance, and the adoption of emerging AI technologies that will influence how data is used across the organization for years to come. You will also be a key player in our drive for Self Service Analytics at PFG. **As our Senior Data Engineer, you will have the opportunity to:** * Help define the long\-term strategy for Penn Foster Group's modern Data \& AI platform. * Influence enterprise architecture decisions around Databricks, Azure, Unity Catalog, semantic data products, and AI\-powered analytics. * Build modern, scalable data products that enable self\-service analytics and generative AI. * Lead adoption of emerging Databricks capabilities, including Genie, AI/BI, Unity Catalog, Lakeflow, and other evolving platform innovations. * Mentor and develop a growing Data Engineering team while establishing engineering standards that scale across the organization. * Partner directly with technology and business Leaders to solve meaningful business problems using modern cloud and AI technologies. If you're passionate about building modern data platforms, mentoring engineers, and helping shape the future of AI\-enabled analytics, this is an opportunity to make a lasting impact. Key Responsibilities Technical Leadership * Provide technical Leadership for the Data Engineering team through architecture guidance, code reviews, mentoring, and engineering best practices. * Mentor and develop junior and mid\-level Data Engineers, fostering technical growth, knowledge sharing, and continuous learning. * Establish engineering standards for software development, testing, CI/CD, documentation, observability, and operational excellence. * Senior technical design discussions, evaluate architectural tradeoffs, and drive adoption of modern engineering practices. * Champion a culture of quality, collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement. Data Platform \& Databricks Leadership * Serve as the technical Senior Engineer for Penn Foster Group's Databricks Lakehouse platform. * Design, build, and support scalable enterprise data pipelines using SQL, Python, Apache Spark, and Databricks. * Define best practices for Databricks development, including Workflows, Repos, Jobs, notebooks, reusable Python libraries, Git integration, cluster policies, SQL Warehouses, and deployment automation. * Design and optimize Delta Lake architectures using Medallion patterns, Delta optimization, Liquid Clustering, and Photon. * Build reusable ingestion frameworks supporting batch, streaming, CDC, and API\-based integration patterns. * Optimize Spark workloads for performance, scalability, reliability, and cloud cost efficiency.
