jobs.description: **About Pinterest:** Millions of people around the world come to our platform to find creative ideas, dream about new possibilities and plan for memories that will last a lifetime. At Pinterest, we're on a mission to bring everyone the inspiration to create a life they love, and that starts with the people behind the product. Discover a career where you ignite innovation for millions, transform passion into growth opportunities, celebrate each other's unique experiences and embrace the flexibility to do your best work. Creating a career you love? It's Possible. At Pinterest, AI isn't just a feature, it's a powerful partner that augments our creativity and amplifies our impact, and we're looking for candidates who are excited to be a part of that. To get a complete picture of your experience and abilities, we'll explore your foundational skills and how you collaborate with AI. Through our interview process, what matters most is that you can always explain your approach, showing us not just what you know, but how you think. Our Retrieval team builds shared machine learning capabilities that help Pinterest connect people with relevant ideas. Your primary focus will be Reflex, our effort to automate and accelerate recommendation research and development. You will own a major technical area, building agents that investigate opportunities, implement changes, run experiments and learn from their results. You will work closely with other technical leaders while remaining hands\-on with the hardest engineering and modeling problems. You will also contribute to generative retrieval, with a particular focus on Semantic IDs: learning structured representations of content that recommendation models can generate and use to retrieve relevant items. This role combines applied AI research, production engineering and technical leadership, with opportunities to improve both our recommendation models and the way engineers build them. What you'll do: * Own and advance a major technical area in automated recommendation research within Reflex, collaborating with other technical leads and partner teams. * Build LLM agents that connect hypothesis generation, implementation, experiment execution, evaluation and learning from previous results. * Develop rigorous evaluations for agent behavior and research outputs, and use them to improve quality, reliability and efficiency. * Contribute to generative retrieval models, particularly Semantic ID learning, evaluation and integration into production recommendation systems. * Take promising ideas from research and prototypes through offline evaluation, online experimentation and production launches. * Build reliable integrations with ML development infrastructure and make informed tradeoffs across model quality, iteration speed, compute cost and operational complexity. * Raise technical quality through hands\-on implementation, design and code reviews, documentation and mentorship. * Work with research, recommendation and ML infrastructure teams to shape technical approaches, resolve dependencies and support adoption. * Identify and apply relevant advances from research, and contribute new methods where existing approaches fall short. What we're looking for: * Bachelor's in Computer Science, Machine Learning or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. * Minimum 8 years of experience building and shipping ML or AI systems, including substantial hands\-on engineering and technical leadership. * Demonstrated experience building LLM agents or other agentic AI systems for complex tasks, with a clear approach to evaluating and improving their performance. * Strong ML fundamentals and depth in one or more relevant areas, such as applied LLMs, representation learning, recommendation systems, retrieval or ML systems. * Experience taking research ideas into reliable production systems and evaluating their impact through meaningful experiments. * Strong software engineering skills, including the ability to design maintainable systems, implement difficult components and conduct thorough technical reviews. * Experience leading a substantial technical area, making decisions under ambiguity and collaborating effectively across teams. * A track record of mentoring engineers and raising the quality of a team's technical work. * Clear written and verbal communication, including the ability to explain technical tradeoffs to different audiences. * A disciplined approach to using AI in your own work, including verification of generated code, analysis and conclusions. That means we're not always working in an office, but we continue to gather for key moments of collaboration and connection. * This role will need to be in the office for in\-person collaboration 1\-2 times/quarter and therefore can be situated anywhere in the country. \#LI\-REMOTE \#LI\-DM57 **Our Commitment to Inclusion:** Pinterest is an equal opportunity employer and makes employment decisions on the basis of merit. jobs.title: Senior AIOps Engineer
jobs.description: Porch Group is a leading vertical software and insurance platform and is positioned to be the best partner to help homebuyers move, maintain, and fully protect their homes. We offer differentiated products and services, with homeowners insurance at the center of this relationship. We differentiate and look to win in the massive and growing homeowners insurance opportunity by 1\) providing the best services for homebuyers, 2\) led by advantaged underwriting in insurance, 3\) to protect the whole home. As a leader in the home services software\-as\-a\-service (“SaaS”) space, we’ve built deep relationships with approximately 30 thousand companies that are key to the home\-buying transaction, such as home inspectors, mortgage companies, and title companies. In 2020, Porch Group rang the Nasdaq bell and began trading under the ticker symbol PRCH. We are looking to build a truly great company and are JUST GETTING STARTED. **Job Title:** Senior AIOps Engineer I **Location:** United States **Workplace Type:** Remote **Job Summary** The future is bright for the Porch Group, and we’d love for you to be a part of it as our Senior AIOps Engineer I. In this role, you will partner with product managers, platform engineers, data scientists, and machine learning engineers to make sure our AI and ML\-powered systems are reliable, observable, secure, and cost\-efficient in production. You will focus on how AI systems run in the real world: monitoring model performance and drift, keeping deployment pipelines robust, managing incidents, and standing up new AI infrastructure. Our AI/ML stack is built on Python and runs on Kubernetes (GKE) and Google Cloud Platform, using tools such as Union Cloud (Flyte), BentoML, Feast, Label Studio, BigQuery, and Dataflow. On the GenAI side, we operate a centralized LLM routing and gateway service, run batch prediction services for large\-scale inference, and are building out RAG infrastructure. You will help evolve this stack so teams can ship AI features quickly and safely. **What You Will Do As A Senior AIOps Engineer I** * Own production reliability for AI/ML services by monitoring availability and performance, defining SLOs and SLIs (latency, error rates, model performance) tied to user experience and business impact, and owning recurring model refresh cycles (retraining, validation, and redeployment) to prevent staleness and drift. * Design and implement monitoring, logging, and alerting for models and data pipelines, and integrate model and system metrics with existing observability stacks and dashboards (Datadog, Opik, and others). * Streamline deployment workflows with data scientists and ML engineers (blue/green, canary, A/B, and shadow deployments), improve CI/CD pipelines and release processes for AI services, and support the productionization of image\-based ML models, including batch prediction workflows. * Provision, deploy, configure, and maintain new AI infrastructure as it is adopted, including AI gateways, RAG platforms, LLM observability tools, agentic workflows, and no\-code agent builders, using tools such as Union Cloud, BentoML, Feast, Kubernetes, Terraform, and GCP services. * Build automation and tooling to reduce manual operational work around model promotion, configuration, environment management, and Docker image maintenance, and support multi\-BU infrastructure provisioning (separate environments, projects, roles, and CI/CD integrations). * Own the operational health of Label Studio, our production data annotation platform, including supporting GCS buckets, BigQuery pipelines, and database and SSO dependencies, and supporting bi\-weekly annotation project cycles. * Stand up and operate RAG and vector database infrastructure, including embedding pipelines and context retrieval APIs, and optimize embedding storage and retrieval performance at scale. * Monitor and optimize LLM token usage and costs across providers, maintain centralized cost tracking dashboards and alerting across business units, and recommend cost\-efficient model routing and provider selection strategies. * Participate in an on\-call rotation for AI/ML systems, triage and resolve production incidents, and lead and contribute to post\-incident reviews that drive lasting improvements. * Develop production\-grade services and tooling, primarily in Python, on Kubernetes, applying strong engineering practices (testing, code reviews, CI/CD, observability, security), and document standards, architecture diagrams, and operational playbooks for other teams. **What You Will Bring As A Senior AIOps Engineer I** * A curious and driven mindset, with a strong interest in how AI systems behave in production and how to make them more reliable and observable. * 4\+ years of applicable experience, including at least 3 years in commercial software engineering or production operations (SRE, DevOps, Platform, or ML Platform), operating services on Kubernetes and/or major cloud platforms. * Experience operating product siness and interviewing needs. At this time, Porch Group does not consider applicants from the following states or jurisdictions for Remote positions: Alaska, Delaware, Hawaii, Mississippi, Nebraska, Montana, New Hampshire, West Virginia, or the District of Columbia. **What You Will Get As A Porch Group Team Member** Pay Range\*: $135,000 to $189,000 annually * Please know your actual pay at Porch will reflect a number of factors among which are your work experience and skillsets, job\-related knowledge, alignment with market and our Porch employees, as well as your geographic location. Additionally, you will be eligible to receive long\-term incentive awards, subject to program guidelines and approvals. Our benefits package will provide you with comprehensive coverage for your health, life, and financial wellbeing. * Our traditional healthcare benefits include three (3\) Medical plan options, two (2\) Dental plan options, and a Vision plan from which to choose. * Critical Illness, Hospital Indemnity and Accident plans are offered on a voluntary basis. * We offer pre\-tax savings options including a partially employer funded Health Savings Account and employee Flexible Savings Accounts including healthcare, dependent care, and transportation savings options. * We provide company paid Basic Life and AD\&D, Short and Long\-Term Disability benefits. We also offer Voluntary Life and AD\&D plans. * Both traditional and Roth 401(k) plans are available with a discretionary employer match. * Supportlinc is part of our employer paid wellbeing program and provides employees and their families access to on demand guided meditation and mindfulness exercises, mental health coaching, clinical care and online access to confidential resources including will preparation. * LifeBalance is a free resource to employees and their families for year\-round discounts on things like gym memberships, travel, appliances, movies, pet insurance and more. * Our wellness programs include flexible paid vacation, company\-paid holidays of typically nine per year, paid sick time, paid parental leave, identity theft program, travel assistance, and fitness and other discounts programs. \#LI\-NH1 \#LI\-Remote **What’s next?** Submit your application and our Porch Group Talent Acquisition team will be reviewing your application shortly! If your resume gets us intrigued, we will look to connect with you for a chat to learn more about your background, and then possibly invite you to have virtual interviews. What's important to call out is that we want to make sure not only that you're the right person for us, but also that we're the right next step for you, so come prepared with all the questions you have! Porch is committed to building an inclusive culture of belonging that not only embraces the diversity of our people but also reflects the diversity of the communities in which we work and the customers we serve. We know that the happiest and highest performing teams include people with diverse perspectives that encourage new ways of solving problems, so we strive to attract and develop talent from all backgrounds and create workplaces where everyone feels seen, heard and empowered to bring their full, authentic selves to work. Porch is an Equal Opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex including sexual orientation and gender identity, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations, and ordinances. Porch Group is an E\-Verify employer. E\-Verify is a web\-based system that allows an employer to determine an employee's eligibility to work in the US using information reported on an employee's Form I\-9\. The E\-Verify system confirms eligibility with both the Social Security Administration (SSA) and Department of Homeland Security (DHS). For more information, please go to the USCIS E\-Verify website.

jobs.title: Controls Engineer
jobs.description: **Job Overview** **Controls Engineer – Building Automation Systems (BAS)Employment Type:** Full\-time Experience Required: 5\+ years' Work Arrangement: On\-site preferred; remote work acceptable. **Department:** Building Automation / Controls **About the Role** We are looking for an experienced, detail\-oriented Controls Engineer to join our Building Automation Systems (BAS) team. This position will primarily focus on systems integration, programming, configuration, and troubleshooting of building automation systems for commercial HVAC applications. The ideal candidate will have a strong working knowledge of Niagara N4 and experience integrating building automation equipment and systems from multiple manufacturers. In addition to systems integration, this role will support the development of control drawings, project submittals, and as\-built documentation to ensure successful project installation and commissioning.This position is best suited for an experienced controls professional who enjoys solving technical challenges, working across multiple control platforms, and developing reliable solutions for complex HVAC systems.Key ResponsibilitiesPrimary Responsibilities – Systems Integration\- Develop, configure, and integrate building automation systems using the Niagara N4 platform.\- Integrate HVAC equipment, controllers, and third\-party systems across multiple manufacturers and communication protocols.\- Develop and modify control logic, graphics, schedules, alarms, trends, and system databases.\- Troubleshoot communication issues, integration problems, and control system deficiencies.\- Support system commissioning, startup, functional testing, and troubleshooting.\- Coordinate with project managers, field technicians, and other team members to ensure successful project completion.\- Assist with remote monitoring, system optimization, and ongoing controls support.Secondary Responsibilities – Engineering Documentation\- Develop and revise HVAC control drawings and wiring diagrams.\- Prepare project submittals, sequences of operation, and control documentation.\- Produce and maintain accurate as\-built drawings and project records.\- Review project specifications and mechanical drawings to support system design and implementation.\- Assist with estimating and technical review of building automation projects as needed.Required Qualifications\- Current Niagara N4 Certification is required.\- Minimum of 5 years of experience in building automation, HVAC controls, systems integration, or a closely related field.\- Demonstrated experience configuring, programming, integrating, and troubleshooting building automation systems.\- Working knowledge of commercial HVAC systems, control sequences, and network communications.\- Strong understanding of BACnet, Modbus, and other common building automation communication protocols.\- Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem\-solving skills.\- Ability to work independently, manage project responsibilities, and collaborate effectively with team members.\- Strong attention to detail and organizational skills.Preferred QualificationsExperience with one or more of the following platforms and tools is preferred:\- Distech Controls / EC\-Net.\- Trane building automation systems.\- Automated Logic / WebCTRL.\- Carrier i\-Vu.\- Johnson Controls building automation systems.\- AutoCAD, Visio, or similar software for developing control drawings and wiring diagrams.\- HVAC control submittals, sequences of operation, and as\-built documentation.\- Niagara\-based remote monitoring, system analytics, and third\-party equipment integration.Work Arrangement and Travel\- On\-site work is preferred, but remote work will be considered for a qualified candidate.\- The position is primarily office\-based or remote, depending on the candidate's work arrangement.\- Travel is expected to be limited, with the primary focus on systems integration, engineering, programming, and project support rather than routine field service or installation.What We're Looking ForWe are looking for someone who takes pride in producing reliable, well\-documented control systems. The ideal candidate is technically capable, detail\-oriented, and comfortable working across different manufacturers and platforms.This role is an excellent fit for a Niagara N4\-certified controls professional who enjoys the engineering and integration side of building automation rather than a position focused exclusively on field service or installation.Apply TodayIf you have at least five years of building automation experience, hold a Niagara N4 certification, and want to contribute to the integration and performance of modern building automation systems, we encourage you to apply.As a Controls Engineer, you’ll design, develop, and test control systems for industrial and manufacturing applications. Pay: From $100,000\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) * Flexible schedule * Retirement plan Work Location: Hybrid remote in Holland, OH 43528

jobs.description: **About Us** PrismHR is the leading payroll, benefits, and HR software for Human Resource Outsourcing (HRO) organizations, including Professional Employer Organizations (PEOs) and Administrative Service Organizations (ASOs). Powering more than 80,000\+ companies, 2\.5 million worksite employees, and $85 billion in payroll processed annually, PrismHR is the most efficient, reliable, and scalable software solution to help PEOs and ASOs grow and prosper. The PrismHR platform is a complete, integrated HR solution supporting the full "hire\-to\-retire” lifecycle of HR services. And PrismHR provides a wide range of additional resources that go beyond just technology and support: PrismHR SEEDS sales and marketing program, the annual PrismHR LIVE Conference, and numerous learning opportunities throughout the year are all designed specifically to help PrismHR customers grow their business. **Summary** We are seeking a skilled and motivated **Software Engineer** with 12\+ years of experience to design, build, test, and maintain core PrismHR software applications that power our customer\-facing businesses. In this role, you will collaborate with internal product teams and stakeholders to gather requirements and translate them into technical specifications. As part of a high\-performing engineering team, you will follow established best practices for code management and software development, perform code and security reviews, conduct integration testing, and implement existing DevOps procedures to support reliable software delivery. **Job Responsibilities** **Solution Design and Implementation** * Create efficient, scalable, and logical solution designs that meet business and customer requirements. * Understand and apply appropriate design methodologies and object\-oriented programming (OOP) principles. * Identify system deficiencies and implement effective, maintainable solutions. * Design and develop high\-quality software applications that support PrismHR's business objectives. **Coding Standards and Peer Reviews** * Follow, communicate, and reinforce established coding standards and development best practices. * Participate in peer code reviews to maintain code quality, readability, and consistency. * Perform code and security reviews to ensure compliance with organizational standards and security requirements. * Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives related to software quality and development practices. **Software Development** * Design, develop, test, debug, and maintain software solutions in a fast\-paced environment. * Write clean, efficient, and maintainable code using modern development frameworks and technologies. * Participate in troubleshooting and resolving production and application issues. * Seek and participate in professional development opportunities beyond required training. * Contribute to a collaborative, innovative, and high\-performing engineering culture. **Collaboration and Communication** * Work closely with internal product teams, business stakeholders, and other technical resources to gather and clarify requirements. * Translate business requirements into technical designs and implementation plans. * Provide technical expertise and recommendations during planning and design discussions. * Utilize strong interpersonal and communication skills to foster collaboration across teams. **Technical and DevOps Responsibilities** * Implement and follow established DevOps processes and deployment procedures. * Participate in integration testing to ensure seamless functionality across systems and applications. * Support continuous integration and continuous deployment (CI/CD) practices. * Assist in maintaining application performance, reliability, and scalability. **Additional Skills** **Core Competencies** * 12\+ years of experience with **C\#** and object\-oriented programming (OOP) methodologies. * 5\+ years of experience with the **ASP.NET Framework**, including **ASP.NET Core**. * 5\+ years of experience with modern front\-end JavaScript frameworks and component libraries such as: + Angular (preferred) + React + Vue * 5\+ years of experience in SQL database development, including: + Microsoft SQL Server + T\-SQL **Technical Expertise** * Experience developing solutions using **Microsoft Azure** serverless technologies, including: + Azure Functions + Azure Logic Apps * Strong understanding of RESTful services and API development technologies. * Experience designing, developing, and consuming APIs. * Experience with modern front\-end web development technologies, including: + HTML5 + CSS3 + JavaScript + TypeScript * Working knowledge of Agile software development methodologies, including: + Scrum + Kanban + Extreme Programming (XP) + Other Agile frameworks **Preferred Qualifications** * Additional hands\-on experience with **Angular** development. * Experience with Microsoft Azure cloud technologies, including: + Azure API Management (API Gateway) + Azure SQL Database + Azure App Services * Experience building and supporting cloud\-native applications in Azure environments. * Strong understanding of scalable application architecture and modern software engineering practices. PrismHR is a fast\-paced SaaS company which provides customers with a cloud\-based payroll process software application. PrismHR also provides professional services including system implementation consulting, custom configurations, and training. Lastly, via the Company’s Marketplace platform customers and end users access other human resources and employee benefits applications from PrismHR’s Marketplace Partners. **Diversity, Equity and Inclusion Program/Affirmative Action Plan:** We have transformed our company into an inclusive environment where individuals are valued for their talents and empowered to reach their fullest potential. At PrismHR, we strive to continually lead with our values and beliefs that enable our employees to develop their potential, bring their full self to work, and engage in a world of inclusion. Ensuring an inclusive environment for our employees is an integral part of the PrismHR culture. We aren't just checking a box, we are truly committed to creating a workplace that celebrates the diversity of our employees and fosters a sense of belonging for everyone. This is essential to our success. We are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about our roles but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for these open roles or other open roles. We particularly encourage applicants from traditionally under\-represented groups as we seek to increase the diversity of our workforce and provide fair opportunities for all. As a proud Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employer, PrismHR encourages talent from all backgrounds to join our team. Employment decisions are based on an individual’s qualifications as they relate to the job under consideration. jobs.title: Senior AI Engineer
jobs.description: **About us** ------------ **At Provectus**, you don’t prototype in a sandbox and hand a client a slide deck. You embed inside a bank, an insurer, or a health system, learn the work, and ship a Claude \+ AWS system into their real, regulated production — then you watch the business number move. We’re an Anthropic and AWS Partner with 150\+ certified architects. That means the newest models, real budgets, and problems that matter — without the layers, politics, and years\-to\-impact of a hundred\-thousand\-person firm. 350\+ builders, 100\+ customers in production, founder\-led since 2010, offices across North America, LATAM, and EMEA. **Why Provectus** ----------------- * **Frontier access — Anthropic Preferred Partner:** newest Claude models, real budgets, real problems. * **Real tasks (not scope), real deployment.** You go where the operating problem is and ship production code to real users, not slide decks that sit in a drive. * **Embedded, not engaged.** You are part of the customer’s team and inside their process — not a vendor running a project alongside it. Embedded is not staff\-augmented. * **Autonomous.** You own the work from framing through to production, visible to clients and founders. You own the method; nobody hands you a ticket. * **Your experience stays portable.** Every engagement is a new problem, often in a new industry, so your skills compound instead of narrowing to one product. No legacy\-maintenance grind, not a single stack. * **Craft \& growth** — build beside senior FDEs on a Claude\-certified team; a real platform (talks, OSS) to grow your name. * **We give you a stage:** Claude certification, conference talks, open\-source contributions, published work under your own name. ### **What you’ll do:** * Spend the first weeks of each engagement in the operator’s seat, learning the constraints from the inside, then rebuild the function from first principles alongside the client and a Forward Deployed Executive — and you are the one who builds it. * Be part of the customer’s team, inside their process; work on real tasks, not scoped deliverables, and own the method autonomously. * You won’t start from zero. Provectus builds industry Blueprints — working systems that have already shipped for a customer in your industry. Your engagement starts from that baseline, and what you learn in the field goes back into it. * Deliver across Cowork Activation, Agentic SDLC, and Blueprint Activations in Financial Services and Healthcare. * Help shape how leading enterprises adopt AI, from strategy through first deployment; help build the tooling and frameworks of a growing AI delivery practice. ### **What we look for:** * Typically 7\+ years building software, a substantial share of it writing production code you were accountable for. You are hands\-on today and intend to stay that way. * Genuinely willing to spend time understanding someone else’s job before writing code; demonstrated ability to become conversant in an unfamiliar business function quickly. * Shipped GenAI/LLM systems to production — not demos, not notebooks. You’ve handled the parts that get hard after the prototype works. * You evaluate. You have built or owned an eval suite for a non\-deterministic system, and you can explain what you measured and why. * Strong engineering fundamentals — dropped into an unfamiliar codebase or language, you’re productive. Python and/or TypeScript proficiency; depth matters more than stack. * Cloud\-native delivery on AWS (GCP/Azure a plus), including the operational reality of a system someone else inherits. * Pre\-sales experience. Credible with senior stakeholders — you can hold a redesign conversation with a BU head and a scoping conversation with a CTO without losing either room. * Comfort with ambiguity and ownership. Engagements start underspecified by design. Closing that gap is the job. * Hands\-on experience with Claude, Claude Code, and Cowork (skills, workflows, MCP, integrations, connectors, custom harnesses). ### **Nice to have:** * Containers and orchestration (Kubernetes/ECS) and CI/CD in production. * IaC depth: AWS CDK, CloudFormation, Terraform. * Open\-source contributions or public writing on applied AI. ### **What we offer:** * Full\-time. * On\-site visits to client’s facilities and our office in NYC 1/week * Unlimited Vacation policy. * Generous health, vision, and dental insurance. * 401(K) matching plan. * Base salary $180k–$200k \+ bonuses; OTE up to $250k. The salary range is determined through interviews and a review of the education, experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities of the applicant, and alignment with market data. * No Visa sponsorship ### **We’re real** * **A person reads your application.** We filter out AI\-generated and fraudulent submissions automatically. Every application that clears that filter is read by someone on our team. * **We may ask for a quick ID verification.** Fraudulent applications are common, and this protects real candidates. * **You’ll meet the people you’d work with.** We host AI engineering events in New York and San Francisco. We'd be happy to talk in person. Your interviews are with Pavel Borobov, Solutions Architect, and Stepan Pushkarev, Co\-Founder \& CEO. ### **How we hire:** * Recruitment interview. * Tech interview with our FDE (30 min). * A live engineering building session (1\.5 hours). We hand you a business function and the constraints. You have to understand the job and rebuild it — then say what you’d build and how you’d know it worked. ***Use AI the way you normally would; we expect AI\-generated code. What we look at is how you used AI, the judgment behind your choices, and what you researched beyond what any LLM already knows.*** * Soft skills interview. * Offer discussion. We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

jobs.title: AI Agent Engineer, AI Transformation
jobs.description: **About Psomagen** **Psomagen, Inc.** is a U.S. genomics services company headquartered in Maryland, operating CLIA/CAP\-certified laboratories. We provide sequencing, single\-cell, spatial, proteomics and bioinformatics services to academic, foundation, pharma and clinical customers. We are building AI into how the company operates, so that our teams spend less time on routine work and more time on science and customers. **About the role** We are looking for a hands\-on developer with real AI agent experience to lead Psomagen's company\-wide AI transformation. You will design, build and operate AI agents on top of the tools our teams use every day: Google Workspace, HubSpot, our in\-house LIMS and SAP. You will work directly with the CEO and with every function, identify where agents can remove manual work, ship them quickly, and keep them reliable in production. This is a builder role, not an advisory one. **What you'll do** * Design, develop and operate AI agents using Hermes and comparable agent frameworks, and keep the underlying models swappable as better ones appear * Connect agents to our business systems (Google Workspace, HubSpot, LIMS, SAP) and choose the right way to integrate each one, so that agents can read, draft and act within defined permissions * Work with sales, project management, lab operations, finance, regulatory/quality and IT to find high\-value workflows (for example quoting, customer communication, document management, reporting and internal Q\&A) and turn them into working agents * Build the supporting infrastructure: knowledge retrieval over company documents, evaluation and testing of agent outputs, logging, monitoring and cost control * Put guardrails in place: role\-based access, audit trails and human approval steps for actions that touch customers, finance or regulated records * Collaborate with our LIMS development and bioinformatics teams so that agents fit our existing systems and pipelines * Train employees to use agents effectively, gather feedback and keep improving what is deployed * Track new AI models, tools and practices, and bring in the ones that make a practical difference to the business **Required Qualifications** * Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in computer science, software engineering or a related field * 4\+ years of professional software development experience, with strong Python skills * Demonstrated experience building and operating LLM\-based agents in production or in substantial real\-world use (tool calling, multi\-step workflows, retrieval, prompt and context design, evaluation) * Current knowledge of frontier AI models and agent tooling, with the ability to explain trade\-offs among models, frameworks and cost * Experience connecting software or agents to business systems (for example Google Workspace, HubSpot, an ERP such as SAP, or similar), including authentication and permission design * Strong communication skills, and comfort working with non\-technical colleagues to understand their workflows * Awareness of data security and privacy requirements when AI handles customer, financial or health\-related data * Legally authorized to work in the U.S. **Preferred** * Experience with Hermes or similar open agent frameworks, and with Google Cloud * Hands\-on experience with Google Workspace administration and APIs, Apps Script, and HubSpot * Experience with LIMS, SAP or other laboratory and enterprise operations systems * Domain knowledge of sequencing services or genomics, especially bioinformatics (pipelines, workflow tools such as Airflow, QC and reporting) * Experience in a regulated environment (CLIA/CAP, ISO 9001 or ISO 27001\) * Experience with SQL and data pipelines **Compensation \& Benefits** * Base salary range: $70,000 to $140,000, depending on experience and qualifications, plus a performance\-based bonus * Benefits: \[medical/dental/vision, 401(k), PTO, etc.] Psomagen is an equal opportunity employer. **The pay range for this role is:** 70,000 \- 140,000 USD per year(Psomagen HQ)

jobs.title: Software Engineer - WMS Integration and Reporting (Hybrid)
jobs.description: Publix Super Markets, Inc., the largest employee\-owned company in the U.S., is driven by a dynamic technology team of 2,300\+ professionals delivering innovative solutions to 1,400\+ stores and 260,000\+ associates across 8 states. From IT security and platform engineering to architecture, software development, and infrastructure, we offer career opportunities at every level \- internships through technical leadership. Join a company consistently ranked among Fortune’s “100 Best **The Warehousing Modernization team is currently seeking a Software Engineer for modernizing Publix legacy warehousing systems. This key role involves participating in initiatives to modernize warehousing processes like receiving, integrating with other Warehousing Systems, and Reporting that currently supports our expanding distribution network, encompassing 9 Distribution Centers and 33 warehouses dedicated to servicing over 1200 retail stores.** **Location: Hybrid (Lakeland, FL):** To support our hybrid work model, candidates must reside, or be willing to relocate, within a commutable distance of Lakeland, FL. **Work Model:** Enjoy the best of both worlds \- collaborate in person and innovate remotely. **Interview Process:** Candidates selected to advance in the interview process will be required to participate in at least one onsite interview at our Lakeland, FL campus. **Why Join Us?*** **Hybrid Flexibility:** Work remotely when you need focus time and join us onsite for high\-impact collaboration and brainstorming sessions. * **Operational Efficiency:** Ensure technology solutions support efficient workflows and enable automation to improve operational effectiveness. * **Cutting\-Edge AI Projects:** Drive innovation in AI platforms, integrating advanced tools and frameworks to solve complex business challenges. * **Empowered Culture:** We value autonomy, creativity, and continuous learning—your ideas shape the future of technology in our organization. **Your impact:*** Design and develop enterprise\-grade technology solutions using modern methodologies (Agile and traditional) ensuring performance, scalability, stability, usability, and cross\-system integration while leveraging CI/CD pipelines (e.g., Azure DevOps, GitHub, etc.). * Analyze business and system requirements, user stories, and technical design artifacts to develop internal designs, program specifications, and product backlog items under guidance. * Collaborate with Architecture and Technical Leads to ensure alignment with enterprise standards, best practices, and solution designs. * Partner with Business Systems Analysts and Product Owners to validate business requirements and support solution delivery. * Develop, maintain, and automate unit test plans, test scripts, and test cases to ensure application quality and reliability. * Utilize development tools, including AI, and environments to efficiently code, unit test, debug, and manage application components throughout the development lifecycle. * Create and maintain comprehensive technical documentation, including solution designs, program specifications, and testing results. * Plan, coordinate, and support the deployment of technical solutions from testing environments to production under established guidance. * Troubleshoot, analyze, and resolve moderately complex application and production issues, escalating when appropriate. * Participate in on\-call rotation to support production systems and ensure operational continuity. \#LI\-JB1

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Agentic AI
jobs.description: *We're building an autonomous infrastructure engineering agent: think Claude Code, but for your cloud. If you're excited about agentic AI systems that solve impactful problems for engineers, developers, and security experts at innovative startups and iconic enterprises alike, this role is for you.* Neo is Pulumi's answer to what infrastructure engineering looks like in an AI\-first era. It's a virtual infrastructure teammate that understands your cloud environment, plans and executes multi\-step operations, and brings domain expertise to problems ranging from spinning up complex ML infrastructures to cloud migrations to continuous compliance enforcement. What makes Neo possible is infrastructure\-as\-code: by modeling cloud infrastructure in code space, we can leverage the fact that LLMs are already excellent at coding to affect cloud infrastructure changes. Combined with Pulumi's registry and petabytes of deployment history, we have a unique foundation for building infrastructure intelligence. We're looking for engineers to build all aspects of Neo: from agent orchestration and tool interfaces to the web experience where users watch Neo work, approve operations, and understand its reasoning, to the interface with the models and how we orchestrate and fine\-tune them to maximize impact. We seek bold thinkers to reimagine the entirety of cloud engineering. While Pulumi is headquartered in Seattle, WA., we are dedicated to being a remote first company. This role will be located remotely within the U.S., with a preference for candidates based in Pacific Time Zone locations. #### **Responsibilities** * Build the planning and execution systems that let Neo safely perform multi\-step infrastructure operations across AWS, Azure, GCP, Kubernetes, and more * Design tool interfaces that give the agent semantic understanding of cloud resources and access to engineering workflows * Develop the context systems that help Neo understand each customer's infrastructure patterns and usage * Create the feedback loops and self\-correction mechanisms that make autonomous operation reliable * Build evaluation frameworks to measure agent performance across Neo's capability areas: migrations, compliance, cost optimization, diagnostics, and more * Work on the web interface where Neo operates as a "virtual teammate"—task assignment, progress visibility, approval workflows * Integrate Neo's capabilities into Pulumi's MCP Server for agent\-to\-agent workflows * Collaborate with platform teams to deeply integrate agent capabilities into the CLI, SDKs, and Pulumi Cloud #### **You may be a good fit if you:** * Are genuinely excited about agentic AI—systems that plan, act, and adapt in the real world, not just generate text * Have built production systems using LLMs, including experience with skill design, tool use, function calling, and multi\-step orchestration * Care deeply about reliability and safety when AI systems take real actions with real consequences * Are comfortable across the stack—agent orchestration, backend services, and frontend interfaces * Write production\-grade Go (our primary language), with working proficiency in Python and TypeScript, and can pick up new environments quickly * Bring a product mindset: you think about what users need, not just what's technically interesting * Communicate clearly and work well with a distributed team #### **Strong candidates may also have:** * Experience with cloud infrastructure (AWS, Azure, GCP) or infrastructure\-as\-code tools * Background in building developer tools, CLIs, or platform engineering systems * Familiarity with container orchestration (Kubernetes, Docker) * Experience building evaluation frameworks and benchmarks for AI systems * Knowledge of prompt engineering, fine\-tuning, MCP, or retrieval\-augmented generation #### **Compensation** * Base Salary Hiring Range: $185,000 to 215,000 * All full\-time employee offers at Pulumi include base salary, bonus or variable, equity and benefits (details below). **Benefits \& Perks at Pulumi:** **Healthcare Coverage:** We offer comprehensive medical, dental, vision, and supplemental insurance at no cost to U.S. employees. Internationally, we comply with local healthcare requirements and provide regionally appropriate coverage. **Time Off:** Our unlimited PTO policy encourages balance and rest — and we require employees to take at least three weeks off annually, plus 13 U.S. holidays. **401(k):** U.S. employees are eligible for a 401(k) plan with an employer match to support long\-term financial wellness. **Parental Leave:** We provide 20 weeks of paid leave for birthing parents or primary caregivers, and 16 weeks for non\-birthing parents or secondary caregivers. **Remote\-First Culture:** Pulumi has been fully remote since 2020, with teammates across 20\+ U.S. states and 12\+ countries. We support flexible work with asynchronous collaboration and an annual "work from anywhere" stipend. **Professional Development:** Every employee receives an annual learning and development budget to support growth, learning, and career goals. **Equity Ownership:** We believe in acting like owners. All employees receive equity and are empowered to think big, move fast, and build the future of cloud together. **Additional Support:** We offer a monthly wellness fund to support mental and physical well\-being, and a quarterly happiness fund for team connection. **About Pulumi:** Pulumi is reimagining how teams build cloud software, enabling developers and infrastructure experts to work better together through a unique combination of programming languages, tools, and systems innovation. Our flagship infrastructure as code technology is open source and our SaaS product, Pulumi Cloud, provides platform teams, secrets management, and cloud management capabilities, and more. We have pioneered leveraging AI across all of these areas with our LLM\-powered Pulumi Copilot to push the boundaries of what's possible. At Pulumi, we dream big, in the pursuit of helping our customers out\-innovate and win. Founded in 2017 by industry veterans with over five decades of combined experience building developer platforms, Pulumi now has a global community of more than 350,000 members and serves over 3,250 customers. Despite our rapid growth, we're still only getting started, and are early in our mission to democratize the cloud. If you thrive in a fast\-paced, high\-performance, we want to work with you to accelerate Pulumi's impact. *At Pulumi, we don't just accept difference, we celebrate, support, and thrive on it for the benefit of our employees, our products, and our customers. Pulumi is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is committed to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know.*

jobs.title: Data & Analytics Engineer – Microsoft Fabric
jobs.description: Data \& Analytics Engineer – Microsoft Fabric **Location:** Irving, TX **Job Type:** Full\-time **Schedule:** Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM–5:00 PM **Salary:** $100,000–$120,000 per year **Work Setting:** Primarily in person About the Role Quantum Pain \& Spine is looking for a **Data \& Analytics Engineer** to help build and own the data foundation supporting a growing multi\-entity healthcare organization. We are building a centralized analytics environment in **Microsoft Fabric** that will bring together data from eClinicalWorks, HubSpot, financial and operational systems, and other business applications. This role sits between traditional data engineering and analytics engineering. We are not looking for someone focused primarily on massive distributed systems, streaming infrastructure, or highly complex data platforms. We need someone who can take source data, make it reliable and understandable, model it around real business questions, and deliver trusted datasets and reporting that leadership can actually use. The ideal candidate combines strong SQL and data\-modeling skills with practical Microsoft Fabric and Power BI experience and is comfortable working directly with business stakeholders. ResponsibilitiesMicrosoft Fabric \& Data Platform * Help design, build, and maintain our Microsoft Fabric environment. * Work with Fabric Lakehouse, Warehouse, pipelines, and related services. * Build and maintain reliable data pipelines from business systems. * Integrate data from sources including eClinicalWorks, HubSpot, spreadsheets, APIs, and other operational platforms. * Develop repeatable ingestion and transformation processes. * Monitor data refreshes, pipeline performance, and failures. * Help establish deployment, documentation, and data\-development standards. Analytics Engineering \& Data Modeling * Transform raw and standardized data into business\-ready analytical models. * Build dimensional and star\-schema models. * Develop curated Gold\-layer datasets for reporting and analysis. * Create reusable definitions for key business metrics. * Build and maintain semantic models for Power BI. * Work with DAX where needed to support reporting and analytical use cases. * Create data\-quality checks and reconciliation processes. * Investigate conflicting data and help determine reliable sources of truth. Reporting \& Business Analytics * Partner with Strategic Operations, Finance, Operations, and leadership to understand business questions. * Translate business requirements into datasets, models, and reporting solutions. * Build or support Power BI dashboards and reporting products. * Improve the reliability and consistency of existing reporting. * Reduce manual spreadsheet\-based reporting where appropriate. * Help develop analytics around financial/AR performance, referral performance, patient journeys, operational efficiency, and other business priorities. Data Governance \& Documentation * Document data sources, transformations, business definitions, and dependencies. * Help establish consistent data standards across the organization. * Identify data\-quality issues and work with operational teams to understand their root causes. * Help create scalable structures that make future analytics work easier and more reliable. * Support appropriate access controls for business and healthcare data. What We’re Looking For * Approximately 3–5 years of experience in data engineering, analytics engineering, BI engineering, or a similar role. * Strong SQL skills. * Strong understanding of dimensional modeling and star\-schema design. * Experience building business\-ready datasets from multiple source systems. * Experience with Microsoft Fabric or closely related Microsoft data technologies. * Experience with Power BI. * Understanding of semantic models and DAX. * Ability to investigate messy or conflicting data and determine how it should be reconciled. * Experience working directly with business stakeholders to translate questions into technical solutions. * Strong problem\-solving and documentation skills. * Ability to own projects from source data through final analytical product. Preferred Qualifications * Hands\-on Microsoft Fabric experience. * Experience with Fabric Lakehouse and/or Warehouse. * Experience with Power BI semantic models. * Experience integrating REST APIs or SaaS platforms. * Python experience. * Familiarity with Azure data services. * Experience with HubSpot data. * Healthcare analytics experience. * Experience with EHR data, particularly eClinicalWorks. * Experience with financial, revenue\-cycle, referral, or operational healthcare data. * Familiarity with data governance and healthcare privacy considerations. * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Analytics, Information Systems, Engineering, Statistics, or a related field. Equivalent practical experience is also welcome. Experience with PySpark, Databricks, or large\-scale distributed data technologies is useful but is **not the primary focus of this role**. What Success Looks Like Within the first several months, this person should: * Understand the organization’s major data sources and data\-quality challenges. * Establish a stable Microsoft Fabric development foundation. * Validate and organize eClinicalWorks data being shared into Fabric. * Begin integrating additional high\-value data sources. * Establish standards for business\-ready data models. * Deliver the first trusted end\-to\-end analytical products. * Reduce dependence on manually reconciled spreadsheets. * Give leadership faster access to consistent and explainable business information. Initial analytical priorities are expected to include: * Financial and accounts\-receivable visibility * Referral performance and conversion * Operational and patient\-journey analytics Work Environment This is primarily an **in\-person position in Irving, Texas**. Occasional remote work may be approved at manager discretion based on current projects, deadlines, and operational needs. Pay: $100,000\.00 \- $120,000\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) * 401(k) matching * Dental insurance * Health insurance * Life insurance * Paid time off * Vision insurance Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Customer Data Platform (CDP) & Personalization
jobs.description: **Description** At Realtor.com®, we help people discover and create their perfect home. We bring together real estate data, consumer experiences and technology to support people throughout their home journey. Realtor.com is building a Customer Data Platform on Twilio Segment so we can recognize consumers across web, apps, email and push and give each person an experience that fits where they are in their home search. It’s heading to production now, and we need engineers to help build and run it. We’re hiring a Software Engineer for the CDP’s serving path: the profile store and the Personalization Activation Subgraph, a federated GraphQL service between the CDP and our site and apps. Personalization has to be fast and safe. If anything is slow or down, users and search engines just get the standard page. The work is backend\-first but goes all the way to the screen. You’ll write resolvers and profile store code, wire the subgraph into our server\-rendered pages and CMS, and build the components that render each treatment, its fallback and its exposure events. Over time you’ll own treatments end to end, from the CDP trait to the pixel on the page. You’ll start alongside a senior engineer and our vendor, then help bring the platform in\-house with data engineering, Identity \& Authentication, Web Platform, Mobile, Notifications and MarTech. Top Reasons to Apply: * Help build a new platform with real executive sponsorship. * Work on a system that sits at the meeting point of identity, data and the consumer experience on one of the largest real estate sites in the U.S. * Grow quickly with senior engineers on work that spans backend, front end and data What You’ll Do: * Build and maintain an Apollo Federation v2 subgraph that serves profile traits, audiences and personalization decisions to web, CMS and native clients, using our schema conventions, resilience patterns (timeouts, circuit breakers, kill switches, flags) and router\-provided identity so a CDP failure never breaks a page. * Help build the RDC\-owned profile store and its refresh pipeline (event consumers, backfills, rate\-limited batching) to serve traits in single\-digit milliseconds, partnering with Web Platform on caching. * Bring personalization into server\-rendered React pages, islands and CMS experiments with Apollo Client components that load without flicker, never block the page and protect Core Web Vitals, with clean exposure and engagement tracking through Segment. * Help build the Kafka integration that sends identity events to the CDP without PII leakage, and enforce consent and opt\-out so suppressed users are never personalized or tracked. * Ship through EKS, Argo CD, Helm and CircleCI, join on\-call once ramped up, build the dashboards, alerts and runbooks for your services, and turn product requirements into flagged, A/B\-tested features with short design docs. What You’ll Bring: * 3\+ years of software engineering experience, including building and supporting services in production. * Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience. * Experience shipping user\-facing features across both a backend service and the UI. * Solid TypeScript/Node.js for backend work (our subgraphs are Node/TypeScript). * React and TypeScript on the front end, with some experience in server\-side rendering (Next.js or similar) and a GraphQL client such as Apollo Client. * Working knowledge of GraphQL APIs: schema design, resolvers and error handling. * Familiarity with caching and key\-value stores (Redis, DynamoDB or similar) and why latency matters for page rendering. * Understanding of basic resilience patterns: timeouts, retries and fallbacks. * Experience with AWS, Docker and CI/CD pipelines. * Habit of writing tests and adding logging and metrics to the code you ship. * Clear written communication and comfort asking questions and raising risks early. Preferred * Apollo Federation v2 experience: subgraphs, entities and @key, composition checks with Rover/GraphOS. * Hands\-on work with a Customer Data Platform, ideally Twilio Segment (Engage audiences, computed traits, Profile API, Destinations). mParticle, Tealium, Braze or Amperity also count. * Kafka or another event streaming system, including idempotency and ordering. * Core Web Vitals (LCP, INP, CLS) and front\-end performance tuning. * Feature flag and experimentation tools (LaunchDarkly, Amplitude Experiment, Optimizely) and exposure logging. * OAuth 2\.0/OIDC and JWT basics, or identity platforms like Auth0 or Okta. * Client\-side analytics (Segment analytics.js, Amplitude or similar). * Kubernetes, Argo CD, Helm and Terraform. * Observability tools such as New Relic or Datadog. * Awareness of privacy requirements around PII, consent and opt\-out (CCPA/CPRA). * Micro\-frontend, design system or headless CMS experience. How We Work: We balance creativity and innovation on a foundation of in\-person collaboration. For most roles, our employees work four or more days in our offices, where they have the opportunity to collaborate in\-person, adding richness to our culture and knitting us closer together. How We Reward You: Realtor.com is committed to investing in the health and wellbeing of our employees and their families. Our benefits programs include, but are not limited to: * Inclusive and Competitive medical, Rx, dental, and vision coverage * Family forming benefits * 13 Paid Holidays * Flexible Time Off * 8 hours of paid Volunteer Time off * Immediate eligibility into Company 401(k) plan with 3\.5% company match * Tuition Reimbursement program for degreed and non\-degreed programs * 1:1 personalized Financial Planning Sessions * Student Debt Retirement Savings Match program * Free snacks and refreshments in each office location Do the best work of your life at Realtor.com® Here, you’ll partner with a diverse team of experts as you use leading\-edge tech to empower everyone to meet a crucial goal: finding their way home. And you’ll find your way home too. At Realtor.com®, you’ll bring your full self to work as you innovate with speed, serve our consumers, and champion your teammates. In return, we’ll provide you with a warm, welcoming, and inclusive culture; intellectual challenges; and the development opportunities you need to grow. Diversity is important to us, therefore, Realtor.com® is an Equal Opportunity Employer regardless of age, color, national origin, race, religion, creed, gender, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity and/or expression, marital status, status as a disabled veteran and/or veteran of the Vietnam Era or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local law. In addition, Realtor.com® will provide reasonable accommodations for otherwise qualified disabled individuals. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans.
