jobs.title: Digital Print Manufacturing Engineer (Atlanta)
jobs.description: **Digital Print Manufacturing Engineer** *Onsite, based in Kennesaw (Atlanta), GA* **Position Summary** RPI Print is the AI\-enabled technology platform behind the world's leading creative brands, giving businesses of all sizes a single partner for printing, eCommerce fulfillment, and logistics—so they can focus on building their business instead of how their products get made, sold, and shipped. Through its API connection to a platform integrating seamless workflow technology, manufacturing, and global fulfillment, RPI Print delivers consistent, premium quality at any scale while its print\-on\-demand model reduces waste. RPI Print is also the platform behind Blurb (www.blurb.com), the premier bookmaking and self\-publishing destination for creative professionals, businesses, and everyday storytellers alike. To learn more, visit www.rpiprint.com. We are looking for a highly motivated **Digital Print Manufacturing Engineer t**o lead process development and optimization across our digital print production environment. This role requires expertise in digital printing technologies, pre\-press workflows, and print production validation. The ideal candidate will drive quality, efficiency, and innovation in a fast\-paced, high\-volume digital print setting. **Key Responsibilities** * Collaborate with design, prepress, and operations teams to ensure seamless end\-to\-end production. * Review proposed project scopes and provide input to optimize manufacturing efficiency. * Develop, draft, and implement comprehensive test plans based on project scope, requirements, and objectives to ensure accurate validation and quality outcomes. * Develop and execute validation protocols for new digital print products, processes, substrates, and equipment. * Conduct print trials, performance testing, and documentation to ensure production readiness and compliance. * Partner with quality and regulatory teams to maintain validation standards. * Monitor print output for defects and inconsistencies; assist in root cause analysis and corrective actions. * Maintain and update an accurate database of Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), ensuring thorough documentation of materials testing, pre\-press adjustments, and work instructions to support production consistency and compliance. * Assist and conduct hands\-on training sessions for operators on digital print best practices, ensuring adherence to quality standards, operational efficiency, and equipment safety. **Qualifications** * 3\+ years of experience in digital print manufacturing, with strong exposure to pre\-press and production validation. * Experience with digital print platforms such as HP Indigo, Xerox, Canon, or similar. * Understanding of lean manufacturing, Six Sigma, or other process improvement methodologies. * Excellent analytical, documentation, and communication skills. * Self\-driven and motivated, with the ability to work independently and take initiative * Strong team player who thrives in collaborative environments * Demonstrates ownership of tasks and a proactive approach to problem\-solving * Demonstrates flexibility and willingness to travel to other company locations as required to support operational needs and cross\-site collaboration **Preferred Skills** * Experience with web\-to\-print workflows * Knowledge of RIP software (e.g., HP, Fiery, etc), Adobe Creative Suite, and color management * Familiarity with automation tools and digital press APIs * Experience with Rotary Die Cutting, Guillotine, and Book Binding equipment * Knowledge of substrate behavior and ink interaction in digital environments * Project management experience in a digital print or commercial print setting * Ability to support future state strategies through equipment and automation investigations and implementations * Define opportunities to improve KPI's related to cost reductions and performance improvements. * Identify methods to reduce waste and improve utilization of equipment. If you believe you're a good fit for this role and share our passion for excellence, we'd love to hear from you!

jobs.title: Staff AI Engineer
jobs.description: ***Posting Type*** Remote/Hybrid ***Job Overview*** WHO WE ARE Relativity is a leading legal data intelligence company building technology that helps users organize data, discover the truth, and act on it with confidence. Our AI\-powered, cloud platform, RelativityOne, transforms massive volumes of complex information into actionable insights for litigation, investigations, regulatory inquiries, data breach responses, and other high\-stakes legal work where accuracy and trust are crucial. The world’s largest law firms, corporations, and government agencies rely on Relativity’s legal AI software to securely surface and manage the most relevant and impactful information in their matters. Beyond our commercial impact, we are committed to expanding access to technology and supporting pro bono legal work. WHAT WE DO AI engineers at Relativity build and operate the AI/ML systems behind privacy programs, confidential information detection, and misconduct detection at production scale and under real legal stakes. The work spans building, deploying, and operating AI/ML systems, the data platforms that feed them, and the architecture that ties them together. ***Job Description and Requirements*** **ABOUT THE ROLE** This role sits within Data Breach Response (DBR) engineering, which comprises four teams distributed across North America and Poland. DBR is an AI\-powered product that helps identify and respond to data breaches at scale, against strict regulatory deadlines and tight timelines. **WHAT YOU’LL DO** * Architect end\-to\-end AI/ML solutions, applying reliability, scalability, security, cost, and maintainability principles across the AI/ML lifecycle. * Build the AI Engineering discipline in DBR and the broader engineering organization. * Work across Relativity to elevate AI Engineering practices and standards. * Mentor junior AI Engineers, as well as senior and lead engineers. * Partner with product and engineering leadership to define the AI strategy for DBR. * Lead execution of the AI strategy across DBR engineering teams. * Build, deploy, monitor, and operate AI/ML systems in production, including pipelines and evaluation harnesses used by Applied Science. * Build and operate the data pipelines and platforms that feed AI/ML systems, partnering with Product, Applied Science, and DevOps. * Determine how data, models, services, and deployment patterns fit together, balancing latency, throughput, accuracy, and regulatory constraints. * Prevent problems through system design and automation, build alerting, conduct root cause analysis, and share learnings. * Communicate risks and technical decisions across stakeholders. **WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR** **Required** * 10\+ years of experience designing, building, and operating cloud\-native distributed systems, including 5\+ years focused on AI/ML systems and data platforms in production at scale. * Technical leadership across multiple teams or domains, with experience setting direction and aligning teams on architecture decisions. * Background in AI/ML architecture, data engineering, and security at scale. * Fluency with ML frameworks and tooling used to deploy, monitor, and operate models and build the infrastructure against which Applied Science evaluates them. * Experience translating business goals into technical strategy. * Experience with AI/ML Engineering, Data Engineering, MLOps, Distributed Systems, Cloud Architecture, Technical Leadership, and Responsible AI or Governance. **Preferred** * Experience shaping data platforms, evaluation infrastructure, or AI governance standards. * Track record of driving organization\-wide AI/ML engineering improvements in regulated or large\-scale environments. **WHY WE COULD BE A GREAT FIT** **Impactful Mission** * Build systems that help customers organize data, discover the truth, and act on it in high\-stakes legal matters. **Engineering at Scale** * Work on distributed, cloud\-native systems that process large volumes of data. **Cutting\-Edge Technology** * Build with AI, cloud platforms, and scalable architectures shaping legal tech. **Growth and Ownership** * Gain experience owning systems end\-to\-end across cloud and distributed environments. **Collaborative Culture** * Work in a team focused on knowledge sharing and continuous improvement. **Inclusive Environment** * Diverse perspectives create stronger teams and better outcomes. **Compensation and Benefits** * Competitive salary, benefits, DTO, parental leave, and equity program. **Relativity is committed to competitive, fair, and equitable compensation practices.** This position is eligible for total compensation which includes a competitive base salary, an annual performance bonus, and long\-term incentives. The expected salary range for this role is between following values: $205,000 and $307,000 The final offered salary will be based on several factors, including but not limited to the candidate's depth of experience, skill set, qualifications, and internal pay equity. Hiring at the top end of the range would not be typical, to allow for future meaningful salary growth in this position. **Required Skills:** Algorithms, Artificial Intelligence (AI), Big Data, Cloud Computing, Data Science, Deep Learning, Distributed Systems, Natural Language, Python (Programming Language), Software Engineering

jobs.title: Data & Analytics Engineer
jobs.description: **Job Description** =================== **Primary Objective of Position** The data and analytics capabilities supporting Revelyst positioned in our Irvine, California office. This is a hands\-on technical role responsible for developing and supporting data pipelines, data models, reporting solutions, and the underlying analytics environment that enables reliable business decision\-making. This position will serve as a key technical resource for the enterprise data ecosystem, working across enterprise platforms including ERP, CRM, e\-commerce/B2B, custom applications, and other operational data sources. The role will partner closely with Finance, business analysts, application teams, and external technology partners to ensure data is accessible, reliable, appropriately governed, and structured for reporting and analytics. The successful candidate will combine strong data engineering fundamentals, including hands\-on Databricks and Spark experience, with working business intelligence experience and an interest in growing into broader data architecture and platform ownership responsibilities. **Key Responsibilities** * Design, develop, maintain, and support data pipelines and integrations across enterprise applications, APIs, databases, and cloud data platforms such as Databricks and Microsoft Fabric. * Build and maintain scalable data models, transformations, and ETL/ELT processes that provide reliable, usable data for reporting and analytics. * Implement pipeline orchestration, monitoring, alerting, and automated data\-quality checks to keep production data flows reliable and observable. * Develop and support Power BI datasets, semantic models, dashboards, and reports supporting Finance, Sales, Operations, Supply Chain, and other business functions. * Monitor and support the Golf data and analytics environment, troubleshooting pipeline failures, reporting issues, performance problems, and data discrepancies. * Identify data\-quality and normalization issues and partner with business and application owners to improve data accuracy, consistency, and governance. * Support and evolve the data architecture, including transitioning knowledge and ownership of the existing Microsoft Fabric environment from external partners. * Partner with business analysts, application teams, and technology partners to translate business and reporting needs into scalable technical solutions. Identify opportunities to simplify and automate the data environment while helping build a foundation that supports future analytics, AI, and automation capabilities. * **Minimum Qualifications** * 3\+ years of experience in data engineering, business intelligence, analytics engineering, or a related technical role. * Strong SQL skills and experience working with relational and analytical datasets. * Experience with Git\-based version control and engineering practices such as code review, CI/CD, and automated testing of data pipelines. * Hands\-on experience developing and supporting ETL/ELT pipelines, data transformations, and data models. * Proficiency in Python for data engineering, transformation, and automation. * Hands\-on experience with Power BI, including data modeling, dashboards, reports, and semantic models. * Experience working with a cloud data platform, data warehouse, lakehouse, or similar analytics environment. * Experience integrating and working with data from multiple business systems, databases, APIs, or other data sources. * Strong troubleshooting and problem\-solving skills, including the ability to investigate data\-quality, pipeline, reporting, and performance issues. * Strong communication and collaboration skills with the ability to work effectively with both technical and business teams. Equivalent professional experience and demonstrated technical capability will be considered in place of formal education requirements. * **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience with Microsoft Fabric, Azure Data Factory, Azure Synapse, Databricks, or similar modern cloud data platforms. * Experience integrating data from SAP or Oracle ERP, Salesforce CRM, e\-commerce/B2B, and other enterprise business applications. * Experience working with financial, sales, inventory, customer, supply chain, or other operational business data. * Familiarity with Python or other scripting languages commonly used in data engineering and automation. * Experience supporting production data and reporting environments, including monitoring, troubleshooting, and performance optimization. * Exposure to data governance, data\-quality management, AI/advanced analytics, or modern data architecture practices. Experience in working with Ecomm/subscriptions/software business model. * **Key Soft Skills** * Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with a natural curiosity to understand how data, systems, and business processes connect. * Proactive and resourceful, with the ability to independently investigate issues and drive solutions through completion. * Strong attention to detail while maintaining an understanding of broader business objectives and priorities. * Effective communicator who can translate technical concepts and data issues for both technical and non\-technical stakeholders. * Collaborative and comfortable partnering across business teams, application teams, analysts, and external technology partners. Adaptable and comfortable working across multiple priorities in a small, fast\-moving technology environment. * \#LI\-BC1 **Pay Range:** Annual Salary: $100,000\.00 \- $120,000\.00 The actual annual salary offered to a candidate will be based on variables including experience, geographic location, education, and skills/achievements, and will be mutually agreed upon at the time of offer. We offer a highly competitive salary, comprehensive benefits including: medical and dental, vision, disability and life insurance, 401K, PTO, paid holidays, gear discounts and the ability to add value to an exciting mission! Our Postings are not intended for distribution to or use in any jurisdiction, country or territory where such distribution or use would violate local law or would subject us to any regulations in another jurisdiction, country or territory. We reserve the right to limit our Postings in any jurisdiction, country or territory. Equal Opportunity Employer Protected Veteran/Disabled

jobs.title: Solution Engineer
jobs.description: Revinate is the hotel data activation platform for hotels, groups, resorts, and enterprise brands. Every hotel has that guest: years of stays, the same room, never skips the spa. But their story sits scattered across the PMS, the booking engine, the spa system, and whoever happened to be on shift. Revinate brings that story together. We connect and clean guest data from every system into Rich Guest Profile® data, then put it to work for the people who look after guests. Reservations answers the phone already knowing the guest. Marketing sends the spa offer to the guest who raved about the spa. Behind it all, Ivy, our AI intelligence layer trained on 17 years of hospitality data, reads the patterns and handles the digital labor. Revinate powers 1\.1 billion Rich Guest Profile® data points across 12,500\+ hotels, driving over $24 billion in direct revenue. Get Revinate. Get superpowers. **Role Overview** The Solution Engineer is the primary technical and product expert for Revinate’s sales force. You will support regional and global sales teams by understanding complex customer business problems and requirements and articulate those into solutions. Leveraging deep technical expertise and comprehensive hospitality domain knowledge, you will take a consultative approach to architecting, validating, and presenting complex, custom platform solutions that align with critical client needs. As a Solution Engineer, you will collaborate with Product Management and Product Marketing to deliver the right solution and high quality products to Revinate clients in easy\-to\-understand terms. You will be the bridge between the sales team and technical team during implementation to ensure a successful launch. This position will require travel to support business development activities such as conferences, trade shows, and client presentations. ### **What You'll Do** * Be a product, industry, and technical expert in software for the sales team and clients * Provide clarity and leadership in prospect and client engagements of direct revenue\-generating solutions and associated value propositions * Deep Dive Consultation: Conduct sophisticated discovery sessions to uncover critical business and technical requirements, translating them into robust, multi\-product solution blueprints, which may also involve partner solutions * Deliver high quality demos with clear objectives, success criteria and scope control (where required) to successfully position the value of Revinate solutions * Talk confidently about the CDP landscape, and how technology continues to evolve across the software industry * Respond to RFIs, RFPs, Infosec Questionnaires and assist in building a repository of the latest product knowledge * Draft and present business case data for client requested product enhancements, including identification of business impact to product management * Own technical sales FAQs and make sure that answers to technology questions (e.g. availability, disaster recovery, PCI) are consistent and derived from current and accurate data * Executive Presentation: Independently present and defend complex technical architectures and value propositions to C\-level executives (e.g., CIO, CTO, CMO) at major hotel brands, ownership groups, and large\-scale enterprises * Consult early in the sales process with Product Management on one\-off opportunities to ensure customer expectations are well met * Act as a key account strategist; using ability to reference past client solution approaches to enable successful orchestration of new partnerships * Assist with product training and onboarding of new sales reps and solution engineers * Travel throughout sales territory, as needed * Represent Revinate at business development events, as needed ### **What You'll Bring** * 5 \+ years of progressive experience in a Solution Engineering, Sales Engineering, or Technical Architecture role, preferably within a SaaS, MarTech, Contact Center or Revenue Management platform environment. * Deep Domain Expertise: Expert\-level knowledge of the hospitality industry ecosystem, including PMS, CRS, CRM, booking engines, data warehouse structures, Call Center Technology and common API standards (e.g., HTNG) is preferred * Technical Acumen: Demonstrated mastery in discussing, architecting, and troubleshooting complex RESTful APIs, webhooks, SSO (SAML/OAuth), data security (PCI/GDPR), and cloud infrastructure concepts. * Confidence in leading conversations, owning relationships with technical counterparts, and driving projects forward * Ability to work across organization and promote cross functional collaboration * Consultative problem solver * Organized and analytical, able to eliminate sales obstacles through creative and adaptive approaches * Leverage technology solutions for supporting business goals * Self\-motivated with a history of outstanding performance in your role * Ability to demonstrate, communicate and document the value proposition, appropriate solution and unique market positioning * Comfortable in the dynamic atmosphere of a technical organization with a rapidly expanding customer base * Comfortable seeking requirements from and presenting recommendations to executive audiences in hospitality (corporate, ownership, and property) * Embrace being part of a sales organization and competing for business * Contribute to the development of standardized processes and best practices * Project specific responsibilities working within budget/timeline and scopes **Level and Compensation** We’re considering candidates for this role at two levels: Solutions Engineer and Senior Solutions Engineer. The level we offer will depend on the full picture of your background, including: * **Relevant experience:** time spent in solutions engineering, sales engineering or a similar role, and in \[industry/field] * **Scope of responsibility:** the complexity of the deals, customers and projects you’ve owned, and how independently you’ve worked * **Technical aptitude:** your depth of technical knowledge and how well you translate it into solutions for customers We’ll assess these throughout the interview process and match you to the level that best fits your experience. Compensation for this role is made up of 80% base salary and 20% variable pay. The expected ranges for US\-based candidates are: **Solutions Engineer** * Base salary: $90,000 \- $126,000 * On\-target earnings (OTE): $113,000 \- $140,000 **Senior Solutions Engineer** * Base salary: $116,000 \- $150,000 * On\-target earnings (OTE): $145,000 \- $185,000 Where you fall within each range depends on your skills, experience and location. If you don’t meet every qualification but think you’d be a strong fit, we encourage you to apply. **Excited?! Want to learn more? Apply Now!** ***Our Core Values:*** One Revinate \- United \& Strong, on a single mission together Built on Trust \- It’s the foundation of everything we do Expect Amazing \- We think, dream \& deliver big Customer Love \- When the customer wins, we win Make it Simpler \- Apply it to everything we do Hungerness \- Feel it, follow it, be relentless about our success Grounded in Gratitude \- We’re glad to be here \& make the most of every day Revinate Inc. provides Equal Employment Opportunity to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender identity or expression, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, amnesty, or status as a covered veteran in accordance with applicable federal, state and local laws. Revinate complies with applicable state and local laws governing non\-discrimination in employment in every location in which the company has facilities. Revinate is not open to third party solicitation or resumes for our posted FTE positions. Resumes received from third party agencies that are unsolicited will be considered complementary. If you are in need of accommodation or special assistance to navigate our website or to complete your application, please send an e\-mail with your request to recruiting@revinate.com. By submitting your application you acknowledge that you have read Revinate's Privacy Policy (https://www.revinate.com/privacy/) We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

jobs.title: Platform Engineer
jobs.description: **Company Description** HarmonEyes is the world's only open, AI\-powered eye\-tracking platform that identifies and predicts a person's cognitive, emotional, and physical state based on eye movements alone. Compatible with any camera\-based device, HarmonEyes provides a one\-stop shop to analyze eye\-tracking data, develop models, and deploy solutions to applications at scale with the Theia™ SDK. Backed by 60\+ years of eye\-tracking experience and born from the largest validated eye\-tracking database (14 million unique records), HarmonEyes is used by the world's leading organizations in technology, aviation/automotive, healthcare, and elite performance in military and sports. **Job Description** **Job Description** As a Platform Engineer, you'll build and own the software that takes our ML models from research to production: the Theia SDK that runs real\-time inference at the edge, the APIs and services our customers and partners integrate with, and the cloud infrastructure behind our data and model pipelines. You'll work closely with our ML engineers and researchers, so you'll need to understand how models are trained, evaluated, and deployed, but your core focus is building reliable, well\-designed systems around them. **What You'll Do** * **SDK Development:** Design, build, and maintain the Theia SDK in Python and C\+\+, delivering real\-time eye\-tracking inference across desktop, mobile, embedded, and XR platforms. Own packaging, performance, versioning, and the developer experience. * **API \& Backend Development:** Design and implement APIs and backend services for data ingestion, model serving, licensing, and customer integrations, with a focus on clean interfaces, reliability, and security. * **Cloud Engineering:** Build and operate infrastructure on AWS, including containerized services on Kubernetes, infrastructure\-as\-code, CI/CD, and monitoring. * **Full Stack:** Build internal tools, dashboards, and customer\-facing web interfaces that make our data and models accessible. * **Data Science Engineering:** Build and scale the pipelines that process millions of eye\-tracking records for training, evaluation, and analytics. Clean, transform, validate, and analyze large tabular datasets, and build the tooling that lets our ML team explore and work with data efficiently. * **ML Productionization:** Partner with ML engineers to deploy, optimize, and monitor models in production and at the edge, including model conversion, latency and memory optimization, and inference pipelines. **Qualifications** **Qualifications** *Required* * 2–4 years of professional software engineering experience building production systems * Strong Python skills, including packaging and distributing libraries * Working familiarity with C\+\+ (reading, modifying, and building C\+\+ code in a cross\-platform codebase) * Experience designing and building APIs (REST, gRPC, or similar) and backend services * Hands\-on experience with AWS, containers, and CI/CD * Experience working with large tabular datasets in pandas (data cleaning, transformation, aggregation, and performance at scale) * Working familiarity with machine learning: you understand the model lifecycle and have helped deploy or integrate ML models in a product * Strong communication skills and comfort working across engineering and research teams *Nice to Have* * Experience building and shipping SDKs or libraries used by external developers * SQL and database engineering (schema design, query optimization, PostgreSQL or similar) * Kubernetes and infrastructure\-as\-code (Terraform or similar) * Frontend experience (React or similar) * Edge or on\-device inference (ONNX Runtime, TensorRT, TFLite, Core ML, or similar) * Python compilation or distribution tooling (Nuitka, Cython, pybind11, or similar) * Exposure to time\-series, sensor, or signal\-processing data * Interest in VR/AR, eye tracking, or human\-computer interaction * 1 year experience in a research setting (developing or working with ML research domains) **Additional Information** **Why Join Us** * Remote role with room to grow into automation, tooling, and AI\-engineering work—not a pure manual\-QA seat * Direct exposure to a novel technical stack: real\-time eye\-tracking, ML pipelines, SDKs, and VR/AR integrations * Tight feedback loop with senior engineering and leadership—the work you ship is felt across the company How to Apply This position reports into the engineering team. We're looking for someone who pairs solid QA fundamentals with curiosity for automation and AI\-assisted workflows. With your submission please attach: * Your resume * GitHub profile, portfolio, or links to relevant work (test suites, scripts, automations welcome) * A short note on a bug you're proud of finding—or an automation/script that saved you or your team meaningful time

jobs.title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer - AI Cloud
jobs.description: **About Rippling** ------------------ Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system. Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third\-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds. Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1\.4B\+ from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes. We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses. **About the role** At Rippling, we are not just building AI features, we are building an autonomous operating system for work. We are investing heavily in the next generation of enterprise AI: intelligent background automation, systems that monitor and improve themselves, and a custom intelligence layer built on Rippling's unique data and workflows. The opportunity is to push the boundaries of what machine learning can do in the enterprise through purpose\-built ML systems that learn from Rippling's proprietary data graph to deliver compounding intelligence across every product surface. You will be joining the team that recently launched Rippling AI, the fastest\-growing product in Rippling's history. The models and ML systems you build will be the intelligence powering every AI surface at Rippling. As a Senior Machine Learning Engineer, you will own the end\-to\-end ML lifecycle for projects within the AI Cloud team: problem formulation, data preparation, model development, evaluation, and production deployment. You will partner with Staff engineers and cross\-functional teammates to make Rippling's agents reliable, accurate, and continuously improving. This is a deeply hands\-on role, with opportunities to lead project\-level technical decisions and contribute to the team's broader ML direction. **What you will do** * Own the end\-to\-end machine learning lifecycle for high\-impact AI projects, from problem definition through production deployment and iteration. * Design and implement ML systems—including fine\-tuned LLMs, RAG, reward models, and multi\-agent orchestration—tailored to Rippling's enterprise domain. * Build robust evaluation and experimentation capabilities: offline benchmarks, A/B testing, and continuous monitoring of model quality. * Develop training pipelines and data flywheels that leverage Rippling's structured data graph. * Take ML techniques from research to production: evaluate where RLHF, distillation, structured decoding, and tool\-use training can improve model quality, reliability, and efficiency. * Build and improve feedback loops, active learning workflows, and automated retraining pipelines. * Partner closely with Product and Platform teams to translate requirements into reliable ML systems and deliver measurable product improvements. * Contribute to design and code reviews, share ML best practices, and mentor engineers within the team. * Stay current with ML research and apply relevant advances to production systems. **What you will need** * 5\+ years of software engineering experience, including 3\+ years focused on ML, with experience shipping and operating ML systems in production. * Strong practical experience with modern ML, including LLMs, transformer architectures, fine\-tuning, and RAG; familiarity with RLHF or related model\-alignment techniques. * Strong fundamentals in classical ML and statistics. * Hands\-on proficiency with ML frameworks such as PyTorch or JAX and production ML infrastructure. * Experience building evaluation systems for generative AI. * Demonstrated ability to independently deliver complex ML projects, make sound technical tradeoffs, and collaborate across functions. * Strong product instincts and an ability to connect model improvements to customer outcomes. * Clear, precise communication to diverse audiences. * Comfort with ambiguity and high velocity. * Publications in top ML venues (NeurIPS, ICML, ACL, EMNLP) are a plus. * Experience with enterprise data or knowledge graphs is a plus. **Additional Information** Rippling is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce and do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, veteran or military status, or any other legally protected characteristics, Rippling is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities who need assistance during the hiring process. To request a reasonable accommodation, please email accommodations@rippling.com Rippling highly values having employees working in\-office to foster a collaborative work environment and company culture. For office\-based employees (employees who live within a defined radius of a Rippling office), Rippling considers working in the office, at least three days a week under current policy, to be an essential function of the employee's role. This role will receive a competitive salary \+ benefits \+ equity. The salary for US\-based employees will be aligned with one of the ranges below based on location; see which tier applies to your location here A variety of factors are considered when determining someone’s compensation–including a candidate’s professional background, experience, and location. Final offer amounts may vary from the amounts listed below. **The pay range for this role is:** 172,800 \- 288,000 USD per year(US Tier 1\)

jobs.title: Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning Engineer
jobs.description: ### **RESULTS. INNOVATION. VALUES. ACCOUNTABILITY.** That's RIVA. We're a mission\-driven IT services company and systems integrator supporting digital transformation and modernization for federal government agencies. Since 2009, we've partnered with our customers to solve complex challenges through smart, practical innovation to deliver real outcomes where they matter most. Our teams are made up of industry\-leading experts who are passionate about doing great work and making a difference. We don't just develop solutions, we support efforts that strengthen communities and serve the public good. RIVA's culture is built on four core values: Results, Innovation, Values, and Accountability. They guide how we work, how we collaborate, and how we measure success. Our employee\-first approach is rooted in trust, ownership, and meaningful work. By investing in our people and fostering a flexible, supportive environment, employees have the opportunity to grow their skills, contribute ideas, and make an impact from day one. all while supporting missions that matter. ### **POSITION OVERVIEW** RIVA Solutions seeks an AI Subject Matter Expert to support the USPTO P\-TACTS program, the Patent Trial and Appeal Board (PTAB) case tracking and electronic filing system. You will design, build, and evaluate production AI solutions that turn unstructured legal filings into reliable, structured data. A current example: a pipeline that reads PTAB petitions, institution decisions, and final written decisions, then extracts trial\-level and claim\-level outcomes. The team measures the pipeline against analyst\-labeled ground truth. The output supports reporting that PTAB delivers to Congress. You will work mainly in Python on Databricks, inside a secured federal environment. Development runs on remote instances through VPN. LLM access runs through an agency AI gateway, and approved models trail the commercial market. You will work directly with government stakeholders and engineers to turn mission needs into working, maintainable, and measurable applications. ### **WHAT YOU WILL DO** * Build LLM pipelines that extract structured data from long, unstructured legal documents. * Decide when a task needs a flexible agentic harness and when it needs a constrained, step\-by\-step pipeline. Build either one. * Validate model outputs against schemas, allowed values, and business rules. Handle failures without losing records silently. * Design evaluations against ground truth. Choose the right metric for the problem, run error analysis, and report results in plain terms. * Use AI coding tools such as Claude Code every day to build, test, and review code. * Keep pipelines stable as approved models change, using version pinning, regression test sets, and prompt versioning. * Advise the customer on future use cases, including fine\-tuning small language models or adapters when the data supports it. ### **MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, or a related field. * 5\+ years of applied ML, data science, or AI engineering experience, including 2\+ years building applications on large language models in production or near\-production settings. * Strong Python skills, including data work with pandas or PySpark. * Solid ML fundamentals: classification, train and test splits, overfitting, data leakage, and model selection. * Hands\-on evaluation skill: precision, recall, F1, confusion matrices, class imbalance, and comparison to labeled ground truth. * Production experience building with LLM APIs, including structured output, tool calling, and prompt design. * Experience building or debugging an agent harness, and the judgment to explain when a structured pipeline is the better choice. * Experience validating LLM output with schemas (for example, Pydantic or JSON Schema), retries, and exception handling. * Daily use of AI coding assistants such as Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, or GitHub Copilot. * Hands\-on experience building and running ML or LLM workloads on Databricks or a major cloud platform (AWS, Azure, or GCP). Examples: data pipelines in PySpark or notebooks, calling hosted models through Databricks Model Serving, Amazon Bedrock, Amazon SageMaker, Azure OpenAI, Azure Machine Learning, or Vertex AI, and tracking experiments in MLflow. * AWS Certified Machine Learning Engineer \- Associate, or an equivalent cloud ML certification. An active AWS Certified Machine Learning \- Specialty also counts. * Eligibility to obtain a USPTO Public Trust and authorization to work in the U.S. ### **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS** * Databricks experience, including Jobs, Delta Lake, MLflow, and Unity Catalog. PyTorch experience, including fine\-tuning small language models or training LoRA adapters. * AWS experience, including Amazon Bedrock. * Information extraction from scanned or long documents, including OCR and layout analysis. * Retrieval augmented generation and vector databases. * MLOps experience: pipeline orchestration, evaluation sets run in CI, and monitoring of output quality over time. * Experience working through an enterprise AI gateway with cost tracking and request filtering. * Databricks Certified Machine Learning Professional, Databricks Certified Machine Learning Associate, Databricks Certified Generative AI Engineer Associate, AWS Certified Machine Learning Engineer \- Associate, or an equivalent cloud certification. * Experience with USPTO, PTAB, or patent and legal data. * Prior delivery on federal government contracts, including FISMA Moderate systems. ### **EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY \& ACCOMMODATION** We believe great teams are built from different backgrounds, perspectives, and lived experiences, and we mean that beyond the buzzwords. RIVA is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants of every race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, and any other characteristic protected by law. If you need an accommodation at any point in our process, send an email to talent@rivasolutionsinc.com, we'll be happy to help. ### **VETERAN SUPPORT \& ACCESSIBILITY** As a federal contractor, RIVA follows the requirements of the Vietnam Era Veterans' Readjustment Assistance Act (VEVRAA) and Section 503 of the Rehabilitation Act, supporting the employment and advancement of protected veterans and individuals with disabilities. If you're a veteran, we encourage you to self\-identify during the application process, it helps us track our hiring commitments and, in some cases, may support priority referral for open roles. RIVA also invites applicants to voluntarily self\-identify as having a disability during the application process, not because it affects your chances of being hired, but because it helps us measure how well we're living up to our commitments and identify where we can do better. Your response is confidential and entirely optional.

jobs.title: Associate Engineer
jobs.description: Robert Thomas Iron Design (RTID) is a high\-end custom metal fabrication studio specializing in architectural and ornamental metalwork. We strive to create an environment where people can learn and pursue their craft in an artisanal production environment; a creative place to learn, grow, develop and build a fulfilling career. Our goal is to inspire craftsmanship in all we do. Located in the historic Charleston Naval Yard, we are committed to a high standard in everything we do and have fun doing it. Check us out at: www.robertthomasiron.com We are seeking an Associate Engineer to join our engineering team. This role is CAD\-forward: most of your time will be spent building SolidWorks models and producing the drawings our blacksmiths, fabricators, and machinists build from. Every gate, railing, light fixture, piece of furniture, and production tool that leaves our shop starts as a model, so it has to be right. The ideal candidate pairs advanced SolidWorks skill with a solid foundation in engineering principles and machining, and understands how steel is actually forged, cut, machined, and joined. **Key Responsibilities** **CAD Modeling \& Drawing Creation** * Create detailed 3D part, assembly, and weldment models in SolidWorks for architectural ironwork, furniture, lighting, hardware, and production tooling. * Produce complete, accurate fabrication and machining drawings, including dimensions and tolerances (GD\&T where appropriate), weld symbols, finishes, and notes. * Develop drawing packages for internal use, client approval, and shop fabrication, including bills of materials (BOMs), cut lists, and flat patterns/templates * Prepare shop drawings and submittals for clients, architects, and contractors; incorporate redlines and manage revisions. * Model forged components and hand\-forged features with an understanding of how forging tolerances differ from machined tolerances. * Translate sketches, renderings, and field measurements into buildable designs. * Import, clean up, and work with files from other CAD platforms (AutoCAD, Rhino, Inventor, Fusion 360, STEP, DXF) supplied by architects, designers, and 3rd party design services. * Build and maintain RTID’s part, template, and drawing libraries; uphold drawing standards, part numbering, file naming, and revision control. * Tabulate quantity takeoffs and material estimates from drawings. **Engineering \& Manufacturing Support** * Apply sound engineering principles (statics, strength of materials, load paths, connection and weld design) to ensure designs are structurally sound and meet applicable building codes for guards, railings, and gates. * Perform engineering calculations and basic simulation (FEA) where needed, and identify items that require review by a licensed Professional Engineer. * Design for manufacturability: select materials, stock/standard sizes, joinery, and processes that fit RTID’s forging, fabrication, and machining capabilities. * Create machining drawings and support CNC and CAM programming for parts, fixtures, dies, and production tooling, including tooling for our cookware manufacturing division. * Design jigs, fixtures, and forging tooling that improve repeatability, quality, and throughput. * Work closely with the Shop Foreman and craftspeople to answer technical questions, resolve design challenges during production, and feed lessons learned back into the models. * Support development of new forged product lines designed for repeatable standard and semi\-custom production. **Systems \& Coordination** * Structure BOMs and item data for use in our MRP system so engineering information flows cleanly to purchasing and production. * Manage engineering change orders and drawing revisions throughout the project lifecycle. * Coordinate with project management and production on drawing release schedules and priorities. * Coordinate and collaborate with RTID’s supporting 3rd party design services (CAD, rendering, 3D modeling, detailing). * Collaborate with clients, architects, and contractors to clarify design intent and resolve technical questions. * Work with purchasing and outside vendors (laser, waterjet, machining, finishing) on specifications, materials, and lead times. **Wage Range: $28\.00\-$33\.00/hour** **Qualifications \& Skills** **Required** * Minimum 5 years of hands\-on SolidWorks experience, with advanced proficiency in parts, assemblies, weldments, sheet metal, configurations, and drawing creation. * Associate’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Engineering Technology, or a related field preferred; * Solid foundation in engineering principles, including statics, strength of materials, and the properties of carbon and stainless steels. * Working knowledge of machining processes (milling, turning, CNC) and the ability to produce drawings a machinist can build from without questions. * Thorough understanding of drafting standards (ASME Y14\.5\), GD\&T, and AWS weld symbols. * Understanding of metal fabrication processes, including cutting, forming, welding, forging, and finishing. * Ability to read and interpret architectural, structural, and shop drawings. * Excellent attention to detail and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines. * Strong communication and collaboration skills; equally comfortable on the shop floor and in a client meeting. * MS365 Applications and MS Teams ecosystem proficient. * Process and systems mentality – familiarity with Lean/Six Sigma and 5S principles. * Dependable, flexible, and can be counted on to deliver. **Desirable** * Experience in ornamental ironwork, architectural metals, or custom metal fabrication (desirable but not required). * Proficiency in additional CAD software such as AutoCAD, Rhino, Inventor, or Fusion 360\. * Understanding of MRP/ERP systems, including item masters, BOMs, routings, and work orders. * CAM software experience (SolidWorks CAM, Mastercam, Fusion 360 CAM, or similar). * SolidWorks Simulation / FEA experience; CSWA or CSWP certification. * Hands\-on shop experience in machining, welding, or blacksmithing. * Familiarity with PDM and revision control systems. * Experience designing tooling, jigs, and fixtures.

By matching players to servers that fit their needs and each developer’s game, matchmaking helps turn discovery into satisfying play, repeat visits, and long\-term engagement, making it a direct lever for Roblox’s growth. LLM as a judge patterns, ROUGE, METEOR, and statistical validation to ensure performance, reliability, and readiness prior to production release. * Deploys comprehensive observability solutions to monitor model drift, hallucination risk, latency, throughput, and token consumption, balancing model quality with infrastructure cost and operational efficiency. * Define evaluation methodologies and metrics for LLM, RAG, and agent\-based applications (e.g., faithfulness, groundedness, relevance, task completion, tool\-use correctness, safety). * Build reusable evaluation frameworks, templates, and libraries that pods can adopt with minimal effort. * Partner with product owners and SMEs to translate business requirements into measurable quality criteria and acceptance thresholds. * Develop automated evaluation pipelines integrated into CI/CD, with regression testing and quality gates for prompt, model, and retrieval changes. * Implement offline evaluation (benchmark and golden datasets) and online evaluation (production monitoring, sampling, drift and quality alerts). * Support A/B and shadow testing for model, prompt, and architecture changes. * Design, validate, and maintain LLM\-as\-a\-judge evaluators, including rubric design, bias mitigation (position, verbosity, self\-preference), and calibration against human labels. * Establish human annotation workflows, labeling guidelines, and inter\-annotator agreement practices with SMEs. * Track judge reliability over time and re\-calibrate as models and use cases change. * Build and curate golden datasets, adversarial and edge\-case suites, and synthetic test data generation approaches. * Apply approved data\-handling practices (de\-identification, synthetic data, access controls) for any dataset derived from sensitive or regulated data. * Implement red\-teaming, hallucination, toxicity, PII leakage, prompt\-injection, and jailbreak testing. * Produce evaluation evidence and reporting that supports security, privacy, compliance, and model risk reviews. * Contribute to responsible AI standards and release\-readiness criteria. * Embed with pods to onboard them to evaluation practices, then coach teams toward ownership of their own eval suites. * Build dashboards and reporting that give engineering and business leaders transparent quality and cost/latency trends. * Evaluate and recommend eval skills and software engineering fundamentals (testing, version control, CI/CD, code review). * Practical experience evaluating LLM/RAG systems, including retrieval metrics (recall, precision, MRR/nDCG) and generation metrics. * Hands\-on experience with LLM\-as\-a\-judge design, prompt engineering, and judge validation. * Working knowledge of statistics and experimental design: sampling, confidence intervals, significance testing, inter\-rater agreement. * Familiarity with at least one eval or observability tool (e.g., Ragas, DeepEval, promptfoo, LangSmith, Langfuse, MLflow, or equivalent). * Experience with cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, or GCP) and their managed LLM services. * Clear communication skills and the ability to work with engineers, product owners, SMEs, and risk stakeholders. * Excellent oral and written communication skills, including presentation skills * Ability to work in a team environment * Ability to meet or exceed Performance Competencies **Preferred** * Experience evaluating agentic systems (multi\-step reasoning, tool calling, trajectory evaluation). * Background in ML evaluation, search/relevance, NLP, or QA automation. * Experience with LLMOps, monitoring and observability, and production feedback loops. * Familiarity with AI risk and governance frameworks (e.g., NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001\) and secure development practices in regulated environments. * Experience with data annotation workflows and working with SMEs. * Knowledge of enterprise controls: SSO, RBAC, private networking, logging, and encryption. **SUCCESS MEASURES** (first 12 months) * Standard evaluation framework adopted by pods. * Automated quality gates in CI/CD for production\-bound solutions. * Calibrated LLM judges with documented agreement jobs.title: Staff Product Security Engineer
jobs.description: **Ready to be a Titan?** ------------------------ At ServiceTitan, we are transforming product security into a core part of how engineering delivers software. We are looking for a Staff Product Security Engineer to embed with one of our engineering portfolios and own its security outcomes end to end, across application security and cloud security, so that our 80 plus R\&D teams build securely by default without slowing down innovation. In this role, you will sit alongside engineering leaders in planning and design, threat model systems before they are built, own the portfolio's risk picture, and bring secure\-by\-default patterns to each team's architecture and workflow. You will be the security expert engineers know by name and the voice that carries their real\-world context back into the program's strategy. This is an opportunity to shape how security is practiced where software actually gets built, turning security into an enabler of engineering velocity rather than a constraint. **What you'll do** ------------------ **Design Partnership** * **Standing Seat in Planning and Design:** Join the portfolio's planning and design cadences as a permanent participant. Review roadmaps, architecture proposals, and technical designs early enough to shape them rather than gate them. * **Threat Modeling:** Lead and scale threat modeling across the portfolio using the program's standard and tooling. Prioritize top\-tier systems, coach squads to run their own models, and make sure identified threats become tracked requirements in the findings flow. * **Architecture Review:** Provide secure architecture guidance for cloud\-native services, microservices, multi\-tenant data access, identity and secrets handling, and AI\-enabled features. Translate the program's security requirements into concrete design decisions the squads can implement. **Portfolio Risk Ownership** * **Own the Risk Picture:** Maintain a current, evidence\-backed view of the portfolio's security risk across application findings, cloud posture, identity, and data exposure. Know what each squad builds, the data it touches, and where it is heading. * **Drive Priorities with Engineering Leaders:** Partner directly with the portfolio VP and their leaders to set remediation priorities, negotiate tradeoffs, and drive adherence to vulnerability remediation SLAs. Bring the data, own the follow through, and escalate with judgment. * **Risk Acceptance and Exceptions:** Guide squads through the program's risk acceptance process. Make sure exceptions are documented, time\-bound, and visible to the right decision makers. **Paved\-Road Adoption** * **Fit Central Patterns to Local Architecture:** Take the paved roads built by the Platform and Programs team, including secure service templates, secrets management patterns, secure cloud configuration templates, CI/CD guardrails, and IaC policy sets, and adapt them to each squad's stack and workflow. * **Drive Adoption in the Field:** Get squads onto SAST, SCA, secrets scanning, IaC scanning, container scanning, and CSPM coverage, and keep them there. Tune signal quality with squads so findings are actionable, and close the loop on what is noise versus real risk. * **Hands\-On Remediation Support:** Read the code, review the Terraform, and pair with engineers on fixes for the hard findings. Write reference implementations and fixes when that is the fastest way to unblock a squad. **Champion Coaching** * **Develop the Portfolio's Champions:** Recruit, coach, and support the security champions across your squads. Be the technical expert they bring the hard questions to, and build them into the portfolio's first line of security response. * **Contextual Enablement:** Deliver just\-in\-time training, design reviews, and office hours tuned to what the portfolio is actually building. Help squads learn to fix their own code and configuration. **Strategy Feedback** * **Feed the Program Roadmap:** Bring real engineering context back to the Director and the Platform and Programs team. Identify where central tooling, patterns, or standards fall short of what squads need, and shape what gets built next. * **Metrics and Reporting:** Contribute portfolio\-level data to the program's metrics rhythm. Report on coverage, remediation velocity, and risk trends for your portfolio to security and engineering leadership. * **Incident Support:** Support triage and investigation of security incidents touching your portfolio, and turn lessons learned into design changes and paved\-road improvements. **What you'll bring** --------------------- * **Experience:** 7\-10\+ years in product security, application security, cloud security, or a closely related security engineering role, with a strong software engineering foundation. Prior experience embedded with or partnering directly with engineering teams is strongly preferred. * **Breadth Across AppSec and CloudSec:** Demonstrated ability to work across the full stack of a modern SaaS product: secure  sts on the central team when you need depth. **Shape How Security Is Practiced:** You will help define what embedded security partnership looks like at ServiceTitan, from how you engage with engineering leaders to how field learnings become platform patterns that scale across every team. **High Ownership, High Leverage:** You will have the autonomy to identify problems, design solutions, and drive them to completion with your portfolio, and the backing of a central team that turns what you learn into patterns for everyone. **Be Human With Us:** Being human isn’t about checking every box on a list. It’s about the experiences we have, people we meet, and the perspectives we share. So, if you have the skills but are hesitant to apply because of your background, apply anyway. We need amazing people like you to help us challenge the conventional and think differently about the problems that we’re solving. We’re in this together. These tools are designed to improve efficiency and enhance the candidate experience. AI tools are not used to make hiring decisions; all hiring decisions are made by our hiring teams. **What We Offer:** When you join our team, you’re not just accepting a job. You’re making a career move. Here’s how we’ll support you in doing some of the most impactful work of your career: * **Flextime, recognition, and support for autonomous work**: Flexible time off with ample learning and development opportunities to continue growing your career. We offer a comprehensive onboarding program, leadership training for Titans at all levels, and other programs and events. Great work is rewarded through Bonusly, peer\-nominated awards, and more. * **Holistic health and wellness benefits:** Company\-paid medical, dental, and vision (with 100% employer paid options and 90% coverage for dependents), FSA and HSA, 401k match, and telehealth options including memberships to One Medical. * **Support for Titans at all stages of life:** Parental leave and support, up to $20k in fertility services (i.e. IUI and IVF), surrogacy, and adoption reimbursement, on demand maternity support through Maven Maternity, free breast milk shipping through Maven Milk, pet insurance, legal advisory services, financial planning tools, and more. We believe that the convergence of fresh perspectives and experiences from all walks of life is what makes our product and culture so great. jobs.title: Senior Fab Yield Engineer
jobs.description: The Senior Wafer Fab Yield Engineer is responsible for driving systematic yield improvement across semiconductor wafer fabrication. Please note that this is a **hybrid role based in New York City**, with an expectation to be in the office 2–3 days per week at our 60 Madison Avenue location. Candidates must be based in the NYC metro area or able to relocate independently within 90 days of their start date. Occasional travel will be required for team on\-sites. **What you’ll do** ------------------ * Lead hands\-on experimentation, evaluation, and production rollout of modern AI capabilities, frameworks, and workflows (LLMs, model gateways, retrieval systems) across the engineering \& enterprise platforms * Identify recurring systemic breakdowns in the software development lifecycle and design simpler, faster, higher\-quality approaches to raise the bar for code quality, system resilience, and operational health * Take ownership of a team’s architecture—providing system\-wide design guidance, decomposing software architecture into discrete components, and ensuring sound tradeoffs across competing dimensions. * Produce architecture that is exemplary in terms of efficiency, stability, extensibility, and the ability to evolve; lead initiatives to eliminate tech debt and prepare the codebase for future roadmap requirements. * Critically influence large, cross\-team projects—ensuring execution without delay or compromise, and anticipating and removing barriers of all kinds. * Bring critical thinking and drive shared understanding in ambiguous situations; given a clear vision, create a strategy; given a clear strategy, define a sequence of objectives. * Provide a system\-wide view to the engineers you work with; share architectural improvements across the tech org to build buy\-in and drive broad implementation. * Develop strong working relationships cross\-functionally and with business stakeholders; make sound tradeoffs between competing needs across short\- and long\-term horizons. * Empower engineers to set ambitious goals and turn vision into reality; mentor and develop engineers across the organization, not just your immediate team. * Handle operational escalations reliably; lead high\-stakes investigations calmly and communicate progress clearly to stakeholders. * Participate in an on\-call rotation; push for better preparation and planning to reduce the frequency and impact of production incidents. * Serve as a trusted technical thought leader across Engineering, Product, Security, IT, and other functional stakeholders—aligning partners early, clarifying tradeoffs, and navigating project dependencies and risks **AI Fluency Expectations** --------------------------- * Uses AI to explore and validate architectural patterns and decisions that improve system scalability and reliability, k of TypeScript, React and Ruby on Rails is preferred * Proven experience designing and owning Fullstack platform architecture at scale * Uses AI to explore and validate architectural decisions, design AI\-augmented engineering workflows, and establish quality and safety guardrails for AI\-assisted work across a team * Track record of technical leadership: creating clarity from ambiguity, defining strategy from vision, and driving org\-wide architectural improvements * Experience leading and influencing cross\-functional teams and stakeholders at multiple levels * Demonstrated ability to mentor and develop engineers across the organization * Adept at covering the breadth of technology while diving deep into architectural complexity and scalability * At least 2\+ years of hands\-on experience experimenting with, integrating, or architecting modern AI tools, LLMs, model gateways, or retrieval systems into software applications * At least 2\+ years leading architectural direction and project teams that span across multiple domains \& functions * Bonus: Prior experience building technology within regulated or complex domains (healthcare or adjacent industries preferred) **Note**: We have even more benefits than listed here and below, your recruiter will provide more in\-depth information as you continue in the interview process. jobs.title: Network Infrastructure Manager
jobs.description: **Job Summary** The Network Infrastructure Manager is responsible for planning, engineering, securing, and optimizing the agency’s enterprise network across on‑premises and cloud environments. This role leads the design, implementation, and maintenance of network infrastructure including Cisco switches, Meraki wireless, Cisco and FortiGate firewalls, Azure network security services, and BGP routing to remote partner sites. The position also manages the agency’s deployment of NetBrain for network automation and topology mapping and utilizes Rapid7 for vulnerability management and compliance tracking. This role directly supervises a team of three network professionals and ensures continuity, modernization, security, and compliance with all network services supporting statewide operations. This is a hybrid work position, with work onsite and teleworking. **Summary of Essential Job Functions** **Strategy \& Planning** * Develop, maintain, and implement the agency’s network infrastructure strategy and multi‑year roadmap aligned with statewide technology standards and security frameworks. · Design and implement short\- and long\-term strategic plans to make certain network capacity meet existing and future requirements. * Ensure that network capacity, resiliency, scalability, and cybersecurity requirements meet current and future agency needs. · Establish best practices and policies for installing, configuring, maintaining, and troubleshooting end user workstation hardware, software, and peripheral devices. * Create and maintain technical standards, configuration baselines, documentation, and change control processes consistent with state HR classification expectations for IT Infrastructure Managers. * Lead analysis and planning for segmentation and modernization initiatives including HQ‑to‑roadside network separation and experience with network firewall migration. **Technical Responsibilities** · Plan, acquire, and coordinate installation of in\-house and remote hardware and software across the organization’s network. * Manage and optimize enterprise Cisco switching infrastructure across data centers, HQ, and roadside field locations. · Conduct research and make recommendations on network products, services, protocols, and standards in support of network procurement and development efforts. * Administer Meraki wireless systems including access point configuration, RF optimization, and cloud management. · Assess, approve, and administer all equipment, hardware, and software upgrades. * Configure, deploy, and maintain Cisco ASA/Firepower and FortiGate firewalls, including hybrid deployments in Azure. * Lead the agency’s firewall modernization project. * Design and deploy network segmentation to isolate critical remote operational networks from HQ systems. * Maintain BGP routes and troubleshoot connectivity with remote operational environments and partner networks. * Utilize NetBrain for automated topology mapping, diagnostics, and network workflow automation. * Utilize Rapid7 for vulnerability detection, prioritization, and remediation tracking across network components. * Ensure high availability, resiliency, and continuity for mission‑critical transportation and revenue‑generating systems. **Operational \& Security Responsibilities** * Ensure network operations comply with statewide cybersecurity frameworks and internal agency security policies. * Maintain firewall rulesets, segmentation strategies, and network access controls to enforce least‑privilege and zero‑trust principles. * Participate in incident response activities by providing packet analysis, log data, and network forensic insight. * Review and approve network change requests following governance and Change Advisory Board (CAB) processes. * Maintain disaster recovery readiness and test network failover and redundancy plans. **Team Leadership \& Vendor Management** * Supervise, mentor, and evaluate a team of three network engineers; develop professional growth plans and training opportunities. * Coordinate daily operations, project assignments, on‑call rotations, and workload management. * Collaborate with statewide IT groups, transportation partners, external vendors, and service providers. · Establish and maintain regular written and in\-person communications with the organization’s executives, decision\-makers, stakeholders, department heads, and end users regarding pertinent network activities. * Manage licensing, hardware refresh cycles, procurement requests, and vendor contract evaluations related to network infrastructure. * Independent self\-starter with excellent management, oral and written communication skills. * Flexibility to respond to the needs of the organization, including working as needed. * Ability to lead and motivate staff. **Tools \& Platforms** * Meraki wireless systems * Cisco ASA/Firepower and FortiGate firewalls * Azure Firewall, VNets, VPN Gateways * NetBrain automation and mapping * Rapid7 vulnerability management * Standard network monitoring and ITSM tools **Core Competencies** * **Technical Expertise:** Advanced knowledge of networking, cloud security, routing, and firewall technologies. * **Leadership \& Coaching:** Ability to lead, coach, mentor, and evaluate assigned staff in alignment with state expectations. * **Problem‑Solving:** Applies professional‑level analytical skills to identify root causes and deliver sustainable solutions. * **Communication:** Ability to prepare technical documentation and convey complex concepts clearly to non‑technical stakeholders. * **Collaboration:** Works effectively with diverse teams, external partners, statewide IT, and cross‑department leadership. * **Customer Focus:** Demonstrates responsiveness, ownership, and service excellence supporting mission‑critical environments. * **Adaptability:** Responds effectively to shifting workloads, emerging threats, and evolving technology standards. **Minimum Qualifications** * Bachelor’s degree from an accredited college or university in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or related field **or** equivalent professional experience. * Eight (8\) years of progressively responsible experience in enterprise networking, routing, switching, and firewall administration. * Four (4\) years of supervisory or team‑lead experience managing technical IT personnel. * Demonstrated expertise with Cisco switches, Meraki wireless systems, enterprise firewalls, BGP routing, and hybrid cloud networking. **Preferred Qualifications** * Master’s degree from an accredited college or university in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related IT field AND more than ten (10\) years of information technology experience, five (5\) years of which were in network management and/or service desk management. Work experience in the public sector is a plus, specifically in the toll, transit, or transportation industry. * Relevant certifications: * Cisco CCNP / CCNA * Meraki CMNA / CMNP * Fortinet NSE * Azure Network Engineer Associate * Experience implementing large‑scale segmentation and modernization projects. * Experience with automated network mapping and vulnerability management platforms. Pay: $100,000\.00 \- $110,000\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) * 401(k) matching * Dental insurance * Employee assistance program * Flexible schedule * Flexible spending account * Health insurance * Health savings account * Life insurance * Paid time off * Parental leave * Retirement plan * Vision insurance Work Location: Hybrid remote in Atlanta, GA 30303

jobs.title: Director, AI/ML Engineering
jobs.description: Job ID: 2020988 Career Area: Engineering Position Type: Salaried Location: Headquarters \& Technology Center – Auburn Hills 48326, US Date Posted: November 2, 2026 Brand: FCA Group **Role Summary** ---------------- The Director of AI/ML Engineering — North America builds and leads our North American AI/ML engineering organization: a team of full\-stack AI/ML engineers delivering production AI products for engineering, quality, and vehicle\-data use cases. This is a hands\-on engineering leadership role with a deliberate emphasis on **solution development** — complete, production solutions including the user touchpoints and applications on top of them: we are looking for a leader with deep, current software\-development experience — someone who has shipped and operated real solutions end\-to\-end, not only models — to balance and strengthen a team whose roots are in data science and ML. You will build a North America team of 6–8 engineers — including hiring through an active pipeline — and own the delivery and production health of the AI/ML products your teams build. The AI \& ML Engineering organization is global: expect significant coordination across regions, and project teams that may be globally dispersed. **How we operate (read this before applying)** ---------------------------------------------- Our products are owned end\-to\-end by engineering leaders — you and your teams carry them from design through production and into maintain\-and\-optimize. **Direction, requirements, and priorities come through our program and product\-management partners.** This is a deliberate operating model, not a gap: the role succeeds through strong delivery inside that partnership — shaping requirements, pushing back with evidence, and building trust with program teams — not through sole control of product direction. Leaders here own products and stay close to the work; this is not a pass\-through people\-management position. **Key Responsibilities** ------------------------ **Team leadership \& growth** * Build and lead the North America AI/ML engineering team (6–8 engineers, including hiring) — recruiting, coaching, performance, and career development * Drive an active recruiting pipeline (external search partners \+ internal talent acquisition); raise the bar on engineering craft with every hire * Develop engineers toward the full\-stack AI/ML profile: comfortable across data, modeling, services, and application layers **Solution \& product delivery** The workload spans two distinct AI development modes, and this role delivers both: * **Agentic systems (primary growth area):** lead the build\-out of agentic AI capability — tool\-using, multi\-step agents that orchestrate data, models, and services to automate engineering and quality workflows. This is where the team is growing and where the Director is expected to lead from the front: agent architectures, orchestration frameworks, tool/API design for agent consumption, evaluation and guardrails for autonomous behavior * **Generative AI workloads:** deliver and evolve LLM\-powered product features — summarization, retrieval\-augmented generation, content generation, conversational interfaces — as an established and continuing part of the portfolio * Own delivery of production AI/ML solutions end\-to\-end: data pipelines, model services, the agentic and generative components above, APIs, and the user touchpoints — applications and dashboards — on top of them * Set and enforce engineering standards — architecture, code review, testing, CI/CD — and stay hands\-on: expect to read and review code * Work closely with the dedicated MLOps team and hand off to them for production release and operation — build to their readiness standards and gates, and route production\-driven code changes back through your teams * Champion AI\-native engineering practice — agentic development tooling, high AI\-assisted throughput with engineering discipline **Cross\-functional leadership** * Partner with program and product\-management teams on scope, priorities, and delivery commitments; communicate progress with evidence * Operate as part of a global organization — significant coordination with teams and functional leads across regions (data science, MLOps, data engineering); project teams may be globally dispersed, and NA\-built products align with global platforms and standards * Contribute to the AI/ML Engineering leadership team: org design, capacity planning, and the maintain/optimize\-vs\-new\-development balance as products graduate into production **EOE/Disability/Veteran** At Stellantis, we assess candidates based on qualifications, merit, and business needs. We welcome applications from all people without regard to sex, age, ethnicity, nationality, religion, sexual orientation, disability, or any characteristic protected by law. We believe that diverse teams reflect our identity as a global company, enabling us to better address the evolving needs of our customers and care for our future. Our benefits reflects the STELLANTIS commitment to helping you reach your personal and professional goals. In addition to an environment that promotes career development, we offer benefits for a healthy lifestyle and a rewarding future, designed to take care of you and your family, in various stages of life. As a global company, our employee packages will vary by country, customary norms and the legal entity into which you are hired. We care about your privacy.
