jobs.title: Principal Full-Stack Data Scientist - Foundational Models
jobs.description: ### **About Stitch Fix, Inc.** Stitch Fix (NASDAQ: SFIX) Stitch Fix is redefining retail by combining human creativity with advanced data science and Generative AI. As we build the future of personalized shopping, we're equally committed to building yours. We believe in investing in our team as much as our technology. Join us to be a trendsetter in the industry and help us redefine what's possible for our clients, while we help you reach your full potential. ### **About the Role** Stitch Fix is redefining retail by blending the art of fashion with the science of machine learning. The Foundational Models team builds and evolves the machine learning systems that power personalization and recommendations across Stitch Fix. The team owns foundational capabilities—including client and item representations, recommendation and retrieval systems, and core models such as the Client Time Series Model (CTSM)—that are leveraged across multiple client experiences and downstream applications. We foster a culture of ownership where Data Scientists manage the full lifecycle of their work. As a Senior Full\-Stack Data Scientist, you will work across the full machine learning lifecycle: identifying opportunities, developing and evaluating new modeling approaches, running large\-scale experiments, and deploying and operating models in production. You will tackle technically challenging problems in personalization and recommendation systems, working with large\-scale behavioral, transactional, textual, and visual data. This is a highly collaborative and hands\-on role. You will partner with Data Scientists, ML Engineers, Product, and other technical teams to translate research and emerging ML techniques into reliable systems that create measurable client and business impact. ### **Responsibilities:** * Design, develop, evaluate, and productionize machine learning models that improve Stitch Fix's personalization and recommendation systems. * Advance foundational modeling capabilities, including client and item representations, embeddings, retrieval, ranking, recommendation models, and assortment generation. * Explore and apply LLMs and machine learning techniques—including deep learning, representation learning, multimodal modeling, and generative approaches—where they can meaningfully improve our systems. * Own work across the full ML lifecycle, from problem formulation and data exploration through modeling, experimentation, deployment, monitoring, and iteration. * Design rigorous offline evaluations and online experiments to understand model performance, measure client and business impact, and communicate results to stakeholders and leadership. * Work with large\-scale behavioral and product datasets using Python, SQL, and distributed data\-processing tools. * Build production\-quality ML solutions with attention to scalability, reliability, latency, observability, and cost. * Collaborate with Product, Engineering, and other Data Science teams to understand downstream needs and translate them into reusable foundational ML capabilities. * Contribute to the technical direction of the Foundational Models team through design discussions, code reviews, research, prototyping, and development of engineering and modeling best practices. * Communicate complex technical concepts, modeling approaches, and tradeoffs, and recommendations clearly to both technical and non\-technical partners. * Mentor and collaborate with other Data Scientists and engineers, helping raise the technical bar across the team. ### **About You** This is what you'll need to succeed in this role from day 1\. **Requirements:** * Bachelor's Degree in a quantitative field such as Computer Science, Statistics, Physics, Mathematics, or a related field required. Master's Degree or PhD preferred. * 8\+ years of experience in design and deployment of machine learning solutions, ideally in personalization, such as recommendation systems, representation learning, or search. * Strong ability to architect technical solutions and write production\-grade code in Python. * Ability to independently drive ambiguous machine learning problems from initial exploration and prototyping through production deployment, monitoring, iteration, and measurable impact. * Experience working with large\-scale datasets using SQL and distributed data\-processing technologies such as Spark. * Experience with modern deep\-learning frameworks such as PyTorch or TensorFlow. * Strong understanding of model evaluation and experimentation, including offline evaluation, A/B testing, and translating model improvements into measurable product or business outcomes. * Ability to reason about the tradeoffs involved in production ML systems, including model quality, latency, scalability, reliability, and computational cost. * Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to influence technical decisions and communicate complex concepts effectively to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders. * Intellectual curiosity and a demonstrated ability to learn and apply new machine learning techniques to practical problems. ### **Why You'll Love Working at Stitch Fix** * We are a group of bright, kind people who are motivated by challenge. We value integrity, innovation and trust. You'll bring these characteristics to life in everything you do at Stitch Fix. * We cultivate a community of diverse perspectives—all voices are heard and valued. * We are an innovative company and leverage our strengths in fashion and tech to disrupt the future of retail. * We win as a team, commit to our work, and celebrate grit together because we value strong relationships. * We boldly create the future while keeping equity and sustainability at the center of all that we do. * We are the owners of our work and are energized by solving problems through a growth mindset lens. jobs.title: Cybersecurity Vulnerability Management Analyst II
jobs.description: **Summa Health****Full\-Time / Benefit Eligible****Remote Opportunity \- Hybrid Preferred** Summa Health is strengthening how we protect the systems our patients and caregivers depend on, and we’re looking for someone who will find the weaknesses before anyone else does. If you’ve worked in vulnerability management, you know the scan results never end and that not every finding deserves the same urgency. We want the person who can tell the difference. You’ll need the judgment to prioritize risk in a clinical environment, where some systems can’t simply be patched and rebooted, and the communication skills to work with engineers, system owners, and clinical teams to get fixes done without disrupting care. We act with urgency, follow through, and own what we find. **Summary** : Under direction of the Manager, Cybersecurity Operations, the Cybersecurity Vulnerability Management Analyst is responsible for performing the tasks that support enterprise vulnerability identification, assessment, prioritization, and remediation tracking across the organization's technology environment, including on\-premises infrastructure, cloud workloads, medical/IoT devices, and third\-party connected systems. Operates and maintains the organization's vulnerability scanning and assessment platform(s) (e.g., Rapid7 InsightVM), executes scheduled and ad hoc scanning activity, validates and triages findings, and applies risk\-based prioritization using industry\-standard scoring methodologies (e.g., CVSS, EPSS) in conjunction with asset criticality and business/clinical impact. Coordinates with Infrastructure, Application Owners, Clinical Engineering, and third\-party vendors to drive timely remediation of identified vulnerabilities and missing patches within established Service Level Agreements (SLAs), and documents risk exceptions, compensating controls, and Plans of Action and Milestones (POA\&Ms) for vulnerabilities that cannot be remediated on standard timelines. Monitors emerging Common Vulnerabilities and Exposures (CVEs), vendor security advisories, and threat intelligence to identify organizational exposure ahead of active exploitation, and produces recurring vulnerability management metrics, dashboards, and reporting to support Cybersecurity Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) oversight and leadership decision\-making. **1\. Formal Education Required** : a. Bachelor's Degree or equivalent in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, IT, or Engineering or equivalent combination of education and/or experience. **2\. Experience \& Training Required** : a. Five (5\) years information security experience; Five (5\) years of IT related experience; Experience working in a complex healthcare environment. b. Certifications required: i. CompTIA Security\+ (or equivalent) ii. CompTIA CySA\+ (or equivalent) c. Certifications preferred: i. GIAC Vulnerability Assessor (GVFA) (or equivalent) ii. CompTIA CASP (or equivalent) 3\. These recognitions are a testament to our commitment to fostering a positive and engaging work environment for our employees, with a particular emphasis on culture, career growth and development opportunities, financial rewards, leadership and innovation. At Syner\-G, we recognize that our team members are our most valuable asset. Join us in shaping the future, where your talents are valued, and your contributions make a meaningful impact. system. * Generate and execute validation lifecycle documentation, including FAT, SAT, IQ, OQ, PQ, and CSV deliverables for equipment, utilities, facilities, laboratory systems, manufacturing processes, and other GMP\-regulated assets. * Author, execute, review, and close validation documents including validation plans, risk assessments, protocols, reports, discrepancy investigations, and summary reports. * Support qualification and validation activities for analytical laboratory equipment, manufacturing systems, and computerized systems in accordance with applicable regulatory requirements. * Support technology transfer projects through validation planning, protocol execution, documentation review, and qualification activities. * Develop and revise validation documentation, jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Backend
jobs.description: ### **About Takt** Takt is a warehouse intelligence platform that unifies labor, automation, and robotics data so 3PLs, retailers, and e\-commerce companies can run more efficient operations. Warehouses generate enormous amounts of data and most of it never reaches the people doing the work. We build the software that closes that gap, giving supervisors and frontline employees the information they need, when they need it, on the floor where decisions actually get made. Our software runs every shift, every day, in real facilities for leading brands including Macy’s, Target, Stitch Fix, Flexport, ODW Logistics, and CarParts.com. ### **About the Role** We’re hiring a senior backend engineer to design and build the distributed systems at the core of the Takt platform. Warehouses produce large, fast\-moving datasets from labor systems, automation, and robotics, and our backend turns that stream into the real\-time operational views our customers run their shifts on. Our services are written in Go, Python, and Node.js and run on Google Kubernetes Engine across multiple regions. You’ll work across all three, picking the one that fits the problem. This is a senior role with real architectural ownership. Our engineering team is small and works together to solve problems; you’ll work directly with our CTO and Director of Engineering, shape how the platform scales, and mentor other engineers as the team grows. Security is top of mind in everything we build: our customers trust us with operational data from their facilities, and we design for that trust from the first line of code. ### **What You’ll Do** * Design, build, and operate scalable backend services in Go, Python, and Node.js that power the Takt platform. * Build integrations that bring in data from warehouse management, labor, automation, and robotics systems, and keep them reliable when upstream systems change or fail. * Deploy and run services on Google Kubernetes Engine across multi\-region environments, designing for availability, failover, and data locality. * Model, store, and query data at scale with Google Cloud Spanner and Google BigQuery, working with large operational datasets from real warehouse systems. * Design APIs and data pipelines that serve real\-time views to web, TV, kiosk, and mobile experiences on the floor. * Build with security top of mind: least\-privilege access, safe data handling, and designs that hold up in SOC 2 and GDPR audits. * Own services end to end, from design and documentation through deployment, monitoring, and incident follow\-through. * Mentor other engineers through design reviews, code review, and pairing as the team grows. ### **How We Build** We’re an AI\-forward engineering team. Every engineer gets a monthly AI tools budget for Claude, Cursor, and whatever else makes you better, and we expect you to use it. AI\-assisted development isn’t a shortcut here; it’s how we work. As a senior engineer, you’ll help set the standard for using these tools well: reviewing generated code critically, understanding what ships under your name, and building guardrails so the whole team can move fast safely. ### **What We’re Looking For** * 5\+ years of professional backend engineering experience, or equivalent practical experience. * Deep, hands\-on experience building production services in at least one of Go, Python, or Node.js (TypeScript), and the willingness to work across all three. * A track record of designing and operating scalable distributed systems, and reasoning clearly about consistency, latency, and failure modes. * Experience running services on Kubernetes in a cloud environment, ideally GKE on Google Cloud. * Strong SQL skills: writing, optimizing, and debugging queries against large production datasets is a must. * Experience with large datasets and the databases that serve them; Spanner and BigQuery experience is a strong plus, as is depth in comparable systems. * A security mindset applied by default: least privilege, safe handling of customer data, and pragmatic risk trade\-offs. * Ownership and drive: you take ambiguity and run with it, communicate clearly, and leave systems better documented than you found them. ### **Nice to Have** * Production experience in more than one of Go, Python, and Node.js. * Experience with multi\-region architectures and the trade\-offs of replication, failover, and data residency. * Experience with streaming or batch data pipelines, such as Dataflow. * Familiarity with Terraform, GitHub Actions, and infrastructure as code. * Prior startup experience, or comfort owning a domain rather than a slice of one. * Curiosity about logistics, warehousing, or how physical operations actually run. ### **Compensation \& Benefits** The base salary range for this role is $150,000 – $180,000, depending on experience. Benefits include: * Health, dental, and vision insurance. * 401(k) with employer match. * Unlimited PTO. * A monthly AI tools budget for every engineer. * A top\-of\-the\-line MacBook Pro, dual 4K monitors, and your choice of keyboard and mouse at your desk in the office. ### **Interview Process** Two phone screens, followed by an onsite in our Reston office with four to five interviews. We’ll keep you informed at every step; no black holes. ### **Location** Takt is based in Reston, VA, with our office located next to the Wiehle\-Reston East Metro station on the Silver Line. We’re looking for local candidates who can be in the office at least four days a week; we build together. Please note that visa sponsorship is not available for this position. ### **Our Commitment** Ensuring a diverse and inclusive workplace where we learn from each other is core to Takt’s values. We welcome people of different backgrounds, experiences, abilities, and perspectives. We are an equal opportunity employer and a supportive place to work. Takt will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodations to participate in the interview process, perform essential job functions, and receive other benefits of employment. Compensation Range: $150K \- $180K

jobs.description: About Us: TRC, Member of WSP, is a global consulting environmental and engineering firm and one of the top design firms in the energy sector. We're looking for a full\-stack developer — primarily frontend, comfortable across the stack — to build features, solve demanding data\-delivery problems, and help us shape both frontend and backend architecture. Prior telecom experience isn't required. What matters is the ability to make large geospatial datasets render, process, and deliver efficiently, along with the adaptability to ramp on a complex domain and contribute creative solutions. Responsibilities: * Build features in our React 19 / Redux Toolkit application — interactive Mapbox GL maps, geospatial visualization, and enterprise data grids. * Design performant solutions for rendering, processing, and delivering large geospatial datasets across the frontend, PostgREST/PostGIS layer, and vector\-tile delivery (PMTiles, Martin, and similar). * Collaborate on frontend and backend architecture, and prototype approaches for demanding spectrum/telecom use cases. * Use AI\-assisted development tools day\-to\-day, and help design and build application\-integrated AI features into the platform. Qualifications: What we're looking for* Process: Lead feature initiatives, work independently, break down complicated problems and collaborate across the team. * Expert frontend: React 19, JavaScript/TypeScript, and Redux Toolkit, with a strong grasp of performance in large applications. Frontend UI/UX oriented. * Mapping/geospatial: Mapbox GL JS (or MapLibre) and working knowledge of geospatial data. * Backend fundamentals: PostgreSQL/SQL and extending REST APIs (PostgREST or similar). * AI fluency: daily use of AI coding tools and sound judgment on where they help; experience building application\-integrated AI (LLM APIs, RAG, agents) is a plus. * Adaptability: ramps quickly on unfamiliar domains and brings well\-reasoned ideas across the stack. Stack* React 19, Redux Toolkit, Vite, Mapbox GL JS, Tailwind \+ Radix/shadcn, AG Grid, PostgREST, Aurora PostgreSQL 17 \+ PostGIS, vector\-tile delivery (PMTiles, Martin), AWS, Kubernetes, GitLab CI. jobs.title: AI Infrastructure Engineer
jobs.description: Our technical teams rack, power, cool, cable, configure, and troubleshoot the GPU clusters that customers train and serve models on. We are hiring an AI Infrastructure Engineer to be the technical depth of that team. This role spans the full stack of a GPU deployment: you will install and commission the hardware, configure the Linux hosts and the InfiniBand or RoCE fabric that connects them, and own the Tier 2 and Tier 3 tickets that no one else can close. When a node fails repeatedly, you are the person who finds out why. This is a hands\-on role. You will still be in the aisle with a torque wrench during deployment windows. You will also write the runbook that prevents the next escalation, tune the fabric that shaved 8% off a customer’s job time, and sit in the vendor call explaining why their firmware is the root cause. The work is hybrid. Deployment windows, hardware break\-fix, and physical layer work happen on site. Configuration, diagnostics, ticket ownership, automation, and documentation can happen from wherever you work best. What you’ll do Escalation and root cause ownership * Own Tier 2 and Tier 3 tickets end to end — accept escalations from Tier 1 and support teams, drive them to resolution, and close them with a documented cause rather than a reboot. * Perform root cause analysis on server hardware failures: correlate IPMI/BMC event logs, MCE and EDAC records, kernel messages, thermal and power telemetry, and vendor diagnostics to distinguish a genuine component failure from firmware, configuration, environmental, or workload causes. * Identify recurring failure patterns across the fleet — a DIMM slot that fails repeatedly, a firmware revision correlated with GPU falloff, a rack with marginal airflow — and drive the systemic fix. * Lead or contribute to post\-incident reviews; translate findings into monitoring, runbook, and standards changes. * Serve as the technical escalation point for vendors: build the evidence package, defend the diagnosis, and manage RMA and field\-service engagements through to closure. * Communicate directly with customers during open incidents and maintenance windows, not only after the fact: status while the issue is live, the notice before a window, and the confirmation after it closes. Concise and factual, with no speculation about cause before it is established. * Direct colocation remote hands in writing, to the level of cabinet, rack unit, port, and cable label, and verify the result remotely before accepting the work as done. * Participate in a shared on\-call rotation for infrastructure incidents. **GPU systems and troubleshooting** * Administer and troubleshoot GPU compute nodes — NVIDIA H100/H200/B200/B300 SXM and PCIe platforms, AMD Instinct, or comparable accelerators. * Diagnose GPU\-level faults using vendor tooling: nvidia\-smi, DCGM and DCGM diagnostics, XID error interpretation, NVLink and NVSwitch health, ECC and row\-remapping events, thermal and power throttling analysis. * Install, update, and validate GPU drivers, CUDA toolkits, fabric manager, and container runtimes; manage version compatibility across the fleet. * Run and interpret node validation and burn\-in — NCCL tests, bandwidth and all\-reduce benchmarks, GPU stress tests — before handing capacity to customers. * Investigate performance degradation that is not an outright failure: straggler nodes, reduced collective bandwidth, PCIe link width or speed downgrades, NUMA and topology misconfiguration. **Network administration: AI fabric and tenant connectivity** * Configure and administer high\-performance AI fabrics — InfiniBand (NDR/HDR) and RoCEv2 Ethernet — including switch configuration, firmware management, and topology validation. * Operate InfiniBand subnet management: subnet manager configuration and failover, partitioning (P\_Keys), routing engine selection, and topology verification against the intended fat\-tree or rail\-optimized design. * Troubleshoot fabric health with UFM and the OFED toolchain — ibdiagnet, ibnetdiscover, perfquery, port counters — to isolate symbol errors, link flaps, degraded optics, and bad cables to a specific port. * Tune and validate RoCE deployments: PFC and ECN configuration, lossless queue setup, and congestion control behavior under collective traffic. * Configure and maintain host\-side networking: RDMA and OFED stacks, NIC and HCA firmware, adapter tuning, bonding, VLANs, and out\-of\-band management networks. * Validate fabric performance after deployment and after change and maintain accurate port maps and topology documentation. * Operate the tenant\-facing side of the network alongside the AI fabric: VLANs and trunking, LACP port\-channels across an MLAG or VLT switch pair, enterprise switch CLI, and the firewall, NAT, VPN, DHCP, and DNS configuration that customer connectivity depends on. Verify tenant segmentation and isolation against the design before capacity is handed over. **Linux systems administration** * Administer the Linux fleet ( uns, serials, port maps, firmware inventory, and lifecycle state. * Write and refine runbooks, install standards, and validation checklists so deployments are repeatable rather than improvised. **What you bring** * 4–7 years combining data center or infrastructure operations with Linux systems administration; time spent in both the aisle and the terminal. * Strong Linux administration skills in a production environment — RHEL, Rocky, or Ubuntu — including kernel and driver management, storage, networking, and shell\-level diagnostics. * Hands\-on experience with a bare\-metal provisioning system as an operator, not just an installer, including diagnosing nodes that fail to enlist, PXE, or commission. Comfort using Redfish and IPMI as automation interfaces for power, boot order, and firmware, not only as sources of event logs. * Demonstrated Tier 2/3 escalation experience: you have been the person a ticket lands on when the first two people could not solve it. * Server hardware root cause analysis experience — reading BMC, IPMI, and system event logs and correlating them with kernel and application symptoms to reach a defensible cause. * Hands\-on experience with high\-performance or data center networking: InfiniBand, RoCE, or high\-speed Ethernet fabrics, including switch configuration and link\-level troubleshooting. * Working knowledge of production L2 and L3 networking beyond the AI fabric, enough to isolate whether a customer problem is host, switch, firewall, or upstream. * Experience administering or supporting GPU or accelerated compute systems, including driver stacks and vendor diagnostic tooling. * Solid data center fundamentals: power distribution and redundancy, cooling and airflow, structured cabling, and rack layout. * Scripting ability in Python or Bash, and comfort with configuration management such as Ansible. * Clear technical writing — incident summaries, runbooks, and RCA document a customer or an executive can read. * Experience as the customer\-facing technical contact during a live incident, and experience directing remote hands or field technicians in writing at a site you are not standing in. * Availability for on\-call rotation and occasional after\-hours maintenance windows. **Nice to have** * Production experience with large\-scale GPU clusters — multi\-rack SXM deployments, NVLink/NVSwitch topologies, or rail\-optimized fabric designs. * Deep InfiniBand experience: UFM, subnet manager tuning, ibdiagnet\-driven fault isolation, adaptive routing, or SHARP. * Familiarity with HPC and AI workload schedulers — Slurm, Kubernetes with GPU operators, or Run:ai — and how scheduling interacts with node health. * Experience with parallel or high\-performance storage (Lustre, GPFS, WEKA, VAST, or NFS over RDMA). • Exposure to liquid\-cooled and high\-density deployments — rear\-door heat exchangers, direct\-to\-chip, CDUs. • Observability stack experience: Prometheus, Grafana, DCGM exporter, Elasticsearch, or equivalent. * Certifications such as RHCE or RHCSA, NVIDIA networking or InfiniBand credentials, CompTIA Server\+/Network\+, or Uptime Institute DCCA/DCCS. * Experience in a growth\-stage environment where standards are being written rather than inherited. **Working conditions and physical requirements** Part of this role is performed in an operating data center. Candidates should be able to, with or without reasonable accommodation: * Lift and maneuver equipment up to 50 lbs unassisted, and heavier items with team or lift assist. • Work at heights on ladders and in confined spaces, including under raised floors and in overhead cable trays. * Stand, walk, kneel, and reach for extended periods in an environment with sustained noise, cold aisles, and limited natural light. * Wear required PPE and follow all electrical and site safety procedures. **Compensation and benefits** ● Negotiable – Depending on Experience Pay: From $140,000\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) * Health insurance Work Location: In person

jobs.title: SAP Principal Pre-Sales & Delivery Architect
jobs.description: **About Tessera Labs** Tessera is an AI\-native platform for enterprise transformation. The multi\-agent platform delivers governed execution across ERP, CRM, HCM, and finance systems, cutting timelines from years to weeks and costs by more than half. Built on deep expertise across SAP, Oracle, Salesforce, Workday, and other systems of record, Tessera combines the reliability of an integrator with the speed of an AI\-native platform. For decades, enterprises have struggled with fragmented business systems, where migrations have consumed hundreds of millions of dollars, data stayed inconsistent and unreliable, and business processes slowed under manual review. Tessera was founded to change that, for SAP and every other system enterprises depend on. The name itself — a tessera, a single tile in a mosaic — reflects our mission: unifying the disparate pieces of the enterprise into a coherent whole. Tessera is an AI\-powered, multi\-agent platform that harmonizes systems and lets teams work in plain English. **Role Summary** We are looking for an SAP Principal Pre\-Sales \& Delivery Architect to hold the solution direction across several customer engagements at the same time, from the first customer conversation through delivery. This is not a project role, and it is not a consulting role: we are a software platform company. Two outcomes define the job. The first is that the customer sees value, stated in their terms, agreed in writing, and tracked. The second is that the customer's own teams adopt the Tessera platform as their normal way of working, rather than working around it. The second is what makes the first durable, and it is the measure you will be held to. The role also sits partly ahead of delivery in pre\-sales. You will join early customer and partner conversations together with the Tessera client partner, because an architect who only sees signed work designs for the problem we solved last year. What you learn there is expected to change how you run the engagements you already hold, and what we ask Product to build next. SAP is where most of our engagements start, and deep SAP judgment is what the role needs on day one. It is not where they stop. Our platform spans ERP, CRM, HCM and SCM, and integrations of orbital systems with SAP and your design view is expected to widen with it. This role owns the proposal definition, solution build and solution delivery with AI across several SAP engagements/ accounts — how it is shaped in the sales cycle, how it is designed, and how it lands. **Key Responsibilities** **1\. Solution Direction Across Engagements (35%)** * Own the functional and architectural direction on several concurrent engagements, including the trade\-offs between what the customer asked for and what will actually create value. * Orchestrate the engagement team across functional, technical, data and other AI enabled workstreams — you are the person who holds the whole picture when nobody else does. * Translate customer business outcomes into a solution shape the Tessera AI platform can deliver — and say clearly, early, when it cannot. Provide feedback to the Tessera product platform team for new R\&D initiatives. * Agree what "better" means with each customer before execution starts: measurable, written, and owned by a named person on their side. * Hold the line between business intent and technical design, working directly with Forward Deployed Engineers, Tessera AI agents and customer architects. * Act as the counterpart our Technical Program Managers come to first, and get a straight answer from. **2\. Pre\-Sales, Go\-to\-Market and Product Input (30%)** * Lead the solution definition and approach in early customer and partner conversations. Shape opportunities before they are scoped — approach, effort and risk — and tell our go\-to\-market teams what is real and what is not. * Own the SAP solution story in proposals and statements of work, alongside the sales team/client partner and the Forward Deployed Engineers who run platform demonstrations. * Bring the forward view back into live engagements and adjust how we run them. * Close the loop with Product: turn field findings into Tessera platform product input, so one fix and new features \& functions serves many customers instead of one. * Contribute your SAP domain know\-how back into the Tessera platform, so the agents get better at this work with every engagement. **3\. Customer Platform Adoption (25%)** * Own customer platform adoption as a deliverable, not a hope. Make Tessera capabilities the default path for the customer's teams and retire the workarounds. * Define what adoption means on each engagement, measure it, and report it alongside delivery status. * Find where adoption stalls — process, skills, trust, or product gap — and fix the cause rather than the symptom. * Build the customer\-side advocates who carry the platform after we step back. **4\. Engagement Shaping and Workforce Rationalization (10%)** * Decide what an eng nt\-facing presence: able to hold a room of customer architects, business owners and finance stakeholders, and to say no to a customer in a way that keeps the relationship. * A record of driving adoption, not just go\-live: evidence that the customer's teams kept using what you delivered. * 15\+ years in enterprise transformation with an SAP foundation (ECC and S/4HANA), spanning several process such as Finance and Logistics areas rather than depth in only one — enough judgment to design across finance, supply chain and order management, and to know when to bring in a specialist. Experience in several end\-to\-end SAP S/4HANA implementations across Greenfield/ Brownfield/ Selective Data Transition approach and very familiar with the key challenges and major activities for each transition path. * Solid technical architecture knowledge: integration patterns, data architecture, and how an SAP landscape actually fits together, including SAP BTP and integration with non\-SAP systems. Have a good understanding of SAP Business AI roadmap. You can hold your own in a room full of engineers. * The confidence to tell a program it is over\-staffed, and the evidence to back it. * Proven ability to learn a new AI platform quickly and become the person others ask. You will be expected to reach real fluency in the Tessera platform within your first months. * Excellent verbal and written business English, with strong presentation ability to both business and technical audiences. * Demonstrated experience leading distributed (onshore, nearshore and offshore) delivery teams, with strong asynchronous communication discipline. * Bachelor's degree in a related field, or equivalent practical experience. **Who This Role Is Not For** If your experience is deep configuration inside one or two process areas, this is not the role — we hire specialists for that work and you would be underused here. If your pre\-sales experience is running the demo rather than owning the solution, the same applies. And if you prefer one engagement at a time with a clear scope agreed by someone else, you will find this uncomfortable. We are asking for a senior architect who is at ease holding several unfinished things at once in various stages of the sales cycle and delivery. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience across more than one enterprise suite — ERP, CRM, HCM or SCM. SAP is the entry point, not the whole picture. * Experience across more than one SAP S/4HANA transition path (Greenfield, Brownfield, Selective Data Transition). * Prior experience partnering with AI, automation or RPA tooling inside an enterprise delivery context. * Experience working within the SAP partner and co\-sell ecosystem, including RISE with SAP. * SAP Activate methodology experience across multiple full\-lifecycle S/4HANA programs. * SAP certifications, for example in S/4HANA Finance, Sourcing and Procurement, or SAP Activate. * Spanish, Portuguese or German is a plus. **First\-Year Measures of Success** * **Month 3:** Fluent in the Tessera platform. Holding at least two engagements. Trusted by the Technical Program Management and sales client partners on those accounts. * **Month 6:** Value targets agreed and tracked on every engagement you hold. Adoption measured and improving. A steady flow of field input reaching Tessera product platform R\&D. Owning the solution on at least two new SAP opportunities. * **Month 12:** Tessera AI Platform client user adoption on your accounts is the norm rather than the exception. Your engagement teams are sized on evidence. Your read of where customers are heading has changed at least one thing in how we deliver or what we build. *No third party may recruit, solicit candidates, publish job opportunities, use Tessera Labs' name or branding, or represent that they are acting on behalf of Tessera Labs without prior written authorization. Any such activity conducted without explicit written consent is strictly prohibited.* Compensation Range: $147K \- $212K

jobs.title: Commissioning Engineer
jobs.description: **Company Overview** Tetra Pak provides food processing and packaging solutions, working with customers and suppliers to deliver safe, innovative products. Its work supports food availability and a sustainable approach to business. **Job Summary** We’re seeking for a skilled and motivated Commissioning Engineer to play a key role in ensuring our membrane filtration systems deliver exceptional performance. In this position, you’ll work directly with customers and collaborate across all levels of the organization, making a real impact on our service quality and customer satisfaction. As a vital part of our team, you’ll be responsible for the installation, commissioning, and maintenance of our equipment. This includes executing preventive and corrective maintenance, coordinating short\-term planning, and troubleshooting control systems. You’ll serve as the primary point of contact on\-site, ensuring smooth operations and outstanding support during commissioning activities. At Tetra Pak, we deliver tailored process solutions that are customized to each customer and product \- meaning your work will always be varied, challenging, and rewarding. Our team thrives on being open\-minded, self\-driven, adaptable, and ready to rise to the occasion in competitive environments. The position is based in Brooklyn Park, MN. You will be travelling 50% of your time to our customer sites within the Americas Region. Tetra Pak is not considering applicants (Internal or External) who require International relocation to the United States. Tetra Pak is not sponsoring work visas or relocation for this position. You must be work authorized in the United States on a full time basis without the need for employer sponsorship now or in the future. The Company cannot offer employment to F\-1 (student) visa holders who require employer sponsorship in the future or cannot work now on a full time basis. **What you will do** As Commissioning Engineer you will: * Support the preparation of customer sites for installation and commissioning of processing equipment. * Collaborate with the Project Manager to prepare materials for plant start\-up, handover, and commissioning activities. * Independently or collaboratively start up membrane filtration equipment to ensure smooth operation and performance. * Conduct commissioning and troubleshooting at customer sites, and provide detailed commissioning reports and feedback to sales, project, and development teams. * Take part in Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT) and I/O testing, often alongside customers at the workshop. * Train customer operators in the operation and oversight of cheese processing equipment. * Provide occasional support to internal teams, including assisting with sales efforts, addressing customer claims, contributing to product improvements and development, and participating in on\-site audits. * Ensure all equipment operates to specification and capacity, making mechanical adjustments as needed to enhance performance and meet customer expectations. * Perform all duties in strict alignment with Tetra Pak and customer safety standards, ensuring compliance with product quality and food safety requirements. **We believe you have** * Bachelor’s degree in Dairy Technology, Automation, Mechanical, Chemical or Electrical Engineering. * At least 3 years of experience * Experience in the dairy or food industry is a plus, with a focus on equipment installation, maintenance, and/or commissioning. * Basic understanding of PLC programming, ideally with experience on Siemens or Allen Bradley platforms. * Experience with FactoryTalk View SE HMI development is preferred. * Familiarity with Virtual Machines and VMware is a plus. * Strong background in electrical, hydraulic, and pneumatic systems is highly desirable. * Prior experience in the food industry with a working knowledge of fluid dynamics and heat transfer is a plus. * Proficient in the Microsoft Office Suite. * A collaborative team player with a strong ability to work across departments and functions. * Willingness to travel up to 50% to customer sites across the U.S. and Canada for equipment start\-up and commissioning. * Fluent English proficiency is required. Pay: $72,500\.00 \- $113,800\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) * 401(k) matching * Dental insurance * Health insurance * Life insurance * Paid time off * Parental leave * Vision insurance Work Location: Hybrid remote in Brooklyn Park, MN 55445

jobs.title: Assistant/Associate Professor of Civil Engineering
jobs.description: **Job Title** Assistant/Associate Professor of Civil Engineering**Agency** Texas A\&M University \- Texarkana**Department** College of Engineering and Computing \- Engineering**Proposed Minimum Salary** Commensurate**Job Location** Texarkana, Texas**Job Type** Faculty**Job Description** The College of Engineering and Computing invites applications for a full\-time, nine\-month, tenure\-track faculty position at the rank of Assistant/Associate Professor of Civil Engineering, with an anticipated start date in Fall 2027\. The successful candidate will teach and develop undergraduate and graduate courses in civil engineering; support student success through teaching, mentoring, and advising; collaborate with colleagues across the college; and contribute to teaching, scholarship, service, and the advancement of the department's and college's strategic goals. Consistent with the University's R2 research aspirations, the successful candidate will establish a productive research program, pursue external funding, disseminate scholarly work, and engage students in research. Strong communication and interpersonal skills, along with a commitment to a student\-centered learning environment, are essential. Working closely with college leadership and faculty colleagues, the successful candidate will contribute to implementing and continuously improving the civil engineering curriculum, develop teaching and research laboratories, participate in ABET assessment and accreditation activities, and build partnerships with industry and research organizations. The faculty member will help create a dynamic learning environment that provides students with hands\-on experiences through laboratories, undergraduate research, design projects, industry\-sponsored projects, internships, and other experiential learning opportunities, while supporting the continued growth of the program, the college, and the university. **ESSENTIAL DUTIES \& RESPONSIBILITIES:** * Teach civil engineering courses and labs as well as selected interdisciplinary engineering courses. * Conduct course assessments to evaluate and improve student learning outcomes and program effectiveness. * Advise students on academic and career matters. * Engage in professional and scholarly activities, including research, publication, and participation in professional organizations. * Serve on departmental, college, and university committees. * Participate in outreach activities to promote the civil engineering program and engage with the community. * Actively participate in student recruitment efforts to attract and retain talented students in the civil engineering program. **KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS \& ABILITIES:** * An earned doctorate (Ph.D.) in civil engineering with a concentration in Geotechnical, Geoenvironmental, and/or Environmental and Water Resources Engineering from an accredited institution. * A record of, or demonstrated potential for, effective teaching in civil engineering courses and laboratories. * A record of, or demonstrated potential for, active and impactful research, scholarly publication, and external funding appropriate for the rank sought. * Excellent verbal and written communication skills. * For appointment at the Associate Professor rank, a record of teaching, scholarship, and service that meets Texas A\&M University Texarkana standards for appointment at that rank; normally, this includes at least five years of successful service at the Assistant Professor rank or equivalent experience. **Preferred Qualifications** * Professional Engineer (PE) registration in the United States * Ability to teach across the curriculum, in one or more sub\-disciplines, including geotechnical, geoenvironmental, water resources, and other related fields. * Experience in curriculum development and innovative teaching methodologies. * Experience in developing and teaching civil engineering laboratories * Professional experience in industry or a government agency * Familiarity and experience with ABET accreditation processes * Experience in grant writing and securing research funding **Other Requirements** * Eligibility to work in the United States at the time of hire. No pre\-employment sponsorship is authorized for this position. * Ability to travel or work beyond normal office hours when required for program activities. * Ability to maintain confidentiality in academic and student matters. **ABOUT TEXAS A\&M UNIVERSITY TEXARKANA** Texas A\&M University Texarkana is a regional comprehensive university committed to academic excellence, student success, applied research, and service to the communities of Northeast Texas and the surrounding region. The College of Engineering and Computing is developing programs that address workforce needs, create pathways for first\-generation and transfer students, and connect engineering education with industry, innovation, and economic development. **Applicants should submit the following materials:** * Cover letter describing the candidate’s interest in the position and alignment with the mission of the University and College. * Curriculum vitae. * Teaching statement that includes the candidate’s teaching philosophy, courses, and laboratories the candidate is prepared to teach or develop, and evidence of teaching effectiveness. * Statement of research interests and plans, including opportunities to engage undergraduate students. * Unofficial graduate transcript. * Contact information for three professional references with at least one being from a previous/current supervisor. For applicants with degrees from non\-U.S. institutions, transcripts and academic records must be evaluated on a course\-by\-course basis by **WES** or another **NACES\-approved** agency as part of the application. If documents are not in English, notarized English translations are required. Applicants are responsible for all evaluation and translation/notarization costs. Please remember once you submit your application you will not be able to “revise” or upload any documents. If you have any questions about uploading or a revision to your application, you may contact HR@tamut.edu. All positions are security\-sensitive. Applicants are subject to a criminal history investigation, and employment is contingent upon the institution’s verification of credentials and/or other information required by the institution’s procedures, including the completion of the criminal history check. jobs.title: Digital Product Manager - Obie Insurance
jobs.description: **At Obie, we don’t just insure properties — we ensure progress.** With advanced technology, real\-time data, and a vast network of agents and partners, we help real estate investors and landlords get insurance coverage whenever and wherever they need it. Thousands of owners nationwide trust us to be the insurance experts, so they don’t have to be. Joining our team means embracing a fast\-moving environment driven by innovation, collaboration, and constant progress. We learn quickly, iterate often, and celebrate wins together. If you're passionate about driving change and eager to impact the real estate and insurance market, Obie is the place for you. Our Chicago based employees are hybrid, and expected to be in office on Tuesdays and Thursdays. **Brief Summary of Role** We’re looking for an experienced, hands\-on Product Manager who loves figuring out how things work and can’t wait to make them better. You’ll join our growing team as an individual contributor, turning messy, technically complex problems into solutions and products that people actually use \- and checking that they made a difference! You don’t need prior insurance experience; curiosity, ownership, and strong product judgement matter most. You’ll own a meaningful product area end\-to\-end: bring your own point of view, get clear on why it matters to customers and the business, and build it with Design and Engineering. You enjoy turning “could we…?” into a working first version. You’ll think across customers, agents, internal teams, and interconnected systems. Initial ownership is open, with room to contribute access domains as priorities evolve. You’re the person who asks, “What does the data say?” and then goes looking, talking to customers and teammates along the way. You can explain tradeoffs, make timely decisions with incomplete information, and follow through on results after launch. You’re curious beyond the current tools and playbook. If you find a smarter way to do something, you’re eager to try it with the team and share what worked (and what didn’t). **What you'll Do** * **You’ll be a product owner:** Take a problem from “we should…” to shipped, used, and improved. The backlog is a part of the job, not the finish line. Shape the vision, strategy, and roadmap for your area, define KPIs and success upfront, and use business and customer evidence to prioritize. You can point to work you’ve owned through multiple iterations and explain what changed as you learned. * **You’re the best listener in the room:** Seek out customer insight, relevant data, and cross\-functional input without treating every request as a requirement. Weigh options, make tradeoffs visible, and explain both what you recommend and what you choose not to do. You know which decisions need a deeper dive and which need a sensible call so the team can keep building. * **You get that product building is a team sport:** Build trust across Engineering, Design, Technical Project Management, QA, operations, and business partners. Bring people into decisions early, navigate disagreement, and create clarity that helps others execute with confidence. You’re happy to own the hard call, share the credit, and jump in when a fellow PM needs a hand. Making the team better is part of the fun. * **You’re mission first:** You get stuff done. Help the team turn business priorities into clear work that’s ready to build, without getting stuck in planning limbo. Balance larger bets with smaller, high\-leverage improvements, remove avoidable process drag, and keep attention on outcomes. You’ve improved the flow, clarity, or quality or work reaching engineering and can show how you evaluated results after launch. * **You can get your hands dirty:** Turn complex problems into clear, buildable work with Design and Engineering. Bring experience with technically deep products, such as APIs, integrations, data pipelines, or Salesforce’y systems. You’ll happily dig into an API spec or sketch a workflow in Figma to understand what’s going on under the hood. Learn enough to ask good questions, spot constraints, and sequence the work \- and notice when the UX still feels clunky. * **You can work async:** You don’t need someone hovering over your shoulder to move things forward. Own decisions as context shifts, and leave a trail your teammates can actually follow: research, decisions, metrics, and open questions that are easy to find and use. You can show who a written artifact or stakeholder conversation clarified a complex decision, resolved disagreement, or enabled others to act. * **Nice to have:** Experience in insurance, insurtech, fintech, or another regulated environment; Salesforce, data products, carrier/partner integrations, or workflow\-heavy B2B software; or balancing platform work with customer facing improvements. Have you built a scrappy AI prototype, tinkered with an agent, or found a better way to show an engineer what you mean? We’d love to hear about it! These are help additions,  t. * **Interview Process** At Obie, transparency is core to our interview process. We focus on open communication and a positive experience; no trick questions—just honest conversations about your skills and aspirations. To help you prepare, please familiarize yourself with these resources before moving forward: * Our company’s blog to learn more about the market we serve and the information our customers value. * Check out our LinkedIn to see how people interact with our brand and product. * Press and podcast features like Inc. 5000 , TechCrunch , Innovate State , Uncontested Investing Podcast , Insurtech Amplified Podcast * Meet us and get to know Obie You'll first talk to Kara on a 30\-minute call to determine whether we’re a good fit for one another. You’ll learn more about Obie and have the chance to ask about our company, team, culture, and product. * Meet the hiring manager Next, you'll have a 45 minute video interview with the hiring manager, Adam Tsouras , to assess your technical skills. * Complete a Project Exercise This role requires strong planning, collaboration, and communication skills, so we'll also present you with a short exercise to complete to provide you a chance to flex those muscles. You will be able to complete this exercise on your own time, so please be thorough and use the resources available to you. We'll be looking to see your problem solving abilities, writing and communication skills, empathy, general demeanor, and ability to leverage key product management strategies. More on this when you get there! * Meet the Team Since you'll be joining a close\-knit team, we'll ask you to meet other people in the company so we get to know each other a bit better **Moving Forward with Obie** Obie is a leading insurance platform for real estate investors, combining proprietary technology with a modern insurance experience to simplify Home and Landlord insurance. Today, we serve customers nationwide through direct digital experiences, a growing network of insurance agents, and strategic partnerships with lenders, property management platforms, and real estate technology companies. As part of The Baldwin Group, one of the nation's leading insurance distribution platforms and a USA TODAY Top Workplace, we're combining the agility of a fast\-growing technology company with the scale, resources, and career opportunities of a larger organization as we shape the future of investment property insurance. **Obie has you Covered** Being in the insurance industry, we understand the importance of comprehensive benefits for you and your family. These are just some of the benefits and perks we provide: * Comprehensive health, dental, vision and life insurance * Flexible paid time off Retirement savings plan with company match * Obie values transparency and data driven decision making, enabling us to have a consistent and equitable approach to compensation. We are informed by a benchmarking tool which provides real time compensation data allowing us to regularly check our salary ranges against other venture backed companies and startups within our industry. We've provided the full base salary range for this role below, but please note that we typically target the mid point of the salary range to allow room for growth within the role. Your salary is dependent upon many factors, including years of relevant experience, expertise, etc. During your first interview, you can expect to have an open conversation with your recruiter regarding your compensation expectations. The pay range for this role is: 90,000 \- 130,000 USD per year (Remote (United States)) The Baldwin Group will not accept unsolicited resumes from any source other than directly from a candidate who applies on our career site. Any unsolicited resumes sent to The Baldwin Group, including unsolicited resumes sent via any source from an Agency, will not be considered and are not subject to any fees for any placement resulting from the receipt of an unsolicited resume.

jobs.title: Manager, Software Quality & Integration Engineer
jobs.description: **Job Description Summary:** In 2009, The Coca\-Cola Company introduced the revolutionary Freestyle dispenser. Open its door and you’ll find embedded software directing an orchestra of motors, sensors and precision pumps to pour a virtually unlimited selection of beverages. Today, Freestyle is part of a growing portfolio of connected beverage equipment: multiple embedded operating systems, digitally enabled dispensers and devices, and the cloud, web and IoT services that tie them together. As **Manager, Software Quality \& Integration Engineer,** you’ll be central to the software quality, integration and release readiness of new software and hardware across that portfolio. Working closely with software and hardware development teams, product owners and Coca\-Cola customers, you’ll drive software quality from test strategy through release: defining test coverage, validating new software on real equipment, triaging and resolving issues in the field, spotting defect patterns before they spread, and making sure every release is ready for the equipment and customers that depend on it. Every release you validate ends up running on real hardware in front of real customers, so the role calls for someone who is solutions\-oriented and can balance competing priorities across teams. If you’re excited by REST endpoints that open doors, run compressors and pump fluids, and by the tools that keep a fleet of connected machines healthy, this may be the job for you. **What You’ll Do platforms, connected devices, and hardware integrations. * Coordinate end\-to\-end integration efforts across software release cycles, ensuring system stability, functionality, and operational readiness through comprehensive testing and validation processes. * Define test coverage, develop test plans, create and maintain test cases, and execute both manual and automated functional and performance tests that identify issues and mitigate risk to the fleet. * Bridge technical and business requirements during software release cycles and innovation projects by collaborating with cross\-functional stakeholders to align system functionality, user needs, operational goals, and deployment expectations. * Analyze dispenser logs to assist development resources in defect debugging and leverage and enhance existing test tools to automate testing of physical dispensers. * Partner with development and engineering management to understand dispenser and equipment requirements and improvements across Freestyle platforms and connected equipment. * Investigate and resolve escalated field issues through advanced troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and data\-driven problem solving to improve system reliability and minimize operational disruptions. * Review and validate new hardware and software prototypes, identifying integration improvements and ensuring compatibility, performance, and readiness for deployment in production environments. Provide fluency in AI\-driven tools to support integration and troubleshooting efforts, enabling efficient analysis of large datasets and accelerating issue resolution for field and engineering teams. * **Qualifications \& Skills:** * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related engineering field (e.g., Electrical, Mechanical, Chemical, or Food Engineering). * 3\+ years of industry experience, ideally in a fast\-moving consumer goods company, with the ability to leverage technical knowledge to provide competitive advantage. * Strong knowledge of testing IoT and embedded devices, including Linux, at least one programming language (Java preferred), and backend protocols communicating to hardware. * Excellent knowledge of both the embedded and full\-stack software development lifecycle, testing methodologies, and testing tools. * Ability to help refine solutions and manage internal and external partners’ expectations against technical and business success criteria * Strong working knowledge of shell scripting and Unix command\-line tools. * Ability to use backend communication protocols such as APIs and web services. * Knowledge of test automation tools (Selenium, JUnit, JavaScript, Java, Groovy). * Knowledge of version control systems such as Git or similar tools. * Experience developing test plans, assessing risk, detailing defects, and providing relevant data for test reporting. * Fluent in software QA metrics, operations, and statistics. * Ability to triage problems, prioritize accordingly, and propose resolutions. * Ability to work independently, raise issues, and take corrective action. * Strong interpersonal communication skills. * Proficiency in the Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint). jobs.description: ### **About Throne** Throne is a fast growing Series C startup transforming local communities by delivering clean, safe, accessible restrooms to cities, transit agencies, and public spaces. With flagship customers in Los Angeles, the San Francisco Bay Area, Ann Arbor, and Washington DC, and recent launches in New York City, Atlanta, and Seattle, we're rapidly scaling into new markets in 2027 and beyond. We recognize an unspoken problem: that better bathroom accommodations are sorely needed in most cities. Public and retail bathrooms are neither positioned to meet demand, nor incentivized to provide the quality experience people deserve. Our mission is to provide peace of mind to the millions of people who set out on an adventure on any given day. That adventure may be big or small. It may involve taking your toddler to the park, driving a stranger to the airport, running a half marathon, or exploring a new city for the first time. **About the Role** Throne is looking for a full\-time Software Quality Assurance (QA) Engineer to be a crucial member of the Software and R\&D Engineering Teams. Thrones are proprietary technology which include mechanical components, smart plumbing, smart HVAC, various sensors, actuators, and on\-board processing systems, cellular connectivity and a solar/battery driven power system. Software QA Engineer will be contributing into establishing QA/QC processes, improving time\-to\-market and maintaining high quality of our custom firmware and software solutions for internal Staff, and external Users and Partners. You will work closely with Throne's extended team, consisting of start\-up veterans, creative innovators, and portable sanitation experts. We are passionate about defining Throne as the reliably clean option at some of life's most stressful moments. We are ruthless about results, relentless about improvement, and we value diversity, inclusion, and having fun. The person hired in this role will work a hybrid schedule, and will be expected to work onsite about 3 days a week from either Brentwood, MD (right outside of Washington, D.C.) or Seattle, WA (Industrial District). The base salary range for this position is $100,000 \- $135,000\. Actual compensation will depend on a candidate's applicable experience, skills, and geographic location. This role is also eligible for a comprehensive benefits package, including equity. **At Throne You Will:** * Work closely with the product and engineering teams to understand business requirements. * Participate in test efforts estimation. * Design test cases, checklists and scenarios for different test levels and types using test design techniques. * Conduct manual testing of firmware and software to ensure products and features perform according to the requirements and contribute to a lovable user experience. * Perform integration testing of hardware/firmware/software components and communicate issues to the relevant teams, ensuring seamless collaboration across departments. * Investigate logs, identify and localize issues on production and QA environments. * Provide traceability/test coverage information, contribute to the Test Plan. * Setup/maintain QA test environment. * Optimize testing, considering different contexts and different constraints, by applying various testing practices, utilizing AI and other tools for test and process automation. * Contribute to technical and testing documentation creation and maintenance. **We Are Looking For:** * Solid knowledge in software quality assurance with a minimum 4 years of relevant commercial experience. * Experience with back\-end (API, database testing), web and mobile testing. * Understanding of cloud\-based architecture and hands\-on experience with AWS tools and services (e.g. Lambda, CloudWatch). * Understanding of specifics of micro\-services and serverless architecture. * Familiarity with observability and monitoring tools (e.g. Datadog, Grafana, Sentry, OpenSearch, or similar). * Experience with test automation (JavaScript, TypeScript or Python). * Willingness to work in a startup lab environment in an active R\&D phase. * Tolerance to changing requirements and priorities, and context switching between different products. * Ability to communicate effectively with on\-site and remote teams, and explain technical concepts and issues to less tech savvy colleagues. * Proactiveness in giving feedback and improving existing processes. * Hands\-on experience using AI\-assisted tools for test case generation, log analysis, or automation (e.g. GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude, Testim, or similar). **Preferred Qualifications:** * Awareness of security testing fundamentals and/or accessibility standards (WCAG) is a plus. * Experience with performance testing is a plus. * Experience with testing of IoT and hardware products is a plus. ### **Benefits:** * plan * Paid time off that grows with tenure, in addition to paid sick time and paid parental leave * Life insurance, AD\&D coverage, and short and long\-term disability insurance * Employee Assistance jobs.description: Technology Sr. Software Engineer \- Data Subject Rights \- TikTok Privacy and Security **Location :** San Jose **Employment Type :** Regular **Job Code :** A81056 Responsibilities The TikTok Privacy and Security (PnS) R\&D team creates privacy solutions that are intuitive for users, auditable for regulators, and sustainable for the company, making TikTok a platform where people can safely discover, create, and connect. We build user\-facing privacy features, including privacy settings, consent management, data access and export, and age\-appropriate experiences. We protect personal data across its full lifecycle, from collection and transfer through access, storage, retention, and deletion. We develop the platforms, technical controls, and governance tools behind privacy protection and regulatory compliance in global markets, and we bring privacy\-enhancing technologies and research into production at scale. We tackle challenges unique to operating a platform at global scale: translating rapidly evolving laws and policies into reliable technical controls, providing transparency and auditability across highly complex data systems, supporting different regulatory requirements across regions, and making privacy protection work at the quality and speed production systems demand. You will work across product privacy, data lifecycle management, data protection and residency, privacy engineering platforms, AI governance, and privacy\-preserving technologies, using techniques including automated compliance enforcement, data lineage and taxonomy, differential privacy, trusted execution environments, AI fairness, and privacy protection for generative AI. The systems you build will protect hundreds of millions of people, and the privacy decisions you make will reach every one of them. The TikTok Privacy and Security Product DSR team builds the platform behind data subject requests: the rights users exercise to access, delete, correct, or export their data. The team turns those rights into systems that run accurately, on time, and at global scale, across the products and data stores where that data actually lives. In this role, you will design and build core DSR systems, apply judgment where business goals and compliance meet, and take that work end to end with partner teams. Responsibilities As a Sr. Software Engineer on the TikTok Privacy and Security Product DSR team, you will: \- Design, build, and evolve backend systems that improve privacy across TikTok, and help turn repeated requirements into shared platform capabilities. \- Make sound business and compliance judgments in the systems you own, and carry the work end to end: problem framing, technical design, delivery, launch, and adoption. \- Partner across product, legal, policy, data, and engineering teams. Align on requirements and tradeoffs, and land privacy capabilities in the products and data systems that depend on them. \- Work with data and its lifecycle. Implement how data is collected, stored, used, shared, retained, and deleted, and connect those controls to how products operate. \- Use data analysis and data processing to measure privacy coverage, risk, and business impact, and extend privacy capabilities into new scenarios and product lines. \- Build and operate high\-scale backend services, and take part in privacy incident response, including scope, root cause, and remediation. Qualifications Minimum Qualification(s) \- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. \- Experience building backend services for large\-scale, consumer\-facing products. \- A solid grasp of data, its lifecycle, and how data systems support the business. \- Ability to make sound judgments on business and compliance tradeoffs, and to plan and deliver work end to end. \- Experience working with partner teams across organizations, and communicating clearly enough to land a shared technical decision. \- Proficiency in at least one of Java, Go, C\+\+, or Python. \- Strong fundamentals in data structures, algorithms, and backend system design. Preferred Qualification(s) \- Experience on a large platform, such as infrastructure, ads, recommendation, or an open platform. \- Experience contributing to longer\-term platform planning, or turning fragmented capabilities into a shared service. \- Hands\-on experience with data analysis and data processing, and with using those skills to support new business use cases. \- Experience designing or implementing privacy, data governance, or trust and safety features. \- Experience operating systems at very large consumer scale. TikTok's global headquarters are in Los Angeles and Singapore, and we also have offices in New York City, London, Dublin, Paris, Berlin, Dubai, Jakarta, Seoul, and Tokyo. ​ Why Join Us Inspiring creativity is at the core of TikTok's mission. Our innovative product is built to help people authentically express themselves, discover and connect – and our global, diverse teams make that possible. jobs.title: Member of the Technical Staff, Software Engineering
jobs.description: ABOUT TOLMO Tolmo is cybersecurity for the age of AI. Coding agents now ship software faster than any human team can review or secure it; 100\+ pull requests per engineer per week is no longer an outlier, and attackers are using the same agents to find and exploit weaknesses in days, not months. The old playbook of quarterly pentests and endless alert queues breaks at this speed. We're building a new security playbook. Tolmo runs a fleet of AI security agents that reason over a live graph of your entire production system (code, CI, cloud, and telemetry) and continuously attack a faithful copy of it like a real adversary. Every finding arrives validated, with its blast radius and a remediation plan that lands in your workflow, ready for a coding agent to fix. Hours to integrate, days to your first validated finding. We've done this before: Tolmo's founders built Sqreen (acquired by Datadog) and led security products that thousands of organizations trusted. We're backed by Accel and Y Combinator and just getting started. THE ROLE As a Member of the Technical Staff, you build the system that makes our agents good at security: the graph they reason over, the infrastructure they run on, and the agents themselves. There are no fixed lanes. In one week you might ship a new cloud integration, rework how the graph links an endpoint to the code that serves it, and tune an offensive agent so it chains two low\-severity findings into a real exploit. You'll work directly with the founders and a small team of engineers who ship to production every day, and who use coding agents as heavily as the customers we protect. You'll own problems end to end: talk to the customer, design the fix, ship it, and watch it run in production. WHAT YOU'LL DO * Build and extend the live security graph: crawlers that discover cloud, SaaS, and code resources, and the pipeline that turns them into a consistent model of a customer's production system. * Design, evaluate, and improve AI security agents that pentest, triage, chain, and remediate findings, and build the evals that tell us whether they actually got better. * Own services end to end across Go, TypeScript, PostgreSQL, graph databases, and AWS, from design through deployment and on\-call. * Make the platform safe to point at production: strict tenant isolation, egress controls, and secrets handling that customers' security teams will scrutinize. * Work with customers and our security leads to turn real findings, misses, and false positives into product improvements. * Set the engineering bar as we grow: code quality, review culture, tooling, and how we build with AI agents. WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR * Strong software engineering fundamentals and a track record of shipping and owning production systems end to end. * Fluency in at least one of Go or TypeScript, and the willingness to work across the stack. * Experience with distributed systems, data pipelines, or cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP, or Azure). * You build with AI coding agents daily (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor) and have opinions about how to make them reliable. * Curiosity about how real systems break: you want to understand the attack, not just the alert. * You own ambiguity: energized by defining how something works, not just executing a process. NICE TO HAVE * Offensive security experience: penetration testing, red teaming, bug bounty, or CTFs. * Experience building LLM agents, evals, or agent tooling in production. * Experience with graph data models or graph databases (Neptune, Neo4j, Memgraph). * Background in application or cloud security tooling (SAST, DAST, CSPM, SIEM). * Prior early\-stage startup or founding\-engineer experience. COMPENSATION \& BENEFITS * Base salary: \[PAY RANGE], depending on level and experience. * Early\-stage equity: you're joining early; you'll own a real piece of what we build. * Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, and the equipment you need to do your best work. * Based in San Francisco; we work in person. Tolmo is building a team with wide\-ranging backgrounds, perspectives, and paths into security; we think it makes our product and judgment better. If you're excited about this role but don't match every point above, we'd still like to hear from you. We're an equal opportunity employer and welcome applicants of every background.
