jobs.title: Systems and Network Engineer
jobs.description: Description: POSITION SUMMARY Systems and Network Engineer is a hands\-on technical role responsible for maintaining and improving Trean’s technology environment to support day\-to\-day operations. The position combines infrastructure engineering with advanced technical support to help ensure systems and services remain secure, reliable, and available to the business. The role works closely with end users, internal IT teams, business stakeholders, technology vendors, and service providers to resolve complex technical issues, deliver infrastructure projects, and drive ongoing technology improvements. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES AND ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS * Administer, maintain, patch, and upgrade Trean’s server, network, cloud, and related infrastructure technologies. * Administer and support Microsoft Azure, Microsoft 365, Entra ID, and related cloud, identity, collaboration, and endpoint technologies. * Monitor infrastructure performance and availability, troubleshoot complex technical issues, and perform root cause analysis. * Maintain secure infrastructure configurations, remediate vulnerabilities, and support security, access management, audit, and compliance activities. * Support backup, data recovery, and disaster recovery activities, including scheduled recovery testing. * Plan and implement infrastructure projects, upgrades, migrations, and technology improvements. * Use PowerShell and automation to improve infrastructure administration and operational efficiency and apply AI technologies such as Microsoft Copilot where they can improve IT operations and service delivery. * Maintain accurate infrastructure documentation, including configurations, diagrams, inventories, procedures, and system changes. * Work directly with end users and collaborate with IT staff, business stakeholders, vendors, and service providers to resolve technical issues and support business needs. * Participate in scheduled maintenance and after\-hours or on\-call support as required. Requirements: MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS * Bachelor’s degree in information technology or a related field, or equivalent relevant professional experience. * Five or more years of hands\-on experience supporting enterprise systems, networks, cloud services, or related infrastructure. * Experience administering Windows Server, Microsoft Azure and Microsoft 365 services, enterprise networking, virtualization, and backup and recovery technologies. * Experience configuring and troubleshooting switching, VLANs, firewalls, wireless networking, VPNs, and related network technologies. * Working knowledge of Microsoft Entra ID, identity and access management, endpoint management, and data protection technologies. * Working knowledge of infrastructure security, vulnerability remediation, patch management, backup, and disaster recovery practices. * Experience implementing infrastructure upgrades, migrations, and system changes in production environments. * Strong troubleshooting, analytical, problem\-solving, and technical documentation skills. * Ability to manage day\-to\-day operational responsibilities and technical projects with limited supervision. * Demonstrated commitment to continual learning and professional growth, with a Driver mentality focused on initiative, adaptability, and continuous improvement. * Strong written and verbal communication skills and the ability to work effectively with technical teams, end users, business stakeholders, vendors, and service providers. CORE TECHNICAL COMPETENCIES * Microsoft Cloud and Productivity: Azure, Microsoft 365, Entra ID, Exchange Online, Teams, SharePoint Online, OneDrive, Intune, and Purview. * Systems and Infrastructure: Windows Server, virtualization, systems administration, infrastructure monitoring, and performance management. * Networking: Switching, VLANs, network segmentation, enterprise firewalls, wireless networking, VPNs, remote connectivity, monitoring, and troubleshooting. * Infrastructure Security: Secure system and network configuration, vulnerability remediation, authentication, access controls, logging, and monitoring. * Backup and Recovery: Backup, restoration, disaster recovery, and business continuity technologies. * Automation and AI: PowerShell, scripting, automation, Microsoft Copilot, Copilot Studio, and practical application of AI technologies. * IT Operations: Change management, inventory and asset management, technical documentation, and infrastructure support processes. PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS * Experience supporting hybrid infrastructure across on\-premises and cloud environments, including geographically distributed locations and remote users. * Experience working in a regulated or security\-focused environment with established security, change management, and compliance requirements. * Experience evaluating and applying AI technologies, including Microsoft Copilot, to improve IT operations and service delivery. * Experience leading or serving in a key technical role on infrastructure upgrades, migrations, and modernization initiatives.

jobs.title: C++ Developer
jobs.description: Trexquant is a growing systematic fund at the forefront of quantitative finance, with a core team of highly accomplished researchers and engineers. We are continuously optimizing and reimagining our trading infrastructure to keep pace with our expanding business. To support our rapid growth, we are seeking a talented C\+\+ Developer to join our technology team and help build and enhance the systems that power our quantitative trading platform. As a C\+\+ Developer, you will work closely with our engineering teams to design, develop, and optimize high\-performance trading systems infrastructure. Your responsibilities will span multiple greenfield areas, including order management systems (OMS), market data, trading infrastructure, and data platforms. The ideal candidate will have strong modern C\+\+ fundamentals, experience with distributed systems, and a demonstrated ability to write performant, memory\-efficient code. **Responsibilities** * Design, develop, and maintain high\-performance C\+\+ infrastructure supporting our trading systems, including order management systems (OMS), market data, and data platforms. * Build and optimize scalable, distributed systems with a focus on execution speed, memory efficiency, reliability, and throughput. * Collaborate closely with engineering teams and quantitative researchers to develop innovative technical solutions, improve existing systems, and contribute to new infrastructure initiatives across the firm's trading platform. **Requirements** * Degree in Computer Science or a related field, with 1–3\+ years of software engineering experience or equivalent experience through advanced academic research (MS/PhD). * Strong proficiency in modern C\+\+ (C\+\+17/20/23\), with a deep understanding of data structures, algorithms, memory management, multithreading, and concurrency. * Demonstrated ability to write efficient, production\-quality C\+\+ code, with an emphasis on execution speed and memory optimization. * Experience designing and developing distributed systems, with a solid understanding of networking fundamentals. * Experience developing software in a Linux environment. * Experience with trading systems, market data, or financial technology is a plus, but not required. **Benefits** * Competitive salary plus bonus based on individual and company performance. * Collaborative, casual, and friendly work environment. * PPO Health, dental and vision insurance premiums fully covered for you and your dependents. * Pre\-tax commuter benefits. * Weekly company meals. Base salary is one component of Trexquant’s total compensation, which may also include a discretionary, performance\-based bonus. This position is classified as overtime\-exempt. Trexquant is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Applied AI Engineer, Finance
jobs.description: **About Tutor** We believe robots are the biggest lever we have to making the physical world a better, more affordable place. But robots are a rounding error in our society: nearly nine out of ten American factories and warehouses don’t even have a single robot, and robots have yet to make their way into our homes or places of business. Tutor Intelligence is changing that. Tutor is a robotics research and deployment company, building generally capable robot hardware and artificial intelligence to enable robots to go where no robots have gone before. Sonny is a semi\-humanoid robot with frontier dexterity approaching the human form. Cassie does back\-breaking work, moving boxes, pallets, and bulk goods for businesses from family\-owned manufacturers to some of the largest brands in the world. Tutor robots are manufactured at scale and operate as a network, combining the whole fleet’s learned experience to train ever more capable robot artificial intelligence. Founded at MIT and headquartered in Watertown, MA, our team is full stack: we design and manufacture robot hardware, train our own models, work directly with the smallest and largest end\-customers, and maintain our fleet across the United States. We’re a team of researchers, engineers, technicians, operators, and sellers who love building things and solving hard problems. Our mission is grand: robots everywhere, for the common good, raising the standard of living across North America, and then the world. **The Role** As our first Applied AI Engineer on Finance, you'll build the operating system for how Tutor runs its finances: planning and forecasting, billing, the close, and the numbers leadership and the board run the company on. You'll design the process flows and change the shape of the work, and you'll do it by writing a lot of software: building whole workflows, tools, and AI agents from scratch rather than living in spreadsheets. This is a technical role where you write and own software, and you'll embed as a true member of our finance team, owning outcomes for that team through technology. You'll have full visibility into what finance does across the business, and you'll treat finance as part of the wider Tutor system: our robots, deployments, customers, and data. Tutor sells robot labor with usage\-based pricing, so billing, revenue, and unit economics all depend on what the robots actually do. You'll join our forward\-deployed AI engineering team: a strategic team of engineers already embedded across deployment, manufacturing, maintenance, and hardware and software engineering, using AI to change how each of those functions works. You'll be its first engineer dedicated to finance. You'll start by taking over and extending finance tools we've already built. jobs.description: **About Tutor** We believe robots are the biggest lever we have to making the physical world a better, more affordable place. Sonny is a semi\-humanoid robot with frontier dexterity approaching the human form. Cassie does back\-breaking work, moving boxes, pallets, and bulk goods for businesses from family\-owned manufacturers to some of the largest brands in the world. addressing bias, drift, robustness, and performance * Tune cloud infrastructure for performance, reliability, and cost efficiency across compute, storage, and data transfer layers * Build and maintain lifecycle **Qualifications** ------------------ * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, Engineering, Applied Mathematics, or related field (or equivalent experience) * 3\+ years of jobs.title: AI Engineer – Agentic Systems & Automation
jobs.description: **The Role** We're hiring an engineer to build production AI agents that do real work across our business. You'll take processes like document intake, data extraction, keeping systems in sync, internal copilots, decision support, and workflow orchestration, and turn them into agents that run reliably every day. This is a hands\-on engineering position. We need someone who writes the code, deploys the agent, and stays accountable for how it performs. If your strength is AI strategy decks rather than shipped systems, this isn't the right fit. You'll report directly to the Director of Technology, with nothing standing between a problem you identify and a solution you put into production. **Location and Schedule** This is a full\-time, in\-office role at our headquarters in Kennesaw, GA. Remote and hybrid arrangements are not available, and we are not offering relocation for this position. You should be able to commute to Kennesaw reliably starting on your first day. **What You'll Build and Own** **Agent Design and Development** * Architect and ship production agentic systems using tool calling, multi\-step reasoning, sub\-agent orchestration, memory, retrieval, and human\-in\-the\-loop review points * Work with leadership and operators in each business unit to find the automation opportunities worth pursuing, then deliver agents that capture them **Integration and Security** * Connect agents to our existing environment, including Microsoft Graph, Entra, SharePoint, Teams, Procore, Azure Functions, Make.com, and outside APIs * Build secure identity and access patterns for agents: managed identities, service principals, OAuth2 flows, least\-privilege Graph permissions, and audit logging **Evaluation and Reliability** * Stand up evaluation pipelines and observability for every production agent, covering cost, output quality, failure modes, and regression testing * Track down problems early and keep agents performing as the business and the models change **Governance and Direction** * Set and maintain AI governance standards across our companies for data handling, model selection, prompt management, versioning, and rollback * Write clear documentation of architecture and decisions so your systems can be maintained long after they're built * Follow the agentic AI space closely (Claude, OpenAI, Azure AI Foundry, Copilot Studio, LangGraph, MCP, and others) and give practical recommendations on which platforms to use **The Environment You'll Build In** Our technology runs on a modern, well\-maintained foundation: Microsoft 365, Entra ID, Intune, Azure (Functions, Table Storage, Entra Domain Services), Procore, and custom integrations built with Make.com and Microsoft Graph. We see well\-applied technology as a real competitive edge across our portfolio of operating companies, and agentic AI is now a core investment for all of them. **Must\-Haves** * 3 to 5 years of professional software engineering experience, including at least 1 year delivering AI/LLM systems in production (prototypes and demos don't count) * Strong Python and/or TypeScript skills * Hands\-on work with at least one major agent framework or SDK, such as the Anthropic Claude SDK, OpenAI Agents SDK, LangGraph, Vercel AI SDK, Semantic Kernel, or Azure AI Foundry * Real experience building eval harnesses and interpreting the results. You should be able to show how you know an agent is working * Working knowledge of Azure Functions, Microsoft Graph API, Entra ID app registrations, OAuth2, and managed identities * Solid backend and integration skills: REST APIs, webhooks, queues, state management, and authentication patterns * Clear writing and the ability to lay out trade\-offs for a technical leader making investment calls * ***Able to work on\-site daily in Kennesaw, GA*** **We'd Especially Like to See** * Production work with Microsoft Copilot Studio, Power Automate, or Azure AI Foundry * Experience with Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers or similar tool\-server designs * Retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG) built over enterprise document stores like SharePoint, OneDrive, or Confluence * Background in multi\-entity or multi\-tenant environments where identity and data concerns cut across organizations * Infrastructure\-as\-code or DevOps experience with Bicep, Terraform, GitHub Actions, or Azure DevOps * Exposure to construction technology (Procore, Bluebeam, etc.) or vertical SaaS integrations **Also a Plus** * A cybersecurity or compliance background, especially in AI governance, data classification, or zero\-trust * Open\-source contributions to agent frameworks or developer tools * Experience as one of the first AI hires at a company **How We'll Measure Success** * How quickly new agents and automations go from idea to production * Business results you can point to, such as hours saved, faster cycle times, fewer errors, or revenue gained * Reliability, including uptime, eval pass rates, cost efficiency, and how incidents are handled * The strength of what you leave behind: maintainable code, documentation, security posture, and knowledge shared with the team **What Sets This Role Apart** * You report straight to the Director of Technology, with no extra layers in the way * You'll have a real budget for tools and platforms, not a free\-tier mandate * You'll be building on a clean, modern stack instead of untangling legacy systems * Your work will span multiple operating companies and touch many parts of the business * You'll be able to point to live production systems and say you built them **Benefits and Growth** We offer a competitive base salary based on experience, along with health, dental, and vision coverage, a retirement plan, and paid time off. We also support continued growth through learning budgets, conference attendance, and dedicated time for building new skills. **Applying** Along with your resume, send a brief write\-up of one agentic AI system you've put into production. Tell us what it did, what was hardest about building it, how you evaluated it, and what you'd change if you built it again. That write\-up matters more to us than your resume. Public repos, write\-ups, or recorded demos are very welcome. A cover letter isn't required, but the project description is. **About United Contractor Services** United Contractor Services (UCS) is a national specialty subcontractor ranked among the Top 50 Walls and Ceilings contractors in North America. We deliver commercial interior scopes, including metal framing, drywall, acoustical ceilings, EIFS, stucco, painting, and Division 8 and 10 Specialties, across multiple markets, with UCS superintendents leading the work on every project. ***United Contractor Services is an Equal Opportunity Employer.***

jobs.title: Software Developer – Full Stack (Internal Applications)
jobs.description: **About United Contractor Services** United Contractor Services is a national specialty contractor and one of the Top 50 Walls and Ceilings contractors in North America. Our project teams deliver commercial interior scopes, including metal framing, drywall, acoustical ceilings, EIFS, stucco, painting, and Division 8 and 10 Specialties, across multiple markets. Behind every job is a set of systems that keeps estimating, accounting, payroll, and project management moving. We're looking for a developer to make those systems work better. **The Opportunity** This is a full\-time, in\-office position based at our headquarters in Kennesaw, GA. You'll be the person who designs, builds, and stands behind the internal software our people use every day. That means working across the whole stack, from the screens a superintendent or accountant interacts with down to the database and the integrations underneath. The key word is ownership. You won't be closing tickets someone else wrote. You'll sit down with the people doing the work, figure out what they really need, build it, ship it, and keep it running. When something breaks, it's yours to fix. When something could be better, it's yours to propose. **What You'll Do** **Understand the Business Before Building** * Work directly with accounting, operations, HR, IT, and project teams to learn how their work actually gets done * Find manual, repetitive processes that a purpose\-built tool or automation could eliminate * Turn what you hear into technical designs, data models, and realistic delivery plans **Build Across the Full Stack** * Develop internal web applications end to end: user interface, business logic, APIs, and database * Design relational schemas and write efficient queries and stored procedures * Create and consume REST APIs and webhooks that connect internal apps with our core platforms * Keep code clean, testable, and maintainable, and take part in code reviews **Ship It and Keep It Running** * Handle testing, deployment, and monitoring for the applications you build * Track down and fix bugs, slowdowns, and data integrity problems wherever they live in the stack * Build in logging, alerts, validation, and error handling so issues get caught before users notice them **Set the Standards** * Document architecture, data models, field definitions, and business rules so others can follow your work * Define practices for source control, API usage, authentication, and change management * Make sure applications meet security, access control, and audit expectations **Keep Raising the Bar** * Research frameworks, third\-party tools, and APIs that could speed up delivery * Improve the performance, scalability, and maintainability of existing applications * Bring ideas to leadership on your own initiative rather than waiting for direction **Systems You'll Work With** Our environment includes the following (not an exhaustive list): * Viewpoint Vista (ERP) and Procore (project management), including their data and APIs * ADP and Paylocity payroll and HR platforms * Microsoft 365, Entra ID, Teams, Power Platform, and Azure * ManageEngine ServiceDesk or Freshservice * Internal web apps and dashboards serving both field and office teams What You Bring * At least 3 years of professional development experience covering both front end and back end * Solid skills in one or more back\-end languages such as C\#, Python, or JavaScript/Node * Front\-end skills in HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, plus experience with a modern framework like React, Angular, or Vue * Strong SQL and relational database design ability * Practical experience building and integrating REST/JSON APIs, including OAuth and token\-based authentication * Comfort with Git and standard development workflows * A track record of turning business requirements into software people actually use * Sharp troubleshooting skills and a habit of finding the root cause, not just the symptom * The independence to own your work and the results that come from it * Must be able to work on\-site daily at our Kennesaw, GA office **Bonus Points** * Integration or reporting work with Viewpoint Vista, Procore, ADP, or Paylocity * Development within the Microsoft ecosystem, such as Azure Functions, Power Platform, or Entra ID * Experience with cloud hosting, CI/CD pipelines, or containers * Power BI, SSRS, or other reporting and BI tools * Background in construction or another project\-driven industry ***United Contractor Services is an Equal Opportunity Employer.***

jobs.title: Assistant Professor in Transportation Engineering (Tenure Track)
jobs.description: **Assistant Professor in Transportation Engineering (Tenure Track)** ==================================================================== ### **Position Overview** **School / Campus / College:** College of Engineering **Organization:** Civil \& Environmental Engineering **Title:** Assistant Professor in Transportation Engineering (Tenure Track) ### **Position Details** #### **Position Description** The Department of Civil and Environmental Engineering (CEE) at the University of Washington invites applications for a faculty position at the rank of Assistant Professor (Tenure Track), with an anticipated start date of September, 2027\. The location of this position is on the University of Washington campus in Seattle, Washington. We seek applicants who demonstrate commitment to excellence in research, teaching, and service in a diverse and inclusive academic community. The successful candidate will join our faculty on a full\-time basis for a nine\-month academic appointment, 3\-year term, renewable, beginning September 16, 2027\. The base salary range for this position will be \[$11,500 \- $13,500] per month, commensurate with experience and qualifications, or as mandated by a U.S. Department of Labor prevailing wage determination. Positive factors for consideration include, but are not limited to, candidates with a promising record of research excellence in transportation; candidates working with emerging methods, tools, or technologies, such as artificial intelligence and machine learning, robotics and automation, new sensing and data sources, quantum applications, or directions we have not anticipated; and/or candidates who bring new areas of strength for the department. Applicants are encouraged to connect their work to one or more of the Grand Challenges identified in the Department's strategic plan. All University of Washington faculty are expected to engage in teaching, research, and service. Our department offers a highly collegial and collaborative culture, with broad interdisciplinary research ties and opportunities. The UW has an active community of transportation researchers within CEE, the College of Engineering (CoE), and across the university. The candidate is expected to collaborate with colleagues within CEE, CoE, throughout the university, and externally; and to develop an externally funded research program. In teaching, the candidate will support and expand transportation course offerings at the undergraduate and graduate levels. In all aspects of this position, the candidate will be expected to contribute to a welcoming and inclusive environment in research, teaching, mentoring, and service. #### **Qualifications** Applicants for this position must meet the following minimum qualifications: * A PhD or foreign equivalent degree, in civil engineering or a related discipline, by the date of appointment. #### **Instructions** To ensure full consideration of your application, please submit all materials no later than November 29, 2026\. Priority will be given to those applications received by November 29, 2026\. Applications will only be accepted via Interfolio. The position will remain open until filled. Applications should include the following materials, noting that any content exceeding page limits will not be reviewed: 1\. a cover letter of no more than 1 page detailing the candidate’s interest in the position, relevant qualifications and experiences, and a link to their Google Scholar profile; 2\. a curriculum vitae; 3\. a two\-page research statement that includes the candidate’s vision for their research for the next 5 years, alignment of their work with one or more of the Grand Challenges identified in the department’s Strategic Plan, and the potential for research collaboration and external funding; 4\. a one\-page description of the candidate’s vision for instruction and learning in civil and environmental engineering, identifying current undergraduate and graduate courses the candidate is interested in teaching and potential new course offerings; 5\. a one\-page description of the candidate’s record of and plans for service, including service to the profession, to the department and the University, and/or engagement with public agencies, industry, and the communities affected by transportation decisions; 6\. up to three publications that illustrate the candidate’s research contributions; 7\. contact information for at least 3 referees who are prepared to provide letters of recommendation upon request. References will only be contacted for short\-listed candidates, but if asked will be expected to submit recommendations within thirty days. Applicants should articulate how their past experiences and/or future plans in research, teaching, mentoring, and/or service promote a sense of belonging and foster a welcoming and inclusive environment. Any such information should be integrated into the statements on research, teaching, and service, not included as a separate statement. #### **Equal Employment Opportunity Statement** **Equal Opportunity** The University of Washington is committed to fostering an inclusive, respectful and welcoming community for all. As an equal opportunity employer, the University considers applicants for employment without regard to race, color, creed, religion, national origin, citizenship, sex, pregnancy, age, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, disability, or veteran status consistent with UW Executive Order No. 81\. **Benefits Information** The University is committed to providing excellent benefits to our faculty. For a summary of available benefits, please see UWHR benefits information. **Privacy Notice** Your application materials may be used for employment consideration and shared in accordance with UW’s Privacy Policy. **Disability Services** The University of Washington is committed to providing access and reasonable accommodation in its services, programs, activities, education, and employment for individuals with disabilities. To request disability accommodation in the application process, contact the Disability Services Office at 206\-543\-6450 or dso@uw.edu.

Experience creating informational publications, training materials, brochures, or facts sheets. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment or volunteer status without regard to any legally protected basis and will not be discriminated against because of their protected status. Enterprise Data Services (EDS), part of Enterprise Engineering in the University of Maryland's Division of Information Technology (DIT), designs, builds, and supports the enterprise data platforms that power analytics, reporting, and decision\-making across UMD, a top 20 public research institution. EDS manages core university data domains and partners with colleges, departments, and administrative units to ensure data is trusted, accessible, and ready for decisions. The Lead Data Engineer will play a key role in building out and driving adoption of the University's Microsoft Fabric data platform, leading complex data initiatives, and raising the technical bar across EDS. **Role Overview** We're looking for a lead data engineer who loves turning messy, multi\-system data into trusted, reusable solutions and who gets energy from helping other engineers and business partners grow. Serve as an escalation point for complex data and platform issues, driving root\-cause analysis and lasting fixes. * \*\*This position is considered essential and may be required to work at the normal work location or an alternative location during a major catastrophic event, weather emergency, or other operational emergency to help maintain the continuity of University services.\*\* \*\*May be required to work evenings, nights, weekends, or different shifts for extended periods.\*\* **Physical Demands:** Sedentary work. jobs.description: * JR10016350 * Remote * Madison, Wisconsin * Information Technology * Full time * Closing at: Nov 17 2026 \- 11:00pm CST **Job Category:** ----------------- Academic Staff **Employment Type:** -------------------- Regular **Job Profile:** ---------------- Technical Integration Engineer III **Job Summary:** ---------------- The Division of Information Technology (DoIT) is an exciting and dynamic work environment grounded in organizational principles that include family and personal life/work balance; an inclusive, respectful, and supportive work environment; professional development opportunities; innovation; and alignment with the campus's teaching, learning, and research missions. DoIT provides core IT infrastructure services to the university, develops and implements services for the university and in some cases, for the Universities of Wisconsin, plays a major role in managing the state\-wide higher education network and regional networks. The Integrated Business Solutions team within the Division of Information Technology is seeking a highly skilled AI Solutions Engineer to design, build, operate, and continuously improve the cloud and hybrid platforms that support AI\-enabled services. This position is responsible for managing multi\-cloud infrastructure, automation, security, observability, and operational governance, enabling development teams to deliver reliable, scalable, and secure solutions. Working closely with software engineers, architects, business partners, and stakeholders across UW\-Madison and affiliated university organizations, this role will drive the infrastructure and operational capabilities needed to support administrative AI and automation initiatives that improve organizational efficiency. The successful candidate will help establish platform standards, streamline deployment processes, and advance the adoption of emerging technologies across the university. Candidates should enjoy working independently in an agile environment while contributing to the development and support of innovative AI solutions. Responsibilities include: * Lead the design, deployment, operation, and continuous improvement of hybrid AI platforms supporting and integrating AI\-enabled services * Architect, design and maintain secure traditional and AI infrastructure, automation, CI/CD pipelines for automation and deployment processes that enable reliable and scalable service delivery * Implement and support observability, monitoring, troubleshooting, logging, performance optimization, and operational practices that ensure platform reliability, security, and availability * Establish and maintain platform standards, governance controls, and operational best practices for hosted applications and services * Collaborate with developers, architects, security and network teams, and business stakeholders to support onboarding, deployment, and operation of AI applications on the Cloud AI platform * Evaluate and recommend technologies that improve platform capabilities, operational efficiency, security, and developer experience This position is eligible for any of the following: 100% remote work; partial remote work; or fully on\-site. Remote work requires an approved flexible work arrangement (FWA), which is reviewed and approved annually. An FWA requires successful candidates to possess their own high\-speed internet and phone to perform the work on a university provided computer. Per University policy, transportation between home and assigned work location is not payable/reimbursable and will be at the expense of the employee. **Key Job Responsibilities:** ----------------------------- * Plans, coordinates, and executes the development, testing, implementation, integration, and installation of moderately complex system resources, upgrades, and security components in alignment with industry best practices * Designs small components and runs, maintains, and operates technical systems and infrastructure * Plans and directs staff implementation of small to medium technical projects as needed * Assist in the adoption of agentic AI solutions * Integrates, identifies, troubleshoots, monitors, and resolves complex and varied supported services, systems, network, and application problems according to established processes and procedures * Serves as an expert point of contact for external stakeholders and IT partners regarding system integrations, identifies needs, provides solution options, and communicates issue updates and resolutions * Participates in the evaluation of vendor software releases, upgrade planning, and impact. Documents and communicates system enhancements or changes * Assists in the design of system and infrastructure specifications, implementation, and/or integration, trend analysis, and capacity planning **Department:** --------------- Division of Information Technology, Enterprise Business Systems, Integrated Business Solutions Enterprise Business Systems (EBS) delivers comprehensive services to UW–Madi platforms spanning cloud and on\-premises environments in higher education **Preferred Qualifications:** ----------------------------- In addition to required qualifications, the most qualified candidates may also have the following preferred qualifications: * Experience using AI\-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, or similar technologies within professional software engineering workflows. * Experience supporting multi\-cloud platforms that host AI\-enabled or data\-intensive applications. * Experience establishing platform standards, governance controls, networks and security practices for cloud\-native applications. **Education:** -------------- Bachelor’s Degree preferably in Computer Science, Information Technology or related field **How to Apply:** ----------------- You will be prompted to upload the following documents: * Resume * Letter of Qualifications Applicants should attach a letter of qualifications and resume detailing their training and experience relating to the required and preferred qualifications referenced above. The application reviewers will be relying on written application materials to determine which qualified applicants will advance in the recruitment process. Please note that successful applicants must be authorized to work in the United States without need of employer sponsorship, on or before the effective date of appointment. University sponsorship is not available for this position. **Contact Information:** ------------------------ DoIT Human Resources, doit\-hr@doit.wisc.edu, 608\-263\-1790 Relay Access (WTRS): 7\-1\-1\. See RELAY\_SERVICE for further information. **Institutional Statement on Diversity:** ----------------------------------------- Diversity is a source of strength, creativity, and innovation for UW\-Madison. We commit ourselves to the pursuit of excellence in teaching, research, outreach, and diversity as inextricably linked goals. The University of Wisconsin\-Madison fulfills its public mission by creating a welcoming and inclusive community for people from every background \- people who as students, faculty, and staff serve Wisconsin and the world. **The University of Wisconsin\-Madison is an Equal Opportunity Employer.** Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to, including but not limited to, race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, age, pregnancy, disability, or status as a protected veteran and other bases as defined by federal regulations and UW System policies. We promote excellence by acknowledging skills and expertise from all backgrounds and encourage all qualified individuals to apply. To request a disability or pregnancy\-related accommodation for any step in the hiring process (e.g., application, interview, pre\-employment testing, etc.), please contact the Divisional Disability Representative (DDR) in the division you are applying to. Stat. sec. 19\.36(7\). jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer
jobs.description: Job Posting End Date: November 16 When you join the team at Unum, you become part of an organization committed to helping you thrive. Here, we work to provide the employee benefits and service solutions that enable employees at our client companies to thrive throughout life’s moments. And this starts with ensuring that every one of our team members enjoys opportunities to succeed both professionally and personally. To enable this, we provide: * Award\-winning culture * Inclusion and diversity as a priority * Performance Based Incentive Plans * Competitive benefits package that includes: Health, Vision, Dental, Short \& Long\-Term Disability * Generous PTO (including paid time to volunteer!) * Up to 9\.5% 401(k) employer contribution * Mental health support * Career advancement opportunities * Student loan repayment options * Tuition reimbursement * Flexible work environments * ***All the benefits listed above are subject to the terms of their individual Plans*** **.** And that’s just the beginning… With 10,000 employees helping more than 39 million people worldwide, every role at Unum is meaningful and impacts the lives of our customers. Whether you’re directly supporting a growing family, or developing online tools to help navigate a difficult loss, customers are counting on the combined talents of our entire team. Help us help others, and join Team Unum today! **General Summary:** -------------------- This position is for an experienced Senior Data Engineer who will serve as a hands\-on technical lead for data engineering across assigned Value Streams, providing technical leadership across at least two Value Streams, translating enterprise architecture standards, patterns, and governance guardrails into detailed, production\-ready designs that engineering teams can successfully implement. This is a 100% hands\-on technical role. The Senior Data Engineer will actively design solutions, solve complex engineering challenges, make key technical decisions, review code and implementations, and guide engineers through delivery. The role will lead by doing, not simply coordinate the work. The Senior Data Engineer will lead the design and delivery of complex data pipelines, ETL/ELT processes, data warehouses, data marts, data models, and integration solutions using technologies including Snowflake, SQL, Python, and modern ETL/ELT tooling. This individual will partner closely with architects, product owners, engineers, analysts, and business stakeholders to deliver scalable, reliable, secure, and maintainable data solutions. They will also play an important role in Value Stream transformation by establishing engineering best practices, leading design and code reviews, mentoring engineers, and driving consistency and technical excellence across teams. **Job Specifications:** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related technical field preferred. * 6\+ years of experience in Data Engineering, Software Engineering, Data Integration, or related technical disciplines. * Demonstrated hands\-on experience designing and building complex data pipelines, ETL/ELT solutions, data warehouses, data marts, and data models in large\-scale enterprise environments. * Strong hands\-on expertise with Snowflake, SQL, Python, and modern ETL/ELT technologies. * Experience working with cloud data platforms and integrating data through APIs, batch, near\-real\-time, and real\-time integration patterns. * Deep knowledge of data modeling, data integration patterns, solution design, and modern data engineering practices. * Demonstrated ability to translate enterprise architecture patterns, standards, and guardrails into detailed, scalable, production\-ready technical designs. * Proven experience serving as a hands\-on technical lead, including making design decisions, conducting design and code reviews, solving complex engineering problems, and guiding engineers through implementation. * Strong understanding of DevOps and CI/CD practices, Git, automated testing, automation, deployment, and operational excellence. * Experience delivering solutions within complex enterprise data environments involving multiple systems, platforms, and data sources. * Familiarity with legacy data platforms such as Teradata and DB2 is beneficial, particularly within modernization or transformation environments. * Demonstrated ability to mentor engineers and influence technical direction while remaining actively involved in engineering delivery. * Strong problem\-solving, communication, and stakeholder management skills. * Strong business acumen with the ability to balance technical quality, delivery objectives, and business outcomes. **Principal Duties and Responsibilities:** * Serve as the hands\-on technical lead for data engineering across assigned Value Streams, providing technical direction across at least two Value Streams. * Lead the design and implementation of complex data engineering solutions, including data pipelines, ETL/ELT processes, data warehouses, data marts, data models, and enterprise data assets. * Translate enterprise architecture standards, patterns, and governance guardrails into detailed, scalable, and implementable technical designs. * Actively contribute to solution design and engineering, troubleshooting complex technical challenges and guiding solutions through implementation and production. * Make key technical design decisions and lead design and code reviews to ensure solutions meet scalability, reliability, security, performance, and maintainability standards. * Lead complex integrations across cloud, on\-premises, internal, and external data sources, including batch, near\-real\-time, real\-time, and API\-based integrations. * Partner with architects, product owners, analysts, engineers, and business stakeholders to understand requirements and determine appropriate technical solutions. * Establish and promote engineering best practices for data modeling, integration, automation, testing, performance optimization, deployment, and operational support. * Guide engineers through implementation and provide hands\-on technical coaching and mentoring to strengthen engineering capabilities across teams. * Support Value Stream transformation through the adoption of modern data engineering patterns, technologies, and development practices. * Apply approved AI\-enabled tools where appropriate to improve engineering productivity, quality, and delivery. \#LI\-TS1 \~IN1 Unum and Colonial Life are part of Unum Group, a Fortune 500 company and leading provider of employee benefits to companies worldwide. Headquartered in Chattanooga, TN, with international offices in Ireland, Poland and the UK, Unum also has significant operations in Portland, ME \- plus over 35 US field offices. Colonial Life is headquartered in Columbia, SC, with over 40 field offices nationwide. Unum is an equal opportunity employer, considering all qualified applicants and employees for hiring, placement, and advancement, without regard to a person's race, color, religion, national origin, age, genetic information, military status, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, disability, or protected veteran status. The base salary range for applicants for this position is listed below. Unless actual salary is indicated above in the job description, actual pay will be based on skill, geographical location and experience. $98,340\.00\-$201,900\.00 Additionally, Unum offers a portfolio of benefits and rewards that are competitive and comprehensive including healthcare benefits (health, vision, dental), insurance benefits (short \& long\-term disability), performance\-based incentive plans, paid time off, and a 401(k) retirement plan with an employer match up to 5% and an additional 4\.5% contribution whether you contribute to the plan or not. All benefits are subject to the terms and conditions of individual Plans. Company: Unum

Our work directly impacts Utah citizens by delivering meaningful software, reliable services, and modernized data infrastructure that evolves with county needs. **Job Overview** The Database Administrator I oversees the design, administration, security, performance, and availability of Azure\-based data platforms and supporting cloud infrastructure across multiple county environments. Serving as the technical lead for Azure SQL environments and supporting data services, this role balances core database administration with cloud engineering. The Database Administrator I collaborates with software development teams, infrastructure engineers, security stakeholders, and county customers to maintain highly available, resilient, and cost\-effective data solutions. **Key Responsibilities** * **Database Administration and Optimization:** Administer, monitor, and maintain Azure SQL Database, Azure SQL Managed Instance, and SQL Server on Aure VMs. Proactively analyze and optimize queries, indexes, and database configurations to sustain peak performance and system health. * **High Availability \& Business Continuity:** Architect, test, and manage backup, restore, geo\-replication, and disaster recovery strategies to satisfy recovery point (RPO) and recovery time (RTO) objectives. Instance. * Proven experience designing and managing complex backup, recovery, and disaster recovery solutions. * Strong proficiency in T\-SQL development, indexing, and query performance tuning. * Demonstrated experience managing access controls with Microsoft Entra ID and RBAC. * Experience developing or supporting Azure Data Factory ETL pipelines and Power BI reports/dashboards. * Working Storage Accounts, Virtual Machines, and Key Vaults. * Experience utilizing Infrastructure as Code (Bicep) and Ci/CD pipelines within Azure DevOps. * Experience in supporting multi\-tenant SaaS environments or public\-sector/local government entities. * Familiarity with security audits, compliance initiative, and cloud governance frameworks. **Success Measures** Performance and impact in testing. * **Performance \& Data Reliability:** Delivering measurable query performance improvements, resolving technical issues promptly, and ensuring dependable data integration and reporting pipelines. * **Security, Compliance \& Cost Governance:** Sustaining least\-privileged access, ensuring continuous audit compliance, and optimizing cloud resource spend. * **Automation \& Operational Standards:** Driving operational efficiency through CI/CD and scripting automation while maintaining clear technical documentation and standard runbooks. **How to Apply** To be considered for this Pay: $80,000\.00 \- $95,000\.00 per year Benefits: * Dental insurance * Health insurance * Health savings account * Life insurance * Paid time off * Retirement plan Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Linux Infrastructure Engineer (Bare Metal, Storage & AI Factory Infrastructure)
jobs.description: **Job Overview** We are seeking a highly experienced **Senior Linux Infrastructure Engineer** with deep expertise in Linux administration, bare metal infrastructure, enterprise storage, and next\-generation **AI Factory / GPU infrastructure platforms**. This role is focused on designing, deploying, operating, and troubleshooting large\-scale Linux\-based infrastructure that powers both traditional enterprise workloads and modern AI/ML environments. This is **not a DevOps\-focused role**. We already have a dedicated DevOps team and are looking for an engineer with extensive hands\-on experience in **Bare Metal as a Service (BMaaS), GPU infrastructure, high\-performance storage, data center operations, and enterprise Linux platforms**. The ideal candidate will have experience building and managing infrastructure from the hardware layer up, including servers, networking, storage, GPU clusters, and AI\-ready platforms. They should be comfortable working with high\-performance computing (HPC), AI Factory environments, and large\-scale Linux deployments where performance, reliability, and operational excellence are critical. **Key Responsibilities \& Required Skills** **Linux \& Bare Metal Infrastructure** * Expert\-level Linux administration (Ubuntu required; Red Hat and SUSE preferred) * Deep expertise in **bare metal server deployment, architecture, provisioning, and lifecycle management** * Experience operating **Bare Metal as a Service (BMaaS)** platforms and large\-scale infrastructure environments * Strong understanding of server hardware, including: + BIOS/UEFI + RAID controllers + Firmware management + iLO/iDRAC/IPMI + NICs and SmartNICs + HBA cards + Hardware diagnostics and troubleshooting * Experience designing, implementing, and supporting enterprise Linux infrastructure at scale **AI Factory \& GPU Infrastructure** * Experience deploying and managing **GPU\-accelerated infrastructure** for AI/ML workloads * Understanding of NVIDIA GPU technologies including: + A100, H100, H200, B200, or equivalent GPU platforms + NVIDIA DGX and OEM GPU servers + GPU provisioning and lifecycle management + GPU monitoring and performance optimization * Knowledge of AI Factory architecture and infrastructure requirements * Experience supporting GPU clusters, AI training environments, and high\-performance computing (HPC) workloads * Understanding of: + GPU resource allocation and scheduling + Multi\-GPU systems + GPU networking requirements + High\-bandwidth, low\-latency infrastructure design * Familiarity with NVIDIA ecosystem technologies such as: + CUDA + NCCL + GPUDirect Storage + NVIDIA Fabric Manager + NVIDIA Base Command (preferred) **Enterprise Storage \& Data Platforms** * Advanced Linux storage administration: + LVM + XFS, EXT4 + NFS + iSCSI + Fibre Channel SAN + Multipath I/O * Strong hands\-on experience with **Ceph**, including: + Cluster architecture + MON, OSD, MDS + RBD, CephFS, RGW + Capacity planning + Performance tuning + Failure recovery * Experience with high\-performance AI storage platforms such as: + WEKA + VAST Data + Dell PowerScale + Pure Storage FlashBlade + NetApp * Understanding of: + NVMe\-over\-Fabrics (NVMe\-oF) + RDMA + GPUDirect Storage + Parallel file systems + AI data pipelines **Networking \& Infrastructure** * Strong networking knowledge: + Bonding + VLANs + Routing + MTU optimization + DNS + DHCP * Experience with high\-performance data center networking: + 100G/200G/400G Ethernet + RoCE + RDMA + Spine\-Leaf architectures * Familiarity with NVIDIA Spectrum\-X, Mellanox/NVIDIA ConnectX adapters, or equivalent technologies * Strong understanding of Layer 2 and Layer 3 infrastructure design and troubleshooting **Operations \& Reliability** * Experience with high availability, clustering, and disaster recovery * Strong troubleshooting skills across: + Linux operating systems + Hardware platforms + GPU infrastructure + Networking + Enterprise storage * Experience supporting mission\-critical production environments * Bash and Python scripting for automation and operational efficiency * Experience creating operational documentation, runbooks, and infrastructure standards * Understanding of AI infrastructure design and reference architectures * AI cloud integration for workloads * SOP and runbook development and maintenance * Incident, problem, and capacity management * Business continuity and disaster recovery planning for AI workloads * Proactive risk identification and mitigation to avoid business impact **Nice to Have** * Kubernetes infrastructure (especially AI/ML and GPU integration) * KVM, VMware, OpenShift Virtualization, or similar virtualization platforms * Ansible automation * NVIDIA Base Command Manager * Slurm or HPC workload schedulers * Observability and monitoring platforms (Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry) * Data Center Infrastructure Management (DCIM) tools * IPAM solutions * AWS, Azure, or hybrid cloud exposure **We Are Not Looking For** * Candidates whose experience is primarily CI/CD pipeline engineering * Engineers focused mainly on Terraform, GitOps, or application delivery pipelines * Cloud\-only administrators with limited bare metal, storage, or hardware experience * Professionals whose primary expertise is software development rather than infrastructure engineering **Ideal Candidate** Someone who has spent years designing, building, and operating enterprise Linux environments, large\-scale bare metal infrastructure, storage platforms, and modern AI Factory environments. The ideal candidate understands how to deploy and manage GPU\-enabled infrastructure, BMaaS platforms, enterprise storage, and high\-performance networking while solving complex operating system, hardware, storage, and AI infrastructure challenges. DevOps experience is a plus, but deep Linux, infrastructure, storage, BMaaS, and AI Factory expertise is the primary requirement.

jobs.title: AI Research Engineer, Multiomics and Imaging
jobs.description: **Position Summary** **:** Build the computational infrastructure for discovering how cells organize into tissues. The Biological Information Architecture (BIA) Lab, led by Dr. Felix Zhou at Vanderbilt University, seeks a strong, self\-motivated Research Engineer to help build the software, AI workflows, and computational methods that will power a new generation of biological discovery. This is not a conventional academic programming role. You will have substantial ownership over the lab’s technical direction: architecting software from the ground up, building agentic AI systems for scientific analysis, developing new computational methods, and turning promising ideas into robust tools used by researchers. We are interested in strong software engineers from industry, computationally exceptional undergraduate or master’s students, and quantitative scientists who want to work on genuinely difficult scientific problems. We care more about technical ability, curiosity, and evidence that you can build things than academic qualifications. You will also contribute to publications and grants, help establish engineering practice, mentor trainees, and help identify technologies with potential for open\-source release, licensing, or commercialization. ***This position is a term position. A term position is a staff appointment established for a defined period of time based on the operational needs of the business unit and Vanderbilt University, generally expected to exceed six months but not extend beyond one year. This position's incumbent will be evaluated at the end of a one year assignment for renewal.*** **About the Work Unit** **:** The BIA Lab is a new, interdisciplinary computational biology group built around a founding north star mission: “develop the computational tools to decode and ultimately help reprogram the rules governing how individual cells determine tissue\-scale behavior”. The lab pursues this objective through atlas\-scale multimodal data analysis: combining advanced microscopy, quantitative cell phenomics, spatial tissue profiling and multi\-omics data; first\-principles open\-minded, curiosity\-driven scientific inquiry integrating ideas across disciplines without borders, be it theoretical physics, philosophy, economics, biology, computing or mathematics. We work closely with an expansive network of internal and external collaborators, and committed to open, well\-engineered software for the wider bioimage\-analysis and computational biology community. The lab is based in Vanderbilt’s Department of Cell and Developmental Biology and affiliated with the Center for Computational Systems Biology (CCSB), a trans\-institutional center spanning Vanderbilt Basic Sciences, Vanderbilt University Medical Center, and the College of Connected Computing, placing the lab within a growing community of computational biologists, imaging scientists, and systems\-level researchers on campus. Though newly launched, the lab has a strong methods track record. We have released a suite of open\-source tools used by the community, including u\-Segment3D (3D cell segmentation); u\-Unwrap3D (geometric computing), u\-Protrude3D (surface protrusion analysis), SAM\-SPOT and MOSES (phenotyping and motion quantification), and v\-InfoTrace (information\-flow analysis in images). The opportunity now, with real ownership, is to connect and build these cell\-level tools into scalable workflows to reverse\-engineer the logic circuitry of tissue signaling. BIA lab website: https://bia\-lab\-team.github.io/BIA\_Lab\_Website/index.html BIA lab GitHub: https://github.com/BIA\-Lab\-Team BIA lab publications: https://bia\-lab\-team.github.io/BIA\_Lab\_Website/publications.html **Why Join** **:** * Direct influence over software architecture, tooling choices, and engineering culture from day one * Work at the frontier of agentic AI applied to multi\-omics and imaging science, with substantial latitude to prototype and ship your own ideas * Solve real scientific problems involving large, messy, multimodal datasets * Work closely with the PI on scientific and technical direction in a high\-trust environment with substantial autonomy. * Build tools that enable non\-expert researchers to run s ophisticated analyses at scale. * Shape your own growth path toward technical leadership, scientific softwar e, AI systems, computational biology, or technology development. * Potential opportunities for open\-source releases, technology transfer, licensing, or spin\-out development as promising technologies mature. * Join an interdisciplinary environment without borders where ideas from computing, mathematics, physics, biology, arts and philosophy can directly shape the work. **Key Functions and Expected Performance:** Shape the lab’s technical vision and roadmap * Define software architecture, development standards, and infrastructure choices for the lab * Advise the PI on build\-vs\-adopt decisions and long\-term technical strategy Design and development of agentic workflows for multi\-omics and imaging data * Build agentic, LLM\-based pipelines that automate ingestion, quality control, processing, and analysis of multi\-omics (genomics, transcriptomics, proteomics) and imaging (light\-sheet, high\-content, spatial) data * Integrate agentic workflows with existing lab software and HPC/cloud compute infrastructure Evaluation, integration, and potential commercialization of new methodologies and tools * Research and assess suitability of emerging methodologies, algorithms, and open\-source packages relevant to the lab’s research direction * Turn promising research ideas into reliable, reusable software. * Identify lab\-developed technologies with translational or commercial potential and support early\-stage technology\-transfer, licensing, or spin\-out discussions. Teaching, onboarding, and community engagement * Onboard and train graduate students, postdocs, and rotation students on lab software and computational workflows. * Promote and communicate the lab’s software through open\-source releases, conferences, GitHub, forums, workshops, and other community channels. * Contribute to publications and grant writing **Experience and Skills:** Necessary * Strong software development and technical ability through research, open\-source work, internships, industry experience, competitions, or substantial independent projects. * A bachelor’s degree in a relevant scientific or computational field is sufficient; exceptional candidates with unconventional backgrounds are encouraged to apply. * Strong Python skills and familiarity with scientific libraries such as NumPy, SciPy, pandas, scikit\-image, or scikit\-learn. * Experience developing, releasing, and maintaining software projects. * Experience with, or strong interest in developing, agentic and LLM\-based workflows (e.g., Claude Agent SDK, LangChain, or similar frameworks). * Strong communication skills and the ability to work effectively with technical and non\-technical colleagues. * Self\-motivated, enterprising, intellectually curious, and comfortable operating with an incompletely specified roadmap. Preferred * Experience with multi\-omics data types (genomics, transcriptomics, proteomics) and/or bioimage analysis (light\-sheet, high\-content, or spatial imaging). * Knowledge of workflow orchestration and parallel/distributed computing technologies (e.g., Snakemake, Nextflow, NVIDIA CUDA, OpenMPI, or cloud\-based HPC). * Experience with production\-scale software engineering, scientific computing, or large\-scale data systems. **Education and Certifications:** * Bachelor’s degree in a relevant scientific or computational field with strong computational emphasis. * A minimum of 1–2 years of postgraduate or industry experience in software engineering, software development, or a related field is required. * Exceptional undergraduate and master’s candidates are encouraged to apply, particularly those with substantial software\-building experience. * Master’s or PhD preferred but not required.

jobs.title: AI Technical Lead
jobs.description: * **Employment Type:** Full\-Time * **FLSA Status:** Exempt * **Pay Type:** Salary, Exempt. $115,000 \- $140,000 annual base salary, depending on experience * **Work Location:** Remote. Applicants must be authorized to work in the United States without sponsorship. This position is open only to candidates currently residing in the United States. * **Travel Requirement:** Occasional travel for all\-team meetings and client workshops **AI Technical Lead** **Purpose of this Position** The AI Technical Lead is a seasoned AI practitioner and trusted client consultant who serves as the senior technical voice of VeilSun’s AI Practice. This role is consultant first. Before a model is selected or an integration is built, the Technical Lead has done the harder and more important work. They have learned the client’s business, their data, and their goals, and achieved Radical Alignment on what AI should accomplish and why. Radical Alignment is genuine, documented agreement with the client on what is being built, why it is being built, and what success looks like before development begins. This role combines hands\-on AI engineering depth with the consultative presence to guide enterprise AI roadmaps and AI service package engagements. Their expertise goes well beyond third\-party AI tools. It includes models, APIs, MCP servers, and the work of connecting AI securely to client data and schemas. The AI Technical Lead also carries an internal mandate. They redesign how VeilSun delivers, prove on real projects that AI can compress weeks of technical work into days, and build AI capability across the delivery organization. Low code moves the work. AI makes it intelligent. This role makes that promise real for our clients and keeps VeilSun’s low\-code practices competitive and growing. **Business Outcomes** Success in this role means AI engagements deliver measurable client value, VeilSun delivers faster with leaner teams, and AI capability is spreading across the delivery organization. You will be measured on: * **Engagement quality.** AI roadmaps and service package engagements are technically sound, right\-sized, and tied to client business outcomes. * **Client satisfaction.** Clients feel heard, informed, and confident. Risks around data, security, and model behavior are surfaced early and worked through together. * **Acceleration results.** Complex work such as data mapping and code generation moves from weeks or months to days. Results are measured, documented, and repeatable. * **Team enablement.** Delivery team members, including PMs and leadership, show measurable growth in AI skills and day\-to\-day adoption. * **Knowledge distribution.** AI expertise is held by multiple team members, not one person. * **Commercial discipline.** Meets the billable utilization target agreed with AI Practice leadership. Estimates are accurate and margin is protected. ### **Core Responsibilities** ### **Enterprise AI Roadmapping \& Client Consulting** * Serve as the technical expert on enterprise AI roadmap and AI service package engagements, partnering with the AI Services Lead and the project lead. * Lead discovery with discipline. Learn the client’s business, data landscape, and systems before recommending an AI approach. * Achieve Radical Alignment on AI use cases, success measures, and boundaries before any build begins. * Translate AI possibilities into practical, phased roadmaps that deliver value in small, high\-value increments. * Advise clients candidly on what AI can and cannot do today. Redirect them away from poorly fit use cases, unsafe data practices, or oversized investments. * Educate client stakeholders on tradeoffs among cost, accuracy, security, and speed so they can make informed decisions. * Partner with the Solution Engineer during the handoff from sales so technical design and estimates carry into delivery intact. ### **AI Engineering \& Architecture** * Design and build AI solutions that go beyond off\-the\-shelf tools, including model selection, API integration, prompt and agent design, and MCP server development. * Connect AI to client data and schemas securely, with attention to data quality, access controls, and governance. * Integrate AI capabilities with the Quickbase, Mendix, and custom web applications delivered by VeilSun’s other practices. * Serve as the primary technical authority on assigned AI engagements. Make and defend architecture decisions with confidence. * Establish and document AI development standards, reusable patterns, and evaluation practices for the practice. * Validate AI output quality through testing and evaluation. Keep a human in the loop where the risk calls for it. ### **Delivery Model Modernization** * Redesign VeilSun’s delivery methods so engagements of $400K to $500K can be run by a project lead and one developer, with QA added when needed. * Identify where AI can compress effort across the delivery lifecycle, including requirements, data mapping, code generation, testing,  ws when a human must stay in the loop. * **Composure Under Pressure.** Steady when experiments fail, timelines compress, or clients are frustrated. Sets the tone for the team and does not pass stress downward. **Failure Patterns We Avoid** * **Building before Radical Alignment.** Starting an AI build before use cases, data, and success measures are agreed is a fundamental failure of this role. * **Leading with the technology.** AI is a means, not the goal. Solutions must tie back to the client’s business outcomes. * **Overpromising.** Unrealistic claims about what AI can do damage client trust and VeilSun’s credibility. * **Staying at the surface.** Relying only on third\-party tools when the engagement calls for deeper engineering. * **Demonstrating without delivering.** Proofs of concept that never become repeatable practice do not change how VeilSun works. * **Hoarding expertise.** Knowledge that sits with one person is a business risk, not job security. * **Trading quality for speed.** Faster delivery never excuses unreviewed, untested, or unmaintainable AI\-generated work. * **Ignoring data security and governance.** Connecting AI to client data without proper controls is unacceptable. * **Leaving people behind.** Enablement that builds awareness but not skill and confidence does not change behavior. * **Letting scope drift without surfacing it.** Scope integrity is a core responsibility of this role, not the project lead’s alone. **Preferred Capabilities** * 5\+ years of software development or technical consulting experience, including 1\+ years of hands\-on AI solution delivery. * Hands\-on experience with LLM APIs such as Anthropic, OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, or Google, including prompt design, tool use, and agent patterns. * Experience building or integrating MCP servers and connecting AI to enterprise data sources, APIs, and database schemas. * Proficiency in at least one language commonly used for AI integration, such as Python or TypeScript. * Experience with data science, analytics, or AI modeling platforms. VeilSun currently uses RapidMiner AI Studio and AI Graph, but experience with similar tools is acceptable, along with the willingness to build depth on ours. * Experience with low\-code platforms, especially Quickbase or Mendix, is a strong plus. * Demonstrated experience leading client engagements from discovery through delivery in a consulting environment. * Experience designing and delivering technical training, workshops, or enablement programs. * Working knowledge of AI governance, data privacy, and security practices. * Familiarity with Agile and Waterfall delivery methodologies. * Strong written and verbal communication across technical and non\-technical audiences. **Compensation \& Benefits** The annual base salary range for this position is **$115,000–$140,000**, depending on experience. VeilSun offers a **comprehensive benefits package** that includes medical, dental, vision, life and supplemental insurance, short\- and long\-term disability, eligibility to participate in company stock or equity programs, 401(k), paid vacation, and sick time. **Inclusion \& Accommodations** VeilSun is an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, veteran status, or any other protected status under applicable law. VeilSun also complies with all applicable laws regarding employment eligibility and verification. VeilSun provides reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities throughout the application and hiring process. Applicants who require a reasonable accommodation to submit an application or participate in the interview process should contact VeilSun’s Talent Management team at hr@veilsun.com. Learn more about us at www.veilsun.com aj4FffEluV
