jobs.title: Software Engineer, Agent Auth
jobs.description: * Engineering * San Francisco * Full Time **About Vercel:** ----------------- Vercel is the agentic infrastructure company, freeing people and agents to ship what's next. For more than a decade we've helped builders move from idea to production with speed, security, and exceptional developer experience. Now we're scaling our products for both agents and people to ship and run software, built in the open and trusted by OpenAI, PayPal, Ramp, Supreme, and millions of developers worldwide. **About the role** ------------------ Agents are becoming first\-class users of the internet. They sign in, call APIs, deploy code, and act on behalf of people and teams. That raises questions the web was never designed to answer: Who is this agent? Who does it work for? What is it allowed to do, for how long, and how do we know? As an engineer on the \[*Agent Auth and Identity*] team, you'll help answer those questions. You'll build the systems that let agents and people authenticate, delegate access, and act safely across Vercel and the services our customers connect to. This is foundational work: identity and authorization sit underneath everything we ship, and getting them right for agents will shape how modern software gets built. The scope is intentionally broad. You might spend one quarter designing how credentials are issued and scoped for autonomous agents, and the next building the developer\-facing APIs and SDKs that make secure auth feel effortless. You'll own systems end\-to\-end, from design through long\-term operation in production. We're looking for engineers who care deeply about security and developer experience in equal measure, enjoy working on problems without established playbooks, and want to define how trust works in an agentic world. **What you'll do** ------------------ * Design, build, and operate the identity, authentication, and authorization systems that power Vercel and our Customers for both people and agents. * Shape how agents prove who they are, act on behalf of users and teams, and receive scoped, time\-bound, auditable access. * Build secure, scalable APIs, services, and SDKs that make auth simple for developers and their agents to adopt. * Work with modern and emerging standards (such as OAuth 2\.x, OIDC, and agent\-focused protocols) and help influence where they go next. * Lead projects end\-to\-end: identify opportunities, set technical direction, and deliver improvements in security, reliability, and developer experience. * Partner closely with product, security, and platform teams across Vercel to make identity a strength of every product we ship. * Participate in the on\-call rotation, taking responsibility for the reliability of critical systems. * Contribute to open source and the broader community conversation on agent identity and trust. * Write clean, efficient, tested, and well\-documented code that others can build upon confidently. **What you need** ----------------- * \[3\+] years of experience designing, building, and operating backend systems in production at scale. * Strong proficiency in JavaScript/TypeScript, or a comparable backend language and the willingness to work primarily in TypeScript. * Solid understanding of authentication and authorization concepts, such as sessions, tokens, OAuth/OIDC flows, permission models, and secrets management. * A security\-minded approach to engineering: you think about threat models, least privilege, and failure modes as part of design, not as an afterthought. * A track record of end\-to\-end ownership, from design and implementation through to long\-term operation. * Ability to reason about architectural tradeoffs, balancing long\-term vision with pragmatic delivery. * Strong cross\-team collaboration skills and the ability to drive alignment toward shared goals. * Curiosity and comfort working in a fast\-moving space where the right answers are still being figured out. **Bonus if you** ---------------- * Have built or operated identity providers, auth platforms, or access\-control systems used by other developers. * Have experience with delegated authorization, workload identity, service\-to\-service auth, or machine credentials. * Have worked on LLM\-powered agents, tool calling, or protocols like MCP. * Have experience with cloud infrastructure (AWS) and infrastructure as code (Terraform). * Are familiar with React or Next.js. * Have contributed to open\-source projects or standards bodies. **Benefits \& Compensation** ---------------------------- * Competitive compensation package, including equity. * Inclusive Healthcare Package. * Learn and Grow: we provide mentorship and send you to events that help you build your network and skills. * Flexible Time Off. * We will provide you the gear you need to do your role, and a WFH budget for you to outfit your space as needed. The base pay range for this role is **$196,000 – $294,000\.** Actual salary will be based on job\-related skills, experience, and location. The total compensation package may include benefits, equity\-based compensation, and eligibility for a company bonus or variable pay program depending on the role. Your recruiter can share more details during the hiring process. **Disclosures:** ---------------- * **Privacy:** Please review our Job Applicant Privacy Policy for more information on how we handle your data. * **Equal Opportunity:** Vercel is committed to fostering and empowering an inclusive community within our organization. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation, national origin, citizenship, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Vercel encourages everyone to apply for our available positions, even if they don't necessarily check every box on the job description.

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Connect
jobs.description: * Engineering * San Francisco * Full Time **About Vercel:** ----------------- Vercel is the agentic infrastructure company, freeing people and agents to ship what's next. For more than a decade we've helped builders move from idea to production with speed, security, and exceptional developer experience. Now we're scaling our products for both agents and people to ship and run software, built in the open and trusted by OpenAI, PayPal, Ramp, Supreme, and millions of developers worldwide. **About the Role** ------------------ Vercel Connect helps developers give agents and AI\-built apps secure access to the data, tools, and events they need—without wrestling with OAuth, credentials, and integration complexity. We’re currently building two things: 1\) a platform for managing agent identity, access and permissions and 2\) a set of rich connectors for the 1000s of systems (like Linear, Slack, GitHub, Google, etc.) that agents will need to talk to. We’re solving core problems like agent identity and delegated access, tool approval and standards around making agents aware of changes on 3rd party platforms. As a senior engineer on this team you'll not only own our APIs, token infrastructure, authorization, SDKs, and more, but work with external companies to make it easier for developers to build agents that integrate with their products. You’ll need to balance both high uptime and fast performance with flexibility to allow for seamless connection to many systems that weren’t designed with agents in mind. If you’re looking for a role that will put you at the center of how agent identity and credentials work, this is it! **What You Will Do** -------------------- * Ship provider integrations end to end — auth flows, token exchange, app registration, and the configuration UI — from generic API\-key and OAuth presets through bespoke cases like Snowflake Partner Connect, Slack manager apps, and Microsoft Entra. * Own and improve our infrastructure (uptime, performance, secure storage of credentials and keys) and developer experience for Connect * Work with industry leaders within and outside of Vercel to propose and implement new authentication and authorization protocols for AI era * Build and harden event forwarding — signature verification inbound, project\-scoped identity outbound, delivered to the right deployment and environment. * Make Connect the obvious way to give an agent a credential, extending the SDKs , consent\-redirect flow, and framework adapters. * Reduce the cost of the next hundred integrations, so most new providers become configuration rather than code. * Work directly with the teams building on Connect, and turn what you learn into platform improvements. **About You** ------------- * **6\+ years** building and operating production backend or full\-stack systems, with a track record of owning a service or platform surface rather than a feature. * You deeply understand your users problems and work in a focused manner to address them, leveling up the product you’re working on over time. * Deep, practical understanding of **OAuth 2\.0/2\.1, OIDC, and JWTs** — not just wiring up a client library, but reasoning about authorization codes, PKCE, refresh semantics, audience and scope restriction, token exchange, and what each of those actually protects against. * A **security instinct for integration code specifically** — SSRF and DNS rebinding, confused\-deputy and mix\-up attacks, redirect\-URI validation, webhook signature verification, tenant isolation. You've either found these bugs or fixed them. * Strong **TypeScript**, and comfort developing backend and frontend components. * Experience integrating with **many third\-party APIs**, an appetite for the reality of it — undocumented behavior, non\-compliant OAuth, inconsistent errors — and the judgment to absorb that mess behind a clean abstraction. * You're comfortable with ambiguity, ship incrementally against a large surface, and communicate clearly with the teams building on top of you. * You push the envelope of leveraging agents and AI in ur dev workflow, giving you the insight to help build the agent platform of the future **Bonus Points** ---------------- * You've built or operated an **OAuth authorization server**, an identity provider, or a multi\-tenant integrations platform. * Experience with **MCP**, agent tool\-calling, or delegated\-access and consent patterns. * Prior work on integration marketplaces, partner engineering, or webhook infrastructure at scale. * Open source contributions, particularly in the auth, Next.js, or agent tooling ecosystems. **Compensation \& Benefits:** ----------------------------- * Competitive compensation package, including equity. * Inclusive Healthcare Package. * Learn and Grow \- we provide mentorship and send you to events that help you build your network and skills. * Flexible Time Off. * We will provide you the gear you need to do your role, and a WFH budget for you to outfit your space as needed. The San Francisco, CA base pay range for this role is $196,000\-$294,000\. Actual salary will be based on job\-related skills, experience, and location. Compensation outside of San Francisco may be adjusted based on employee location. The total compensation package may include benefits, equity\-based compensation, and eligibility for a company bonus or variable pay program depending on the role. Your recruiter can share more details during the hiring process. **Disclosures:** ---------------- * **Privacy:** Please review our Job Applicant Privacy Policy for more information on how we handle your data. * **Equal Opportunity:** Vercel is committed to fostering and empowering an inclusive community within our organization. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation, national origin, citizenship, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status, or any other characteristic protected by law. jobs.description: ### **When you join Verizon** You want more out of a career. A place to share your ideas freely — even if they’re daring or different. Where the true you can learn, grow, and thrive. At Verizon, we power and empower how people live, work and play by connecting them to what brings them joy. We do what we love — driving innovation, creativity, and impact in the world. Our V Team is a community of people who anticipate, lead, and believe that listening is where learning begins. In crisis and in celebration, we come together — lifting our communities and building trust in how we show up, everywhere \& always. Want in? Join the \#VTeamLife. We're building an internal API Gateway platform that consolidates network operations, project management, and AI\-assisted tooling for a global network engineering organization. You'll design and ship APIs, widgets, and AI agents that run against production data center inventory (Cisco Nexus, Pica8, Arista) and drive real infrastructure decisions — site refreshes, tech refreshes, NAC deployments, and switch migrations across dozens of enterprise sites. This is a hands\-on builder role. You'll write the API, design the schema, build the Vue.js view, wire up the agent, and own the outcome end\-to\-end. ### **What You'll Do** * Designing and build REST APIs (Node.js) against Postgres, with versioning, input schemas, caching, and hybrid NP/prod auth models. * Building widgets and Vue.js views that surface network inventory and operational metrics (counts dashboards, site status, work\-item boards). * Configuring and extending AI agents (MCP servers, tool bindings, prompt design) that assist network engineers with day\-to\-day ops. * Modelling relational data for work\-item tracking, project management, and CMDB\-adjacent inventory. * Owning the full lifecycle: schema migration API widget agent tool PR prod deploy. * Debugging across the stack: platform security policies, credential vaults, DB pool exhaustion, agent tool\-call failures. * Collaborating with network engineers to translate ops asks ("we need a counts page showing X Nexus, Y Pica8") into shipped features. ### **You’ll need to have:** * Bachelor’s degree or one or more years of relevant work experience. * One or more years of relevant work experience, demonstrated through one or a combination of work and/or military experience, or specialized training. * Experience in JavaScript/Node.js — async patterns, REST handler design, error handling. * Experience with AI agents / LLM tool\-use patterns (MCP, function calling, agent orchestration). * Frontend fundamentals — Vue.js (or React), HTML/CSS, browser networking, state management for dashboards. **Even better if you have one or more of the following:** * Network engineering domain knowledge (Cisco Nexus, Pica8, Arista, NAC, VXLAN, data center refresh workflows) * Strong SQL and relational modeling — Postgres preferred; comfortable writing migrations, joins, and parameterized queries. * API design discipline — input validation, versioning, idempotency, auth, rate limiting. * Git workflow proficiency — branching, PR hygiene, disciplined commits, comfortable with staged/unstaged distinctions. * Debugging across boundaries — reading platform errors, tracing failures from UI API DB external system. * Security\-aware coding — credential vaults, secrets handling, least privilege, understanding prod vs non\-prod boundaries. * Clear written communication — turning fuzzy asks into scoped work items; documentation others can act on. * Project management systems (PMO, epics/stories/tasks) and integrations with them. * Prior work on internal developer platforms or low\-code/API\-gateway tooling. * Experience with ServiceNow, CMDB, or IT asset management systems. ### **What Success Looks Like in Year One** * You've shipped multiple end\-to\-end features (schema API UI agent tool) that network engineers use weekly. * You've reduced manual toil for at least one recurring ops workflow. * You've extended the platform's agent capabilities so engineers can get answers conversationally instead of navigating dashboards. If Verizon and this role sound like a fit for you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every “even better” qualification listed above. ### **Where you’ll be working** In this hybrid role, you'll have a defined work location that includes working from home and a minimum of three days per week in the office, which will be set by your manager. Employees are responsible for maintaining compliance with hybrid work policies.### **Scheduled Weekly Hours** 40### **Equal Employment Opportunity** Verizon is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to veteran status, disability or other legally protected characteristics. ### **Benefits and Compensation** Our benefits are designed to help you move forward in your career, and in areas of your life outside of Verizon. From health and wellness benefit options including: medical, dental, vision, short and long term disability, basic life insurance, supplemental life insurance, AD\&D insurance, identity theft protection, pet insurance and group home \& auto insurance. We also offer a matched 401(k) savings plan, up to 8 company paid holidays per year and up to 6 personal days per year, paid parental leave, adoption assistance and tuition assistance, plus other incentives, we’ve got you covered with our award\-winning total rewards package. jobs.title: Senior Engineer, Machine Learning
jobs.description: Virta Health is on a mission to transform type 2 diabetes and weight\-loss care. Current treatment approaches aren't working—over half of US adults have either type 2 diabetes or prediabetes, and obesity rates are at an all\-time high. Virta is changing this by helping people reverse their metabolic condition through innovations in technology, personalized nutrition, and virtual care delivery reinvented from the ground up. We have raised over $350 million from top\-tier investors, and partner with the largest health plans, employers, and government organizations to help their employees and members restore their health and take back their lives. Join us on our mission to reverse diabetes and obesity in one billion people. **About the Role** ------------------ As a Senior Engineer, Machine Learning on Virta's Applied AI team, you build the models that shape how Virta shows up for each member: who needs a coach's attention this week, which nudge will land, what moves someone closer to reversing their disease. You take a fuzzy clinical or operational question, sharpen it into something a model can actually answer, and carry it the whole way to production. You are hard to fool. A number that looks good on a slide doesn't convince you until you've checked what's underneath it: whether a leak inflated it, or whether it's quietly wrong for a segment it doesn't call out. You start simple, prove the baseline honestly, and add complexity only once it earns its place. Your models don't just ship, they stay healthy without you babysitting them. As Applied AI moves from linear to exponential, you build models on Virta's deep, longitudinal member data and put them on the ML platform that retrains them, watches their quality, and pulls you in only when something is genuinely wrong. What one engineer can deliver stops being capped by how many models they can keep alive. None of this happens solo. You hand models to product engineering to get them in front of members and care teams, lean on ML Ops's infrastructure to keep models running, sit with clinicians to pressure\-test what the data is really saying, and work with Product Analytics to design experiments sharp enough to trust, and to separate what actually drives better outcomes from what only correlates with them. **Responsibilities** -------------------- * **Problem Framing \& Modeling**: Turn ambiguous clinical and operational questions into well\-scoped ML tasks, and build strong baselines before adding complexity. * **Model Delivery at Scale**: Build predictive models that drive member care, like who is at risk of disengaging, who benefits most from a coach's outreach, or where a member's health is trending. Learning systems for real\-world use cases. * Strong foundation in traditional ML (predictive modeling, tree\-based models like XGBoost, time\-series analysis on structured longitudinal data). * * Responsible use of AI\-assisted development to meaningfully accelerate and improve model development. **Nice to Haves** ----------------- * Background in clinical or health\-tech ML (claims, EHR, clinical notes, scheduling, utilization, or member engagement data), and experience with PHI, HIPAA\-aware systems, or other regulated data. * Judgment about when traditional ML outperforms LLMs, and when an LLM is the right tool. **Values\-driven culture** -------------------------- Virta's company values drive our culture, so you'll do well if: * You put people first and take care of yourself, your peers, and our patients equally * You have a strong sense of ownership and take initiative while empowering others to do the same * You prioritize positive impact over busy work * You have no ego and understand that everyone has something to bring to the table regardless of experience * You appreciate transparency and promote trust and empowerment through open access of information * You are evidence\-based and prioritize data and science over seniority or dogma * You take risks and rapidly iterate Is this role not quite what you're looking for? Information about Virta’s benefits is on our Careers page at:* https://www.virtahealth.com/careers*.* *As part of your duties at Virta, you may come in contact with sensitive patient information that is governed by HIPAA. Throughout your career at Virta, you will be expected to follow Virta's security and privacy procedures to ensure our patients' information remains strictly confidential. Security and privacy training will be provided.* *As a remote\-first company, our team is spread across various locations with office hubs in Denver and San Francisco.* *Clinical roles:* *We currently* ***do not hire*** *in the following states: AK, HI, RI* *Corporate roles:* *We currently* ***do not hire*** *in the following states: AK, DE, HI, ME, MS, OK, SD, VT.* *Virta uses Ashby as its applicant tracking system, which incorporates AI\-powered tools (provided by OpenAI, AWS, and Google Gemini) in certain aspects of the recruiting process, including application review, candidate screening, and interview note taking; your data is not used to train AI models, and all final hiring decisions are made by Virta Health personnel.* **For more information, see Virta’s AI Interview Resources page.** **https://www.virtahealth.com/careers/ai\-interview\-resources** Compensation Range: $161\.5K \- $232\.5K

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description: **About Virtru:** While the rest of the security industry obsesses over locking data down to prevent it from being lost or stolen, we're doing something fundamentally different at Virtru. We're setting data free so that you can intentionally share it with others, but without sacrificing security, privacy, or control. We've created both a suite of powerful data protection applications and an open platform that's sparking an ecosystem of innovation. Through the Trusted Data Format (TDF) open standard, we're not just protecting data; we're creating a new paradigm where security enables sharing rather than preventing it. Think of us as the Android of data protection: a robust platform with an open core that developers and partners can build upon, coupled with our own best\-in\-class applications that showcase what's possible when you reimagine security from the ground up. Backed by Iconiq Capital, Bessemer Venture Partners, Foundry Capital, and Tiger Global, we're helping Fortune 500 companies and government agencies discover that true data security means having the freedom to share, collaborate, and innovate — without compromise. **Compensation: $190,000 \- 250,000/year** **Team \& Position Details:** Virtru protects data wherever it travels, for customers ranging from commercial enterprises to the Department of Defense, the Intelligence Community, Law Enforcement, and Federal Civilian agencies. Many of these customers run Virtru inside their mission environments, and the most sensitive of those environments are cleared spaces where work happens on site, alongside the customer's own engineers. As a Senior Software Engineer in the Delivery Engineering organization, you'd be helping to build a founder team focused on making these deployments simple, easy, and fast. You will be the engineer who builds what a cleared customer needs and cannot get from the product alone: custom integrations and policy enforcement points (the components that enforce access policy inside a customer's application) delivered into the customer's environment. You will sit with customer engineers, understand how their systems really work, and ship working software that fits them. You will work directly with deployment engineers and forward deployed engineers on the customer side of each engagement, with QA to prove what you build before it ships, and with our product engineering and Platform Engineering counterparts to carry what you learn back into the product. The test of your work is simple: the second time we face the same customer need, we should be configuring something you built, not writing it again. The impact of this role is company and product wide, heavily enabling our goals to scale Virtru, partner, and customer led deployments non\-linearly without having to throw more humans at the problem. You'll be expected to come up with AI\-native design patterns that will increase our velocity without compromising our high bar for quality and security. The right candidate is excited about working on a small, nimble, highly autonomous and empowered team where everyone is expected to make high judgement, high velocity decisions independently and with urgency. If you want a role where the connection between what you build and what the customer achieves requires no explaining, this is one. **As a Senior Software Engineer in Delivery Engineering, your responsibilities will include:** * **Build custom integrations and policy enforcement points for cleared customers**, scoped against a statement of work, tested with QA, and delivered into environments Virtru does not operate. * **Work directly with customer engineers inside cleared environments** to understand their systems, agree what will be built, and explain your design to their security team. * **Turn what you build twice into a reusable asset.** When a second customer needs the same thing, the first build becomes a template, a library, or a tool that deployment engineers and forward deployed engineers can use without you. * Build on the SDKs and APIs that our product engineering teams maintain, and bring gaps and defects back to them with a clear reproduction and a documented outcome. * Write code that follows the engineering standard set by Delivery Engineering's Principal Software Engineer, and submit your work to the design review that standard calls for. * Package your work so it installs, upgrades, and runs in disconnected environments with no path to the internet. * Partner with deployment engineers and forward deployed engineers so the person who installs your work in the field has what they need: documentation, test evidence, and a clear way to report back. * Partner with our Platform Engineering counterparts on how your work is built, signed, and released. * Use AI coding agents as part of your daily workflow, and help the team learn which patterns raise quality and speed together. * Mentor and learn from peers across the organization, and help define what good looks like for  our software does, what it touches, and why it is safe to run, and you can answer the follow\-up questions. * **Nice to haves** + Windows and .NET depth: production .NET on Windows, including Windows Services, signed installers, and managed distribution. Many of our customers' end\-user environments are Windows\-heavy, and some of our policy enforcement points deploy on Windows client endpoints. + Go proficiency, which is what the Data Security Platform and OpenTDF are written in. + Kubernetes experience, including packaging and running software across more than one distribution. + Identity and authorization integration experience: OIDC, SAML, and attribute\-based access control (ABAC). + Familiarity with Zero Trust security architecture and concepts such as Policy Enforcement and Decision Points, cryptography, and identity. + Experience delivering software into air\-gapped or disconnected environments. + Experience building with AI coding agents. * **Where this role may not be a fit** + **Wanting a product\-only role with no customer contact.** Much of this job is working next to the customer, in their environment, on their problem. If you prefer to build away from customers, this role may not be for you. + **Inability to earn trust and credibility with partners and customers.** You may be the person who has to explain to a skeptical government security team why our software is safe, or to an internal VP of Engineering why we need to prioritize critical platform features. Those have to be conversations you are willing and excited to have. **Virtruvian qualities that will set you up for success:** * Thinking outside of the box to respectfully challenge your teammates and managers in the pursuit of excellence * Strong sense of urgency with an action\-oriented mindset * Able to collaborate and adapt to shifting priorities as business needs evolve * Comfortable with asynchronous communication including slack, email, zoom, etc. **Perks \& Benefits:** At Virtru, we believe people do their best work when their wellbeing is put first. This is why we make your wellbeing our priority with a thoughtful and holistic program that encompasses Occupational, Mental, Social, Physical, and Environmental Wellness by offering benefits such as… * A **Flexible PTO policy** — we strongly encourage you to take time off (in addition to 14 holidays) to ensure that you are getting the proper time needed to unplug and recharge. * A $1,500 annual **Learning \& Development Stipend** focused on providing you the resources to continually learn and professionally grow. * Frequent company\-sponsored **team celebrations** that provide ample opportunities to connect with teammates and be social! * Access to an **Employee Assistance Program** * Access to **Headspace**, a mental health app tailored to your specific needs. * A flat 3% contribution to your retirement account * **A high degree of flexibility** — Have an appointment, errand, or family emergency to take care of? Hop to it! We give you the time and space to take care of you and your own first. In addition to wellbeing, Virtru places a strong emphasis on diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging. Our DB\&I Council is dedicated to fostering an inclusive workplace and making the psychological safety of each and every one of our teammates a top priority. **Additional perks include:** * Competitive compensation * Generous parental, medical, and bereavement policies * 401K contribution and stock options * Full medical, dental, and vision benefits * New Hire Swag and IT Welcome boxes * Structured semi\-annual 360° performance reviews Virtru is committed to building an inclusive environment for people of all backgrounds and everyone is encouraged to apply. Virtru is an Equal Opportunity Employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, gender, religion, disability, national origin, protected veteran status, age, or any other status protected by applicable national, federal, state, or local law.

jobs.description: **About Us** Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid. At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world. Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you. **Job Description** Role Summary: Software Development Engineers are expert problem\-solvers and builders who design, implement, and improve software applications and systems. In this role, engineers spend approximately 60–75% of their time coding, working hands\-on with code, data, and modern tools (including AI\-assisted development, cloud services, and automation frameworks) to deliver secure, scalable, and high\-quality technology solutions that drive business outcomes in the fintech sector. They collaborate with cross\-functional teams – product managers, designers, data scientists, QA, operations, and compliance – to translate business requirements into robust technical solutions, all while adhering to best practices, security standards, and regulatory requirements. All roles require digital fluency, including the ability to work with emerging technologies such as Generative AI tools (e.g. ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot) to support everyday work. Key Responsibilities: * Collaborate with stakeholders to determine requirements for product components and incorporate feedback into future designs or solutions. * Translate functional requirements into system designs and communicate component interactions, ensuring alignment with business needs and timelines. * Design and develop product components, refine code plans, and lead design reviews to ensure completeness and adherence to requirements. * Contribute to project estimation, considering delivery costs and escalating issues that may cause delays. * Lead by example in creating, implementing, and maintaining extensible, reusable code, and drive code quality through metrics and best practices. * Apply debugging tools to resolve moderately complex issues and identify opportunities for automation across products. * Lead code reviews, ensuring adherence to coding standards and providing feedback to team members. * Create complex test plans, identify test gaps, and proactively address defects to minimize customer impact. * Leverage data analysis and monitoring standards to identify patterns and defects in all environments. * Respond to incidents during on\-call rotations, troubleshoot complex issues, and assist in incident response and resolution. * Build, enhance, and identify new developer tools to support programs and applications. * Proactively seek new knowledge and adapt to trends and technical solutions to improve product performance and recommend resources to other engineers. Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager. **Qualifications** Basic Qualifications: * 5\+ years of relevant work experience with a Bachelor's Degree or at least 2 years of work experience with an Advanced Degree (e.g., Master's, MBA, JD, MD) or 0 years of work experience with a PhD, OR 8\+ years of relevant work experience. * Experience in software engineering or a directly related field. * Experience in developing and/or implementing web\-based or mobile applications. * Experience in a leadership role with or without direct reports. * Experience in technologies/software systems or a directly related field. * Experience in creating and maintaining test plans and executing testing procedures. * Experience in debugging and troubleshooting software issues. * Experience in collaborating with cross\-functional teams to deliver technical solutions. * Experience in code review and applying coding standards. * Experience in building or enhancing developer tools. * Practical exposure to AI/ML or GenAI solutions, with the ability to assess use cases, integration approaches, limitations, risks, and production\-readiness. Preferred Qualifications: * 6 or more years of work experience with a Bachelor's Degree or 4 or more years of relevant experience with an Advanced Degree (e.g., Master's, MBA, JD, MD) or up to 3 years of relevant experience with a PhD. * Experience building high\-volume, highly available, consumer\- or client\-facing platforms. * Hands\-on exposure to public cloud platforms and managed AI services. * Experience prototyping or delivering RAG, semantic search, conversational AI, or agentic workflow solutions. * Knowledge of model evaluation, hallucination mitigation, AI observability, token and infrastructure cost management, and privacy controls. * Experience mentoring engineers and influencing technical direction across multiple teams. Technical Skills: * Java: Advanced proficiency in core Java, concurrency, collections, JVM fundamentals, performance tuning, and modern language features. * Backend Engineering: Strong experience with Spring Boot, Spring Framework, JPA/Hibernate, REST APIs, microservices, and distributed systems. * Front\-End Engineering: Good knowledge of modern web development using Angular or React, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3, responsive design, component\-based architecture, state management, accessibility, and secure integration with REST APIs. * Database Engineering: Strong knowledge of relational databases, SQL, data modeling, schema design, indexing, query optimization, transactions, and performance tuning, with working experience in NoSQL databases, caching, and Java data\-access frameworks such as JPA/Hibernate. * Data and Messaging: Experience with relational databases, SQL, NoSQL technologies, caching, and messaging platforms such as Kafka or NATS. * Cloud\-Native Delivery: Hands\-on experience with Docker, Kubernetes, Linux, infrastructure environments, and CI/CD tools such as Maven, Gradle, Jenkins, or equivalent platforms. * Security: Knowledge of secure coding, OAuth 2\.0, OIDC, API security, secrets management, vulnerability remediation, and enterprise security standards. * Observability: Experience with application logging, metrics, tracing, alerting, and tools such as Splunk, Prometheus, Grafana, or OpenTelemetry. * Testing: Strong experience with JUnit, Mockito, automated integration testing, code\-quality tools, and test\-driven development. * AI/GenAI: Good understanding of LLMs, prompt engineering, embeddings, vector databases, RAG, model APIs, AI agents, evaluation, and responsible\-AI practices. * AI Integration: Ability to integrate AI services through APIs or SDKs; familiarity with frameworks such as Spring AI, LangChain4j, LangChain, or equivalent is desirable. **Information for US Applicants** For roles located in the US, the estimated salary range for this position is $133,300\.00 to $ 213,400\.00 USD per year, which may include potential sales incentive payments (if applicable). Salary may vary depending on job\-related factors which may include knowledge, skills, experience, and location. In addition, this position may be eligible for bonus and equity.Visa has a comprehensive benefits package for which this position may be eligible that includes Medical, Dental, Vision, 401(k), FSA/HSA, Life Insurance, Paid Time Off, and Wellness Program.**Work Hours** Varies upon the needs of the department. **Travel Requirements** This position requires travel 5\-10% of the time. **Mental/Physical Requirements** This position will be performed in an office setting. The position will require the incumbent to sit and stand at a desk, communicate in person and by telephone, frequently operate standard office equipment, such as telephones and computers. **Visa is an EEO Employer** Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protect veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.

jobs.title: Experience Designer (UX/UI)
jobs.description: We're hiring an Experience Designer I (XD I) to join our digital team. You'll design apps, web products, and interfaces for connected devices, from the first research interview to the launch video. This is an early\-career role. You've got 2 to 3 years of experience and you're ready to work on real products with real constraints. You won't own every skill below on day one, and we don't expect you to. You'll get hands\-on time across the whole process and learn from senior designers who've shipped a lot of it. The best fit is someone who loves the messy middle of a project. You ask good questions, sketch fast, test early, and care about how the last pixel moves. Our digital work rarely lives on just one screen. In a given year you might touch: * **Consumer apps** for iOS and Android, often as the companion to a physical product * **Web apps** and dashboards that turn sensor data into something people can act on * **IoT products** where the app, the device, and the setup flow all need to feel like one thing * **Medtech touchscreens** built for clinicians and patients, where clarity and safety come first * **Non\-traditional interfaces** like voice, light, haptics, embedded displays, and AI\-driven experiences One week you're designing an onboarding flow for a smart home device. The next, you're figuring out how a nurse reads a screen from six feet away with gloves on. ‍ Whipsaw is a product design and brand consultancy in San Francisco. We take products from first insight to first customer, with one team covering strategy, industrial design, digital experience, brand, packaging, and launch. We've partnered with 350\+ clients, designed 1,000\+ products, and picked up 325\+ design awards along the way. Our clients range from funded startups shipping their first product to established companies building something new. Here's what makes us a little different. The product leads, and the brand follows. Our digital designers sit next to industrial designers and engineers, so the screen on a device and the device itself grow up together. ‍ **Base Salary Range:** $80,000 to $100,000 per year, based on experience and skills **Location:** Hybrid (3\-days in person) at 55 Mississippi Street, San Francisco, CA 94107 ### **What you'll do** You'll work across every phase of a project, usually as part of a small team with a senior or lead designer. **Discover** * Run needs finding and user research: interviews, observation, competitive reviews * Synthesize what you learn into insights, journey maps, and clear problem statements **Define and ideate** * Map flows, information architecture, and wireframes * Use AI tools to generate and stress\-test ideas quickly, then apply your own judgment to pick what's worth pursuing * Explore app concepts and visual directions, from rough sketches to polished comps **Prototype and test** * Build AI\-enabled prototypes that feel real enough to test with users and clients * Plan and run usability and validation testing, then turn findings into design changes * Write front\-end code when it's the fastest way to prove an idea **Refine and ship** * Refine visual design until every state, edge case, and screen size holds up * Design UI microinteractions and motion that make interfaces feel alive and easy to read * Build and maintain design systems that engineering teams can actually use * Create launch assets and motion graphics for product reveals, websites, and campaigns **Work with clients** * Present work in client reviews and workshops, and explain the thinking behind it * Partner with industrial designers, engineers, and brand designers so hardware and software line up ### **What you'll bring** **You'll need** * 2 to 3 years of professional UX/UI experience, at a studio, agency, or in\-house team * A degree in interaction design, HCI, graphic design, industrial design, or a related field * Strong visual craft: type, layout, color, hierarchy, and an eye for detail * A solid grasp of UX process, from research through testing * Fluency in Figma, including components, auto layout, and interactive prototyping * Hands\-on experience using AI tools in your design process, and opinions about where they help and where they don't * Clear communication, both in writing and when presenting to a room * A portfolio that shows your thinking and your polish (more on that below) **Nice to have** * Front\-end coding skills (HTML, CSS, JavaScript) or experience building in Framer or Webflow * Motion design in After Effects, Rive, Protopie, or similar * Experience designing for hardware, embedded screens, or regulated products like medical devices * Work on a design system used by a real engineering team * Comfort running usability sessions and synthesizing results on your own Don't check every box? Apply anyway. We care more about how you think and how fast you learn than a perfect match.

jobs.description: **Position Description:** This position is responsible for the reliability of turbine engines, internal combustion engines, centrifugal compressors, reciprocating compressors, coolers, exchangers, glycol dehys, PSVs, and pumps within WhiteWater assets. This position will be based out of Austin or Houston, TX. **Job Responsibilities:** * Improve the performance of physical assets and establish strategies to enhance maintenance and reliability performance using KPIs. Collaborate with Operations leadership, engineering teams, corporate functions, external partners, and contractors to achieve these goals. * Provide reliability and maintenance expertise on capital projects to ensure equipment reliability and maintainability. Support Installation Qualification during commissioning and validate updates to equipment strategies and specifications in the CMMS database as needed. * Lead cross\-site reliability initiatives to standardize processes and drive improvements across multiple locations. Assist and support local teams (e.g., plant and project engineering) in identifying, collecting, analyzing, and managing data to reduce failures and improve performance. Provide mentorship and training to junior engineers and field personnel on advanced reliability methodologies and tools. * Create and implement reliability strategies at sites, including Asset Criticality Assessments, Proactive Maintenance (PM) strategies, and Spare Parts analyses. Develop and monitor corporate\-level KPIs, dashboards, and reporting systems to monitor and improve asset performance. Align proactive maintenance strategies (e.g., preventive, and predictive tasks) with asset criticality to ensure efficient and effective processes. Conduct and facilitate Root Cause Failure Analysis (RCFA) for significant or recurring failures, and implement strategy improvements to prevent recurrence * Ensure best practices in CMMS utilization, including maintaining accurate preventive and predictive maintenance procedures as well as asset master data, hierarchy, and configuration. Analyze CMMS data to enhance reliability and reduce maintenance costs while ensuring visibility of performance metrics to site managers. Drive the implementation and sustainability of effective workflow processes, including work request management, work request authorization, work order planning, kitting, scheduling, execution, and documentation/closure * Benchmark asset reliability performance and determine best practices, collaborating closely with local teams. Oversee asset lifecycle management for critical corporate physical assets, focusing on Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) and long\-term performance optimization. * Develop tools to identify recurring mechanical issues and collaborate with field operations to resolve them effectively. * Manage maintenance program to ensure that the Company remains in compliance with the Long\-Term Service Agreement (LTSA) * Provide preliminary work scopes, estimates and budgeting details of assigned projects or work items * Effectively plan, schedule, and manage multiple capital and operational projects concurrently * Comply with safety and environmental practices in accordance with regulatory and company requirements * Attend safety trainings, maintain required certifications to perform job duties, set example of high safety standards and assist in regulatory inspections * Occasional travel, including overnight visits, to other compressor stations will be required **Requirements \& Qualifications:** * Bachelor's degree in engineering is required * Minimum of 5 years' experience in engineering is required; at least 3 years' experience in asset reliability engineering is preferred * Certified Maintenance and Reliability Professional accreditation preferred * Must be willing to travel approximately 10\-25% of time * Practical knowledge of relevant industry codes, such as API and ASME, and the application of Non\-Destructive Testing methodologies * Solid understanding of predictive and preventative maintenance programs * Knowledge of maintenance best practices in the chemical industry preferred * Ability to mentor, train, facilitate, and influence others in the use of reliability tools and systems * Experience with Mechanical Integrity and Process Safety Management Programs * Practical understanding Inventory Management * Ability to effectively solve problems and manage multiple priorities and programs * CMMS experience required * Experience with rotating equipment (e.g., pumps and compressors) preferred * Reliability program implementation and oversight experience preferred * Must possess valid driver's license and meet company insurability requirements * Ability to work overtime, weekends, holidays and respond to call outs and emergencies * Knowledge of reading and interpreting charts, assembly and instruction manuals * Ability to work in changing climate conditions * Excellent verbal and written communication skills and fluency in English is required * Must be able to lift, push and pull a minimum of 75 lbs. and be able to work in tight spaces, climb to and work from elevated platforms, ladders, walkways, etc. **Benefits**: This position is located in Austin, Houston, Alice or Midland, Texas and is an in\-office position. Selected candidate is eligible for employer matched 401(k), medical, dental, vision, basic life and AD\&D insurances and other benefit offerings.

jobs.title: AI Transformation Engineer
jobs.description: Yext (NYSE: YEXT) is the enterprise agentic marketing platform. Built on the world's most comprehensive structured data platform for local businesses, Yext gives brands and their partners the visibility intelligence to win every moment of discovery – across AI and traditional search. Yext's API\-first architecture connects structured data to APIs, MCP servers, and generative interfaces, so partners and developers can build purpose\-built experiences on the same infrastructure powering Yext's own products. Thousands of brands and digital marketing partners in financial services, healthcare, retail, hospitality, and food rely on Yext to manage, measure, and optimize visibility at scale. For more information, visit yext.com. The AI Transformation Office partners with departments across Yext to improve business outcomes through 30 to 60 day transformation sprints. As an **AI Transformation Engineer**, you build the production systems that make that real: retrieval, answer drafting, routing and evaluation on live data, plus the APIs, automations and pipelines around them. Each sprint ends with a handoff to the team that owns the outcome. This is not a product\-roadmap engineering role. You embed with department teams, learn how work actually gets done, and build with whatever fits. That is usually a workflow platform such as n8n first, and code only where the platform runs out. You care as much about whether someone else can run your work as whether it runs in production. You build and you teach, as one motion. **What You'll Do** Production LLM systems (40%) * Build and run production LLM workflows in n8n and similar platforms: retrieval over ticket and documentation data, answer drafting and routing. * Build APIs, integrations and data pipelines that connect CRM, support and operational systems. * Build and calibrate confidence scoring so teams know when to trust an answer, and design the review steps and approval gates where a person decides. * Protect the data you work with: scope what each workflow can read, handle PII and sensitive fields, and keep access logs. * Ship every solution monitored, error\-handled and version\-controlled, not just functional. Evals and quality (15%) * Define evals before each build: test sets, groundedness and accuracy checks, and the thresholds that decide whether output ships or needs review. * Report quality results to partner teams in plain terms. * Track LLM spend and usage by team, manage API keys, and report run rate. Knowledge transfer and enablement (20%) * Pair\-build with embedded team members so they learn by doing, not by watching. * Write documentation that scales: runbooks, admin guides, architecture diagrams and decision logs. * Train department champions at the right altitude: enough to maintain and extend, not enough to overwhelm. * Build with handoff in mind from day one. The owning team should run each system day to day within 30 days of launch. They own workflow configuration, prompts, review queues and reports. You keep the retrieval, eval and scoring code until a second engineer can take it. System design and architecture (15%) * Design integration patterns that connect CRM, support and operational systems. * Architect data flows that enable automation and AI\-powered decisions. * Evaluate new models and tools, and make build\-vs\-buy recommendations grounded in the team's real maintenance capacity. Opportunity identification (10%) * Spot automation and integration opportunities others miss by understanding how work actually gets done. * Translate technical possibilities into language department stakeholders can evaluate. * Estimate effort honestly and scope tightly: cut work that does not change the outcome, and say so early. **What You Have** * 5 to 8 years in software engineering, integration development or automation engineering. * Production experience with a workflow platform such as n8n, Zapier or Tray.io, building automations that other teams rely on. * Experience designing reliable autonomous agents: agent frameworks and patterns such as tool calling, orchestration, guardrails and human escalation, with eval feedback loops that keep output high quality and consistent. * Python or TypeScript for the work a platform cannot do, with API design skills and an understanding of how software is operated: monitoring, error handling, version control and deployment discipline. * Hands\-on production use of LLM APIs (Anthropic, OpenAI or Google), including prompt design and structured outputs. * Retrieval experience: vector databases such as Qdrant or pgvector, chunking and grounding. * Experience measuring LLM output quality with test sets, graded review or evals. * Experience handling sensitive data in production systems: PII, permissions and audit logging. * A teaching instinct. You explain what you build and why, and you notice when someone is lost before they say so. * Documentation discipline, and the ability to explain trade\-offs to non\-technical stakeholders without jargon. **Bonus Points** * MCP servers, agent frameworks or tool\-calling design. * Experience governing a shared LLM cost budget or API keys. * CRM systems (Salesforce, HubSpot), data engineering or ETL, and warehouse analytics such as Snowflake. * Familiarity with support, customer success or professional services operations. * Experience building internal tools where the users are colleagues, not customers. * Training, facilitation or mentoring experience, formal or informal. * Comfort in ambiguous environments where requirements evolve as understanding deepens. **Flex Capabilities** You bring enough business context to understand why a process exists, not only how to automate it. You can contribute to prioritization, challenge assumptions about what is worth building, and sharpen your business instincts over time. We are a small team, and everyone stretches beyond their primary role. **What Success Looks Like** Each engagement agrees on key metrics before work starts, such as deflection rate, handle time or hours saved, and measures it against a baseline taken before launch. **30 days:** You understand the systems landscape across the partner department and have identified three or more high\-impact automation or integration opportunities. The first sprint has an agreed metric, baseline and eval set. Embedded team members see you as approachable and are already learning from working alongside you. **60 days:** The first automation is live, meets the agreed quality threshold, and moves the agreed metric. At least one embedded team member can explain how it works and make minor changes without you. Documentation is current, not aspirational. **90 days:** The first system is owned by the partner team day to day, and a second is live and stable. Embedded champions can maintain and extend them, and LLM spend is tracked by team. Handoff documentation is complete enough that a new engineer could onboard from it. The department refers to your work as "ours," not "the AI team's." \#LI\-JB2 Yext is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a results\-driven, engaging culture where every employee has the opportunity to contribute to the success of the Company, perform at the highest possible level, and grow their skills and capabilities. Yext welcomes employees and applicants of all backgrounds and demographics, and does not engage in discrimination on the basis of any protected characteristic recognized under applicable law. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. The Company believes a broad variety of life experiences across the Yext team is critical to its mission to help every business in the world be visible everywhere customers search. By seeking out fresh perspectives and fostering a positive interview experience and employee experience, Yext can remain at the forefront of innovation, and better serve its customers. It is Yext's policy to provide reasonable accommodations to people with disabilities as required by applicable law. If you have a disability that requires an accommodation in completing this application, interviewing, or participating in the employee selection process, please complete this form. **Security Alert** All legitimate Yext communications come from @yext.com email addresses. Messages from other domains (for example, @yext.team) are not authorized and are likely fraudulent. If you receive a message that seems suspicious, do not share personal information, click on links, or provide payment. Instead, please report the communication to security@yext.com.

Designed for multi\-task learning across various surfaces, these models are applied to numerous downstream tasks, including retrieval, user action prediction, rich user generation, and knowledge distillation for training more compact models. This role has been categorized as a Remote position. “Remote” employees do not have a permanent corporate office workplace and, instead, work from a physical location of their choice, which must be identified to the Company. U.S. employees may live in any of the 50 United States, with limited exceptions. In California, Connecticut, Maryland, Massachusetts, New Jersey, New York, Washington state, and Washington DC the standard base pay range for this role is $164,400\.00 \- $262,600\.00 annually. This base pay range is specific to these locations and may not be applicable to other locations.\&\#xa;\&\#xa;In Colorado, Hawaii, Illinois, Maine, Minnesota, Nevada, Ohio, Rhode Island, Vermont, and Virginia the standard base pay range for this role is $156,200\.00 \- $249,400\.00 annually. The base pay range is specific to these locations and may not be applicable to other locations. In addition to a competitive base salary this position is also eligible for equity awards based on factors such as experience, performance and location. Actual amounts will vary depending on experience, performance and location. Employees in this role will not be paid below the salary threshold for exempt employees in the state where they reside. **Who you are** --------------- \- Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field. \- 8\+ years of professional software engineering experience, including significant work across both front\-end and back\-end web application development. \- Proven experience designing, building, and operating scalable, reliable services and user\-facing features in a modern cloud environment. \- Demonstrated experience collaborating in cross\-functional, agile teams and influencing technical direction for complex projects. \- Or an equivalent combination of education and experience. **Get to know us** ------------------ At Zillow, we’re reimagining how people move—through the real estate market and through their careers.
