jobs.title: Software Quality Engineer
jobs.description: Zipliens is a leading lien resolution company that specializes in streamlining the lien process for personal injury law firms. Our work helps law firms operate more efficiently and helps the injured people they serve access settlement funds more quickly and accurately. We are looking for a quality engineer who is passionate about building the testing and evaluation that keeps complex, data\-heavy products working correctly at scale. Zipliens is looking for a Quality Engineer to join our team and own quality for a product area within the applications we build for the legal industry. After several years of high growth, Zipliens has become a leader in lien resolution, a process required in most personal injury settlements. The software we build supports that work, so the quality of what we ship has a clear, real\-world impact on law firms and the people they represent. We're scaling engineering significantly this year, and quality engineering is growing along with it. QA at Zipliens is embedded in the engineering teams and combines exploratory testing with automation. You'd own quality for a feature or product area, including the test strategy, the automation behind it, and the release sign\-off for that area. You'll have established patterns and existing test suites to work from, and you'll help improve them as the team grows. We also build with AI as a first\-class part of the workflow, and that applies to testing as much as to development. Our product uses LLMs to extract structure from medical records and lien correspondence, so evaluating non\-deterministic output is a regular part of the job. We also use agentic coding tools and internal skills and harnesses we've written ourselves to build and maintain automation, and you'd be expected to use those tools well, review what they produce, and help improve them. **Requirements**### **Responsibilities:** * Own quality for a feature or product area, including the risk\-based test strategy, the regression scope, and the release sign\-off for that area. * Build and maintain the automated test suites for your area and keep them integrated with CI. When tests fail or become flaky, you'll troubleshoot them and fix the underlying cause. * Run exploratory testing against the lien workflow and develop a detailed understanding of the applications your team owns, including their risk areas and failure modes. * Test our LLM\-based features. This includes building the evaluation suite for a feature, setting acceptance thresholds with product (for example, precision and recall targets for extraction), checking LLM\-judge agreement against human labels, and adding adversarial and prompt\-injection cases. * Use agentic coding tools to build and maintain automation, and review AI\-generated tests before they merge. * Join refinement early enough to shape Acceptance Criteria with the Product Owner, flag testability gaps before development starts, and recommend coverage and risk priorities for your area. * Shepherd defects for your area from triage through resolution, writing clear, reproducible reports that engineers can act on. * Work directly with the engineers on your team day to day. QA at Zipliens is embedded in the engineering teams rather than run as a separate function. ### **Qualifications:** * 3\+ years on a QA or software development team, including experience owning test coverage for a feature or product area. * Strong skills in at least one of exploratory testing and test design, test automation and infrastructure, or AI/LLM evaluation, with working proficiency in a second. We don't expect the same depth in all three. * Hands\-on experience building and maintaining automated test suites in a modern framework (Playwright, Cypress, pytest, or similar), including diagnosing flaky tests and fixing their root causes. * Comfortable reading and writing code. Our backend is Python/Django and our frontend is React, and you should be able to read a change in either and understand what it affects and what it puts at risk. * Experience integrating tests into CI pipelines and deciding which checks should gate a merge or a deploy. * Strong SQL. Much of what we test lives in PostgreSQL, and verifying a workflow often means verifying the data it produced as well as what the UI shows. * Hands\-on experience testing LLM or ML features, whether in production or through prototypes and experimentation: building golden datasets, measuring output quality, and understanding how these systems fail. * Experience using or experimenting with agentic coding tools, and good judgment about when their output needs a closer look. * Clear written communication. You'll be writing defect reports, test plans, and release sign\-offs for engineers and product, and explaining risk to non\-technical stakeholders. ### **Nice to Have:** * Experience testing document processing or extraction from unstructured data. * Experience testing third\-party integrations, especially where the counterparty's documentation isn't solid and you need contract tests, sandboxes, or recorded fixtures to work around it. * Familiarity with AWS and Kubernetes. We have an SRE who owns the cluster \- you won't be running it, but you'll be reading logs and working out where a failure happened in it. * Experience handling sensitive data such as PHI, or working under HIPAA\-style requirements. **Benefits** * Private Health Care Plan (Medical, Dental \& Vision) * Company HSA contributions for HDHP participants * Flexible Spending Accounts (Health \& Dependent Care) * Company\-Paid Short\-Term Disability Coverage * Voluntary Long\-Term Disability, Life, AD\&D, and Supplemental Coverage Options * 401(k) Plan with Company Match * Paid Time Off (Vacation, Sick Time \& 10 paid Holidays) * Parental Leave Pay Disclosure: The total base salary range for this role is $77,000 \- $104,000 annually with an opportunity to earn a discretionary quarterly bonus. Final compensation will be determined based on skills and experience. Work Authorization: Applicants must be authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer\-sponsored visa support now or in the future.

jobs.title: Software Architect, Insurance and Payment - athenaCollector
jobs.description: Join us as we work to create a thriving ecosystem that delivers accessible, high\-quality, and sustainable healthcare for all. **Role Summary:** The Software Architect leads architecture strategy for complex software and AI systems in a healthcare environment. This role is based in Boston, MA and follows a hybrid work model. The architect will define target\-state architecture, guide multi\-quarter modernization plans, and help engineering teams deliver scalable, reliable, and compliant platform capabilities. This position reports to the VP engineering. **Team Summary:** We are seeking a Director\-level Architect to define and drive architecture strategy for complex software and AI systems in a healthcare environment, with a strong emphasis on Insurance and Payment space modernization and cross\-zone platform influence. This role sits at the intersection of software engineering, systems architecture, and applied AI. The architect will establish target\-state architecture, incremental migration plans, shared principles, and technical standards across engineering teams, prioritizing platform\-level solutions over zone\-specific duplication. The ideal candidate brings deep experience designing large\-scale distributed systems, leading large modernization programs, and operationalizing AI capabilities in production with strong attention to reliability, performance, security, maintainability, cost, and compliance. This is an individual\-contributor role with no direct reports. Its leverage comes from technical credibility and influence across organizations, not from positional authority. **Essential Job Responsibilities:** * Develop target\-state architecture and multi\-quarter migration roadmaps for complex platform capabilities across multiple teams in Medical Insurance and Payment space. * Define architecture principles, technical standards, reference patterns, and decision records that guide engineering execution. * Ability to dive into monolith systems, understand the pattern, capture key details, identify pitfalls, come up with migration strategies and improvement areas * Design scalable, reliable, and performant distributed systems with measurable outcomes tied to service\-level objectives (SLOs), benchmarks, and operational results. * Establish observability, incident response, runbook, and capacity planning practices that improve system health and operational readiness. * Evaluate event\-driven and workflow orchestration approaches, including failure modes, resiliency patterns, and interoperability across consuming teams. * Partner with engineering, product, security, and operations leaders to influence platform direction and modernization priorities without direct authority. * Review application, data, and integration designs to ensure alignment with architecture standards, compliance requirements, and long\-term platform goals. * Guide technical tradeoff discussions and decision\-making across teams, balancing delivery speed, maintainability, cost, and risk. * Apply AI experience to architect, evaluate, and govern production AI capabilities, including orchestration, tool\-calling patterns, context and state handling, monitoring, and model risk controls. * Use current hands\-on technical depth in infrastructure as code, container platforms, continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD), and Java or a comparable modern language to prototype, review, and refine solutions. **Additional Job Responsibilities:** * Support modernization planning for shared platform services and common capabilities. * Contribute to architecture review forums and design governance processes. * Help define integration standards, versioning approaches, and contract management practices. * Participate in incident reviews and help translate findings into architecture improvements. * Mentor engineers and architects through design feedback and technical discussion. * Evaluate emerging technologies and recommend where they should or should not be applied. * Collaborate on long\-range planning for platform investments and technical debt reduction. * Assist in defining security, privacy, auditability, and access\-control patterns for regulated systems. **Expected Education \& Experience:** * Typically requires 15\+ years of software engineering experience, including significant architecture ownership across multiple teams. * Demonstrated experience leading architecture strategy for complex, distributed software systems. * Hands\-on experience on AWS, Java, AI tools, enterprise applications, Kubernetes and modern LLM tools * Proven success creating target\-state architectures and multi\-quarter migration plans with measurable delivery outcomes. * Experience defining and operationalizing architecture principles, standards, reference patterns, and architecture decision records. * Strong background in system design for scalability, reliability, performance, and operational excellence. * Deep knowledge of observability and Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) practices, including SLOs, alerting, incident management, and post\-mortems. * Experience with event\-driven architectures, API design, contract versioning, and workflow orchestration. * Hands\-on experience with infrastructure as code, container platforms, CI/CD pipelines, and tooling. * Experience designing or governing AI\-enabled systems in production, including orchestration, monitoring, and model risk considerations. * Experience building systems in regulated environments with attention to compliance, consent, data governance, auditability, and access control. * Strong communication and influencing skills with the ability to drive adoption across teams and functions. ***Expected Compensation*** $216,000 \- $366,000*The base salary range shown reflects the full range for this role from minimum to maximum. At athenahealth, base pay depends on multiple factors, including job\-related experience,* *relevant knowledge* *and skills, how your qualifications compare to others in similar roles, and geographical market rates. Base pay is only one part of our competitive Total Rewards package \- depending on role eligibility, we offer both short and long\-term incentives by way of an annual discretionary bonus plan, variable compensation plan, and equity plans.* ***About athenahealth*** ***Our vision:*** *In an industry that becomes more complex by the day, we stand for simplicity. We offer IT solutions and expert services that eliminate the daily hurdles preventing healthcare providers from focusing entirely on their patients — powered by our vision to create a thriving ecosystem that delivers accessible, high\-quality, and sustainable healthcare for all.* ***Our company culture:*** *Our talented* *employees — or athenistas, as we call ourselves — spark the innovation and passion needed to accomplish our vision. We are a diverse group of dreamers and do\-ers with unique knowledge, expertise, backgrounds, and perspectives. We unite as mission\-driven problem\-solvers with a deep desire to achieve our vision and make our time here count. Our award\-winning culture is built around shared values of inclusiveness, accountability, and support.* ***Our DEI commitment:*** *Our vision of accessible, high\-quality, and sustainable healthcare for all requires addressing the inequities that stand in the way. That's one reason we prioritize diversity, equity, and inclusion in every aspect of our business, from attracting and sustaining a diverse workforce to maintaining an inclusive environment for athenistas, our partners, customers and the communities where we work and serve.* ***What we can do for you:*** *Along with health and financial benefits, athenistas enjoy perks specific to each location, including commuter support, employee assistance programs, tuition assistance, employee resource groups, and collaborative* *workspaces* — *some offices even welcome dogs.* *We also encourage a better work\-life balance for athenistas with our flexibility. While we know in\-office collaboration is critical to our vision, we recognize that not all work needs to be done within an office environment,* *full\-time. With consistent communication and digital collaboration tools, athenahealth* *enables* *employees to find a balance that feels fulfilling and productive for each individual situation.* *In addition to our traditional benefits and perks, we sponsor events throughout the year, including book clubs, external speakers, and hackathons. We provide athenistas with a company culture based on learning, the support of an engaged team, and an inclusive environment where all employees are valued.* *Learn more about our culture and benefits here:* *athenahealth.com/careers* *https://www.athenahealth.com/careers/equal\-opportunity*

jobs.title: Senior Lead Software Engineer
jobs.description: **About defi SOLUTIONS:** It’s an exciting time to join defi! defi SOLUTIONS provides end\-to\-end, B2B SaaS lending and managed servicing solutions. The company partners with many of the highest\-volume captive auto lenders, banks, finance companies, and credit unions in North America. Through its flexible and configurable loan origination platform, servicing technology, and managed servicing solutions, defi SOLUTIONS helps lenders improve efficiency, streamline operations, and address lenders' and borrowers' ever\-evolving needs. defi SOLUTIONS combines more than three decades of lending expertise, including the expertise of former Sagent Auto Lending, with the backing of Warburg Pincus, Bain Capital Ventures, and Fiserv. **About the Role:** defi SOLUTIONS builds loan origination and servicing software for banks, credit unions and lenders. We are hiring Senior Software Engineers to build and evolve our auto, mortgage and banking platform across .NET services, Vue.js front ends, SQL Server data, and the cloud infrastructure that runs them. This role exists because we are expanding AI\-assisted development across our engineering teams. You will use AI coding tools and agents every day, help shape how we use them, and be accountable for what they produce. We want engineers with sharp analytical skills who can break ambiguous features into well\-scoped work, review generated code critically, and ship secure, tested software for regulated financial institutions. **Essential Job Responsibilities:*** Design, build and maintain features across our .NET services, Vue.js UI, and SQL Server schema (versioned through Flyway migrations). * Break features and epics into well\-scoped, independently deliverable tasks with clear acceptance criteria. * Work with AI coding assistants and agents to accelerate delivery, and critically review all AI\-generated code for correctness, security, performance and maintainability before it ships. * Apply the testing pyramid: unit, integration and end\-to\-end tests that give fast, reliable feedback. * Apply proven design patterns and secure\-coding practices to code that handles sensitive lending data. * Diagnose and resolve complex production and performance issues, using logs, traces and metrics to find root cause. * Containerize and deploy services using Docker, Kubernetes, Helm and Terraform on Azure or AWS. * Build and improve CI/CD pipelines, and contribute to agentic tooling (MCP servers, hooks, custom skills) that makes the team faster and safer. * Partner with product, QA and client\-facing teams to translate lending business rules into reliable software. **Required Qualifications:*** 5\+ years of professional software development experience, including significant time building and operating production systems. * **Domain and judgment** + Working knowledge of the auto, mortgage or banking domain (origination, underwriting, decisioning, servicing, or related compliance). + Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, with a track record of debugging hard, ambiguous issues to root cause. + Ability to break features into well\-scoped tasks and estimate and sequence them. * **Engineering fundamentals** + Strong command of design patterns and when not to use them. + Practical experience with the testing pyramid and writing maintainable automated tests. + Working knowledge of OWASP Top 10 and secure development practices. * **AI\-assisted development** + Hands\-on experience with agentic development using LLM\-based coding tools. + Demonstrated ability to critically review AI\-generated code: catching subtle bugs, insecure patterns, unnecessary complexity and hallucinated APIs. * **Technology Stack** **Area** **Required** **Preferred** Back end .NET (C\#) Front end Vue.js / Razor Data SQL Server Cloud Azure or AWS Infrastructure as code Terraform Containers and orchestration Docker, Kubernetes, Helm VM\-based infrastructure Delivery CI/CD pipelines Observability OpenTelemetry (OTEL **Preferred Qualifications:*** Experience building agentic tooling: MCP servers, hooks and custom skills. * Hands\-on CI/CD pipeline design in Azure DevOps or a comparable platform. * Experience with containers and virtual machines in production, including OpenTelemetry\-based tracing and metrics. * Experience in regulated environments (SOC 2, FFIEC) serving financial institutions. **Affirmative Action/EEO statement:** defi SOLUTIONS is an Equal Opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability or protected veteran status.

jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer
jobs.description: **The Role** ------------ You will be Doctronic's first dedicated data engineer, and you will own the plumbing end to end: how data moves from our production systems into our lakehouse and warehouse, how it gets transformed into trusted, documented tables, and who can access what. This role serves every team in the company: AI engineering, product, finance, partnerships, and data to name a few. **What You'll Do** ------------------ * Build reliable, monitored CDC pipelines from our production databases (MariaDB, PostgreSQL, MongoDB) into our S3 \+ Iceberg lake and Snowflake * Stand up a transformation layer (e.g. dbt) on Snowflake so core business metrics (visits, bookings, revenue, retention) come from tested, version\-controlled models * Select and implement an orchestration tool so pipelines and dashboard refreshes run automatically, with alerting when they break * Design and enforce the access control model for patient data: row/column\-level PHI restrictions, HIPAA Safe Harbor compliance, anonymization pipelines, and account deletion workflows * Establish a single governed copy of production data that analytics, finance, and the AI team all read from * Support the AI team's data needs for model training * Design and build a best\-practice warehouse architecture with clean raw, transformed, and business\-ready layers powering our executive dashboards **What We're Looking For** -------------------------- * 5\+ years of data engineering experience, including ownership of production data platforms end to end * Strong SQL and Python, with experience building and operating ELT/CDC pipelines (Fivetran, Airbyte, or similar) * Hands\-on experience with a modern lakehouse/warehouse stack: S3, Apache Iceberg, a catalog layer, and Snowflake or an equivalent warehouse * Experience with transformation frameworks (dbt or similar) and orchestration tools (Airflow, Dagster, Glue workflows, or similar) * Solid AWS fundamentals: IAM, Lambda, Kinesis, Glue * A pragmatic, reliability\-first mindset * Comfort operating with high autonomy and minimal specs in a flat, engineering\-first organization * Strong communication skills; you'll work directly with product, marketing, finance, and AI stakeholders **Nice to Have** ---------------- * Experience with HIPAA/PHI data governance, anonymization, or healthcare data * Experience with event/behavioral data pipelines (ClickHouse, GTM/server\-side tracking, CDPs) * Familiarity with ML data workflows: feature pipelines, training datasets, notebook environments (SageMaker, Databricks, Jupyter) * Experience with BI tooling (Metabase or similar) and semantic/metrics layers * Prior experience as the first or only data engineer at a startup **Compensation \& Benefits** ---------------------------- * Base salary range: $200,000 to $275,000 annually, depending on experience, plus meaningful equity * Parental Leave: 12 weeks fully paid parental leave for all parents, regardless of gender or path to parenthood — no distinction between birthing and non\-birthing parent Compensation Range: $200K \- $275K

jobs.title: Senior iOS Developer
jobs.description: **Job Summary** As a Senior iOS Developer, you’ll lead the design, development, testing, and release of mobile applications for Apple platforms. You’ll turn product needs into reliable, intuitive experiences, collaborating with product, design, and engineering partners throughout the software development life cycle (SDLC). Your impact: By building and improving dependable iOS features, you help users complete tasks smoothly and confidently. **Responsibilities** * Develop and maintain iOS applications using Swift and Objective\-C, applying object\-oriented programming (OOP), model\-view\-controller (MVC), and established design patterns. * Implement user interfaces (UI) and user experiences (UX), integrate application programming interfaces (APIs), web services, authentication, and networking, and address performance and multithreading needs. * Write unit tests, support iOS development testing, debug issues, and contribute to test\-driven development and continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD). * Coordinate releases, including iOS App Store submission, and collaborate through Agile or Scrum workflows using tools such as GitHub, Git, Jira, and Jenkins. **Requirements** * Demonstrated iOS development and mobile application development experience; proficiency with Swift, Xcode, iOS software development kits (SDKs), RESTful APIs, and iOS application development. * Knowledge of SQL, MySQL, SQLite, NoSQL, JSON, XML, and REST or SOAP services; familiarity with continuous integration, scripting, Bash (Unix shell), and shell scripting. * Additional technologies may include Visual Studio, SVN, Xamarin, React Native, JavaScript, Java, C\#, C, C\+\+, Python, PHP, ASP.NET Core, Node.js, React Express, React, Angular, AJAX, HTML, CSS, Bootstrap, and Linux. * Experience with Agile software development, application development, computer networking, and managing Apple App Store submission processes is valuable; Android experience is a plus. Pay: $100,000\.00 \- $120,000\.00 per year Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Backend Engineer
jobs.description: **Position Title:** Backend Engineer **Office Location:** Broomfield, CO \| Local candidates only **Work Schedule:** Full\-time, 40 hours/week \| In\-office Wednesdays; additional days as business needs require **Work Authorization:** Must be authorized to work in the US without sponsorship, now or in the future **Reports to**: Director, Engineering **Salary Range:** $120,000 \- $140,000 annually **About IKE** Every utility pole carries something essential: power, fiber, and the connections communities depend on. We're ikeGPS, the PoleOS™ Company, and we're working to become the standard for collecting, managing, and analyzing pole and overhead asset information. Electric utilities, communications companies, and their engineering partners rely on our solutions to design, construct, and inspect overhead infrastructure. It's an industry that flies under the radar, and we're proud to help build the power and communications infrastructure of the future. IKE is publicly traded on the New Zealand (NZX) and Australian (ASX) stock exchanges under the ticker IKE. We're a collaborative team, with our US headquarters in Broomfield, Colorado, offices in Chelsea, Alabama, and Wellington, New Zealand, and colleagues working across the US. We're guided by Manaakitanga, a te reo Māori word for caring for and uplifting others, which we live as "we rise by lifting others." Our values shape how we work: we keep things simple, speak openly, and bring ingenuity to every challenge. **The Role** As a Backend Engineer on the PoleOS team, you'll own services end to end: design, build, ship to production, and keep them running. The work is mostly TypeScript and NestJS, with some Python, on AWS. Your work splits between building new product features and making the platform faster, safer, and more reliable as more customers come on board. We work in sprints, and you'll carry work from a written user story through code, tests, release, and the runbook. You'll also work directly with customer user groups, so what you build is shaped by the people who use it. **Why This Role** * End\-to\-end ownership: you design it, build it, ship it, and run it. jobs.title: Data Engineer Client Data Operations
jobs.description: **An important note before applying:** ***We're a small, growing team, and openings like this can attract 1,000 or more applications. We want to give as many qualified candidates as possible a fair shot, but there's only so much a small team can do when reviewing that volume while also doing the work that's the reason this opportunity exists.******To help, we're using an AI\-powered verbal screening tool where you can talk through your experience and how you approach problems. We know... we know... another AI tool in the hiring process. We're not exactly fans of that either, but we believe it gives more people an opportunity to show us what they know beyond what's on their résumé.*** ***We're not looking for perfect or rehearsed answers. In fact, we'd much rather hear a genuine, imperfect answer than something polished that doesn't really tell us anything. We want to hear about your actual experience, and our team will make the hiring decisions, not the AI.*** ***Please complete the screening questions as part of your application. Quick Apply or Easy Apply submissions without completed responses may not be considered.*** **Data Engineer Client Data Operations** Location: Remote (United States; Dallas, TX area preferred, not required)**About Limetree** ================== Limetree is a performance\-focused marketing agency that blends behavioral science, data, and practical marketing know\-how to help organizations say the right thing, to the right people, in ways that actually work. We specialize in industries where customer interaction is high\-value and high\-stakes, including healthcare, financial services, and other regulated or complex environments. Our work connects insight to action, using behavioral science and data to inform strategy, creative, and delivery in ways that drive measurable outcomes for our clients. Limetree has been recognized multiple times on the Inc. 5000 as well as a national Inc. Best Workplace, and holds multiple patents that inform our approach to marketing performance, decision\-making, and execution.**Role Summary** ================ We are hiring a hands\-on Data Engineer to own how new client data gets into our systems and keep the pipelines behind our direct mail, digital marketing, and reporting work reliable. You will take unfamiliar feeds, make sense of them, build repeatable ingestion processes, and catch problems before they become bad data or missed campaign deliveries. This is a production ownership role. You will be the first person working through data and pipeline failures and, as you learn our processes, take over the technical execution of routine mail drops. You will work closely with our Senior Analytics Engineer, who depends on clean, consistent data for downstream analytics and reporting. This is an individual contributor role, not a people\-management position.**What You Will Do** ==================== **Onboard Client Data** ----------------------- * Set up new feeds from client and vendor systems, including SFTP and scheduled file deliveries; identify source fields, changes, missing data, and inconsistent formats. * Map incoming data into established schemas and tables, identify sensitive fields, and apply approved privacy and access rules. Raise ambiguous data or policy questions before moving forward. * Build the validation and matching steps that make data usable, including record counts, identity matching or LTID assignment, and CASS/NCOA processing where relevant. * Document each feed so someone else can understand the inputs, transformations, checks, outputs, and what to do when it fails. **Build New Pipelines** ----------------------- * Build and extend SQL, Python, and Spark pipelines as we bring on new direct mail and digital clients, using consistent data structures rather than one\-off solutions. * Set up scheduled jobs, file watchers, transformations, testing, and monitoring so new data streams run with minimal manual intervention. * Improve existing pipelines as source files, schemas, tools, and business requirements change. **Keep Production and Campaign Delivery Running** ------------------------------------------------- * Own the day\-to\-day checks and troubleshooting for current Databricks workflows, AWS jobs, and related tools; investigate failures and fix root causes. * Handle schema drift, bad source files, expired credentials, broken dependencies, stale data, and vendor\-tool issues; improve alerts, recovery steps, and runbooks. * Take ownership of routine audience and mail\-drop production, including suppressions, address hygiene, count reconciliation, QC, and vendor file preparation, within established approvals. * Flag risks to scheduled client drops early, explain what is affected, and recommend a safe path to resolution. **Work With the Team** ---------------------- * Hand off reliable, documented data to our Senior Analytics Engineer for downstream modeling, analysis, and reporting; work together when definitions or matching rules need decisions. * Partner with campaign, account, and technical colleagues to clarify requirements and resolve issues without making them chase the status of a feed or delivery. **What Success Looks Like** =========================== * First 90 days: Understand the main feeds and drops, take over daily checks, fix production issues with support, and independently set up or improve a client data flow with review. * By six months: Own routine new\-client ingestion and pipeline maintenance, be the first responder for issues, and run standard mail drops with documented quality and release checks. * The result: New client data is repeatable and trustworthy; pipeline failures have a clear owner; routine troubleshooting and drop execution no longer depend on a single senior colleague. **What We Are Looking For** =========================== **Experience and Judgment** --------------------------- * Several years of hands\-on data engineering experience, ideally four or more, including pipelines you have operated in production and failures you personally diagnosed. * Comfort taking a messy or poorly documented source file from first inspection through a reliable production data feed. * Strong attention to detail: you reconcile counts, question suspicious data, and make fixes that prevent a problem from coming back. * Able to work independently, explain technical issues plainly, and know when a business rule or privacy question needs an owner to decide. **Technical Skills** -------------------- * Strong SQL and Python; practical experience with Spark or similar large\-scale data processing. * Production cloud data engineering experience. We currently use Databricks and AWS, but value strong AWS\-native or comparable experience as our platform evolves. * Experience with orchestration, monitoring, schema mapping, file\-based integrations, access controls, Git, testing, and operational documentation. * Careful handling of personally identifiable or protected health information in regulated data environments. **Helpful Background** ====================== * Direct mail and/or digital marketing audience data, including deduplication, suppressions, CASS/NCOA, AccuZIP, AccuTrace, USPS tracking, or digital marketing sources and APIs. * Healthcare, Medicare, or health plan marketing data; SFTP, S3, Parquet, and client\-facing reporting feeds. **Why Join Limetree** ===================== You will own real production work, see the effect of getting data right, and improve the processes as you learn them. We need someone who likes building reliable systems and taking ownership of how they run.**Compensation** ================ Base salary: $115,000\-$145,000, depending on experience and qualifications. eFP00eeEvE

Build benchmarks, simulations, and automated checks that detect methodological errors, unsupported claims, and misleading interpretations. * Own the implementation of scientific methods in production software, writing robust Python code and partnering with engineers on libraries, APIs, data pipelines, observability, and system design. * Work with data scientists and business partners to identify recurring analytical needs and translate them into accessible platform capabilities, documentation, and workflows. * Influence technical and organizational strategy through clear scientific recommendations, mentor scientists and engineers, and share methodological advances internally and externally where appropriate. **Required Qualifications:** * A doctorate in Statistics, Economics, Computer Science, Applied Mathematics, Operations Research, or a related discipline; alternatively, a master's degree supported by comparable depth of expertise. * At least eight years of relevant industry work following a doctorate, or ten years with a master's degree, in applied science, data science, scientific software development, or related roles. * Deep knowledge of statistical inference and econometrics, with practical experience developing causal methods for observational data and evaluating the assumptions that make their conclusions credible. * Experience developing and deploying forecasting systems, including time series modeling, temporal validation, prediction intervals, and assessment of performance as underlying conditions change. * Strong software engineering skills, including substantial experience writing and maintaining production Python software. Familiarity with API design, automated testing, code review, version control, and operational monitoring. * A demonstrated ability to critically assess scientific literature, reproduce relevant findings, and turn promising methods into reliable software that solves practical problems. * Experience developing LLM applications or analytical agents, including tool use, code execution, and systematic evaluation of their outputs. * Clear communication of statistical assumptions, uncertainty, and technical tradeoffs to business audiences. * Experience developing other technical contributors through mentorship, design reviews, and collaboration across organizational boundaries. * The ability to make progress on ambiguous problems, prioritize consequential work, and deliver useful capabilities through rapid iteration. **Preferred Qualifications:** * Publications, open\-source contributions, or widely adopted internal tools in agentic analytics, causal inference, forecasting, or other related fields. * Experience building scientific libraries or platforms used by other data scientists, including interfaces that make sophisticated methods accessible to people with different levels of statistical expertise. * Experience building agents at scale that perform substantive analytical work, including retrieval of relevant data and context, selection of methods, execution of Python or SQL, and validation of findings. **Benefits:** * 100% remote opportunity (we have four office locations for hybrid/onsite work preference in NY, SF, LA and Chicago) * Comprehensive Healthcare Benefits and Income Replacement Programs * 401K with Employer Match * Global Benefit programs that fit your lifestyle, from workspace to professional development to caregiving support * Family Planning Support * Gender\-Affirming Care * Mental Health \& Coaching Benefits * Flexible Vacation \& Paid Volunteer Time Off * Generous Paid Parental Leave \#LI\-AJ1 In select roles
